zh.summary: 先用兩筆合成資料檢查成品，再把畫面、業務規則與交付證據連起來。你將能指出原型已做到什麼，以及下一個需要驗證的問題。
objectives: 用具體任務描述軟體成果，而非只列出畫面或工具。
區分功能展示、規格驗證、使用者驗收與正式上線。
從一次缺漏檢核追溯需求、實作、測試與交接作品。

sections.heading: 先給成品一個任務
paragraphs: 想像你是收件人員，桌上有一份虛構申請資料。你需要知道必要欄位是否齊全，並把檢查結果交給下一位同事。你打開的軟體有三個欄位：申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型。這些都是本課自訂的教學規則，不代表任何機關的正式收件規定。
先輸入編號 SYN-001、代號 DEMO-A，將文件類型留白。按下檢查後，畫面應指出缺少文件類型，且不得提供標記為完整的報告。補上文件類型「合成申請表」，再次檢查，才可以預覽並匯出完整報告。這兩筆輸入讓我們看見系統要維持的承諾。

sections.heading: 像交接一份收件檢查表
paragraphs: 把程式想成協助你檢查清單的同事：它要能說出哪一欄尚未完成，也要讓下一位接手者知道它檢查了哪些項目。如果它只說「成功」，卻沒有交代成功的是存檔、檢查還是正式受理，使用者可能採取錯誤的下一步。
本課把「完整」限定為三個必要欄位通過教學規則。它不表示內容真實、文件合法、身分已確認或業務已核准。先說清楚詞語的邊界，才能寫出可檢查的規格。

sections.heading: 從一次操作回看工程證據
paragraphs: 需求說明為什麼要檢查；介面引導人完成檢查；業務規則決定何時通過；測試留下對指定輸入的觀察；README 則讓下一位同事能重新啟動。這些作品回答不同問題，彼此可以追溯。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜沿著一個需求追溯四種證據；箭頭表示依據與驗證的先後，不代表一次完成後不再修改。
blocks.description: 依編號閱讀各步驟。

items.title: problem.md：需求
items.body: 收件人員希望在交接前知道缺少哪些必要欄位。

items.title: spec.md：承諾
items.body: 缺少文件類型時，列出缺漏，不能匯出完整報告。

items.title: app.py：實作
items.body: 表單與業務規則依同一份規格處理輸入。

items.title: tests/ 與 README：證據及交接
items.body: 保留缺漏與完整兩種結果，說明如何重現及目前限制。

sections.heading: 四個不同的完成層次
paragraphs: 功能展示表示在特定環境可以操作。規格驗證表示指定情境有證據支持，例如缺漏欄位被正確阻擋。使用者驗收還要觀察目標使用者能否理解提示並完成任務。組織正式上線則需要另外處理存取權、儲存、備份及維運等要求。
例如 AppTest 可以模擬 Streamlit 的輸入與呈現結果，但這類程式測試不會告訴你同事是否看得懂「資料完整」的意思。測試名稱與結果要說明所驗證的層次，避免用一個綠色勾勾代替所有判斷。

sections.heading: 人與 Agent 各自要交付什麼
paragraphs: 你可以請 Coding Agent 依 spec.md 建立表單、撰寫規則並執行測試。交付要求要包含可修改檔案、驗收命令及停止條件。當 Agent 發現必要欄位的定義不明時，應提出問題，由領域負責人確認；不能讓它自行發明正式收件規則。
審查時先讀需求與 Diff，再看實際結果。如果畫面很漂亮，但缺漏資料仍能匯出完整報告，就要回到規格修正。把這項差異寫成可重現的測試，比單純要求「再改善一下」更容易確認修改是否有效。

sections.heading: 常見誤解與反例
paragraphs: 「AI 寫出很多程式，所以成果很完整」無法作為驗收依據。程式碼數量沒有說明收件人員能否完成工作。反例是增加登入畫面，卻沒有任何後端授權檢查；畫面存在不代表資料已被隔離。
「只要測試都過，就可以讓十人共用」也需要補充條件。若測試只涵蓋本機單人資料檢核，它沒有驗證多人資料隔離。下一步應先畫出共用時的資料流與信任邊界，重新確認需求。C4 的 Context 與 Container 圖可協助描述這些不同層次的系統關係。

exercise.environment: 紙筆或本機文字編輯器；只用下列合成資料，不需安裝 Agent。
steps: 建立一份成品觀察紀錄，列出 SYN-001、DEMO-A、文件類型空白的預期結果。
再列出三欄皆有值的預期結果，明寫「完整」的教學定義。
將每項預期分別連到 problem.md、spec.md、app.py 或 tests/，指出你目前實際擁有哪些證據。
exercise.expected: 得到兩個輸入情境、一個明確的完整性定義，以及作品與證據對照。
exercise.check: 請同儕讀你的紀錄：他能否在不猜測的情況下說出缺漏時能不能匯出完整報告？若不能，補寫規則。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成紀錄供 M03 使用；不要填入真實收件資料。

readingGuide.goal: 用具體任務描述軟體成果，而非只列出畫面或工具。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 紙筆或本機文字編輯器；只用下列合成資料，不需安裝 Agent。
readingGuide.route: 先讀原理與例子，再完成最小實作，最後核對理解檢核與參考解析。
readingGuide.output: 得到兩個輸入情境、一個明確的完整性定義，以及作品與證據對照。

en.summary: Check a product with two synthetic inputs, then connect its interface, business rules and delivery evidence. Identify what the prototype already does and the next question that needs verification.
objectives: Describe a software outcome through a concrete task, beyond a list of screens or tools.
Distinguish feature demonstrations, specification verification, user acceptance and production release.
Trace one missing-data check through requirements, implementation, tests and handoff artifacts.

sections.heading: Give the Product a Task First
paragraphs: Imagine you work at an intake desk with a fictional application. You need to check that required fields are present and hand the result to a colleague. The software has three fields: application ID, applicant code and document type. These are teaching rules defined for this course, not official intake rules for any organization.

Enter SYN-001 as the ID and DEMO-A as the code, leaving document type blank. After checking, the interface should identify the missing document type and offer no report marked complete. Enter “合成申請表” (synthetic application form) as the document type and check again; only then should a complete report be available for preview and export. These two inputs expose the promise the system must keep.

sections.heading: Like Handing Over an Intake Checklist
paragraphs: Think of the program as a colleague helping with a checklist. It needs to identify unfinished fields and tell the next person what it checked. A message that only says “success” leaves the user guessing whether saving, checking or official acceptance succeeded, which can lead to the wrong next action.

In this course, “complete” means only that three required fields passed the teaching rules. It does not establish truth, legal validity, verified identity or business approval. Define that boundary before writing a specification that can be checked.

sections.heading: Trace One Action Back to Engineering Evidence
paragraphs: Requirements explain why a check is needed; the interface helps someone perform it; business rules decide when it passes; tests record observations for specified inputs; and the README lets the next colleague start the application again. These artifacts answer different questions and can be traced to one another.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Trace one requirement through four kinds of evidence. Arrows show the order of justification and verification, not a one-time process with no later revisions.
blocks.description: Read the numbered steps in order.

items.title: problem.md: the need
items.body: Intake staff need to know which required fields are missing before handoff.

items.title: spec.md: the promise
items.body: When document type is missing, list the omission and prevent complete-report export.

items.title: app.py: the implementation
items.body: The form and business rules process input according to the same specification.

items.title: tests/ and README: evidence and handoff
items.body: Retain incomplete and complete results, reproduction instructions and current limits.

sections.heading: Four Different Levels of Completion
paragraphs: A feature demonstration shows that the application can be operated in a particular environment. Specification verification provides evidence for stated scenarios, such as correctly blocking missing fields. User acceptance also requires observing whether target users understand the feedback and complete their task. Production release adds requirements such as access permissions, storage, backups and operations.

For example, AppTest can simulate Streamlit input and inspect displayed results, but a programmatic test does not tell you whether a colleague understands “data complete.” Name tests and results according to the level they verify, so that one green check does not stand in for every decision.

sections.heading: What People and Agents Must Deliver
paragraphs: You can ask a Coding Agent to build a form, write rules and run tests according to spec.md. State which files it may change, the acceptance commands and the stop conditions. If the definition of a required field is unclear, the agent should ask the domain owner to decide; it must not invent official intake rules.

Review the requirement and diff, then inspect actual results. If the interface looks polished but incomplete data still produces a complete report, return to the specification and correct the behavior. Recording the discrepancy as a reproducible test makes the effect of a change easier to verify than a request to “improve it again.”

sections.heading: Common Misunderstandings and Counterexamples
paragraphs: “The AI wrote a lot of code, so the product is complete” is not an acceptance criterion. Code volume does not tell you whether intake staff can do their work. Consider a login screen with no server-side authorization checks: the screen alone does not establish data isolation.

“All tests pass, so ten people can share it” also needs conditions. Tests limited to local single-user completeness checking do not verify shared-user data isolation. First map the shared system’s data flows and trust boundaries, and revisit requirements. C4 Context and Container diagrams help describe system relationships at these different levels.

exercise.environment: Paper or a local text editor. Use only the synthetic data below; no agent installation is needed.
steps: Create a product observation record with the expected result for SYN-001, DEMO-A and a blank document type.
Record the expected result when all three fields have values, explicitly defining “complete” for this exercise.
Link each expectation to problem.md, spec.md, app.py or tests/, and state which evidence you actually have.
exercise.expected: Two input scenarios, an explicit completeness definition, and a mapping of artifacts to evidence.
exercise.check: Ask a peer to read the record: can they tell, without guessing, whether incomplete input may produce a complete report? If not, add the missing rule.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the synthetic record for M03. Do not enter real intake data.

readingGuide.goal: Describe a software outcome through a concrete task, beyond a list of screens or tools.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Paper or a local text editor. Use only the synthetic data below; no agent installation is needed.
readingGuide.route: Read the principles and examples, complete the small exercise, then compare your reasoning with the checks and reference explanations.
readingGuide.output: Two input scenarios, an explicit completeness definition, and a mapping of artifacts to evidence.

zh.prompt: 你看到原型能在本機啟動，應如何描述目前成果？
options: 系統已可正式供十人共用
特定環境可啟動；仍需按規格與使用者任務驗證
AI 已完成工程責任
只要頁面沒有錯字就完成驗收
rationales: 本機啟動沒有證明多人授權、儲存及維運需求。
這個說法精確對應已觀察到的啟動結果，並指出下一道驗證。
人仍需確認規則、審查修改及判讀證據。
文字校對是品質的一部分，不能代替功能或任務驗收。

en.prompt: The prototype starts locally. How should you describe the result?
options: The system is ready for ten people to share in production.
It starts in a particular environment; specification and user-task verification are still needed.
The AI has completed all engineering responsibilities.
Acceptance is complete if the page has no typos.
rationales: Local startup does not establish shared-user authorization, storage or operations requirements.
This statement matches the observed startup result and identifies the next verification step.
People still need to confirm rules, review changes and interpret evidence.
Copyediting contributes to quality but cannot replace functional or task acceptance.

zh.summary: 把規則決定、程式修改、工具執行與成果驗收分開，讓 AI 協作任務有明確的負責人、可用權限與停止條件。
objectives: 區分模型產生的建議、工具實際做過的操作與已驗證的結果。
替一個收件檢核修改任務分配人與 Agent 的責任。
寫出可修改範圍、驗收依據與遇到歧義時的停止條件。

readingGuide.goal: 為一次 Agent 修改任務建立清楚的人機分工與驗收契約。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 先想一條規格：缺少文件類型時，不得匯出完整報告。
readingGuide.route: 先分配責任，再追蹤規格、修改、執行與驗收；最後寫出任務契約。
readingGuide.output: problem.md 的責任分工附錄與一份可審查的 Agent 任務契約。

sections.heading: 同一句「完成」，可能指不同的事
paragraphs: 這裡的 Coding Agent 指能依指令協助讀取專案、修改程式及呼叫工具的軟體代理；它實際能做什麼，取決於工具與環境設定。
你請 Coding Agent 修改收件網站，回覆寫著「已完成欄位驗證」。這句話可能只代表它產生了程式，也可能代表它已修改檔案並執行測試。要知道現在能交付什麼，還要看修改檔案、實際命令、輸出與適用範圍。
本課沿用三欄合成案例：申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型。目標是缺少任一必要欄位時，指出缺漏並阻擋完整報告。Agent 可以協助實作這條規則；哪些欄位必填、完整代表什麼，仍要由負責需求的人確認。

sections.heading: 像把一份工作交給新加入的同事
paragraphs: 新同事可能熟悉寫程式，卻不熟悉你所在單位的收件規則。你不會只說「把它做好」，而會提供工作目的、可參考文件、能修改的範圍，以及遇到什麼問題要先停下來詢問。AI 協作也需要這些條件。
這個類比用來說明委派契約。Agent 的流暢回答不會自動取得領域知識、資料使用權或發布權；你需要從可觀察的操作與作品判斷它實際完成了哪些工作。

sections.heading: 規則、執行與驗收各有負責人
paragraphs: 可以把任務拆成需求決策、程式修改、執行環境與成果驗收。這些責任有時由同一位學員兼任，但仍要逐項說清楚。測試程式會檢查某些條件，最終是否符合工作需要，則要對照已確認的需求。 Diff 是修改前後的差異清單，用來核對程式實際變動。
NIST AI RMF 1.0 的 GOVERN 2.1 與 3.2 提醒組織明確記錄角色、溝通與人機分工。這裡採其責任清楚的原則，將它轉成課堂工作分配；不是取得框架認證或宣稱已符合所有治理要求。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜本課的角色分配範例
rows: 決定規則
學員扮演需求負責人，確認三欄與完整的定義
problem.md、spec.md 的規則及理由
提出及修改程式
Agent 依規格提出 Diff；學員審查
指定檔案的變更與決策紀錄
執行工具
環境只開放任務所需工具；操作者核對實際呼叫
命令、退出結果與測試輸出
判定可交付範圍
學員核對規格、重演操作，必要時請同儕試用
驗收結果、限制與下一步

sections.heading: 從建議走到證據，需要哪些連結
paragraphs: 模型可以提出測試命令，但文字裡出現「pytest 通過」與工具真的執行過 pytest 是兩件可分別核對的事。你要找到命令在哪個目錄、對哪個版本執行，以及輸出是否涵蓋這次變更。
例如只驗證「空字串會被拒絕」，仍未證明「先填完整、之後清空欄位」會讓舊報告失效。驗收者應挑選能反駁成功主張的案例，重現它，再看修改是否真的修正問題。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜一次可審查的 Agent 任務
blocks.description: 編號表示交付依據；任何一步發現歧義，都可回到規格修訂。

items.title: 確認規格
items.body: 人先定義必要欄位、完整狀態與不做事項。

items.title: 委派有限修改
items.body: Agent 只修改指定檔案；新規則或額外服務先提出問題。

items.title: 檢查實際執行
items.body: 核對 Diff、工具命令、測試輸出與修改版本。

items.title: 判定與保留界線
items.body: 人重演目標任務，記錄通過情境及未驗證範圍。

sections.heading: 指令、權限與停止條件要一起設定
paragraphs: 指令中的「不要修改其他檔案」表達工作範圍；檔案權限、沙箱（限制程式可接觸資源的執行環境）與工具允許清單才決定系統是否能限制越界操作。單靠文字提醒，不能作為隔離已生效的證據。學員應核對實際環境，給 Agent 完成本次工作所需的最小權限。
這次任務可允許讀取 problem.md、spec.md，修改 app.py、rules.py 與指定測試；不需要正式資料、帳號秘密、對外發布或外部付費服務。若它認為必須新增必填欄位、安裝未核對依賴，或修改範圍以外的檔案，就先列出理由與影響，等需求負責人決定。

blocks.caption: 表 2｜可直接交給 Agent 的任務契約
rows: 目標
缺少文件類型時，顯示缺漏並拒絕完整匯出
依據
使用目前 spec.md；不要自行新增業務規則
修改範圍
app.py、rules.py、tests/ 中與本情境有關的檔案
驗收
缺漏、完整、空白及舊結果失效情境；附真實命令結果
停止條件
規格歧義、需用真實資料、超出檔案或網路權限
交付
Diff、實際執行紀錄、未完成事項；由人確認可交付範圍

sections.heading: 「人會審核」要變成可以操作的安排
paragraphs: 如果人只看到一段成功摘要，沒有時間、工具或足夠資訊檢查，那麼「最後有人按確認」仍不足以說明審查有效。請把審查對象縮成一次切片：先比對一條規格與一份 Diff，再重演一個會失敗的案例。
另一個常見錯誤是將 Agent 的錯誤當成只能重新問一次。你可以先保留錯誤輸入與輸出，指出和規格差在哪裡，再請它修正並重跑。若問題涉及必要欄位的業務定義，就回到需求負責人決策；增加提示長度不會自動解決規則分歧。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器與本課合成收件情境；不需開通 Agent 或外部服務。
steps: 在 problem.md 加入責任分工小節，分配規則決定、程式修改、工具操作與驗收。
依表 2 寫一份 Agent 任務契約，指定一條缺漏情境與可修改檔案。
假設收到「已完成」摘要，列出還需要哪些命令、Diff 或操作證據，才能判定這條情境通過。
請同儕扮演 Agent，指出一項應停止詢問的歧義，再修正契約。
exercise.expected: 一份能交給另一人理解的任務契約，附責任分工、至少一個停止條件與驗收依據。
exercise.check: 同儕能說出誰決定規則、Agent 可以改哪裡，以及成功摘要還需要什麼證據；未實際執行時保持待驗證。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成契約與去識別化回饋；不要加入實際帳號、憑證或業務資料。

en.summary: Separate rule decisions, code changes, tool execution and acceptance so an AI-assisted task has clear owners, permissions and stop conditions.
objectives: Distinguish model suggestions, actions actually performed by tools and verified results.
Assign human and agent responsibilities for an intake-checking change.
Define the allowed change scope, acceptance criteria and stop conditions for ambiguity.

readingGuide.goal: Define human–agent responsibilities and an acceptance contract for one change task.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Begin with one requirement: a missing document type must prevent a complete-report export.
readingGuide.route: Assign responsibilities, trace the specification through changes, execution and acceptance, then write a task contract.
readingGuide.output: A responsibility appendix in problem.md and a reviewable agent task contract.

sections.heading: “Complete” Can Refer to Different Results
paragraphs: Here, a Coding Agent is a software agent that can help read a project, change code and call tools according to instructions. Its actual capabilities depend on its tools and environment configuration.

You ask a Coding Agent to change the intake website, and it replies, “Field validation is complete.” It might have generated code, or it might have changed files and run tests. To determine what can be delivered, inspect the changed files, actual commands, outputs and applicable scope.

The course uses three synthetic fields: application ID, applicant code and document type. Missing any required field must produce a missing-data message and block a complete report. The agent can help implement the rule; the person responsible for requirements must still confirm which fields are required and what “complete” means.

sections.heading: Like Delegating Work to a New Colleague
paragraphs: A new colleague may know how to program while being unfamiliar with your organization’s intake rules. Give them the purpose, reference documents, allowed change scope and questions that require stopping to ask, beyond “make it work.” AI collaboration needs these conditions too.

This analogy explains a delegation contract. Fluent agent responses do not automatically confer domain knowledge, data-use permission or release authority. Judge completed work through observable actions and artifacts.

sections.heading: Assign Owners for Rules, Execution and Acceptance
paragraphs: Separate requirements decisions, code changes, the execution environment and acceptance. One learner may hold several roles, but each responsibility still needs to be explicit. Tests check specified conditions; acceptance against work needs requires confirmed requirements. A diff lists before-and-after changes so you can inspect what actually changed.

NIST AI RMF 1.0 GOVERN 2.1 and 3.2 call for documented responsibilities, communication and human–AI roles. This lesson adapts that principle into a classroom assignment of responsibilities. It does not establish certification or compliance with the entire framework.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Example Responsibilities for This Course
rows: Decide the rules
The learner acts as requirements owner and confirms the three fields and the meaning of complete.
Rules and reasons in problem.md and spec.md
Propose and change code
The agent proposes a diff against the specification; the learner reviews it.
Changes to named files and decision records
Execute tools
The environment exposes only needed tools; the operator checks actual calls.
Commands, exit results and test output
Determine deliverable scope
The learner checks the specification, replays the task and involves a peer when needed.
Acceptance results, limits and next steps

sections.heading: Connect Suggestions to Evidence
paragraphs: A model can suggest a test command. A statement that “pytest passed” and an actual pytest tool execution are separately verifiable claims. Identify the directory and code version used, and whether the output covers this change.

Checking that an empty string is rejected does not establish that clearing a field after a successful check invalidates the old report. Choose a case that could disprove the success claim, reproduce it and inspect whether the change fixes the problem.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | A Reviewable Agent Task
blocks.description: Numbers show the basis for delivery. Ambiguity at any stage can lead back to a specification revision.

items.title: Confirm the specification
items.body: People define required fields, the complete state and exclusions first.

items.title: Delegate bounded changes
items.body: The agent changes only named files; new rules or extra services require a question first.

items.title: Check actual execution
items.body: Inspect the diff, tool commands, test output and changed version.

items.title: Decide and retain boundaries
items.body: People replay the target task and record passing scenarios and unverified scope.

sections.heading: Set Instructions, Permissions and Stop Conditions Together
paragraphs: “Do not change other files” describes the task scope. File permissions, a sandbox—an execution environment that limits accessible resources—and tool allowlists determine whether the system can restrict out-of-scope actions. A written reminder alone is not evidence of effective isolation. Check the actual environment and grant only the permissions needed for the task.

This task may allow reading problem.md and spec.md, and changing app.py, rules.py and named tests. It needs no production data, account secrets, external publication or paid external service. If the agent believes it must add a required field, install an unchecked dependency or change a file outside scope, it should first explain the reason and impact for the requirements owner to decide.

blocks.caption: Table 2 | A Task Contract You Can Give an Agent
rows: Goal
Show missing document type and reject complete-report export.
Basis
Use the current spec.md; do not invent business rules.
Change scope
Files in app.py, rules.py and tests/ relevant to this scenario.
Acceptance
Missing, complete, blank and stale-result scenarios, with actual command results.
Stop conditions
Ambiguous specification, need for real data, or actions beyond file or network permissions.
Delivery
Diff, actual execution record and unfinished work; people confirm deliverable scope.

sections.heading: Make Human Review an Actionable Arrangement
paragraphs: If the reviewer receives only a success summary, without time, tools or enough information to check it, a final confirmation click does not establish effective review. Limit the review to one slice: compare one requirement with one diff, then replay a case that should fail.

An agent error also gives you more options than simply asking again. Retain the failing input and output, identify the discrepancy with the specification, and ask for a correction and rerun. If the issue concerns the business definition of a required field, return the decision to the requirements owner; a longer prompt does not automatically resolve disagreement about rules.

exercise.environment: A text editor and the course’s synthetic intake scenario; no agent account or external service is needed.
steps: Add a responsibility section to problem.md, assigning rule decisions, code changes, tool operations and acceptance.
Use Table 2 to write an agent task contract with one missing-data scenario and allowed files.
Suppose you receive a “complete” summary. List the commands, diff or task evidence still needed to decide whether the scenario passed.
Have a peer act as the agent, identify an ambiguity that requires stopping to ask, then revise the contract.
exercise.expected: A task contract another person can understand, including responsibilities, at least one stop condition and an acceptance basis.
exercise.check: A peer can identify who decides rules, what the agent may change and which evidence a success summary still needs. Keep unexecuted work unverified.
exercise.cleanup: Retain the synthetic contract and de-identified feedback. Exclude actual accounts, credentials and business data.

zh.prompt: Agent 表示「測試都過了」，但沒有命令或輸出。下一步最合適的是？
options: 立刻宣告正式可用
請它提供對應版本的執行紀錄，並重演目標情境
把摘要存成測試證據即可
增加更多功能來確認能力
rationales: 正式可用還需更多需求與驗證，摘要不足以支持。
這讓主張連回實際操作、程式版本與規格結果。
摘要可以保留為回報，但尚不能證明工具執行與驗證範圍。
增加功能沒有補上目前缺少的證據。

en.prompt: The agent reports “all tests passed” without commands or output. What is the best next step?
options: Immediately declare production readiness.
Request execution records for the corresponding version and replay the target scenario.
Save the summary as sufficient test evidence.
Add more features to confirm capability.
rationales: Production readiness requires more requirements and verification than this summary supports.
This connects the claim to actual actions, the code version and specification outcomes.
A summary can be retained as a report, but does not yet establish tool execution or verified scope.
More features do not supply the missing evidence.

zh.prompt: Agent 發現規格沒有說文件類型是否必填，應如何處理？
options: 自己選一種規則並隱藏差異
改用更長 Prompt 後直接發布
列出歧義，請需求負責人確認，再同步規格與測試
刪掉該欄位以免出錯
rationales: 這會把未確認的規則當成事實。
提示長度無法取代業務決策與授權。
需求確認、規格與測試可共同維持同一條規則。
移除欄位仍是未獲確認的需求改動。

en.prompt: The specification does not say whether document type is required. What should the agent do?
options: Choose a rule and hide the discrepancy.
Use a longer prompt and publish immediately.
List the ambiguity, ask the requirements owner to confirm, then align the specification and tests.
Delete the field to avoid errors.
rationales: That would treat an unconfirmed rule as fact.
Prompt length cannot replace a business decision or authority.
Confirmed requirements, specifications and tests can maintain the same rule.
Removing the field is another unconfirmed requirements change.

zh.prompt: 哪一項能支持「Agent 只能修改指定範圍」的主張？
options: 它在回覆中答應不越界
提示最後加上驚嘆號
它產生的程式碼很少
已核對環境的檔案及工具權限，並檢查本次實際修改
rationales: 承諾是指令回應，尚未證明執行限制。
標點不會建立檔案或工具權限。
修改量小仍可能越界。
系統限制與事後證據分別支持允許範圍及本次實際行為。

en.prompt: Which evidence supports the claim that the agent can change only the specified scope?
options: It promised to stay in scope.
The prompt ends with an exclamation mark.
It generated very little code.
The environment’s file and tool permissions were checked, along with actual changes.
rationales: A promise responds to an instruction; it does not establish execution restrictions.
Punctuation creates no file or tool permissions.
A small change can still exceed scope.
System restrictions support allowed scope; the change record supports what happened in this task.

zh.summary: 從單人本機原型擴大到多人共用時，重新確認角色、資料存取、保存、維運與交接要求，避免把一個可運行的網址當成完整組織系統。
objectives: 指出個人工具與組織共用系統在使用情境與責任上的差異。
區分登入、資料授權與資料保存的要求。
為十人共用情境列出未實作事項及進入下一階段的條件。

readingGuide.goal: 辨識原型變成共用系統時新增的需求與驗證界線。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 沿用本機單人收件原型，假設十位同仁希望共用。
readingGuide.route: 比較使用情境，再分清登入與授權，最後寫出下一階段的需求及驗收條件。
readingGuide.output: architecture.md 的共用需求附錄、權限表與兩條授權情境。

sections.heading: 多一個網址，沒有自動增加一套管理方式
paragraphs: 你在自己的電腦上完成收件檢核原型。主管希望十位同仁共用，於是有人提議把網址傳給大家。操作入口雖然相同，背後的問題已經改變：不同人能看哪些資料？兩人同時使用會如何？誰負責更新、備份與處理錯誤？
本課的 Streamlit 參考解答仍是本機單人、合成資料的教學原型，沒有正式帳號、多人授權或持久資料庫。這一課用紙上設計辨識共用需求，不把尚未建置的控制標為通過。

sections.heading: 像個人筆記本變成共用收件櫃
paragraphs: 個人筆記本由你保管，也由你解釋每一欄的意思。當它變成辦公室的共用收件櫃，就需要知道誰能放入、取閱、修改或銷毀資料。櫃子的位置只是入口；使用規則、鑰匙管理與交接方式會影響大家能否可靠地共同工作。
軟體也要把這些安排轉成明確需求。有些由程序執行，有些由管理流程與負責人處理。原本由作者記在腦中的假設，應寫進文件並交給接手者核對。

sections.heading: 使用情境擴大，哪些假設需要重問
paragraphs: 個人工具也可能處理重要資料，需要保護與備份；多人系統則更需要明確協調角色、存取規則及維運責任。下表比較的是本課兩個具體情境，不能用使用人數單獨判定軟體是否安全。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜由本機單人原型轉成十人共用的需求變更
rows: 操作者
一位操作者使用合成資料
有哪些角色？誰負責收件、複核與管理？
資料可見性
未實作多人存取規則
誰可讀取、修改、匯出哪一筆資料？
保存與下載
程序工作階段及操作者的下載檔
資料保存在哪裡、保存多久、誰可刪除或還原？
共同使用
未驗證多人同時操作
同時修改時如何避免覆蓋或錯用別人的結果？
維運與交接
作者依 README 啟動與停止
誰管理環境、更新、備份、事件回應與交接？

sections.heading: 登入與授權回答不同問題
paragraphs: 身分驗證（Authentication）確認正在使用哪個身分；授權（Authorization）決定這個身分能對哪些資料做什麼操作。即使 A、B 都已登入，也不表示 B 可以讀取 A 的收件資料。
OWASP 的授權指南建議最小權限、預設拒絕與每次請求的權限檢查。套用到本課共用版時，需要在實際資料存取處核對操作者、目標資料與操作，而不只在畫面隱藏一個連結。這是待實作的設計要求。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜同一套共用系統裡的三種存取要求
blocks.description: 三張卡是不同操作的授權問題，不表示固定的角色階級。角色與權限應依需求確認。

items.title: 收件人員 A
items.body: 可處理獲授權的資料；能登入不代表可以查看所有同仁的紀錄。

items.title: 複核人員
items.body: 若工作需要跨承辦人複核，須明確授權其可讀取的資料與可做操作。

items.title: 維運人員
items.body: 環境管理權與業務內容存取權分別決定，不能因維護主機就默認可看所有資料。

sections.heading: 把共用願望改寫成可驗證要求
paragraphs: 以下是本課自訂、仍待單位確認的合成情境：A 和 B 各負責不同收件資料，主管希望複核者能查看指定案件。你先訪談角色與工作流程，再確認這是否真是需要的存取關係，不能直接把職稱當作完整權限表。
需求確認後，可以寫成：「Given B 只獲授權存取資料 B，When B 要求讀取資料 A，Then 應拒絕，且回應不包含資料 A 的內容。」這條情境必須對應實際身分與資料儲存層，單人原型的完整性測試無法驗證它。
接著追問匯出後的資料：即使網站限制了存取，下載檔仍有後續保管與分享的問題。請確認誰可以匯出、用途與保存方式，再決定系統及作業流程要提供哪些控制。

sections.heading: 以需求及證據決定是否進入共用階段
paragraphs: 先在 architecture.md 列出使用者、應用程式、資料儲存與外部服務，再標記新增的信任邊界。這裡只需說明資料由誰送入、在哪裡處理與保存、誰可取回，不必急著選定所有技術。C4 Context 與 Container 的用途會在 M06 詳細練習。
共用前的下一道閘門應包括：規則負責人確認、角色及資料權限、實際部署環境、資料保存及還原、維運負責人，以及對應的正常和負向測試。尚無證據的項目標為待設計、待實作或待驗證，讓下一位接手者知道工作從哪裡繼續。
如果目前目標只是教學，可以維持單人合成資料範圍，完成需求與驗證方法的練習。是否進入正式共用階段，應由負責人依實際需求決定，不能只由「已經有一個網址」決定。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器與虛構 A、B、複核者三種角色；不建立真實帳號或共用服務。
steps: 在 architecture.md 列出單人原型目前已具備及未實作的能力。
用合成資料 A、B 畫一張角色—資料—操作權限表，將未確認的規則標為假設。
寫一條允許讀取與一條拒絕讀取的 Given／When／Then，說明應在哪裡檢查權限。
列出資料保存、同時使用、備份及維運的待確認問題，指定下一步由誰核對。
exercise.expected: 一份共用版需求差異表、兩條授權情境與清楚的進入下一階段條件。
exercise.check: 同儕能分清已在原型實作的完整性規則，與尚未實作的多人授權要求；沒有執行時不標示測試通過。
exercise.cleanup: 只保留合成角色與資料代號；不要為紙上練習分享實際資料或改動正式系統權限。

en.summary: When a local single-user prototype becomes shared software, revisit roles, data access, retention, operations and handoff rather than treating a working URL as a complete organizational system.
objectives: Identify differences in use and responsibility between personal tools and shared organizational systems.
Distinguish login, data authorization and data retention requirements.
List unimplemented work and conditions for the next stage of a ten-user shared scenario.

readingGuide.goal: Identify new requirements and verification boundaries when a prototype becomes a shared system.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Start with the local single-user intake prototype and suppose ten colleagues want to share it.
readingGuide.route: Compare use contexts, distinguish login from authorization, then write requirements and acceptance conditions for the next stage.
readingGuide.output: A shared-use appendix in architecture.md, a permission matrix and two authorization scenarios.

sections.heading: A URL Does Not Establish an Operating Model
paragraphs: You have built an intake-checking prototype on your computer. A manager wants ten colleagues to share it, so someone suggests sending everyone the URL. The entry point may look the same, but the questions have changed: which data may each person see, what happens during simultaneous use, and who owns updates, backups and errors?

The course’s Streamlit reference solution remains a local, single-user teaching prototype using synthetic data. It has no production accounts, shared-user authorization or persistent database. This lesson uses a tabletop design to identify shared-use requirements, keeping unbuilt controls unverified.

sections.heading: Like Turning a Personal Notebook into a Shared Filing Cabinet
paragraphs: You keep a personal notebook and explain what its fields mean. A shared office filing cabinet requires agreement about who can add, read, change or destroy records. Its location is only the entry point; usage rules, key custody and handoff arrangements affect reliable shared work.

Turn those arrangements into explicit software requirements. Some belong in program behavior, others in management procedures and assigned responsibilities. Write down assumptions previously held in the author’s head so the next person can check them.

sections.heading: Which Assumptions Change When Use Expands?
paragraphs: Personal tools can also hold important data and need protection and backups. Shared systems add a greater need to coordinate roles, access rules and operational responsibility. The table compares two specific course scenarios; user count alone cannot establish software security.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Requirements Changes from a Local Prototype to Ten Shared Users
rows: Operator
One operator uses synthetic data.
Which roles handle intake, review and administration?
Data visibility
Shared-user access rules are not implemented.
Who may read, change or export each record?
Retention and downloads
Process session and the operator’s downloaded files.
Where is data kept, for how long, and who may delete or restore it?
Concurrent use
Simultaneous use by multiple people is unverified.
How will simultaneous edits avoid overwriting data or using someone else’s result?
Operations and handoff
The author starts and stops the app using the README.
Who owns the environment, updates, backups, incident response and handoff?

sections.heading: Authentication and Authorization Answer Different Questions
paragraphs: Authentication verifies which identity is in use. Authorization determines which operations that identity may perform on which data. Both A and B being logged in does not imply that B may read A’s intake records.

OWASP’s authorization guidance recommends least privilege, denying access by default and checking permissions on every request. In the course’s shared design, check the operator, target data and requested action at the actual data-access boundary, beyond hiding a link on screen. This is a design requirement that remains to be implemented.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Access Requirements in One Shared System
blocks.description: These cards represent authorization questions for different operations, not a fixed role hierarchy. Confirm roles and permissions against requirements.

items.title: Intake operator A
items.body: May process authorized data; logging in does not grant access to every colleague’s records.

items.title: Reviewer
items.body: If review across operators is required, explicitly authorize which records and actions are allowed.

items.title: Operations staff
items.body: Decide environment administration and business-data access separately; maintaining a host does not automatically grant access to all data.

sections.heading: Turn a Sharing Request into Verifiable Requirements
paragraphs: This synthetic scenario is defined for the course and still requires organizational confirmation: A and B handle different intake records, and the manager wants reviewers to see specified cases. Interview the roles about their work, then confirm the access relationships they actually need. Job titles alone are not a complete permission matrix.

After confirming requirements, write: “Given B is authorized to access only record B, When B requests record A, Then deny access and return no content from record A.” The scenario must correspond to actual identity and storage layers. Single-user completeness tests cannot verify it.

Ask what happens after export too. Access limits within the website do not settle how downloaded files are kept and shared. Confirm who may export, for what purpose and under which retention arrangements before choosing system and procedural controls.

sections.heading: Use Requirements and Evidence to Decide Whether to Share
paragraphs: List users, the application, data stores and external services in architecture.md, then mark new trust boundaries. At this stage, explain who supplies data, where it is processed and kept, and who can retrieve it; you need not select every technology yet. M06 develops C4 Context and Container views in detail.

The next gate before shared use should cover confirmation by rule owners, roles and data permissions, the actual deployment environment, retention and restoration, operational ownership, and corresponding normal and negative tests. Mark items without evidence as pending design, implementation or verification so the next person knows where to continue.

For a teaching goal, you can retain the single-user synthetic-data scope and practice requirements and verification methods. Responsible owners should decide whether to move into production sharing based on actual needs, beyond the existence of a URL.

exercise.environment: A text editor and fictional roles A, B and reviewer. Do not create real accounts or a shared service.
steps: List the prototype’s implemented and unimplemented capabilities in architecture.md.
Use synthetic records A and B to create a role–data–action permission matrix, marking unconfirmed rules as assumptions.
Write one allowed-read and one denied-read Given/When/Then scenario and identify where permission checks belong.
List questions about retention, simultaneous use, backups and operations, assigning who should check them next.
exercise.expected: A shared-use requirements comparison, two authorization scenarios and clear conditions for the next stage.
exercise.check: A peer can distinguish implemented completeness rules from unimplemented shared-user authorization. Do not mark tests passed without execution.
exercise.cleanup: Keep only synthetic roles and record identifiers. Do not share actual data or change production permissions for a tabletop exercise.

zh.prompt: A、B 都能登入網站，能否據此推定 B 可以讀取 A 的資料？
options: 視畫面的顏色而定
可以，因為登入即代表全部授權
不行，還要依資料與操作檢查授權
只要把 A 的按鈕隱藏就可以
rationales: 色彩不決定授權。
登入與資料授權是不同的要求。
需要核對目前身分是否被允許對目標資料執行這項操作。
畫面限制不能取代實際資料存取處的檢查。

en.prompt: A and B can both log in. Does that establish that B may read A’s data?
options: It depends on the screen colors.
Yes; login grants all permissions.
No; authorization must also be checked for the data and action.
Hiding A’s button is sufficient.
rationales: Color does not determine authorization.
Login and data authorization are different requirements.
Check whether the current identity may perform the requested action on the target data.
Interface restrictions cannot replace checks at actual data access.

zh.prompt: 單人原型的缺漏檢核測試全部通過，接著應如何處理十人共用需求？
options: 重新確認角色、資料流、儲存及維運要求，並建立對應驗證
只改 README 的使用人數
沿用同一個成功結論即可
先開放真實資料，出錯再改
rationales: 共用需求改變了環境及責任，需有自己的規格與證據。
文件數字不會建立多人能力。
既有測試沒有涵蓋新增的共用情境。
真實資料不應被當作尚未確認控制的測試材料。

en.prompt: All single-user missing-data tests pass. How should a request for ten shared users be handled next?
options: Reconfirm roles, data flows, storage and operations requirements, and establish corresponding verification.
Change only the user count in the README.
Reuse the same success conclusion.
Open real data first and fix problems later.
rationales: Shared use changes the environment and responsibilities, requiring its own specification and evidence.
A number in a document does not implement shared use.
Existing tests do not cover the new shared-use scenarios.
Actual data should not be used to test controls that have not been confirmed.

zh.prompt: 以下哪個描述最精確？
options: 有 HTTPS 就已具備資料授權
個人與多人情境都需評估資料風險，共用版還要明確協調存取與維運責任
個人工具永遠不需要備份
十人共用就一定不安全
rationales: 傳輸保護與資料授權處理不同問題。
這同時保留個人工具的責任，並指出共用情境新增的協調需求。
個人工具也可能需要保存與還原。
安全性需依設計、環境與證據判斷，不能只看人數。

en.prompt: Which statement is most precise?
options: HTTPS establishes data authorization.
Both personal and shared use need data-risk assessment; shared use also needs explicit coordination of access and operations responsibilities.
Personal tools never need backups.
Sharing among ten people is always unsafe.
rationales: Transport protection and data authorization address different problems.
This retains personal-tool responsibilities and identifies the coordination added by shared use.
Personal tools may also require retention and restoration.
Security depends on design, environment and evidence, beyond the number of users.

zh.summary: 用現況調查找到值得追問的工作問題，再用中立訪談確認情境，分清回答、解釋與尚待驗證的需求。
objectives: 將工具經驗調查與工作需求問題分開。
改寫誘導式問題，詢問具體工作事件。
從合成回答建立訪談追問、假設與需求紀錄，不宣稱已取得真實使用者證據。

readingGuide.goal: 用現況調查找到值得追問的問題，保留回答、推論與驗證的區別。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 先閱讀一段明確標為虛構的缺件經驗，不需要採訪真實業務。
readingGuide.route: 先設計有用途的問題，再練習中立追問，最後將合成回答轉成待驗證需求。
readingGuide.output: problem.md 的需求線索附錄：調查問題、訪談追問、假設與驗證動作。

sections.heading: 先問工作，再決定要展示哪個工具
paragraphs: 工作坊開始時，你可以詢問大家是否用過 Coding Agent、能否啟動 Python，以及希望改善哪一項工作。工具經驗能幫教師安排支援方式；工作困難則提供需求線索。兩類回答用途不同，不應把「用過某工具」當成已具備完整工程能力。
對自學者來說，也可以先回答同樣問題，再檢查自己的假設。請把「我想做一個 AI 系統」接著寫成「誰在什麼工作時機遇到困難」，讓後續學習有可討論的對象。

sections.heading: 像到餐廳前先知道用餐需求
paragraphs: 安排用餐時，只問大家喜歡哪一家店，未必知道是否有人需要無障礙入口、是否趕時間或有其他必要條件。先知道使用情境，才有辦法判斷推薦是否合適。
同樣地，詢問大家偏好哪一種程式框架，不能直接解釋收件工作為什麼卡住。你需要知道他們在哪一步、碰到哪一種資料、如何補救，以及結果由誰接手。這些問題會影響需求與介面。

sections.heading: 讓每個調查問題都有明確用途
paragraphs: 課前或現場調查可以幫你整理工具經驗、工作角色與困難線索。每題都應知道答案將如何影響授課或下一步研究；不需要的姓名、正式案件編號、個人聯絡資訊就不收集。若只做課堂示範，使用合成回答即可。
選項也要留出「未使用」「不確定」「目前不方便回答」等適當回應，避免迫使人選擇不符合經驗的答案。若開放自由文字，提醒只描述一般流程，不填入非公開業務或個人資料。這是本課的調查設計取捨，不代表已建立線上調查服務。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜可以用於課堂討論的調查題
rows: 最近一次啟動本機程式時，你在哪一步需要協助？
具體環境與操作困難
安排環境示範或同儕支援，不把困難歸因為能力不足
請描述交接一份資料前，你通常做的檢查
現行工作與規則線索
訪談檢查項目的負責人及例外情境
最近一次需要補件時，從發現到完成發生了什麼？
事件順序與影響
畫出現行工作流程，找出需要進一步確認的步驟
如果這次只能改善一個步驟，你會選哪裡？理由是什麼？
受訪者的優先順序
比較不同角色，不直接當作第一版範圍的最終決策

sections.heading: 把誘導式問題改成中立的事件追問
paragraphs: 「如果有 AI 自動檢查，你是不是就能大幅提升效率？」同時暗示了解法與期待效果。即使對方回答同意，你仍不知道原本工作如何進行，也沒有測量效率改善。
可以改問：「請描述最近一次發現缺件的經過。你當時先做什麼？怎麼知道少了什麼？後來如何處理？」再依回答追問，確認你理解的是同一個事件。GOV.UK 的深度訪談指南強調開放、中立問題與具體故事，也建議先試問同事以修正不清楚的提問。
對方說「系統很慢」時，可以追問是等待畫面、重複輸入，還是找不到下一步。先保留原來的說法，再記錄你對可能原因的解釋；不要未經確認就把問題改成「需要更快的模型」。

sections.heading: 從一個合成回答走向待驗證需求
paragraphs: 以下是虛構示範回答，不是實際學員或機關訪談：「我常到交接時才發現文件類型沒填，然後要再問一次送件者。」它提供了欄位、發現時機與補救動作的線索，但還沒有告訴我們發生頻率、誰定義必要欄位，或改成系統提示後是否有效。
你可以追問：「最近一次是怎麼發現的？填寫與複核由同一人做嗎？哪一份規則說明文件類型必填？」接著暫寫假設：「在交接前顯示必要欄位缺漏，可能減少漏看。」再用合成案例與原型任務試用來檢查提示是否可理解。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜把回答轉成可以驗證的需求線索
blocks.description: 每一步保留自己的證據狀態。示範回答與示範結果都不能寫成真實調查發現。

items.title: 記錄回答
items.body: 保留對方實際描述的事件；本課範例則明寫為合成回答。

items.title: 中立追問
items.body: 確認角色、時機、規則來源與補救過程，不預設工具解法。

items.title: 提出假設
items.body: 把對原因及可能改善的解釋列為待驗，不冒充直接觀察。

items.title: 安排驗證
items.body: 在規格中寫可觀察情境，再透過任務試用檢查效果。

sections.heading: 調查結果需要保留來源與範圍
paragraphs: 「這次回覆者中有人提到補件」與「所有同仁主要都被補件拖慢」是不同強度的結論。自願回覆、樣本來源、未回覆者與不同工作角色，都會影響你能從結果說到哪裡。先記錄這輪收到了什麼，再決定還需要詢問誰。
匿名化也要看整體內容。沒有姓名的自由文字仍可能包含足以辨識某人的細節；公開教學時可改用一般角色、合成資料與去識別化摘錄。需要記錄真人訪談時，先說明用途與記錄方式，取得適當同意，再依實際規範保管；本課練習不要求收集真人資料。
把調查線索接到 M03 的 problem.md：標出回答來源、你提出的假設、待確認問題與下一個驗證動作。等工作流程與需求較清楚，再決定第一版的範圍。不要將問卷票數直接當成所有需求的優先順序。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器與本課提供的合成回答；不需建立問卷網站或收集真人資料。
steps: 在 problem.md 的需求線索小節寫三個問題，分別了解工具操作、工作事件及目前優先困難，逐題註明用途。
將一題含「你是不是也覺得」的誘導問法，改成開放、中立、可追問最近事件的問題。
使用本課合成回答，分欄記錄回答內容、你的解釋、待確認假設與下一步驗證。
請同儕試讀提問，指出是否預設答案、是否可能要求個資，再修正問題。
exercise.expected: 一份有用途說明的調查題目，以及合成回答到訪談追問、假設與驗證的對照。
exercise.check: 同儕能分清哪些是合成回答、哪些是你的推論，以及哪一項需要後續觀察；沒有把示範結果稱為真實訪談發現。
exercise.cleanup: 只保留合成回答與去識別化回饋；若誤填真實姓名、業務細節或聯絡資料，移除後再分享。

en.summary: Use a current-state survey to find work problems worth investigating, then ask neutral interview questions to distinguish reported answers, interpretations and unverified requirements.
objectives: Separate questions about tool experience from questions about work needs.
Rewrite leading questions to ask about concrete work events.
Use synthetic answers to develop follow-up questions, assumptions and requirements records without claiming actual user evidence.

readingGuide.goal: Use a current-state survey to identify questions worth pursuing while separating answers, interpretations and verification.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Read a missing-document experience clearly labeled as fictional; no actual business interview is needed.
readingGuide.route: Design purposeful questions, practice neutral follow-ups, then turn synthetic answers into unverified requirements.
readingGuide.output: A requirements-leads appendix in problem.md containing survey questions, interview follow-ups, assumptions and verification actions.

sections.heading: Ask About Work Before Choosing a Tool Demonstration
paragraphs: At the start of a workshop, ask whether learners have used a Coding Agent, whether they can start Python, and which work task they want to improve. Tool experience helps instructors arrange support; work difficulties provide requirements leads. These answers serve different purposes. Using a tool does not establish complete engineering ability.

Self-study learners can answer the same questions and inspect their assumptions. Follow “I want to build an AI system” with “Who faces a difficulty, and at which point in their work?” Give the later learning a concrete situation to discuss.

sections.heading: Like Understanding Dining Needs Before Choosing a Restaurant
paragraphs: Asking only which restaurant people prefer may miss needs such as an accessible entrance, limited time or other required conditions. Understand the situation before deciding whether a recommendation fits.

Likewise, a preferred programming framework does not explain why intake work gets stuck. Ask at which step the difficulty occurs, which data is involved, how people recover and who takes over the result. These questions shape requirements and interfaces.

sections.heading: Give Every Survey Question a Purpose
paragraphs: A pre-class or live survey can reveal tool experience, work roles and leads about difficulties. Know how each answer will affect teaching or further research. Do not collect names, official case IDs or contact details that are unnecessary for that purpose. Synthetic answers are sufficient for a classroom demonstration.

Offer suitable responses such as “not used,” “not sure” and “prefer not to answer now,” so people are not forced into an inaccurate option. For free text, request general workflow descriptions without nonpublic business or personal data. These are course survey-design choices; no online survey service has been built.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Survey Questions for Classroom Discussion
rows: When you last started a local program, at which step did you need help?
Specific environment and interaction difficulties.
Arrange a setup demonstration or peer support without attributing difficulty to lack of ability.
Describe the checks you normally perform before handing over a record.
Current work and possible rules.
Interview the owners of checking rules and investigate exceptions.
During the most recent request for missing documents, what happened from discovery to completion?
Event sequence and impact.
Map the current flow and identify steps needing confirmation.
If you could improve only one step this time, which would you choose and why?
The respondent’s priorities.
Compare roles without treating the answer as the final first-release scope decision.

sections.heading: Replace Leading Questions with Neutral Event Follow-Ups
paragraphs: “If AI checked automatically, wouldn’t your efficiency improve greatly?” suggests both a solution and an expected effect. Agreement still tells you little about the original workflow and does not measure improved efficiency.

Ask instead: “Describe the most recent time you discovered missing documents. What did you do first? How did you identify what was missing? What happened next?” Follow the answer to confirm you are discussing the same event. GOV.UK’s in-depth interview guidance emphasizes open, neutral questions and concrete stories, and recommends trying questions with a colleague to improve unclear wording.

If someone says “the system is slow,” ask whether they mean waiting for a screen, re-entering information or not knowing the next step. Retain their wording before recording your possible explanation. Do not turn it into “we need a faster model” without confirmation.

sections.heading: Turn a Synthetic Answer into an Unverified Requirement
paragraphs: This is a fictional demonstration answer, not an actual learner or organizational interview: “I often discover the document type is blank only at handoff, and then I have to ask the sender again.” It suggests a field, a discovery point and a recovery action. It does not establish frequency, who defines required fields or whether a system prompt would help.

Follow up: “How was the most recent omission discovered? Does the same person enter and review the data? Which rule makes document type required?” Then record a provisional assumption: “Showing missing required fields before handoff may reduce overlooked omissions.” Use synthetic cases and a prototype task trial to check whether the prompt is understandable.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Turn an Answer into a Verifiable Requirements Lead
blocks.description: Retain the evidence status of each step. Demonstration answers and results must not be reported as actual survey findings.

items.title: Record the answer
items.body: Retain the event the person described; label course examples as synthetic.

items.title: Ask neutral follow-ups
items.body: Confirm roles, timing, rule sources and recovery without assuming a tool-based solution.

items.title: Propose a hypothesis
items.body: Keep explanations of causes and possible improvements unverified, distinct from direct observation.

items.title: Arrange verification
items.body: Write observable scenarios in the specification, then inspect outcomes through a task trial.

sections.heading: Retain the Source and Scope of Survey Findings
paragraphs: “Some respondents in this round mentioned missing-document requests” supports a narrower conclusion than “missing documents are the main delay for all colleagues.” Voluntary responses, recruitment sources, nonrespondents and work roles affect what you can conclude. Record what this round received, then decide whom to ask next.

Anonymization also depends on the whole account. Free text without a name can still contain identifying details. Use general roles, synthetic data and de-identified excerpts in public teaching. If recording actual interviews, explain their purpose and recording method, obtain appropriate consent and follow applicable handling rules. This exercise does not require collecting actual participant data.

Connect survey leads to M03’s problem.md: identify answer sources, hypotheses, unanswered questions and the next verification action. Choose first-release scope after understanding work and requirements more clearly. Survey vote counts alone do not determine every requirement’s priority.

exercise.environment: A text editor and the supplied synthetic answer. No survey website or actual participant data is needed.
steps: In the requirements-leads section of problem.md, write three questions about tool operation, a work event and the current highest-priority difficulty, explaining each question’s purpose.
Rewrite one leading question containing “don’t you also think” as an open, neutral question about a recent event.
Using the synthetic answer, separately record the answer, your interpretation, an unconfirmed hypothesis and the next verification action.
Have a peer read the questions for assumed answers or possible requests for personal data, then revise them.
exercise.expected: Purposeful survey questions and a mapping from a synthetic answer to interview follow-ups, hypotheses and verification.
exercise.check: A peer can distinguish the synthetic answer from your interpretations and identify what needs later observation. Demonstration results are not labeled as actual interview findings.
exercise.cleanup: Retain only synthetic answers and de-identified feedback. Remove any accidentally entered names, business details or contact information before sharing.

zh.prompt: 以下哪個問題較適合了解收件工作困難？
options: 請描述最近一次發現缺件時，從發現到處理完的經過
你喜歡最先進的模型嗎？
為什麼你們都不用自動化？
你是不是也覺得 AI 會讓工作更有效率？
rationales: 它提供具體事件與後續追問的入口，不預設解法。
工具偏好無法直接說明工作困難。
它先下了未經確認的判斷，也可能使受訪者防衛。
它暗示期待的答案，沒有詢問實際流程。

en.prompt: Which question best explores difficulties in intake work?
options: Describe the most recent missing-document event from discovery through resolution.
Do you like the most advanced model?
Why does nobody here use automation?
Don’t you also think AI will make work more efficient?
rationales: It opens a concrete event to follow-up without assuming a solution.
Tool preference does not directly explain work difficulty.
It starts with an unconfirmed judgment and may put the respondent on the defensive.
It suggests the desired answer rather than asking about actual work.

zh.prompt: 三位自願回覆者提到補件，最精確的紀錄是？
options: 問卷無法使用，所以刪除回答
所有同仁都以補件為最大困難
已證明自動化可節省一半時間
這輪三位回覆者提到補件；仍需確認情境、其他角色及影響
rationales: 有限的回答仍可提供線索，重點是適當解釋。
這把有限回答推成全體結論。
尚未測量改善效果，不能編造數字。
這保留觀察範圍，也列出下一步。

en.prompt: Three voluntary respondents mention missing-document requests. Which record is most precise?
options: Delete the answers because the survey is unusable.
Every colleague considers missing documents the biggest difficulty.
Automation has been proven to save half the time.
Three respondents in this round mentioned missing documents; context, other roles and impact still need confirmation.
rationales: Limited answers can still provide leads if interpreted appropriately.
That generalizes limited responses to everyone.
No improvement has been measured, so the number is unsupported.
This retains the observed scope and identifies the next step.

zh.prompt: 哪個做法符合本課的現況調查目的？
options: 把合成回答標成真實學員意見
用過 Agent 就視為已通過課程
只詢問會影響授課或需求研究的資訊，並將線索接到後續訪談
為避免漏資料，收集姓名、正式案件編號及密碼
rationales: 示範材料必須清楚保留合成來源。
工具經驗不等於已具備需求、設計與驗證能力。
每題有用途，回答有後續確認方式，才能形成可用需求線索。
這些資訊不符合本課用途，也不需要用於教學練習。

en.prompt: Which practice fits this course’s current-state survey purpose?
options: Label synthetic answers as actual learner opinions.
Treat previous agent use as passing the course.
Ask only for information that affects teaching or requirements research, then follow leads with interviews.
Collect names, official case IDs and passwords to avoid missing information.
rationales: Demonstration materials must retain their synthetic provenance.
Tool experience does not establish requirements, design and verification skills.
Purposeful questions and a way to confirm answers produce useful requirements leads.
Those details are unnecessary for this course’s teaching purpose.

zh.summary: 從文字如何切成 token，到向量、注意力與下一個 token 的產生，建立能解釋模型輸出及其限制的基本圖像。
objectives: 區分字元、詞語與模型使用的 token，避免用字數直接估算所有模型的容量。
說明 Transformer 中向量表示、位置資訊及 Attention 的基本作用。
用可重現的純數學範例理解加權組合，分清注意力權重與答案正確性。

readingGuide.goal: 說明模型處理文字的基本單位與加權機制，保留輸出驗證的界線。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 沿用三個必要欄位的合成收件要求；數學範例可只用紙筆。
readingGuide.route: 先分清 token，再讀簡化生成路線，最後核對加權計算及其限制。
readingGuide.output: 原理說明與兩組玩具計算結果，作為後續上下文設計的基礎。

sections.heading: 模型讀到的單位與人眼看到的字不同
paragraphs: 你把「請檢查收件資料」交給模型，它會先經過 tokenizer（分詞器），將文字轉成 token 的識別碼。token 可能對應一個字、詞片段、位元組序列或特殊標記；切法取決於詞彙表與演算法。空白、標點與中英文混用也會影響結果。
Hugging Face 的文件介紹 BPE、WordPiece、Unigram 等分詞方式。本課只需先掌握：同一句話在不同分詞器下可能有不同切法，不能把「一個中文字就是一個 token」當成通則。

sections.heading: 像先把文件編成能處理的零件
paragraphs: 可以把 token 想成文件被切成的零件編號，向量則是模型用來計算的數字表示。人看到「文件類型」，可能把它理解成一個欄位；模型使用的 token 邊界未必剛好等於這個概念。
例如把「收件資料」畫成「收件／資料」或「收／件／資／料」，可示意兩種不同粒度；這只是手工切分教具，不是任何真實 tokenizer 的量測結果。要知道實際數量，仍需指定模型與分詞器後測量。

sections.heading: 向量、位置與注意力各自做什麼
paragraphs: Transformer 將 token 轉成向量，結合位置資訊，並透過 Attention（注意力）讓某個位置依其他可見位置的表示更新自己的表示。它還有前饋網路等組件；Attention 不是整個模型。
2017 年 Transformer 原論文包含 encoder 與 decoder。本課以自回歸文字生成的解讀方式為主：模型依目前可用的序列產生下一個 token 的分布，再依解碼規則選取輸出。因果遮罩會限制解碼位置不能讀取尚未產生的未來 token。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜本課用來閱讀文字生成的簡化路線
blocks.description: 這是理解用途的簡化圖，不列出所有層、訓練方法或架構變體。

items.title: 文字轉 token
items.body: 分詞器把文字轉成識別碼；切法由模型配置決定。

items.title: 建立及更新表示
items.body: 向量、位置資訊、注意力與其他網路層共同處理序列。

items.title: 形成下一個 token 分布
items.body: 模型輸出轉成候選 token 的機率分布；這不是事實查核分數。

items.title: 解碼並接續
items.body: 依解碼規則選取 token，再更新序列，直到停止條件。

sections.heading: 用兩個位置看加權組合
paragraphs: 注意力常以 query、key、value 描述：query 是當前位置用來比對的表示，key 用於計算匹配分數，value 是被加權組合的內容。簡化寫法是 softmax(QKᵀ／√dₖ)V；遮罩另限制哪些位置可見。softmax 會將分數轉成總和為 1 的權重。
下例直接給定兩個分數與純量 value，用來觀察加權結果；不是訓練過的 LLM，也沒有生成或查核文字。分數 [1, 0] 會得到約 [0.731, 0.269]，對 value [2, 6] 加權後約為 3.076。

blocks.heading: 純 Python 注意力教具
paragraphs: 環境：Python 3，僅使用標準函式庫。可將程式另存為 attention_demo.py 後執行。
blocks.code:
from math import exp
scores = [1.0, 0.0]
values = [2.0, 6.0]
shift = max(scores)
numerators = [exp(x - shift) for x in scores]
weights = [x / sum(numerators) for x in numerators]
weighted_value = sum(w * value for w, value in zip(weights, values))
print("weights =", [round(w, 3) for w in weights])
print("weighted_value =", round(weighted_value, 3))

sections.heading: 權重很高，不表示內容真實
paragraphs: 注意力權重描述這一次表示計算如何分配到可見位置，不等於模型對某句話的事實信心。下一個 token 的機率又是另一個分布，不能把兩者混為同一種證據。
收件範例中，模型可能產生一份語句通順的報告，但是否缺少文件類型，要由已確認的規則與實際輸入檢查。即使模型回答得很肯定，仍不能把欄位完整性、內容真實與正式受理當成相同狀態。

sections.heading: 把原理用在協作要求上
paragraphs: 請模型協助修改程式時，提供明確欄位名稱、規格、合成輸入及預期結果，比只要求「理解我的意思」更容易讓人審查輸出是否符合工作。模型能利用什麼資訊，也受這次輸入內容與後續工具結果影響。
不要用一次輸出的正確或錯誤推定所有情境。保留輸入、模型與工具環境、輸出及驗收情境，才能討論哪個部分需要修正。接下來一篇會處理這些資訊如何放進有限的上下文窗口。

exercise.environment: 紙筆即可；可選用 Python 3 執行純數學教具，不需模型帳號、套件或網路。
steps: 把一句合成收件要求畫成兩種手工切分，註明不是實際 tokenizer 結果。
依圖 1 說明 token、向量表示、注意力及解碼各處理什麼問題。
手算或執行範例，核對權重約 [0.731, 0.269]、加權結果約 3.076。
將 scores 改為 [0.0, 0.0] 再計算，說明為何權重各 0.5、結果為 4.0，以及它沒有證明哪些模型能力。
exercise.expected: 一份單位與機制的說明，及兩組可核對的玩具加權結果；不把它記為真實模型測試。
exercise.check: 能解釋 token 數為何需指定分詞器，並指出注意力權重、下一 token 機率與事實正確性之間的差別。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成筆記；若建立 attention_demo.py，可刪除或納入個人練習，不產生外部資源。

en.summary: Follow text from tokenization through vectors, attention and next-token generation to explain model output and its limits.
objectives: Distinguish characters, words and model tokens instead of estimating every model’s capacity from character counts.
Explain the basic roles of vector representations, position information and attention in a Transformer.
Use reproducible arithmetic to understand weighted combinations, separating attention weights from answer correctness.

readingGuide.goal: Explain the units and weighting mechanism used to process text while retaining the need to verify output.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Use the synthetic request about three required intake fields; the arithmetic can be done on paper.
readingGuide.route: Distinguish tokens, follow a simplified generation path, then check the weighted calculation and its limits.
readingGuide.output: An explanation and two toy calculation results as a basis for later context design.

sections.heading: Model Units Differ from the Characters We See
paragraphs: When you give a model “請檢查收件資料” (please check the intake data), a tokenizer converts the text into token IDs. A token may represent a character, part of a word, a byte sequence or a special marker. Boundaries depend on the vocabulary and algorithm; spaces, punctuation and mixed Chinese and English can affect the result.

Hugging Face describes tokenization methods including BPE, WordPiece and Unigram. The initial lesson is that the same sentence can be segmented differently by different tokenizers. One Chinese character per token is not a universal rule.

sections.heading: Like Encoding a Document as Processable Parts
paragraphs: Think of tokens as identifiers for document parts, and vectors as numeric representations used in computation. A person may understand “文件類型” (document type) as one field; model token boundaries need not align with that concept.

For example, “收件資料” can be drawn as “收件／資料” or “收／件／資／料” to illustrate two granularities. These are hand-made teaching segmentations, not measurements from an actual tokenizer. Specify the model and tokenizer before measuring a real count.

sections.heading: Vectors, Positions and Attention Have Different Roles
paragraphs: A Transformer maps tokens to vectors, incorporates position information and uses attention to update a position’s representation using other visible positions. It also contains components such as feed-forward networks; attention is not the entire model.

The original 2017 Transformer paper includes an encoder and a decoder. This course focuses on reading autoregressive text generation: the model produces a next-token distribution from the available sequence, and decoding rules select output. A causal mask prevents a decoding position from accessing future tokens that have not yet been generated.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | A Simplified Path for Understanding Text Generation
blocks.description: This teaching diagram omits many layers, training methods and architecture variants.

items.title: Convert text to tokens
items.body: The tokenizer maps text to IDs according to the model configuration.

items.title: Build and update representations
items.body: Vectors, positions, attention and other network layers process the sequence.

items.title: Form a next-token distribution
items.body: Model output becomes probabilities over candidate tokens, not a fact-checking score.

items.title: Decode and continue
items.body: Select a token using decoding rules and update the sequence until a stop condition.

sections.heading: A Weighted Combination of Two Positions
paragraphs: Attention is often described through query, key and value. The query is the current position’s representation for comparison; keys help compute match scores; values supply the content combined with weights. A compact formula is softmax(QKᵀ/√dₖ)V, with masking separately controlling visible positions. Softmax turns scores into weights that sum to 1.

The example supplies two scores and scalar values to illustrate weighting. It is not a trained LLM and neither generates nor fact-checks text. Scores [1, 0] give approximately [0.731, 0.269]; weighting values [2, 6] gives approximately 3.076.

blocks.heading: A Pure-Python Attention Teaching Example
paragraphs: Environment: Python 3 with only the standard library. Save the program as attention_demo.py and run it if desired.
blocks.code:
from math import exp
scores = [1.0, 0.0]
values = [2.0, 6.0]
shift = max(scores)
numerators = [exp(x - shift) for x in scores]
weights = [x / sum(numerators) for x in numerators]
weighted_value = sum(w * value for w, value in zip(weights, values))
print("weights =", [round(w, 3) for w in weights])
print("weighted_value =", round(weighted_value, 3))

sections.heading: A Large Weight Does Not Establish Truth
paragraphs: Attention weights describe the contribution of visible positions to this representation calculation. They are not factual confidence in a sentence. Next-token probabilities form another distribution; the two are different kinds of information.

A model may write a fluent intake report, but checking for a missing document type requires confirmed rules and actual input. A confident response does not make field completeness, truth and official acceptance the same state.

sections.heading: Apply the Mechanism to Collaboration
paragraphs: When asking for a code change, provide explicit field names, specifications, synthetic inputs and expected results. These make the output easier to review than a request to “understand what I mean.” Available information also depends on this input and subsequent tool results.

One correct or incorrect output does not establish performance in every situation. Retain input, model and tool environment, output and acceptance scenarios to identify what needs correction. The next lesson considers how to fit this information into a finite context window.

exercise.environment: Paper is sufficient. Optionally use Python 3 for the arithmetic; no model account, package or network is needed.
steps: Draw two hand-made segmentations of a synthetic intake request and label them as illustrations, not actual tokenizer results.
Use Figure 1 to explain the roles of tokens, vector representations, attention and decoding.
Calculate by hand or run the example to confirm weights approximately [0.731, 0.269] and a weighted result approximately 3.076.
Change scores to [0.0, 0.0] and recalculate. Explain the equal 0.5 weights, result 4.0 and model capabilities this example does not establish.
exercise.expected: An explanation of units and mechanisms with two checkable toy calculations, kept distinct from actual model testing.
exercise.check: Explain why token counts require a specified tokenizer, and distinguish attention weights, next-token probabilities and factual correctness.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic notes. Delete attention_demo.py or retain it as a personal exercise; no external resources are created.

zh.prompt: 下列何者能正確描述 token？
options: 所有中文模型都以一字一 token 計算
token 就是完整句子
切分由分詞器及詞彙表決定，不能固定等同中文字數
只計算使用者看見的英文字
rationales: 中文字與 token 沒有所有模型共用的一對一關係。
句子可能包含多個 token，也可能含特殊標記。
實際計數需要指定分詞器及完整輸入。
標點、空白與系統使用的特殊標記也可能影響計數。

en.prompt: Which statement correctly describes tokens?
options: Every Chinese model uses exactly one token per character.
A token is a complete sentence.
Segmentation depends on the tokenizer and vocabulary, so it cannot always equal the Chinese character count.
Only visible English words count.
rationales: There is no universal one-to-one mapping between Chinese characters and tokens.
A sentence can contain several tokens and special markers.
Actual counts require the tokenizer and full input.
Punctuation, spaces and system special markers can also affect counts.

zh.prompt: 玩具範例的兩個分數相同時，value 為 2 與 6，結果為何？
options: 4，因為兩者各取得 0.5 權重
8，因為直接相加
6，因為最後一個位置必然正確
無法計算，因為必須連接 LLM
rationales: 相同分數經 softmax 得到相同權重，0.5×2＋0.5×6＝4。
加權組合不是忽略權重直接相加。
此例沒有最後位置必勝的規則，也未在查核內容真假。
這是可離線計算的數學教具。

en.prompt: In the toy example, equal scores weight values 2 and 6. What is the result?
options: 4, because each value receives weight 0.5.
8, because the values are simply added.
6, because the last position is always correct.
It cannot be calculated without connecting to an LLM.
rationales: Equal scores yield equal softmax weights: 0.5×2 + 0.5×6 = 4.
A weighted combination includes weights.
The example contains no rule that the last position wins and performs no fact-checking.
This arithmetic can be performed offline.

zh.prompt: 某位置的注意力權重很高，應如何解讀？
options: 該位置文字一定為真
它參與了這次表示計算的加權，仍需另外驗證工作結果
模型已完成資料授權檢查
這就是實際學員的信心分數
rationales: 注意力不是事實查核分數。
這保留了計算意義，也保留外部驗證的責任。
授權由系統控制，不由注意力權重決定。
這個權重與學員作答信心是不同資料。

en.prompt: How should a large attention weight for one position be interpreted?
options: The text at that position must be true.
It contributes to this weighted representation calculation; task outcomes still need verification.
The model has completed data authorization checks.
It is an actual learner’s confidence score.
rationales: Attention is not a fact-checking score.
This preserves the computational meaning and the need for external verification.
System controls determine authorization, not attention weights.
Attention weights and learner confidence are different data.

zh.summary: 把上下文窗口當作每次生成可使用的有限工作空間，安排必要規格、工具結果與輸出預留，並用任務結果檢查資訊是否真的被有效使用。
objectives: 區分聊天介面保存的歷史與某次模型呼叫實際取得的上下文。
用明示假設的 token 預算，辨識超出容量及無關資訊擁擠的問題。
為長任務保留可重新讀取的規格、狀態與來源，避免只靠對話記憶。

readingGuide.goal: 為一次模型呼叫安排有限、相關且可回查的上下文。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 先把聊天歷史與目前真正需要的規格、程式和測試結果分開。
readingGuide.route: 讀工作桌類比，計算合成預算，再替一次修正任務設計工作包。
readingGuide.output: 一份註明假設的預算與含來源、版本、未決問題的任務摘要。

sections.heading: 聊天視窗看得到，不代表本次模型都讀得到
paragraphs: Context Window（上下文窗口）是模型在某次計算中可處理的序列範圍。應用程式會決定送入哪些指令、對話、檔案片段與工具結果；聊天介面保留的完整歷史，未必全部進入這次呼叫。
實際限制也可能涉及輸出長度、圖片表示、工具訊息與服務端處理。要確認特定產品的上限，需查其模型、版本及 API 規則；本課不把某個數字套用到所有模型。

sections.heading: 像一次只能攤開有限文件的工作桌
paragraphs: 把上下文想成目前攤在桌上的資料。倉庫裡有更多文件，不代表你這一刻正在查看它們；桌面變大，也不保證你會找到夾在中間的一條規則。
協作任務可以分成外部正本與當前工作資料。spec.md 是可重新讀取的正本；對話裡某次提到的規則，則需要確認是否仍出現在目前上下文，以及是否已被更新。

sections.heading: 先說清楚假設，再計算預算
paragraphs: 下例假設窗口上限 8192 token，且把輸入與預留輸出合計計入同一上限。各項 token 數皆為教學指定數字，不是真實 tokenizer 或服務的量測；尚未計入的額外封裝，在實際服務中也要核對。
800＋1200＋4800＋1000＝7800，因此剩餘 392。若再加入 600 token 的內容，合計會變成 8400，超出此題假設 208。這只判斷容量條件，沒有判斷模型是否能正確完成任務。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜合成上下文預算
rows: 規則與工具描述
描述任務邊界及可用工具
目前規格
必要欄位與驗收條件
工具結果
與本次修正有關的輸出
預留生成輸出
在題設內保留回答空間

blocks.heading: 可選的 Python 預算核對
paragraphs: 環境：Python 3 標準函式庫即可。執行會顯示 reserved = 7800、remaining = 392、fits = True。
blocks.code:
window = 8192
input_parts = {"rules": 800, "spec": 1200, "tool_results": 4800}
output_reserve = 1000
reserved = sum(input_parts.values()) + output_reserve
remaining = window - reserved
print("reserved =", reserved)
print("remaining =", remaining)
print("fits =", remaining >= 0)

sections.heading: 容量與有效使用是兩項不同檢查
paragraphs: Lost in the Middle 的研究在其多文件問答與鍵值檢索設定中，觀察到資訊位置可能影響表現。這提醒我們，內容能放進窗口，不等於所有資訊都被可靠使用；也不能把那組實驗的結果直接當成所有新模型的固定表現。
收件任務可以用具體案例驗證：必要欄位規則是否被正確套用？舊版本規格是否被誤用？若同時塞入大量無關日誌，應先選出和錯誤相關的片段，而不是只增加更多提醒。

sections.heading: 替下一次呼叫準備可核對的工作包
paragraphs: 本課的工作包可包含目標、目前規格版本、相關程式片段、剛執行的測試結果、未決問題與停止條件。每一項都說明來源；摘要提到「測試通過」時，仍保留可回查的命令與結果。
長任務需要繼續時，先確認正本是否改變，再讀取必要片段並重新核對目前狀態。這個工作流程是本課的設計示例，不表示任何 Agent 已自動做到全部步驟。

blocks.description: 工作包是對當前任務的選材；完整來源仍可回查。

items.body: 取得 spec.md 的現行規則及相關程式，不沿用過期摘要。

items.title: 預留並驗證
items.body: 依服務規則安排容量；執行後仍按情境檢查結果。

sections.heading: 避免把反覆重述當成完整記錄
paragraphs: 重複提醒可能有用，但無法保證資訊永遠保留，也不能代替規格正本。若規則改了，應更新文件並說明版本，不只是繼續在對話後方加上另一種說法。
下一篇會比較摘要壓縮、RAG 與持久記錄。它們可以幫助選擇或重建上下文，但仍有遺漏、過期與錯取資料的風險，需要對照工作結果。

exercise.environment: 紙筆或 Python 3；所有 token 數都使用本課題設，不需呼叫真實模型。
steps: 將必要規格、對話歷史與工具結果分成正本、當前必需、可回查三類，說明分類理由。

en.summary: Treat the context window as finite working space for a generation call. Select specifications and tool results, reserve output space and check whether the task actually uses that information effectively.
objectives: Distinguish chat history retained by the interface from context actually supplied to a model call.
Use an explicitly assumed token budget to identify capacity overflow and crowding by irrelevant material.
Retain rereadable specifications, state and sources for long tasks instead of relying only on conversation history.

readingGuide.goal: Prepare finite, relevant and traceable context for one model call.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Separate chat history from the specifications, code and test results currently needed.
readingGuide.route: Use the work-desk analogy, calculate a synthetic budget, then prepare a task packet for one correction.
readingGuide.output: An assumption-labeled budget and a task summary with sources, versions and unresolved questions.

sections.heading: Visible Chat History May Not Reach This Call
paragraphs: A context window is the sequence range a model can process in a calculation. The application chooses which instructions, messages, file excerpts and tool results to send. The complete history visible in a chat interface need not be included in the current call.

Actual constraints can also involve output length, image representations, tool messages and server-side processing. Check a particular product’s model, version and API rules for its limits; this course does not apply one number to every model.

sections.heading: Like a Desk with Room for Only Some Documents
paragraphs: Think of context as the documents currently open on a desk. More documents in storage do not mean you are reading them now. A larger desk does not guarantee that you will find a rule buried in the middle.

Separate external authoritative records from current working material. spec.md is a record you can reread. A rule mentioned earlier in conversation needs checking for presence in current context and subsequent updates.

sections.heading: State the Assumptions Before Calculating
paragraphs: This example assumes an 8192-token window and counts input plus reserved output against that same limit. All token counts are teaching inputs, not actual tokenizer or service measurements. Check additional message overhead in a real service too.
800 + 1200 + 4800 + 1000 = 7800, leaving 392. Adding 600 tokens gives 8400, exceeding the assumed limit by 208. This checks capacity, not whether the model performs the task correctly.

blocks.heading: Optional Python Budget Check
paragraphs: Environment: Python 3 standard library. The program prints reserved = 7800, remaining = 392 and fits = True.
blocks.code:
window = 8192
input_parts = {"rules": 800, "spec": 1200, "tool_results": 4800}
output_reserve = 1000

remaining = window - reserved
print("reserved =", reserved)
print("remaining =", remaining)

sections.heading: Capacity and Effective Use Need Separate Checks
paragraphs: Lost in the Middle observed position-dependent performance in its multi-document question-answering and key-value retrieval settings. Fitting content into a window does not establish reliable use of all information. Those experiments also do not establish fixed performance for every newer model.

Use concrete intake cases: were required-field rules applied correctly, or was an old specification used? When logs contain much irrelevant material, select excerpts related to the failure before adding more reminders.

sections.heading: Prepare a Traceable Packet for the Next Call
paragraphs: A course task packet can contain the goal, current specification version, relevant code excerpts, newly executed test results, unresolved questions and stop conditions. State each item’s source. When a summary says “tests passed,” retain commands and results that can be inspected.

To continue a long task, check whether authoritative records changed, reread necessary excerpts and verify current state. This is a course workflow example, not a claim that any agent automatically performs every step.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Rebuild Usable Task Context
blocks.description: The packet selects material for the current task while retaining access to full sources.

items.title: Identify the current task
items.body: Fix only the issue where clearing a field after a successful check still allows export.

items.title: Read necessary authoritative records
items.body: Retrieve current spec.md rules and relevant code instead of reusing an outdated summary.

items.title: Include necessary evidence
items.body: Retain the failing case, corresponding test output and file versions.

items.title: Reserve space and verify
items.body: Budget under the service’s rules, then check outcomes against scenarios after execution.

sections.heading: Repeated Reminders Are Not a Complete Record
paragraphs: Repetition can help, but cannot guarantee that information stays available or replace the specification. Update the document and explain its version when rules change instead of adding another variation at the end of a conversation.

The next lesson compares compaction, RAG and persistent records. They can help select or rebuild context, but omissions, stale information and incorrect retrieval still require checking against task outcomes.

exercise.environment: Paper or Python 3. Use only the assigned token counts; no actual model call is needed.
steps: Classify specifications, history and tool results as authoritative records, currently necessary material or retrievable evidence, explaining your choices.
Check the synthetic budget of 7800 and remaining 392, optionally running the program.
Add 600 tokens of irrelevant logs, calculate overflow and decide what to remove from the current packet first.
Write a next-call task summary with specification version, sources, unresolved questions and scenarios still needing verification.
exercise.expected: Synthetic budget calculations and a source-traceable task packet, without claiming real service token measurements.
exercise.check: Explain the difference between fitting content and performing the task correctly, and identify information the next call must retrieve again.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic notes and optionally delete the temporary budget program. No external model or account is created.

zh.prompt: 聊天介面仍顯示很早以前的訊息，是否表示本次模型必定收到它？
options: 是，介面與模型輸入永遠相同
是，只要訊息沒有被使用者刪除
不需要知道，模型能自動恢復所有歷史
不能推定，應確認應用程式實際組裝的上下文
rationales: 介面保存與模型實際輸入是不同層次。
未刪除不保證全部送入模型。
沒有足夠依據可保證所有歷史自動恢復。
這把判斷連回本次呼叫實際取得的資料。

en.prompt: An early message remains visible in chat. Must the model have received it in this call?
options: Yes; the interface and model input are always identical.
Yes, unless the user deleted it.
There is no need to check because the model restores every message automatically.
No; inspect the context the application actually assembled.
rationales: Interface retention and actual model input are different layers.
Not deleting a message does not guarantee it is sent.
There is no basis for guaranteeing automatic restoration of all history.
This connects the judgment to information available in this call.

zh.prompt: 依本課題設，7800 再加入 600，與 8192 上限相比如何？
options: 仍有 208 的餘裕
超出 208
剛好等於上限
因為模型較新所以無法計算
rationales: 8400 大於 8192，不是仍有餘裕。
兩者不相等。
這是已明示假設的算術，不依賴真實模型版本。

en.prompt: Under the course assumptions, how does 7800 plus 600 compare with the 8192 limit?
options: It leaves 208 tokens.
It exceeds the limit by 208.
It exactly equals the limit.
A newer model makes the arithmetic impossible.
rationales: 8400 is greater than 8192, not below it.
The two values differ.
This arithmetic uses explicit assumptions, not a real model version.

zh.prompt: 較大的窗口最直接改變什麼？
options: 保證所有重要規則都會正確套用
保證不再需要規格文件
在對應規則下能容納的序列範圍；有效使用仍需驗證
自動取得所有外部檔案的讀取權
rationales: 容量不等於工作正確性。
仍需要可核對及更新的規格。
這分開容量條件與任務品質。
窗口大小不授予資料權限。

en.prompt: What does a larger context window most directly change?
options: It guarantees correct application of every important rule.
It removes the need for a specification.
The sequence range that can fit under applicable rules; effective use still needs verification.
It grants access to all external files.
rationales: Capacity does not establish task correctness.
Specifications still need to be traceable and maintained.
This separates capacity from task quality.
Window size grants no data permissions.

zh.summary: 辨識推論重用、上下文壓縮、外部檢索與持久記錄的不同層次，針對長任務選擇合適方法並保留查證方式。
objectives: 說明 KV Cache 重用的是注意力計算中的 K／V，而非可直接閱讀的長期筆記。
區分 Compaction、RAG 與 Memory 的資料來源、使用時機及失效風險。
為收件專案的四種問題選擇方法，避免將快取、記憶與模型訓練混為一談。

readingGuide.goal: 依問題選擇快取、摘要、檢索或持久記錄，分清效能與知識使用的證據。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 將「記不住」拆成重算、容量、資料取得及跨次狀態四種需求。
readingGuide.route: 先讀各方法機制，再用比較表選方法，最後設計可回查的專案筆記。
readingGuide.output: 四種方法的用途與失效對照，以及一份合成專案狀態筆記。

sections.heading: 「記不住」可能是四種不同問題
paragraphs: 模型每產生一個 token 都重算過去內容、長對話塞不下、找不到一份規格、隔天不知任務做到哪裡，是不同的工程問題。若都只說「增加記憶」，很難判斷該改哪一層。
本篇是線上延伸節點。工作坊先掌握用途比較即可；不要求學員在 10 小時內實作推論引擎、向量資料庫或完整記憶服務。

sections.heading: KV Cache 重用已計算的表示
paragraphs: 在一般因果自回歸推論中，先前位置的 key／value 可被保留，之後生成時重用，避免重算這些投影；新增位置仍要進行自己的計算與注意力操作。這些張量是推論狀態，不是人可直接當成 spec.md 使用的文字筆記。
Hugging Face 說明了每層 KV Cache 的重用。跨請求的 prefix caching 則還需符合引擎的相同前綴及配置等重用條件。vLLM 的說明也區分前綴處理與後續生成；快取命中不會自動替任務增加上下文容量、資料權限或永久記憶。

sections.heading: 壓縮目前對話，與保存日後可讀的筆記
paragraphs: Compaction（上下文壓縮）可把較長的歷史整理成較短摘要，再以摘要繼續工作。Memory 在本課指可於上下文之外保存、日後再讀回的記錄機制；它可以是檔案或其他儲存，不是一種固定的模型結構。
Anthropic 的工程文章分別討論壓縮與結構化筆記。本課採其用途區別，另要求摘要或筆記留下來源、版本、未決問題及更新方式。摘要可能漏掉細節，持久筆記也可能過期；存進檔案不表示每次呼叫都已讀到，更不表示權重被重新訓練。

sections.heading: RAG 先取回資料，再支援生成
paragraphs: RAG（檢索增強生成）將外部檢索與生成結合。原始 RAG 論文研究以檢索器取得文件資訊的模型；在本課的應用設計中，可先找出獲授權且與任務相關的規格片段，再把片段與來源交給生成步驟。
檢索不保證找對版本或涵蓋全部條件。找到舊版 spec.md、只取回一半規則，或把外部文件中的指令當成操作授權，都會造成問題。資料存取限制應在檢索前後的適當系統邊界執行，不能只要求模型不要洩露已不當讀取的內容。

sections.heading: 依需要保留的東西選方法
paragraphs: 下表是本課用途比較。實際系統可以同時採用多種方法；方法之間可能共享儲存或檢索基礎設施，但仍應分清各自要解決的問題。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜四種方法的作用與驗證問題
rows: KV Cache
重用已處理 token 的注意力 K／V
前綴及配置是否可重用、資源與隔離邊界
Compaction
用較短的摘要接續長歷史
關鍵規則、失敗證據與未決事項有沒有遺漏
RAG
依查詢取回外部資料以支援生成
來源、版本、相關性、完整性及存取權
