blocks.caption: 圖 1｜同一收件專案中的四個獨立需求
blocks.description: 卡片是用途對照，不是一定要依序啟用的四個階段。

items.title: 重算的成本
items.body: 若推論引擎支援，檢查 KV 重用；不要用摘要取代相同數學計算。

items.title: 過長的工作歷史
items.body: 建立可回查的壓縮摘要，核對規則與未決事項。

items.title: 分散的規格
items.body: 查詢並取回正確版本的規格片段，保留來源。

items.title: 跨次的專案狀態
items.body: 保存可更新的任務筆記，下次先核對再讀回。

sections.heading: 為每一種改善留下自己的證據
paragraphs: 若只是要接續昨天的收件原型修改，可以先保存目前規格版本、失敗測試、未完成切片與下一步。這份小型工作筆記比立即建置大型記憶平台更容易檢查是否有用。
也要說清楚尚未驗證的層次。本課沒有測量 KV Cache 加速比例、RAG 檢索品質或真實模型的長任務準確率。紙上比較完成後，仍需在指定引擎、資料與測試任務下另行驗證，才能主張性能或品質改善。

exercise.environment: 紙筆或文字編輯器；只用合成規格與任務紀錄，不安裝檢索服務或推論引擎。
steps: 對照表 1，替重算、歷史太長、規格分散、隔天接續四種需求各選一種主要方法。
寫一段專案筆記，含規格版本、來源、未決問題與下一步，並說明如何重新讀回。
假設摘要刪掉「修改輸入後舊結果失效」，指出可能影響哪條驗收情境及如何發現。
為檢索到舊規格的情境設計檢查方式，分清檢索成功與規格正確套用。
exercise.expected: 用途對照與一份可回查、可更新的合成任務筆記；保留每種方法仍需驗證的事項。
exercise.check: 能解釋為何 KV Cache 命中不等於永久記憶、檢索到文件不等於答案正確、筆記存在不等於本次模型已讀取。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成筆記即可；沒有建立快取、向量資料庫或外部服務可供清理。

en.summary: Distinguish inference reuse, context compaction, external retrieval and persistent records. Choose methods for long tasks while retaining a way to check them.
objectives: Explain that KV Cache reuses attention keys and values, not readable long-term notes.
Distinguish the sources, timing and failure risks of Compaction, RAG and Memory.
Choose methods for four intake-project problems without confusing caches, memory and model training.

readingGuide.goal: Choose caches, summaries, retrieval or persistent records according to the problem, separating performance evidence from knowledge use.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Separate “forgetting” into recomputation, capacity, data access and cross-session state.
readingGuide.route: Understand mechanisms, compare purposes, then design traceable project notes.
readingGuide.output: A purpose-and-failure comparison of four methods and a synthetic project-state note.

sections.heading: “Forgetting” Can Mean Four Different Problems
paragraphs: Recomputing past material for each generated token, an overlong conversation, a missing specification and uncertainty about yesterday’s task state are different engineering problems. Calling them all “more memory” obscures which layer needs changing.

This is an online-extension concept. The workshop needs the purpose comparison first; learners are not expected to implement an inference engine, vector database or complete memory service within ten hours.

sections.heading: KV Cache Reuses Computed Representations
paragraphs: In ordinary causal autoregressive inference, earlier positions’ keys and values can be retained for later generation, avoiding recomputation of those projections. New positions still require their own computations and attention operations. These tensors are inference state, not text notes a person can use as spec.md.

Hugging Face explains per-layer KV reuse. Cross-request prefix caching also requires engine-specific reuse conditions, such as matching prefixes and configuration. vLLM distinguishes prefix processing from subsequent generation. A cache hit does not automatically add context capacity, data permissions or permanent memory.

sections.heading: Compact Current History or Save Notes for Later
paragraphs: Compaction can replace longer history with a shorter summary for continued work. In this course, Memory means records kept outside context and read back later. It may use files or other storage; it is not one fixed model architecture.

Anthropic’s engineering article discusses compaction and structured notes separately. The course uses that purpose distinction and additionally requires sources, versions, unresolved questions and update procedures. Summaries can omit details and persistent notes can become stale. Saving a file does not mean each call has read it or that model weights were retrained.

sections.heading: RAG Retrieves Material to Support Generation
paragraphs: Retrieval-Augmented Generation combines external retrieval with generation. The original RAG paper studies models using a retriever to obtain document information. In this course’s application design, retrieve authorized, relevant specification excerpts and provide them with their sources to the generation step.

Retrieval does not guarantee the right version or complete conditions. An old spec.md, a partial rule or instructions in an external document mistaken for authority can all cause problems. Enforce access restrictions at appropriate retrieval-system boundaries rather than asking a model to hide content it should not have accessed.

sections.heading: Choose What You Need to Retain
paragraphs: This table compares purposes for the course. Systems can combine methods and share storage or retrieval infrastructure while keeping their engineering purposes distinct.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Four Methods and Their Verification Questions
rows: KV Cache
Reuse attention keys and values for processed tokens.
Prefix and configuration compatibility, resources and isolation boundaries.
Compaction
Continue long history using a shorter summary.
Omissions of critical rules, failure evidence and unresolved work.
RAG
Retrieve external material for generation in response to a query.
Source, version, relevance, completeness and access permission.
Memory
Save project or task records for later retrieval.
Whether they were read back, updates, access and deletion.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Four Independent Needs in One Intake Project
blocks.description: These cards compare purposes, not four stages that must be enabled in order.

items.title: Recomputation cost
items.body: Check KV reuse if the engine supports it; a summary is not a substitute for the same mathematical computation.

items.title: Overlong work history
items.body: Create a source-traceable compact summary and check rules and unresolved work.

items.title: Scattered specifications
items.body: Retrieve the correct specification excerpts and retain their sources.

items.title: Cross-session project state
items.body: Save updatable task notes, check them and read them back next time.

sections.heading: Keep Separate Evidence for Each Improvement
paragraphs: To continue yesterday’s prototype change, begin with the specification version, failing tests, unfinished slice and next step. A small task note is easier to inspect for usefulness than an immediate large memory-platform build.

State what remains unverified. This course has not measured KV Cache speedups, RAG retrieval quality or actual model long-task accuracy. After the tabletop comparison, use a specified engine, dataset and task to establish any performance or quality improvement.

exercise.environment: Paper or a text editor with synthetic specifications and task records. Do not install retrieval services or inference engines.
steps: Use Table 1 to choose a primary method for recomputation, overlong history, scattered specifications and next-day continuation.
Write a project note with specification version, sources, unresolved questions and next step, explaining how to read it back.
Suppose a summary omits invalidation after input changes. Identify the affected acceptance scenario and how to detect the omission.
Design a check for an outdated retrieved specification, separating retrieval success from correct rule application.
exercise.expected: A purpose comparison and a traceable, updatable synthetic task note with outstanding verification questions.
exercise.check: Explain why a KV hit is not permanent memory, finding a document is not answer correctness, and a saved note is not proof that the current model read it.
exercise.cleanup: Retain synthetic notes only. No cache, vector database or external service was created.

zh.prompt: KV Cache 最直接重用的是什麼？
options: 推論中已處理位置的 K／V 表示
經人工確認的業務規則權威
永久寫入模型的新知識
所有使用者的聊天歷史
rationales: 這對應避免重算先前 K／V 的用途。
業務規則仍需正本與負責人。
快取不是重新訓練或永久知識保證。
不能由快取概念推定所有歷史都被保存或授權共享。

en.prompt: What does KV Cache most directly reuse?
options: Keys and values for already processed inference positions.
Human-confirmed authority over business rules.
New knowledge permanently written into a model.
Every user’s chat history.
rationales: That corresponds to avoiding recomputation of past keys and values.
Rules still need authoritative records and owners.
Caching is not retraining or a guarantee of permanent knowledge.
Caching does not establish retention or authorization to share all history.

zh.prompt: 摘要漏掉「修改輸入後需重新檢查」，下一步應如何做？
options: 將遺漏當成新規格
提高快取命中率即可
直接宣告模型沒有記憶能力
回查正本，修正摘要並重演舊結果失效的情境
rationales: 摘要不是擅自變更規格的授權。
計算快取無法補回被刪除的文字條件。
單一摘要錯誤無法支持對所有能力的概括。
這能修正工作資料並留下與需求對應的驗證。

en.prompt: A summary omits the need to recheck after input changes. What is the next step?
options: Treat the omission as a new specification.
Increase the cache-hit rate.
Declare that the model has no memory capability.
Check the authoritative record, correct the summary and replay stale-result invalidation.
rationales: A summary does not authorize a requirements change.
A computation cache cannot restore a deleted textual condition.
One summary error cannot support a claim about every capability.
This corrects working information and verifies it against the requirement.

zh.prompt: RAG 找到一份文件時，還需要確認什麼？
options: 不需確認，能找到就是可信
來源、版本、權限及是否涵蓋目前問題
只看文件字數
只確認回答有附連結
rationales: 檢索成功與內容適用不同。
這些條件共同影響文件能否用於本次任務。
字數不代表規格正確或完整。
連結可以幫助回查，但仍需核對內容。

en.prompt: RAG finds a document. What must still be checked?
options: Nothing; retrieval establishes trustworthiness.
Source, version, permission and coverage of the current question.
Only its character count.
Only whether the answer includes a link.
rationales: Retrieval success and applicability differ.
These conditions affect whether the document fits this task.
Length does not establish specification correctness or completeness.
A link aids inspection but its contents still need checking.

zh.summary: 依誰決定下一步、如何使用工具及何時停止，區分聊天介面、預定流程與代理迴圈，選擇適合收件任務的控制方式。
objectives: 區分互動介面的外觀與背後控制流程。
用固定檢核與迭代修正案例說明 Workflow 和 Agent 的差異。
替任務指定輸入、允許動作、停止條件與驗收者。

readingGuide.goal: 從控制流程選擇聊天問答、固定工作流或有限代理迴圈。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 沿用收件解說、缺漏檢核及程式修正三種不同任務。
readingGuide.route: 先分開介面與控制權，再比較案例，最後寫成功與停止出口。
readingGuide.output: 一張有控制者、權限、驗收與退出條件的任務控制卡。

sections.heading: 看到聊天框，還不知道系統如何工作
paragraphs: Chatbot（聊天機器人）描述一種以對話互動的形式。背後可能只是產生回答，也可能呼叫固定流程或工具，甚至啟動 Agent；不能只由聊天框判定其自主程度。
同樣地，一個沒有聊天框的網頁，也可以在背景使用模型。分析系統時，先問：接到要求後由誰決定下一步？能呼叫哪些工具？如何知道要停止？

sections.heading: 固定路線與可調整的工作安排
paragraphs: 可以把 Workflow 想成先安排好的工作路線：先檢查必要欄位，通過才預覽，失敗就回報缺漏。分支可以很多，也可以在某一步呼叫模型，但下一步如何走主要由程式規則決定。
Agent 則可在允許範圍內，依當前結果選擇下一個動作。例如讀取規格、查看測試失敗、修改一個檔案、重跑後再決定是否繼續。這種彈性仍需要權限、預算與終止條件。

sections.heading: 以控制權與邊界比較
paragraphs: Anthropic 在 2024 年的工程文章用預定程式路徑與模型動態決定流程，區分 Workflow 和 Agent。這是有用的架構觀點，不是所有產品的統一命名規則；原文章的工具環境後來已有變動，本課只採控制方式的概念。
模型、流程與介面可以組合。本課的必要欄位檢核使用明確規則，不需要因為可以加入 Agent 就改成讓模型臨時判斷。Coding Agent 可以協助開發它，執行中的應用程式仍可以是確定的檢核流程。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜同一收件情境的三種切入點
blocks.description: 卡片比較用途與控制方式；聊天外觀可以包覆後兩者，不代表互斥產品。

items.title: 聊天問答
items.body: 解釋欄位的教學定義；需核對回答來源，不能直接當正式受理。

items.title: 固定檢核流程
items.body: 依三個必要欄位的規則決定缺漏、預覽與匯出。

items.title: 代理式開發迴圈
items.body: 依失敗測試選擇讀檔、修改與重跑，直到驗收或停止條件。

sections.heading: 同一個任務可以採取不同設計
paragraphs: 如果任務是「每次填完表單就檢查三欄」，先用函式與固定流程會讓規則容易追溯。若任務是「找出測試為何失敗並提出修正」，所需檔案與工具步驟可能要依證據調整，就較適合有限的代理迴圈。
選用 Agent 前仍應確認成功如何判定、工具是否足夠安全、失敗時能否觀察與停止。多次工具呼叫或很多步驟，不會單獨證明它是 Agent，也不會證明品質更好。

sections.heading: 迴圈需要預算與退出路徑
paragraphs: 以修正缺漏匯出為例，可以設定只修改指定專案、一次處理一個驗收情境、每輪記錄結果。達到測試目標後交由人驗收；規格歧義、工具失敗或達到資源上限時先停止，不無限重試。
預算可包含工具呼叫數、時間或費用等限制，實際值需按環境設定。本課不提供適用所有任務的固定數字；重點是能說出誰執行限制、到上限後保留什麼，以及人如何接手。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜任務控制卡
rows: 目標
修正清空文件類型後仍可匯出舊報告
可用動作
讀規格、讀指定程式、修改指定檔案、執行測試
成功出口
指定情境通過且有人審查 Diff 與實際操作
停止出口
規格歧義、越出授權範圍、工具無法使用或預算到限
保留證據
輸入、修改版本、工具結果、未完成步驟

sections.heading: 自動化程度與可交付程度分開判斷
paragraphs: 一個固定 Workflow 可能比自由選工具的 Agent 更適合清楚、穩定的欄位規則。反過來，選擇 Agent 也不表示可以取消驗證；動作更動態時，更需要看見實際發生的事。
交付時說明控制方式與適用範圍，例如「Agent 協助開發、本機程式按固定規則檢核」，比單純標成 AI 系統更能讓接手者理解它能做什麼。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器；只做架構與控制流程設計，不呼叫外部 Agent。
steps: 替欄位解說、固定缺漏檢核、失敗測試修正三種任務選控制方式，逐一說明理由。
將其中一種畫成操作步驟，標出下一步由程式、人或模型決定。
用表 1 寫出允許動作、成功出口與停止出口。
請同儕提出一個工具失敗情境，補寫如何保留證據及交接。
exercise.expected: 三種任務的選型理由與一張可檢查的任務控制卡。
exercise.check: 不靠聊天框或產品名稱分類，能指出控制者、工具權限與停止條件；未執行即不寫通過。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成設計即可；沒有建立 Agent 或修改正式工作流程。

en.summary: Distinguish conversational interfaces, predefined workflows and agent loops by who chooses the next step, how tools are used and when execution stops.
objectives: Separate interface appearance from the underlying control flow.
Use fixed checks and iterative corrections to explain workflow–agent differences.
Specify task inputs, allowed actions, stop conditions and an acceptance owner.

readingGuide.goal: Choose conversational Q&A, a fixed workflow or a bounded agent loop by examining control flow.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Compare explaining intake fields, checking missing data and correcting code.
readingGuide.route: Separate interfaces from control, compare cases, then define success and stop exits.
readingGuide.output: A task-control card with a controller, permissions, acceptance and exit conditions.

sections.heading: A Chat Box Does Not Reveal the Control Flow
paragraphs: A chatbot describes a conversational interaction form. It may generate answers, invoke fixed flows or tools, or start an agent. A chat box alone does not establish autonomy.
A page without a chat box can also use a model in the background. Ask who chooses the next step after a request, which tools can be called and how the system knows to stop.

sections.heading: A Fixed Route or an Adaptable Work Arrangement
paragraphs: Think of a workflow as a planned route: check required fields, allow a preview on success and report omissions on failure. It can branch extensively and call a model at a step while program rules largely determine what happens next.

Within allowed boundaries, an agent can choose its next action from current results. It might read the specification, inspect a failing test, change one file, rerun and decide whether to continue. That flexibility still needs permissions, a budget and termination conditions.

sections.heading: Compare Control and Boundaries
paragraphs: Anthropic’s 2024 engineering article distinguishes predefined program paths from model-directed dynamic control. This is a useful architectural distinction, not a universal naming rule for every product. The article’s tool ecosystem has since changed; the course uses the control-flow concept.

Models, flows and interfaces can be combined. This course’s required-field checks use explicit rules; the availability of an agent is no reason to let a model redefine those rules during execution. A Coding Agent may help develop the application while the running application retains deterministic checks.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Approaches to the Same Intake Situation
blocks.description: Compare purpose and control. A conversational interface can wrap either of the other approaches, so these are not mutually exclusive products.

items.title: Conversational Q&A
items.body: Explain the teaching definitions of fields. Verify sources; an answer does not establish official intake acceptance.

items.title: Fixed checking workflow
items.body: Apply the three required-field rules to missing data, preview and export.

items.title: Agent-assisted development loop
items.body: Use failing tests to choose reading, changes and reruns until acceptance or a stop condition.

sections.heading: Different Designs Can Address the Same Task
paragraphs: For “check three fields after each form entry,” functions and a fixed flow make rules traceable. For “find why a test fails and propose a correction,” files and tool steps may need to change with the evidence, making a bounded agent loop more suitable.

Before choosing an agent, define success, assess tool safety and ensure failures can be observed and execution stopped. Several tool calls or many steps alone establish neither an agent architecture nor better quality.

sections.heading: Loops Need Budgets and Exit Paths
paragraphs: To correct an invalid export, restrict changes to the named project, handle one acceptance scenario at a time and record each round. After the target tests pass, hand off for human acceptance. Stop for ambiguous requirements, unavailable tools or resource limits instead of retrying indefinitely.

Budgets may limit calls, time or cost, with values chosen for the environment. This course gives no universal numeric limit. Identify who enforces each limit, what is retained when it is reached and how a person takes over.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Task-Control Card
rows: Goal
Prevent exporting an old report after clearing document type.
Allowed actions
Read the specification and named code, change named files and run tests.
Success exit
The target scenario passes and a person reviews the diff and actual operation.
Stop exit
Ambiguity, actions beyond authorization, unavailable tools or an exhausted budget.
Retained evidence
Inputs, changed version, tool results and unfinished steps.

sections.heading: Assess Automation and Deliverability Separately
paragraphs: A fixed workflow may fit clear, stable field rules better than free tool selection. Choosing an agent does not remove verification; more dynamic actions make observing actual behavior more important.
At handoff, describe control and scope. “An agent helped develop a local program that checks fixed rules” tells the next person more than a generic “AI system” label.

exercise.environment: A text editor for architecture and control-flow design only. Do not call an external agent.
steps: Choose control approaches for field explanations, fixed completeness checks and failing-test correction, explaining each choice.
Draw one approach as actions and identify whether a program, person or model selects the next step.
Use Table 1 to define allowed actions, a success exit and stop exits.
Have a peer propose a tool failure, then explain how to retain evidence and hand off.
exercise.expected: Reasons for three design choices and a checkable task-control card.
exercise.check: Identify controllers, permissions and stop conditions without relying on chat boxes or product names. Unexecuted designs remain unverified.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the synthetic design only. No agent or production workflow was created or changed.

zh.prompt: 有聊天框的程式，一定是 Agent 嗎？
options: 一定，因為可以多輪對話
不一定，需看背後流程與工具的控制方式
只有畫面深色時才是
只要名稱含 AI 就是
rationales: 多輪對話無法單獨說明控制結構。
介面形式與背後的控制流程是不同層次。
配色與架構分類無關。
產品命名不能代替機制分析。

en.prompt: Is every application with a chat box an agent?
options: Yes, because it supports multiple conversation turns.
Not necessarily; inspect control flow and tool use.
Only when the screen is dark.
Yes, if AI appears in its name.
rationales: Multiple turns alone do not identify the control structure.
The interface and underlying control operate at different layers.
Colors do not classify architecture.
A product name does not explain its mechanism.

zh.prompt: 三個必要欄位已由人確認，每次都套用相同規則，優先可採何種方式？
options: 讓模型每次自行定義完整
不需要任何規格
明確函式與固定檢核流程，Agent 可協助開發
將所有動作都開放給模型
rationales: 這會讓穩定規則變成未授權的臨時決策。
仍需要規格與驗證。
這能保留穩定行為及開發協作的分工。
更多權限不能直接改善此項檢核。

en.prompt: People have confirmed three required fields and the same rules apply each time. Which approach can be preferred?
options: Let the model redefine completeness each time.
Use no specification.
Use explicit functions and a fixed checking flow; an agent can help develop it.
Give the model every possible action.
rationales: That turns stable rules into unauthorized ad hoc decisions.
Specifications and verification are still needed.
This separates stable runtime behavior from development collaboration.
More permissions do not directly improve this check.

zh.prompt: 代理迴圈遇到規格歧義，合適的出口是？
options: 保留目前證據並請負責人釐清，再決定是否繼續
無限重試同一操作
自行假定後宣告成功
刪除失敗紀錄
rationales: 這讓下一步建立在明確規格與可接手證據上。
無限重試可能增加成本與副作用。
這會掩蓋尚未確認的需求。
刪除紀錄會破壞除錯與交接依據。

en.prompt: What is a suitable exit when an agent loop encounters an ambiguous specification?
options: Retain current evidence and ask the owner to clarify before deciding whether to continue.
Repeat the same action indefinitely.
Assume a rule and declare success.
Delete failure records.
rationales: The next step then rests on explicit requirements and usable handoff evidence.
Unbounded retries can increase cost and side effects.
That hides an unresolved requirement.
Deleting records undermines diagnosis and handoff.

zh.summary: 以六個工程面向檢查模型周圍的執行系統，追蹤一次收件專案修正需要哪些上下文、工具、控制、環境、安全與觀察證據。
objectives: 用六個面向解釋 Agent Harness，而不把它當成模型本身或統一產品標準。
追蹤一次工具回合中各面向負責的工作。
指出失敗時應補查的環境、控制與證據，避免只修改提示詞。

readingGuide.goal: 用六個平行面向解釋 Agent 任務如何被支援與限制。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 先沿用讀規格、改一個檔案、重跑測試的合成任務。
readingGuide.route: 先理解 Harness，再追蹤六面向分工，最後用故障反查缺少的證據。
readingGuide.output: architecture.md 的 Harness 責任圖與一份可接手的故障追查說明。

sections.heading: 模型周圍還有一套讓工作發生的系統
paragraphs: Agent Harness 在本課指包覆模型、支援任務執行的程式與環境安排。模型產生下一步建議，周圍系統負責提供資料、呼叫工具、執行限制、保存結果與判斷是否繼續。
這裡採用六個面向作為課程分析框架：Context、Tools、Orchestration、Execution Environment、Security、Observability。它來自本課規劃，不宣稱是所有框架都必須採用的六個獨立模組或通用標準。

sections.heading: 像一張工作單背後的工具與工作場所
paragraphs: 把修改任務想成工作單。只把工作單交給一位會寫程式的人，還不夠完成交付；他還需要拿到正確文件、可用工具、允許操作的工作場所，以及知道誰驗收。
如果測試命令根本無法執行，反覆要求「更仔細測試」不會建立缺少的環境。若檔案被改到錯誤目錄，也應檢查工具的根目錄與執行限制，而不只責怪模型沒有理解。

sections.heading: 六個面向共同支援一次任務
paragraphs: 下圖六張卡是平行檢查面向。安全與可觀測性應跨越任務流程，不是最後才加上的兩個步驟；同一個程式元件也可能同時承擔數個面向。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜本課的 Harness 六面向
blocks.description: 卡片表示責任分工，不表示六個依序執行的階段。

items.title: Context：當前資料
items.body: 規格版本、相關程式、工具結果及未決問題，決定本次可參考什麼。

items.title: Tools：可呼叫能力
items.body: 清楚描述輸入、輸出、錯誤與副作用，讓請求能被檢查。

items.title: Orchestration：流程控制
items.body: 安排回合、任務狀態、成功條件、重試及停止出口。

items.title: Execution Environment：執行環境
items.body: 實際工作目錄、依賴、程序、檔案與網路配置。

items.title: Security：權限與邊界
items.body: 限制資料與動作，處理敏感操作及跨界要求。

items.title: Observability：可觀測性
items.body: 用紀錄及觀察看見工具實際執行、結果、版本與失敗。

sections.heading: 追蹤一次「讀規格、改檔、重跑」
paragraphs: 假設目前目標是修正舊報告失效：Context 提供規格與失敗情境；Tools 提供讀檔、修改及測試能力；流程控制決定一次處理哪個切片；環境提供可用的 Python 與測試依賴。安全配置限制修改與資料範圍；可觀測性保留工具結果與版本。
MCP 的工具規格可作為一個介面例子：它定義工具描述、輸入及結果等交換方式。但能交換訊息，不代表測試環境存在、權限已正確限制，或結果已通過人的驗收。這些仍要由執行系統及操作者實際確認。

sections.heading: 失敗時先找出缺少哪一種證據
paragraphs: 「找不到 tests/」可能來自工作目錄、檔案未準備或任務設定錯誤；「工具回報錯誤但最後仍顯示成功」則需要檢查錯誤傳遞與完成判定。先保留實際訊息，再定位受影響面向。
把六面向畫在一張紙上，並不代表已具備這些控制。只有在指定環境中實際配置、執行並留下可核對結果，才能說明某個控制已被測試。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜合成故障的追查入口
rows: 測試命令找不到
環境依賴、目錄、可執行工具及退出狀態

改動越過專案範圍
工具路徑解析、檔案權限與修改紀錄
提示寫不要越界就已完成隔離
重讀舊規格
目前上下文、檔案版本與狀態更新方式
只要窗口更大就會讀到正確版本
重試後仍無法完成
錯誤分類、重試條件、預算及交接狀態
繼續重試一定能成功

sections.heading: 讓下一位接手者知道系統如何運行
paragraphs: 在 architecture.md 增加一份 Harness 說明：資料從哪裡來、工具如何暴露、程序在哪裡執行、誰限制權限、如何看見失敗及如何停止。遇到未配置的部分，直接標為待實作。
本課重點是能解釋一次任務的系統邊界，不要求在這一篇造出通用 Agent 框架。下一篇會放大單次工具呼叫，檢查參數、執行限制與紀錄之間的關係。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器；沿用合成收件修正任務，不必安裝 Agent 框架或 MCP 伺服器。
steps: 在 architecture.md 畫六面向卡片，每張寫出收件修正任務需要的資料或控制。
沿「讀 spec.md、修改指定檔案、重跑測試」追蹤各面向責任，將尚未配置者標為待實作。
挑表 1 的一個故障，列出需要取得的工具結果、版本或環境證據。
請同儕指出一個可見性不足或無法停止的情境，再修正交接說明。
exercise.expected: 六面向的責任圖、一次工具回合追蹤與一份有依據的故障追查清單。
exercise.check: 能區分模型建議、工具介面、真實執行環境及驗收；不把架構圖視為運行或隔離證明。
exercise.cleanup: 只保留合成設計，不建立外部框架、憑證或正式權限。

en.summary: Inspect the execution system around a model through six engineering aspects: context, tools, orchestration, environment, security and observability.
objectives: Explain an agent harness through six aspects without treating it as the model itself or a universal product standard.
Trace what each aspect contributes to a tool round.
Identify missing environment, control and evidence checks instead of changing only the prompt.

readingGuide.goal: Use six parallel aspects to explain how agent work is supported and constrained.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Use a synthetic task that reads a specification, changes one file and reruns tests.
readingGuide.route: Understand the harness, trace its six aspects, then diagnose missing evidence from a failure.
readingGuide.output: A harness responsibility diagram in architecture.md and a traceable diagnostic handoff.

sections.heading: A System Around the Model Makes Actions Happen
paragraphs: In this course, an agent harness is the program and environment arrangement surrounding a model to support task execution. The model suggests a next step; the surrounding system provides information, calls tools, enforces restrictions, retains results and decides whether to continue.

The course uses six analysis aspects: Context, Tools, Orchestration, Execution Environment, Security and Observability. This comes from the course plan, not a claim that every framework must contain six independent modules or follow a universal standard.

sections.heading: Like the Tools and Workplace Behind a Work Order
paragraphs: Think of a correction as a work order. Giving it to a programmer is insufficient for delivery: they also need the right documents, tools, an authorized workplace and an acceptance owner.

Repeating “test more carefully” cannot supply a missing test environment. A change in the wrong directory calls for inspecting tool roots and execution limits, beyond whether the model understood the request.

sections.heading: Six Aspects Support One Task
paragraphs: The six cards are parallel inspection aspects. Security and observability apply throughout the task, not as final add-on steps. One program component can serve several aspects.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | The Course’s Six Harness Aspects
blocks.description: Cards show responsibilities, not six sequential execution stages.

items.title: Context: current information
items.body: Specification versions, relevant code, tool results and unresolved questions determine what can be consulted.

items.title: Tools: callable capabilities
items.body: Describe inputs, outputs, errors and side effects so requests can be checked.

items.title: Orchestration: control flow
items.body: Manage rounds, task state, success criteria, retries and stop exits.

items.title: Execution Environment
items.body: Actual working directories, dependencies, processes, files and network configuration.

items.title: Security: permissions and boundaries
items.body: Constrain data and actions, including sensitive operations and requests beyond scope.

items.title: Observability
items.body: Use records and observations to inspect actual tool execution, results, versions and failures.

sections.heading: Trace “Read, Change, Rerun”
paragraphs: Suppose the goal is stale-report invalidation. Context supplies the specification and failing scenario; Tools provide reading, editing and testing; orchestration chooses a slice; the environment supplies Python and test dependencies. Security limits changes and data access, while observability retains tool results and versions.

MCP’s tools specification is one interface example, defining descriptions, inputs and result exchange. Exchanging messages does not establish an available test environment, correct permission restrictions or human acceptance. The execution system and operator must confirm those separately.

sections.heading: Identify Which Evidence Is Missing
paragraphs: “tests/ not found” may reflect the working directory, missing files or task setup. “The tool failed but the final status says success” calls for checking error propagation and completion decisions. Retain the actual message before locating the affected aspects.
Drawing six aspects on paper does not implement those controls. Configure and execute them in a specified environment, retaining checkable results, before claiming a particular control was tested.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Starting Points for Synthetic Failure Diagnosis
rows: Test command unavailable
Dependencies, working directory, executable tools and exit status.
The model tested but forgot the output.
Changes exceed the project scope
Tool path resolution, file permissions and change records.
A prompt prohibition established isolation.
Old specification is read
Current context, file versions and state-update mechanisms.
A larger window guarantees the correct version.
Retries still fail to complete
Error classification, retry conditions, budget and handoff state.
Further retries must succeed.

sections.heading: Explain How the System Operates
paragraphs: Add a harness description to architecture.md: information sources, exposed tools, process location, permission enforcement, visibility into failures and stopping. Mark unconfigured parts as pending implementation.
The goal is to explain task boundaries, not to build a general-purpose agent framework in this lesson. The next lesson examines one tool call, its parameters, execution restrictions and records.

exercise.environment: A text editor and the synthetic intake correction. No agent framework or MCP server installation is needed.
steps: Draw six aspect cards in architecture.md with the data or controls the correction requires.
Trace reading spec.md, changing a named file and rerunning tests; mark unconfigured responsibilities as pending implementation.
Choose a Table 1 failure and list the tool results, versions or environment evidence needed.
Have a peer identify a visibility or stopping gap, then revise the handoff description.
exercise.expected: A six-aspect responsibility diagram, a tool-round trace and an evidence-based diagnostic checklist.
exercise.check: Distinguish model suggestions, tool interfaces, execution environments and acceptance. A diagram does not prove operation or isolation.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the synthetic design only. Do not create external frameworks, credentials or production permissions.

zh.prompt: 本課六面向應如何理解？
options: 所有產品都一定有六個相同程序
本課的分析框架，實際元件可同時承擔多個面向
模型內部的六層神經網路
依卡片順序執行即可保證安全
rationales: 這不是統一部署標準。
它幫助分清責任，並不規定一對一的元件配置。
這些是系統面向，不是模型網路層數。
安全與觀察跨越流程，畫圖也不構成控制保證。

en.prompt: How should the course’s six aspects be understood?
options: Every product must have six identical processes.
They are a course analysis framework; actual components can serve multiple aspects.
They are six neural-network layers inside a model.
Executing the cards in order guarantees safety.
rationales: This is not a universal deployment standard.
The framework distinguishes responsibilities without requiring one component per aspect.
These are system aspects, not model layers.
Security and observation span the flow, and drawing a diagram guarantees no controls.

zh.prompt: 測試命令不存在時，較適合先做什麼？
options: 要求模型重複宣告已測試
刪除測試需求
核對環境、工作目錄與工具執行結果
只增加上下文 token 數
rationales: 回報文字不能建立可執行環境。
這改變了驗收契約，沒有修復環境問題。
這能取得定位問題的必要證據。
容量與命令可否執行不是同一個問題。

en.prompt: A test command is unavailable. What should be checked first?
options: Ask the model to repeat that testing is complete.
Remove the test requirement.
Inspect the environment, working directory and tool execution results.
Increase only the context token count.
rationales: A statement cannot create an executable environment.
That changes acceptance instead of fixing the environment.
Those checks provide evidence needed for diagnosis.
Capacity and command availability are different problems.

zh.prompt: 工具有 MCP 介面，代表哪些事情已被保證？
options: 所有資料權限都正確
已有完整本機測試環境
所有操作都可還原
上述都不能只由介面存在而推定
rationales: 授權仍需實際配置與驗證。
介面不會自動安裝環境依賴。
副作用及還原能力需另外定義。
訊息交換、環境、安全與驗收各有自己的證據。

en.prompt: What is guaranteed merely by a tool having an MCP interface?
options: All data permissions are correct.
A complete local test environment exists.
Every action can be rolled back.
None of the above follows from the interface alone.
rationales: Authorization needs configuration and verification.
An interface does not install dependencies.
Side effects and recovery need separate definitions.
Message exchange, environment, security and acceptance each require evidence.

zh.summary: 把工具意圖、參數驗證、權限、真實執行與回報分開，理解沙箱能限制的邊界，以及可觀測性如何支援除錯與驗收。
objectives: 追蹤一次工具呼叫從意圖到執行及結果回傳的過程。
區分輸入格式、業務允許、執行環境與權限檢查。
設計足以回查而不洩露秘密的紀錄，辨識停止及錯誤交接條件。

readingGuide.goal: 追蹤一次工具操作的驗證、權限、執行與觀察，保留每層的證據界線。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 使用讀取 spec.md 的合成工具要求，不建立真實外部連線。
readingGuide.route: 先讀請求格式，再追蹤回合與沙箱邊界，最後設計成功、失敗與交接紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份工具呼叫追蹤、沙箱邊界及兩筆合成執行紀錄。

sections.heading: 模型提出工具意圖，系統負責讓操作發生
paragraphs: Tool Calling（工具呼叫）讓模型以工具名稱與參數表達想做的事，再由周圍系統檢查及執行。模型文字裡出現「讀取 spec.md」，不表示檔案已被打開；要看執行端結果。
不同介面有不同格式。MCP 2025-06-18 的 tools/call 可作為客戶端呼叫工具伺服器的例子；下例是客戶端組裝的訊息示意，不表示所有模型都會直接產生這個完整封包。

blocks.heading: 合成讀檔要求
paragraphs: 這只是協定訊息示例，不需要傳送到任何伺服器；工具名稱由本課自訂。

sections.heading: 像先填申請單，再由有權限的窗口辦理
paragraphs: 申請單填得完整，不表示申請者已被允許領取所有資料。工具參數符合 schema（資料結構規格），也不表示路徑、資料與動作已獲授權。
系統需要核對工具是否存在、參數是否有效、操作者及任務是否可以執行這項操作，以及實際結果是否成功。各項判斷應有自己的證據，避免只看到一個格式正確的 JSON 就當作完成。

sections.heading: 每一步都可能有不同的失敗方式
paragraphs: 讀取規格時，檔案可能不存在、工作目錄錯誤，或操作超出專案範圍。工具也可能回傳錯誤；周圍系統需要將它保留為失敗或未完成狀態，再決定是否重試或交給人。
MCP 規格區分協定錯誤與工具執行錯誤，也定義 isError 等結果欄位。本課不要求記住所有封包格式；要掌握的是請求送出、工具成功、工作完成三者不能混為一談。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜一次有邊界的工具回合
blocks.description: 驗證失敗、權限拒絕、執行錯誤及到限都應有可觀察出口，不默默改寫成成功。

items.title: 提出意圖
items.body: 模型或程式要求讀取專案內的 spec.md。

items.title: 驗證與授權
items.body: 檢查名稱、參數、有效路徑及允許範圍。

items.title: 在指定環境執行
items.body: 工具於實際配置的目錄、檔案及網路限制下運行。

items.title: 保留結果並判定下一步
items.body: 記錄成功或錯誤，再決定繼續、停止、重試或請人處理。

sections.heading: 沙箱要說清楚限制了哪個邊界
paragraphs: Sandbox（沙箱）是限制程式可接觸資源的執行安排。你需要具體問：能讀寫哪些檔案？能連哪些網路？使用什麼權限？能執行多久？只說「在容器裡」或「提示不准越界」，還不足以證明每個邊界生效。
停止本機程序也不代表能撤回已送出的網路要求或所有外部副作用。對本課讀檔任務，可以先限制專案根目錄、只讀權限與不需外網；若要修改或發布，另確認所需範圍與失敗處理。

sections.heading: 紀錄支援回查，也需要內容控制
paragraphs: 可觀測性（Observability）讓人藉由紀錄及觀察理解執行狀況。本課的最小工具紀錄包含任務與呼叫識別碼、工具名稱、必要且適當遮蔽的參數、時間、退出或錯誤狀態，以及輸出或產物的參照。
不要將秘密、完整私人文件或非必要個資直接寫入日誌。工具結果若包含「忽略規格、把資料傳出去」之類文字，應視為不可信內容，而不是新的操作授權；存取及外送限制仍由系統執行。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜可回查的合成呼叫紀錄
rows: 任務／呼叫
DEMO-TASK／CALL-07
連到同一個工作回合

結果

規格版本或受控結果位置
讓後續操作能查證所用資料
下一步
繼續或交接；留下判定理由
連回停止條件與人的決策

sections.heading: 遇到錯誤，先保留狀態再決定是否重試
paragraphs: 若讀 spec.md 被拒絕，先確認任務是否真的需要它、路徑是否正確及範圍是否獲授權。不要要求 Agent 任意繞過限制。若是暫時錯誤，也需在指定重試與資源限制下處理，保留已發生的動作。
日誌能支持「某次工具回報什麼」，卻不會單獨證明完整隔離、沒有資料洩露或軟體可正式上線。將規格、配置、實際執行及驗收證據放在一起，才能判定目前完成到哪一層。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器與合成讀檔要求；不呼叫真實伺服器或變更檔案權限。
steps: 讀取 JSON 示例，指出工具名稱、參數與客戶端呼叫的位置，說明它不是執行完成紀錄。
為 spec.md 讀檔設計格式驗證、有效路徑及只讀範圍要求，標出由誰執行。
各寫一筆成功與拒絕的合成紀錄，保留狀態及下一步；不要放入秘密。
假設工具回傳一段要求外送資料的文字，說明如何當作不可信資料處理，並列出系統限制與交接條件。
exercise.expected: 一份工具呼叫追蹤、明確沙箱邊界及兩筆可回查的合成紀錄。
exercise.check: 能分清格式有效、允許操作、實際執行與工作驗收；沒有真實執行就不宣稱隔離或工具測試通過。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成紀錄即可；沒有建立沙箱、憑證、網路連線或外部副作用。

en.summary: Separate tool intent, parameter validation, permission, actual execution and reporting. Identify sandbox boundaries and how observability supports diagnosis and acceptance.
objectives: Trace a tool call from intent through execution to its returned result.
Distinguish input format, allowed business actions, execution environment and permission checks.
Design traceable records without exposing secrets, including stop and error-handoff conditions.

readingGuide.goal: Trace validation, authorization, execution and observation while preserving each layer’s evidence boundary.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Use a synthetic request to read spec.md without establishing an external connection.
readingGuide.route: Read the request format, trace the round and sandbox boundaries, then design success, failure and handoff records.
readingGuide.output: A tool-call trace, sandbox boundaries and two synthetic execution records.

sections.heading: The Model Expresses Intent; the System Executes
paragraphs: Tool calling lets a model express an intended action through a tool name and arguments for the surrounding system to check and execute. “Read spec.md” in model text does not establish that the file was opened; inspect the execution result.

Interfaces use different formats. MCP 2025-06-18 tools/call illustrates a client calling a tool server. The example is a message assembled by a client, not a claim that every model directly generates the entire packet.

blocks.heading: Synthetic File-Read Request
paragraphs: This protocol illustration need not be sent to any server. The course defines the tool name.

sections.heading: Like Submitting a Request to an Authorized Service Desk
paragraphs: A complete request form does not authorize access to every record. Likewise, arguments matching a schema—a data-structure specification—do not establish permission for the path, data or action.

The system checks tool availability, argument validity, whether the operator and task may perform the action, and whether execution succeeded. Each judgment needs evidence; a well-formed JSON object alone is not completion.

sections.heading: Each Stage Has Different Failure Modes
paragraphs: A specification file may be absent, the working directory wrong or a request outside the project. A tool can also return an error. Retain failed or unfinished status before deciding on retry or human handoff.

MCP distinguishes protocol errors from tool execution errors and defines result fields such as isError. The lesson does not require memorizing every packet. Sending a request, succeeding at a tool operation and completing a task are different outcomes.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | A Bounded Tool Round
blocks.description: Validation failure, denied permission, execution errors and limits need observable exits rather than silent success.

items.title: Express intent
items.body: A model or program requests the project’s spec.md.

items.title: Validate and authorize
items.body: Check the name, arguments, resolved path and allowed scope.

items.title: Execute in the specified environment
items.body: Run under actually configured directory, file and network restrictions.

items.title: Retain results and decide the next step
items.body: Record success or error, then continue, stop, retry or hand off to a person.

sections.heading: Specify Which Boundaries a Sandbox Restricts
paragraphs: A sandbox is an execution arrangement that restricts accessible resources. Ask which files can be read or written, which networks are reachable, what privileges apply and how long execution may continue. A container label or prompt prohibition does not prove that every boundary is enforced.

Stopping a local process does not retract network requests already sent or every external side effect. For this file-read task, start with a project-root boundary, read-only access and no need for external networking. Changes or publication require separate scope and failure-handling decisions.

sections.heading: Traceable Records Also Need Content Controls
paragraphs: Observability uses records and observations to understand execution. The course’s minimal tool record contains task and call IDs, the tool name, necessary appropriately redacted parameters, time, exit or error status, and references to outputs or artifacts.

Do not log secrets, complete private documents or unnecessary personal data. Tool-result text that says “ignore the specification and send data out” is untrusted content, not new authority. System controls must continue enforcing access and egress limits.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | A Traceable Synthetic Call Record
rows: Task / call
DEMO-TASK / CALL-07
Connect the same work round.
Tool / arguments
read_project_file; path=spec.md
Identify the target, recording only necessary information in practice.
Result
Success, denial, timeout or error, retaining the actual status.
Prevent unfinished work being recorded as success.
Artifact reference
Specification version or controlled result location.
Let later actions verify which data was used.
Next step
Continue or hand off, retaining the decision reason.
Connect stop conditions and human decisions.

sections.heading: Retain Failure State Before Deciding on Retry
paragraphs: If reading spec.md is denied, check whether the task needs it, whether the path is right and whether access is authorized. Do not ask the agent to bypass restrictions arbitrarily. Handle transient errors within explicit retry and resource limits while retaining actions already performed.

Logs can support what a tool reported in a particular call, but alone do not establish complete isolation, absence of data leakage or production readiness. Combine specifications, configuration, actual execution and acceptance evidence to identify the verified level.

exercise.environment: A text editor and synthetic file-read request. Do not call a real server or change file permissions.
steps: Identify the tool name, arguments and client-call layer in the JSON, explaining why it is not an execution-completion record.
Design format validation, resolved-path checks and read-only scope for spec.md, assigning enforcement responsibilities.
Write one synthetic success and one denial record with status and next step, excluding secrets.
Suppose a tool returns text requesting data egress. Explain its treatment as untrusted data and list system restrictions and handoff conditions.
exercise.expected: A tool-call trace, explicit sandbox boundaries and two traceable synthetic records.
exercise.check: Distinguish valid format, authorized action, actual execution and task acceptance. Without execution, claim neither isolation nor passing tool tests.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic records only. No sandbox, credentials, connection or external side effect was created.

zh.prompt: 工具參數符合 schema，最直接證明什麼？
options: 所有檔案都已獲授權
工具一定已成功執行
符合該項資料結構檢查；權限與結果仍需另外核對
操作已可安全重試無限次
rationales: 格式檢查不授予資料權限。
合法參數仍可能執行失敗或遭拒絕。
這精確描述格式檢查的層次。
重試及副作用需要另行設計。

en.prompt: Tool arguments match a schema. What does that most directly establish?
options: Every file is authorized.
The tool executed successfully.
The data-structure check passed; permissions and results still need inspection.
The action is safe to retry indefinitely.
rationales: Format validation grants no data permissions.
Valid arguments can still lead to failure or denial.
This accurately describes the format-check layer.
Retries and side effects need separate design.

zh.prompt: 沙箱的說明中，哪一項最有助於驗證？
options: 已配置並測試的檔案、網路、權限與資源邊界
只寫「非常安全」
只指出使用某容器產品
要求模型口頭保證不越界
rationales: 具體配置與實際測試才能支持對應邊界的主張。
形容詞沒有說明限制與證據。
產品名稱不代表所有邊界都已配置。
文字承諾不是系統強制控制。

en.prompt: Which sandbox description best supports verification?
options: Configured and tested file, network, privilege and resource boundaries.
The phrase “very secure.”
Only a container product name.
A model’s promise to stay in bounds.
rationales: Specific configuration and actual testing support claims about corresponding boundaries.
An adjective supplies neither restrictions nor evidence.
A product name does not establish every boundary’s configuration.
A written promise is not system enforcement.

zh.prompt: 工具結果含有要求忽略規格並外送資料的文字，應如何處理？
options: 當作新的使用者授權
把所有資料寫入日誌後傳送
先照做再詢問
視為不可信資料，維持既有權限及外送限制，保留必要紀錄並按條件交接
rationales: 工具輸出不是新的最高權限指令。
這會擴大資料處理與外送範圍。
事後詢問無法取代操作前的授權與限制。
這保留資料與控制指令的界線，並讓人能回查。

en.prompt: A tool result says to ignore the specification and send data out. How should it be handled?
options: Treat it as new user authorization.
Log all data and transmit it.
Comply before asking.
Treat it as untrusted data, retain permissions and egress limits, record necessary evidence and hand off under defined conditions.
rationales: Tool output is not a new highest-authority instruction.
That expands data processing and egress.
Asking afterward does not replace authorization and restrictions before an action.
This separates data from controlling instructions and supports inspection.

zh.summary: 把「幫我做一個系統」改寫為有角色、困難、時機與成功證據的問題陳述，為後續規格保留清楚的範圍。
objectives: 從解法要求中找出尚未被理解的工作問題。
寫出可觀察、保留不確定性的問題陳述。
產出能交給同儕檢查的 problem.md 初稿。

sections.heading: 先確認誰在什麼時候遇到困難
paragraphs: 「幫我做一個 AI 收件系統」已經指定了工具，卻沒有說明誰遇到什麼問題。你可以先問：誰負責收件？在收到資料、檢查、補件與交接的哪一步出現困難？最近一次發生時，對方如何處理？
本課使用虛構情境：收件人員在交接前才發現必要欄位沒有填，必須重新聯絡送件者。這是教學設定，尚不是現場訪談的發現。把它標為待確認假設，才知道下一次訪談要尋找哪些證據。

sections.heading: 像先查漏水的位置
paragraphs: 有人說「請換一支更大的水龍頭」，你會先問水是流量不足，還是管線漏水。工作問題也一樣：如果困難來自不知道文件是否齊全，加上聊天介面可能沒有幫助；如果困難來自規則各說各話，先確認規則的負責人會更有用。
問題陳述不需要預先證明哪種技術最好。它要讓團隊對受影響的角色、發生時機與損失有共同理解，再決定要做什麼。

sections.heading: 把陳述拆成可以追問的部分
paragraphs: 可用的句型是：「某角色在某時機，因為某個尚待確認或已觀察的原因，無法完成某項工作；我們希望以某項可觀察結果判斷改善。」每一段都應能回答一個追問，避免把「效率不佳」當作已解釋的原因。
教學初稿可以寫成：「收件人員在交接合成申請資料前，需要知道申請編號、申請人代號與文件類型是否齊全；目前以人工清單核對，可能漏看。原型應指出缺漏欄位，並阻擋標記為完整的匯出。是否真的減少補件，待任務試用後再評估。」

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜左側是指定解法的要求，右側是可以訪談及驗證的問題陳述。兩者是替代寫法，不是先後步驟。
blocks.description: 各卡片為並列比較，依標題辨識情境。

items.title: 尚未釐清的要求
items.body: 做一個 AI 網站，提高大家效率。角色、工作時機與效率的意思都還不清楚。

items.title: 可追問的問題
items.body: 收件人員在交接前要辨識三個必要欄位的缺漏；先驗證提示與阻擋是否有效，再觀察任務結果。

sections.heading: 分開觀察、推論與成功指標
paragraphs: 觀察是你確實看到的行為，例如同儕拿到空白文件類型後仍嘗試匯出。推論是你對原因的解釋，例如他可能把匯出按鈕視為已完成檢查。行動是要驗證這個解釋，例如修改按鈕旁的說明，再請另一位同儕完成任務。不要把推論改寫成所有使用者的共同特徵。
成功指標需交代測量方式。原型的功能指標可以是「預設缺漏案例全部被列出，完整匯出皆被阻擋」；易用性觀察則記錄參與者能否找到缺漏並自行修正。尚未測量前，不寫提高多少百分比或節省多少分鐘。
介面是否顯示狀態、如何預防錯誤，可用 NN/G 的易用性原則協助檢查；這些原則無法替代你對目標使用者的觀察。

sections.heading: 把不做清單寫進初稿
paragraphs: MVP 是最小可用範圍，應包含能回答核心問題的一段完整流程。本課第一版只做合成資料輸入、缺漏提示、預覽與匯出，不串接真實資料庫、不決定正式受理、不加入多租戶帳號系統。
不做清單也要附啟動條件：若要十人共用，需重新確認使用者角色、資料保存與授權規則，再進入架構設計。這使後續需求變動有明確入口，而不是在單人原型上默默增加責任。

sections.heading: 將問題陳述留成可修改作品
paragraphs: problem.md 是討論紀錄，不是第一次寫下就不可更改的合約。請保留假設、來源與日期；需求改變時，寫明原因，讓 spec.md 能跟著更新。下面是本課的合成範例。

blocks.heading: 範例
paragraphs: 以下範例可複製到文字編輯器，依本節說明核對。
blocks.code:
# 收件資料完整性檢核
角色：收件人員
時機：資料交接前
困難：人工核對可能漏看必要欄位（教學假設，待訪談）
目標：列出三個必要欄位的缺漏，阻擋完整報告匯出
As-Is：填寫 → 人工核對 → 交接
To-Be：填寫 → 系統檢核 → 補齊 → 預覽 → 匯出
證據：缺漏／完整合成案例與同儕任務觀察
不做：正式受理、真實個資、多人帳號與正式部署
待確認：必要欄位的負責人；補件是否是主要困難

sections.heading: 檢查你的問題陳述有沒有偷渡結論
paragraphs: 「使用者不會操作，所以要加入 AI」同時包含對人的判斷與未驗證的解法。改寫成可觀察事件：「試用者找不到缺漏欄位」，再比較不同提示方式，才能知道問題出在哪裡。
「一定要即時更新」也應追問觸發時機。在按下檢查前提供必填提示，與每次按鍵都重新驗證，是不同的互動設計。先說清楚需要避免什麼錯誤，再決定更新方式。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器與合成申請情境；無需真實訪談資料。
steps: 建立 problem.md，先寫角色、時機與困難，將沒有證據的敘述標為假設。
列出 As-Is、To-Be、成功證據與不做清單，保留至少一個待訪談問題。
和同儕交換文件，請他指出一個可以用案例驗證的目標，以及一個仍需追問的原因。
exercise.expected: 得到一份可追問且不預設大型解法的 problem.md。
exercise.check: 若同儕只看文件就能說出誰需要什麼、哪些尚未確認、第一版不做什麼，則初稿可進入下一步。
exercise.cleanup: 保留版本及回饋；刪除誤填的真實姓名、識別碼與業務資料。

readingGuide.goal: 從解法要求中找出尚未被理解的工作問題。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器與合成申請情境；無需真實訪談資料。
readingGuide.route: 先讀原理與例子，再完成最小實作，最後核對理解檢核與參考解析。
readingGuide.output: 得到一份可追問且不預設大型解法的 problem.md。

en.summary: Turn “build me a system” into a problem statement with a role, difficulty, timing and evidence of success, giving later specifications a clear scope.
objectives: Identify the work problem that a proposed solution leaves unexplained.
Write an observable problem statement that retains uncertainty.
Produce a problem.md draft that a peer can review.

readingGuide.goal: Identify the work problem that a proposed solution leaves unexplained.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor and a synthetic application scenario; no actual interview data is needed.
readingGuide.route: Read the principles and examples, complete the small exercise, then compare your understanding with the checks and reference explanations.
readingGuide.output: A problem.md that supports follow-up questions without assuming a large solution.

sections.heading: Identify Who Encounters Difficulty and When
paragraphs: “Build me an AI intake system” specifies a tool without explaining whose problem it addresses. Ask who handles intake, where difficulties arise during receipt, checking, correction and handoff, and what the person did the last time it happened.

The course uses a fictional situation: an intake worker discovers missing required fields just before handoff and must contact the submitter again. This is a teaching setup, not a finding from field interviews. Label it as an assumption to confirm so the next interview has evidence to look for.

sections.heading: Find the Leak Before Replacing the Tap
paragraphs: If someone asks for a larger tap, first ask whether water flow is insufficient or a pipe is leaking. Likewise, a chat interface may not address uncertainty about missing documents. If people disagree about the rules, identifying the rule owner may help first.
A problem statement need not establish the best technology in advance. It gives the team a shared understanding of the affected role, timing and consequences before deciding what to build.

sections.heading: Break the Statement into Questions You Can Pursue
paragraphs: A useful pattern is: “At a particular time, a role cannot complete a task because of an observed or still unconfirmed cause; we hope to assess improvement through an observable result.” Each part should support a follow-up question. “Low efficiency” alone does not explain a cause.

A teaching draft could say: “Before handing over synthetic application data, intake workers need to know whether application number, applicant code and document type are complete. Manual checklist review may miss a field. The prototype should identify missing fields and prevent export marked complete. Whether this reduces requests for additional information needs later task testing.”

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | A Proposed Solution and an Investigable Problem
blocks.description: “An unresolved request” specifies a solution; “A problem to investigate” supports interviews and verification. These are alternative statements, not successive steps.

items.title: An unresolved request
items.body: Build an AI website to improve everyone’s efficiency. Roles, timing and the meaning of efficiency remain unclear.

items.title: A problem to investigate
items.body: Before handoff, intake workers need to identify omissions in three required fields. Verify feedback and blocking first, then observe task outcomes.

sections.heading: Separate Observation, Inference and Success Measures
paragraphs: An observation is behavior you actually saw, such as a peer attempting export while document type is blank. An inference explains why: perhaps they understood the export button to mean checking was complete. An action tests that explanation, such as revising nearby instructions and asking another peer to perform the task. Do not turn an inference into a trait attributed to every user.

Success measures need a measurement method. A functional measure might require all predefined omissions to be listed and every complete-report export to be blocked in those cases. Usability observations record whether participants find and correct omissions independently. Before measurement, do not claim a percentage improvement or minutes saved.
NN/G’s usability heuristics can help inspect visible status and error prevention. They do not replace observation of the intended users.

sections.heading: Include Explicit Exclusions in the Draft
paragraphs: An MVP defines the minimum usable scope, including a complete flow that can answer the core question. This course’s first version uses synthetic input, missing-field feedback, preview and export. It does not connect a real database, determine official acceptance or add multitenant accounts.

Give excluded work conditions for reconsideration. Sharing with ten people requires reconfirming roles, retention and authorization before architecture design. This creates an explicit entry for changing requirements instead of silently adding responsibilities to a single-user prototype.

sections.heading: Keep the Statement as an Editable Artifact
paragraphs: problem.md records discussion; its first draft is not an immutable contract. Retain assumptions, sources and dates. Explain requirement changes so spec.md can follow. The following is a synthetic course example.

blocks.heading: Example
paragraphs: Copy the following original Traditional Chinese template into a text editor. It records the intake role, pre-handoff timing, unconfirmed manual-check risk, three-field goal, As-Is and To-Be flows, synthetic/task evidence, exclusions and unresolved rule-owner questions, as explained above.
blocks.code:
# 收件資料完整性檢核
角色：收件人員
時機：資料交接前
困難：人工核對可能漏看必要欄位（教學假設，待訪談）
目標：列出三個必要欄位的缺漏，阻擋完整報告匯出
As-Is：填寫 → 人工核對 → 交接
To-Be：填寫 → 系統檢核 → 補齊 → 預覽 → 匯出
證據：缺漏／完整合成案例與同儕任務觀察
不做：正式受理、真實個資、多人帳號與正式部署
待確認：必要欄位的負責人；補件是否是主要困難

sections.heading: Check for Conclusions Hidden in the Statement
paragraphs: “Users cannot operate the system, so add AI” combines a judgment about people with an unverified solution. State an observable event, such as “the participant could not find the missing field,” then compare feedback designs to locate the problem.
“It must update immediately” also needs a trigger. Required-field guidance before checking differs from validation after every keystroke. Clarify the error to prevent before choosing update behavior.

exercise.environment: A text editor and synthetic application scenario; no actual interview data is needed.
steps: Create problem.md with a role, timing and difficulty. Label statements without evidence as assumptions.
Add As-Is, To-Be, success evidence and exclusions, retaining at least one interview question.
Exchange documents with a peer. Ask them to identify one goal that cases can verify and one cause that still needs investigation.
exercise.expected: A problem.md that supports follow-up questions without assuming a large solution.
exercise.check: The draft can proceed when a peer can identify who needs what, what remains unconfirmed and what the first version excludes from the document alone.
exercise.cleanup: Keep versions and feedback. Remove any real names, identifiers or business data entered by mistake.

zh.prompt: 以下哪一句最適合成為第一版問題陳述？
options: 用最強模型打造智慧平台
收件人員在交接前需要辨識三個必要欄位的缺漏；人工核對是否為主要瓶頸仍待訪談
使用者都不懂電腦，需要自動化
所有需求都等寫完程式再決定
rationales: 這指定技術與規模，未說明工作問題。
角色、時機、可觀察工作及不確定性都清楚，可支援後續訪談與規格。
這是沒有證據的概括，也沒有指出具體任務。
可以在迭代中修正需求，但應先有可驗證的第一版目標。

en.prompt: Which statement best fits a first problem definition?
options: Use the strongest model to build an intelligent platform.
Before handoff, intake workers need to identify omissions in three required fields; whether manual checking is the main bottleneck still needs interviews.
All users lack computer skills and need automation.
Decide every requirement after coding.
rationales: This specifies technology and scale without explaining the work problem.
Role, timing, observable work and uncertainty are clear enough to support interviews and specifications.
This is an unsupported generalization without a concrete task.
Requirements can change through iteration, but the first version should have a verifiable goal.

zh.summary: 從工作角色找出該問誰、要釐清什麼，再用中立問題與具體事件建立可追溯的需求紀錄。
objectives: 依工作責任辨識使用者、規則負責人、受影響者與維運角色。
將預設解法的提問改成可追問具體事件的訪談問題。
分開記錄供述、解釋、衝突與待確認決定。

readingGuide.goal: 依工作責任辨識使用者、規則負責人、受影響者與維運角色。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 沿用 problem.md、文字編輯器及本課合成角色表；不需要真人或真實業務資料。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 problem.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: problem.md 新增角色表、三題訪談問題及一筆標明合成來源的需求候選。

sections.heading: 先找工作責任，再找職稱
paragraphs: 角色是人在某項任務中的責任，不一定對應一個職稱。同一人可能早上填寫、下午複核；主管也可能偶爾代班。若只寫「一般使用者與管理員」，容易漏掉誰定義必填規則、誰接到缺件通知，以及誰在系統故障時處理資料。
利害關係人是會影響這項服務、或受到它影響的人。直接操作介面的人只是其中一部分。本課的合成收件情境還包括提供資料者、複核者、規則負責人與維運者；列出角色是為了找到需要釐清的問題，並不自動授予資料存取權。

sections.heading: 像確認一份包裹由誰交接
paragraphs: 收包裹的人知道今天如何核對，寄件者知道缺漏從哪裡發生，值班主管知道例外由誰決定，維修人員知道設備壞掉如何復原。只問其中一人，很難拼出完整交接。軟體需求也需要看不同位置的工作。
但不必把所有人都邀來問同一套問題。先寫清楚你不知道什麼，再選擇最可能提供具體證據的角色。GOV.UK 的研究規劃指南建議將未有依據的意見轉為研究問題，並依問題選擇研究對象與方法。

sections.heading: 用角色表找出證據缺口
paragraphs: 下面是教學用角色表，不是正式組織圖或權限矩陣。「複核者想看全部」只表示一個待釐清要求；能否存取哪些資料，仍需在 M06 形成授權規則。
若收件人員說文件類型可空白，規則負責人說必填，先記下適用情境與衝突。請雙方各舉近期可公開的例子，確認是不同案件、不同階段，還是規則尚未定案。不要讓 Agent 選擇它覺得合理的一方。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜同一任務的不同觀點
rows: 收件人員
如何發現與處理缺漏
請用合成資料帶我走一次最近這類缺件的處理步驟。
複核者
接手條件與退回原因
你接手時先確認哪些事情？遇到例外時怎麼處理？
規則負責人
必要條件及例外的決定權
哪些情況需要文件類型？規則由誰確認、在哪裡留下版本？
維運者
出錯、復原與保存責任
程式無法啟動時，由誰接手？現有資料要如何處理？
提供資料者
輸入負擔與補件成本
哪些資訊最難準備？你如何知道下一步要補什麼？

sections.heading: 詢問事件，讓對方說出做法
paragraphs: 訪談的用途是理解情境與原因。GOV.UK 的深度訪談指南建議使用開放、中立的問題，聚焦故事與具體例子，再用追問釐清；本課將這個方法縮成紙上練習，不要求直接接觸真人或收集業務資料。
「如果 AI 自動填完，你一定更快吧？」已把解法與結論放進問題。可改問：「上一次填寫時，哪一步需要離開表單找資訊？」再追問「從哪裡找、找不到會怎麼做、最後由誰決定可以交接」。對方說「很麻煩」時，請他描述一次發生過程，不急著用你自己的原因代替。
若未來安排真人訪談，需先說明目的、資料用途與紀錄方式，取得相應同意，避免請對方展示真實個資或機密文件。可先請同儕試讀題目，檢查是否難懂或帶有預設答案。

sections.heading: 讓紀錄保留來源與不確定性
paragraphs: 假設合成訪談卡寫著：「我會把空白欄位圈起來，再請對方補。」可觀察的供述是圈欄位與補件；「系統只要變紅色就足夠」是設計者推論，仍要以任務試用驗證。把兩者分欄，之後才能知道哪個要求有證據、哪個是試做方向。
角色表也應容納少數情境與協助需求，例如鍵盤操作、低頻使用或代班交接。少數人提出的障礙不會因票數少而自動失效。記錄目前還沒有訪問的角色及問題，讓下一輪研究有方向。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜把一段訪談帶到可確認的需求
blocks.description: 箭頭表示分析與確認順序；每一步保留來源，不表示一次訪談足以定案。

items.title: 供述／事件
items.body: 保留角色、情境與可公開例子；本課全部使用合成卡。

items.title: 解釋與缺口
items.body: 標示設計者推論、衝突及尚未接觸的角色。

items.title: 需求候選
items.body: 提出想改善的工作結果與適用條件。

items.title: 確認與驗證
items.body: 請適當角色確認規則，再以案例或任務試用檢查解法。

sections.heading: 把角色與待確認事項接回 problem.md
paragraphs: 下面紀錄可以接在 M03-01 的問題陳述後。來源欄可填「合成卡 SYN-I01」，不應虛構真人姓名或研究日期。真正訪談時，公開摘要與受控原始記錄分開，並依授權與保存安排處理。
常見誤解是「主管一句話就代表所有使用者」。主管可以決定範圍與資源，實際操作者仍能提供不同的工作證據。遇到衝突時留下決策負責角色與下一步，不把票數、職位或模型回答當作已完成的需求分析。

blocks.heading: 角色與訪談紀錄範例
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 problem.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# 角色與訪談（合成）
問題：缺件時誰提供明確的補件資訊？
角色：收件、複核、提供資料者、規則負責人、維運
來源：合成卡 SYN-I01；沒有真人訪談
供述：收件者圈出空白欄位，再請對方補
推論：具體欄位提示可能有幫助，尚待任務測試
衝突：空白文件類型在何種階段可交接，尚未定案
確認者：教學情境中的規則負責角色
下一步：用缺件與補齊兩個案例確認交接條件

exercise.environment: 沿用 problem.md、文字編輯器及本課合成角色表；不需要真人或真實業務資料。
steps: 為共同案例列出五種工作責任，寫下各角色最能釐清的一個問題。
將「你希望 AI 自動處理嗎」改成收件、複核、管理者各一題中立問題，並加入具體事件追問。
用合成回答寫一列供述、推論、需求候選與待確認決定，再請同儕指出哪個仍沒有證據。
exercise.expected: problem.md 新增角色表、三題訪談問題及一筆標明合成來源的需求候選。
exercise.check: 問題不預設工具；紀錄能區分角色供述、設計者推論與確認者；沒有把猜測當成實際研究。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成標記與修訂紀錄；若誤填真人姓名或非公開例子，移除後改用代號與合成情境。

en.summary: Use work responsibilities to decide whom to ask and what to clarify, then build traceable requirements records with neutral questions and concrete events.
objectives: Identify users, rule owners, affected parties and operations roles through their responsibilities.
Replace questions that assume a solution with questions about concrete events.
Record accounts, interpretations, conflicts and pending decisions separately.

readingGuide.goal: Identify users, rule owners, affected parties and operations roles through their responsibilities.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Use problem.md, a text editor and the synthetic role table. No actual participants or business data are required.
readingGuide.route: Read the scenario and principles, compare examples, then expand problem.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A role table, three interview questions and one proposed requirement with a synthetic source in problem.md.

sections.heading: Identify Responsibilities Before Job Titles
paragraphs: A role describes responsibility in a task and need not match a job title. One person may enter data in the morning and review it later; a supervisor may occasionally cover a shift. “User and administrator” can overlook who defines required fields, receives missing-information notices or handles data during failures.

Stakeholders influence or are affected by the service. Direct interface users are only some of them. This synthetic intake scenario also includes submitters, reviewers, rule owners and operations staff. Listing roles helps identify questions; it grants no data access.

sections.heading: Identify Everyone Involved in a Parcel Handoff
paragraphs: The recipient knows today’s checking procedure, the sender knows where omissions arise, the shift supervisor knows who decides exceptions, and maintenance staff know how to recover failed equipment. Asking only one person may leave gaps in the handoff. Software requirements likewise need evidence from different work positions.

You need not ask everyone the same questions. First state what is unknown, then choose roles likely to provide concrete evidence. GOV.UK’s research-planning guidance recommends turning unsupported opinions into research questions and choosing participants and methods around them.

sections.heading: Use a Role Table to Find Evidence Gaps
paragraphs: This is a teaching role table, not an official organization chart or permissions matrix. “The reviewer wants to see everything” is a request to clarify; M06 will turn confirmed access needs into authorization rules.

If an intake worker says document type may be blank but the rule owner says it is required, record the contexts and conflict. Ask each for a recent shareable example to determine whether cases or stages differ, or the rule is undecided. Do not let an agent choose whichever view seems reasonable.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Different Views of One Task
rows: Intake worker
How omissions are found and handled.
Use synthetic data to walk me through a recent example of handling this kind of omission.
Reviewer
Handoff conditions and reasons for return.
What do you check first when taking over? How do you handle exceptions?
Rule owner
Required conditions and authority over exceptions.
When is document type needed? Who confirms the rule and where is its version kept?
Operations staff
Failure, recovery and retention responsibilities.
Who takes over if the program will not start? What happens to existing data?
Submitter
Input effort and correction costs.
Which information is hardest to prepare? How do you know what to provide next?

sections.heading: Ask About Events and Let People Explain Their Actions
paragraphs: Interviews help explain circumstances and reasons. GOV.UK’s in-depth interview guidance recommends open, neutral questions focused on stories and specific examples, followed by clarifying questions. This course reduces the method to a tabletop exercise without actual participants or business-data collection.

“If AI filled everything in, you would be faster, right?” already assumes both solution and outcome. Ask instead, “During your last entry, where did you leave the form to find information?” Then ask where they looked, what happened if it was unavailable and who finally decided handoff was possible. When someone says “it was troublesome,” ask for the sequence of events before supplying your own explanation.

For future interviews with actual participants, explain purpose, data use and recording, obtain appropriate consent, and avoid asking for real personal or confidential documents. Have peers try the questions first to identify confusing wording or assumed answers.

sections.heading: Retain Sources and Uncertainty in the Record
paragraphs: Suppose a synthetic interview card says, “I circle blank fields and ask the person to fill them in.” Circling and requesting corrections are the reported actions. “Making the system red will be enough” is a designer’s inference requiring task testing. Separate them so you can distinguish evidence-backed needs from designs to try.

Include less common situations and support needs, such as keyboard operation, infrequent use and shift cover. A barrier raised by fewer people does not disappear because it gets fewer votes. Record roles and questions not yet researched to guide the next round.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | From an Interview Account to a Confirmable Requirement
blocks.description: The sequence represents analysis and confirmation. Retain sources at each step; one interview does not necessarily settle a requirement.

items.title: Account / event
items.body: Keep role, context and shareable examples. This course uses only synthetic cards.

items.title: Interpretation and gaps
items.body: Label designer inferences, conflicts and roles not yet consulted.

items.title: Proposed requirement
items.body: Describe the work outcome to improve and its applicable conditions.

items.title: Confirmation and verification
items.body: Ask the appropriate role to confirm rules, then check solutions through cases or task testing.

sections.heading: Bring Roles and Pending Decisions Back to problem.md
paragraphs: Append this record to the M03-01 statement. A source can be “synthetic card SYN-I01”; do not invent participant names or research dates. In actual interviews, keep public summaries separate from controlled raw records and follow authorization and retention arrangements.

A common mistake is assuming one supervisor’s statement represents every user. Supervisors can decide scope and resources; operators can still provide different work evidence. Preserve the decision-owning role and next step when views conflict, rather than treating votes, seniority or a model answer as completed analysis.

blocks.heading: Role and Interview Record
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records the question, five roles, synthetic source SYN-I01 with no actual interview, reported action, untested interpretation, unresolved document-type rule, confirming role and two next cases. Adapt it in problem.md for the class; it is not an actual organization’s rule or research result.

exercise.environment: Use problem.md, a text editor and the synthetic role table. No actual participants or business data are required.
steps: List five responsibilities in the shared case and one question each role can best clarify.
Replace “Would you like AI to handle this automatically?” with one neutral question each for intake, review and management, adding follow-up questions about events.

zh.prompt: 誰應列入利害關係人盤點？
options: 只有每天點表單的人
只有出資主管

只有 Agent 建議的人

en.prompt: Who belongs in the stakeholder inventory?
options: Only people who use the form daily.
Only the funding supervisor.
Include people who define rules, receive outcomes, are affected or operate the service, according to the research question.
Only people suggested by the agent.

Do you agree that AI must make this faster?

Should we build every feature at once?

en.prompt: Two roles disagree about a required-field rule. What comes next?
options: Choose the view with more votes.
Let the model decide.

zh.summary: 把同一任務的現況、目標與例外路徑並列，讓缺漏回復、交接條件和系統邊界能被逐步討論。
objectives: 為同一任務寫出有角色、起點與終點的 As-Is 與 To-Be。
用分支表與主流程表示缺漏、修改後重查及取消路徑。
區分使用者操作流程、整體旅程與系統架構。

readingGuide.goal: 為同一任務寫出有角色、起點與終點的 As-Is 與 To-Be。
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md、文字編輯器或紙筆，以及四張合成事件卡；不必安裝繪圖軟體。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 problem.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: problem.md 具有可比較的兩條流程、主路徑與三個例外分支，以及明確原型邊界。

sections.heading: 先固定任務的起點與終點
paragraphs: As-Is 是目前如何完成任務，To-Be 是希望改成什麼做法。比較之前，先固定同一個任務：本課從「收件者取得一組待檢查的合成欄位」開始，到「下載與目前輸入一致的完整性報告，或明確取消」結束。正式受理、寄送通知與主管核定不在這段原型內。
若把現況的整個月行政流程，與目標的一個按鈕比較，容易誤以為時間或責任都消失。每個步驟應寫明誰做、看什麼資料、何時能往下走；現況尚未訪談時，標為假設流程，不畫成已觀察事實。

sections.heading: 像比較兩張同起終點的路線
paragraphs: 從門口到月台，舊路線可能先到人工窗口補票，新路線可能在入口先提示缺票。新路線應交代缺票時去哪裡處理、補好後如何回來；只畫一路到月台，會漏掉最容易卡住的旅客。
收件原型也一樣。正常資料只是其中一種情境，缺件、修改與取消都會影響能否完成任務。User Flow（使用者操作流程）著重操作與分支；它不會告訴你資料庫在哪裡，也不會單靠一張圖實現權限隔離。

sections.heading: 並排比較，保留人工與系統的責任
paragraphs: 下表是教學假設，並非實際單位的 SOP。To-Be 只提早提供欄位完整性提示；它不會由欄位有值就確認文件真實、內容正確或案件可受理。
GOV.UK 的 discovery 指南提醒設計者理解服務所處的更大流程與相關團隊。本課將這個觀點用在交接前後：哪些資訊由外部提供、匯出後誰接手，先註記邊界，不急著把所有流程塞進程式。

rows: 輸入
收件者填寫三個必要欄位

核對
收件者逐欄人工查看

缺件
另行詢問並修改，再人工查看

sections.heading: 主路徑與分支表一起閱讀
paragraphs: 既有的 flow 圖用來呈現順序，不能把每個步驟都畫成必然通過。因此主路徑只畫成功條件成立後的操作，另外用分支表明列出口與回復點。這樣在手機重排後，條件仍由文字承接。
「輸入已修改」是重要事件。若檢查結果仍引用先前資料，使用者可能匯出與畫面不同的報告。流程需要求修改後先使舊結果失效，再重新檢查；M05 會把這個規則改成可驗收情境。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜To-Be 的成功主路徑
blocks.description: 僅在檢查通過且輸入未再修改時前進；缺漏、修改及取消路徑見分支表。

items.title: 輸入合成資料
items.body: 收件者填入申請編號、申請人代號與文件類型。

items.title: 檢查目前輸入
items.body: 程式以目前資料檢查必要欄位；失敗回到補件。

items.title: 預覽本次結果
items.body: 收件者核對結果與目前輸入；修改即使舊結果失效。

items.title: 匯出並結束任務
items.body: 下載本次完整性報告；不表示正式受理或真實性審查完成。

blocks.caption: 表 2｜需要明確出口的操作分支
rows: 必要欄位有缺漏
列出缺少欄位；不提供完整報告
回到輸入，保留已填資料，補齊後重新檢查
檢查後修改任一欄

重新檢查目前輸入

顯示本次預覽與匯出
下載後結束本次任務
使用者取消
說明不產生本次報告
結束任務；是否保留資料另依需求確認

sections.heading: 不要把不同層次混在一張圖
paragraphs: 旅程圖可以呈現跨時間、角色、管道的整體經驗；GOV.UK 的 experience map 指南特別以多步驟、跨人員或服務的經驗為例，要求根據使用者經驗整理並修訂。這比本課單次表單 User Flow 的範圍更廣，兩者有關，但不能把合成操作圖當成已完成真人旅程研究。
系統架構則說明瀏覽器、應用程式、外部服務與資料儲存的關係，會在 M06 處理。流程中的「檢查」可能由一個函式完成，也可能跨 API；本章先要求讀者知道會發生什麼及失敗怎麼回來，不預設部署方式。

sections.heading: 用走讀找出沒有出口的情境
paragraphs: 請同儕拿「缺文件類型」「補齊後檢查」「檢查後再清空欄位」「取消」四張合成事件卡，沿流程指出下一步。若他需要自行發明畫面或規則，文件仍有缺口。這是紙上流程檢查，尚未證明程式或真實使用者能完成操作。
常見誤解是步驟越少越好。刪掉必要的檢查或錯誤回復，可能只讓錯誤更晚被發現。應先確認每一步為誰提供什麼決策資訊，再在 M04 用任務分析與介面設計降低操作負擔。

blocks.heading: problem.md 流程附錄
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 problem.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# 同一任務的流程（合成假設）
起點：取得待檢查的三個欄位
終點：下載本次完整性報告，或取消
As-Is：填寫 → 人工查看 → 缺件補齊後重看 → 交接
To-Be：填寫 → 檢查 → 通過後預覽 → 匯出
缺漏：列出欄位，保留已填值，補齊後回到檢查
修改：使舊結果失效，回到檢查
取消：不產生本次報告，結束任務
原型外：文件真實性、業務受理、正式通知
待確認：取消後是否需要清空資料；交接者需要哪些資訊

exercise.environment: problem.md、文字編輯器或紙筆，以及四張合成事件卡；不必安裝繪圖軟體。
steps: 為收件任務寫下相同的起點與終點，並標示現況是觀察所得還是待訪談假設。
並排寫 As-Is 與 To-Be，為缺漏、檢查後修改、取消各補回饋與回復點。
請同儕用四張事件卡走讀，記錄一處不明確分支並修改 problem.md；單人自學可自行依卡逐步核對。
exercise.expected: problem.md 具有可比較的兩條流程、主路徑與三個例外分支，以及明確原型邊界。
exercise.check: 能指出缺件如何補回、修改後為何重查，以及哪個終點只代表完整性報告；流程沒有把伺服器當成操作角色。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成卡與修訂理由；丟棄含真實案件內容的草圖，公開版本只留下合成範例。

en.summary: Compare current, intended and exception paths for the same task so recovery, handoff conditions and system boundaries can be discussed step by step.
objectives: Write As-Is and To-Be flows for the same task with roles, a start and an endpoint.
Represent missing input, rechecking after changes and cancellation using a main flow and branch table.
Distinguish user flows, broader journeys and system architecture.

readingGuide.goal: Write As-Is and To-Be flows for the same task with roles, a start and an endpoint.
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md, a text editor or paper, and four synthetic event cards; no diagramming software is needed.
readingGuide.route: Read the scenario and principles, compare examples, then expand problem.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: Two comparable flows, a main path, three exception branches and an explicit prototype boundary in problem.md.

sections.heading: Fix the Start and Endpoint First
paragraphs: As-Is describes how a task currently works; To-Be describes the intended approach. First fix the same task: it begins when an intake worker receives synthetic fields to check and ends with downloading a completeness report matching current input, or explicitly cancelling. Official acceptance, notifications and supervisor approval are outside this prototype segment.

Comparing a month-long administrative process with one new button can make responsibilities or time appear to vanish. State who acts, what data they consult and what permits the next step. If current work has not been researched, label it an assumed flow, not an observation.

sections.heading: Compare Routes with the Same Start and Destination
paragraphs: On a route from the entrance to a station platform, an old path might send passengers to a ticket counter, while a new path warns about missing tickets at entry. Explain where to resolve that problem and how to return. A diagram showing only an uninterrupted route overlooks passengers most likely to get stuck.

The intake prototype has the same issue. Valid input is one situation; omissions, edits and cancellation also affect completion. A User Flow focuses on actions and branches. It does not locate the database or implement permission isolation by itself.

sections.heading: Retain Human and System Responsibilities
paragraphs: This table is a teaching assumption, not an organization’s SOP. To-Be provides earlier completeness feedback; field values alone do not establish document authenticity, content correctness or official acceptability.

GOV.UK’s discovery guidance recommends understanding the wider process and related teams. Apply that perspective around handoff: note which information comes from outside and who takes over after export. Record boundaries before trying to put the whole service into code.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Current and Intended Approaches to One Synthetic Task
rows: Input
The intake worker fills in three required fields.
The worker enters data; the interface explains required fields.
Checking
The worker manually inspects each field.
The program lists omissions under explicit rules; the worker interprets the result.
Missing information
Ask separately, edit and inspect again.
Keep entered values, identify missing fields and recheck after completion.
Before handoff
Manually decide whether fields are complete.
Offer preview and a complete report only after current input passes checking.
Outside the prototype
Subsequent business review remains unconfirmed.
Official acceptance and document-content review remain outside the prototype.

sections.heading: Read the Main Path Together with the Branch Table
paragraphs: The existing flow diagram represents sequence and cannot imply that every step necessarily passes. Show the main path only when success conditions hold, and use a branch table for exits and recovery points. Text retains those conditions when the layout reflows on phones.

Input changes are an important event. If results still refer to earlier data, the exported report may differ from the screen. Require edits to invalidate old results before rechecking. M05 will turn that rule into acceptance scenarios.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | The To-Be Success Path
blocks.description: Proceed only after checking passes and input remains unchanged. Missing information, edits and cancellation are covered in the branch table.

items.title: Enter synthetic data
items.body: The worker enters application number, applicant code and document type.

items.title: Check current input
items.body: The program checks required fields in current data; failure returns to correction.

items.title: Preview this result
items.body: The worker compares results with current input; edits invalidate the old result.

items.title: Export and finish
items.body: Download this completeness report. This does not establish official acceptance or authenticity review.

blocks.caption: Table 2 | Action Branches That Need Explicit Exits
rows: A required field is missing
List missing fields; do not offer a complete report.
Return to input, retain entered values, complete and recheck.
Any field changes after checking
Invalidate the result and remove the old preview and complete-report export.
Recheck current input.
Checking passes and input is unchanged
Show the current preview and export.
Finish the task after downloading.
The user cancels
Explain that this report will not be created.
End the task; separately confirm whether data should be retained.

sections.heading: Distinguish What Each Diagram Explains
paragraphs: A journey map can describe experience across time, roles and channels. GOV.UK’s experience-map guidance includes multi-step experiences involving people or services and calls for organizing and revising maps from users’ experiences. This is broader than a single form User Flow; a synthetic action diagram does not establish completed journey research with actual users.

System architecture explains relationships among browsers, applications, external services and data stores in M06. A “check” step might use one function or several API calls. Here, explain what happens and how to recover from failure without assuming a deployment design.

sections.heading: Walk Through Situations to Find Missing Exits
paragraphs: Ask a peer to use four synthetic event cards: missing document type, checking after completion, clearing a field after checking, and cancellation. Follow the flow to identify each next step. If they must invent a screen or rule, the document still has a gap. This tabletop check does not prove working code or successful use by actual users.

Fewer steps are not always better. Removing necessary checks or recovery may merely delay discovery of errors. Identify the decision information each step provides and for whom, then reduce effort through M04 task analysis and interface design.

blocks.heading: Flow Appendix for problem.md
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records matching task endpoints, assumed As-Is and To-Be flows, missing-input recovery, edit invalidation, cancellation, excluded authenticity/business/notification work and pending cancellation/handoff questions. Adapt it to the class, without treating it as actual rules or research findings.

To-Be：填寫 → 檢查 → 通過後預覽 → 匯出

exercise.environment: problem.md, a text editor or paper, and four synthetic event cards; no diagramming software is needed.
steps: Give the intake task matching start and end conditions, labeling current work as observed or an assumption requiring interviews.
Write As-Is and To-Be side by side. Add feedback and recovery points for missing fields, edits after checking and cancellation.
Ask a peer to walk through the four cards, record one unclear branch and revise problem.md. Independent learners can check each card themselves.

zh.prompt: As-Is 與 To-Be 最適合如何比較？
options: 現況畫整個單位，新流程只畫一個按鈕
先固定相同任務的起點、終點與角色，再比較步驟及條件
只比較框框數量
先決定資料庫，其他以後再說

相同任務邊界有助看出改變了哪些工作與例外處理。
框框少不代表任務可完成。
資料庫屬架構決策，不能取代任務理解。

en.prompt: How should As-Is and To-Be be compared?
options: Map the whole organization for As-Is and one button for To-Be.
Fix the same task’s start, endpoint and roles, then compare steps and conditions.
Compare only the number of boxes.
Decide the database first and everything else later.

Matching boundaries clarify changes in work and exception handling.
Fewer boxes do not establish task completion.
A database decision cannot replace understanding the task.

zh.prompt: 已通過檢查後，使用者又修改欄位，流程應怎麼走？
options: 沿用舊報告，因為剛才通過
只改畫面文字，匯出仍用舊結果
直接宣告業務受理成功
使舊結果失效，重新檢查目前資料後才預覽與完整匯出
rationales: 通過只對當次輸入有效。
畫面與報告不一致會產生錯誤交接。
完整性檢查不等於業務受理。
明確失效與重查路徑可避免過期結果被沿用。

en.prompt: A user changes a field after checking passed. What should happen?
options: Reuse the old report because the check just passed.
Update only the screen while export uses the old result.
Declare official acceptance successful.
Invalidate the result and recheck current data before preview and complete-report export.
rationales: A pass applies only to the input checked then.
Screen/report inconsistency can cause an incorrect handoff.
Completeness checking is not official acceptance.
Explicit invalidation and rechecking prevent reuse of stale results.

zh.prompt: 下列哪項屬於 User Flow 最直接要回答的問題？
options: 缺件時使用者看到什麼、如何補回並重新檢查

sections.heading: 先說明這一版要學到什麼
paragraphs: MVP（Minimum Viable Product）常被譯為最小可行產品。本課在教學原型中借用這個範圍概念：用一段最小、可操作且可驗證的流程，回答核心問題。本版不是組織正式產品的完整發行，也不把一次課堂展示當成市場或業務需求已驗證。
本課要先回答：「收件者能否在完整報告匯出前辨識並修正必要欄位缺漏？」因此輸入、缺漏提示、修正後重查、預覽與匯出互相連動。若只完成漂亮首頁，無法回答這個問題；若加入搜尋、統計與帳號，卻沒有缺件回復，也未完成本版目標。

sections.heading: 先讓一份簡餐能完整出餐
paragraphs: 測試取餐流程時，可以先只供應一種簡餐，但仍要能點餐、確認內容、處理缺貨與交付。省略整份菜單能減少範圍，省略缺貨回應則可能讓顧客付了錢卻不知道接下來怎麼辦。
軟體也可以縮小資料種類與使用情境，同時保留該情境需要的錯誤處理。本課只處理三個合成欄位、單人本機與明確缺漏規則；不因此允許缺欄位也產生「完整」報告。

sections.heading: 先驗證高風險假設，再擴充功能
paragraphs: GOV.UK 的 alpha 指南把原型用於測試最具風險的假設；discovery 指南則允許根據了解的限制，決定繼續、改變方向或停止。本課採用這個「以證據決定下一步」的方法，不將英國服務階段、時間或行政要求當成臺灣課程的規定。
在合成收件案例中，可先問：必要欄位是否有明確規則？缺件提示是否足以讓人自行修正？若規則負責人尚未確認欄位，增加模型功能不會消除規則不明的風險。先保留問題，決定是暫用教學規則演練，還是等待確認後才處理正式流程。

sections.heading: 將需求分成三種範圍狀態
paragraphs: 第一版是本次要驗收的工作；延後是仍可能需要、但必須符合啟動條件才納入；本版不做是明確排除的責任或能力。這是本課的記錄方式，不是宣稱所有團隊都採相同分類。
「多人共用」若延後，應寫明要重新訪談角色、確認資料隔離及保存，再設計驗證。不能因為原型可從另一台電腦連到就宣稱共用系統已完成。任何與真實資料、正式受理或權限相關的變更，都需重新檢視原本邊界。

sections.heading: 新增功能時同時談取捨與驗證
paragraphs: 假設同儕提出「順便做批次匯入」。先問一次要處理多少筆、每筆缺件如何回報、部分失敗怎麼復原、是否仍要逐筆預覽。這些回答可能改變資料模型與介面，不能只以「多一個按鈕」估算。
把這項要求寫成候選變更，列出受影響的流程、規格與測試，請範圍負責角色決定納入、交換掉其他工作或延後。時數固定時，取捨應可見；不要默默刪除負向情境來讓新增功能看起來做得完。

sections.heading: 用完成條件守住最小完整流程
paragraphs: 展示能點開網頁只能證明啟動。本版至少需用缺件、補齊與修改後重查案例，證明匯出限制與輸入一致；再請試用者完成一項指定任務，記錄提示與恢復是否清楚。功能證據與易用性觀察分開保留。
常見誤解是「MVP 可以先不管安全」。可以選擇不收真實資料、不連外或不做共用，縮小責任與風險；但已納入的資料處理與匯出限制仍要遵守。若無法做到核心約束，就留下缺口並停止宣稱該任務已完成。

readingGuide.goal: Define MVP scope and completion conditions from the question to verify.
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md and the synthetic intake case. Classify work on paper or in a text editor; no code additions are needed.
