sections.heading: State What This Version Needs to Establish
paragraphs: MVP means Minimum Viable Product. This course borrows the scope concept for a teaching prototype: a minimum operable, verifiable flow that answers a core question. It is not a full organizational product release, and one classroom demonstration does not validate market or business demand.

The first question is whether intake workers can identify and correct missing required fields before exporting a complete report. Input, feedback, correction and rechecking, preview and export therefore work together. A polished home page cannot answer it. Search, statistics and accounts without recovery from missing input do not meet this version’s goal either.

sections.heading: Deliver One Complete Meal Before Expanding the Menu
paragraphs: To test a meal-collection flow, offer only one meal while retaining ordering, confirmation, handling unavailable items and delivery. Reducing menu choice narrows scope. Omitting out-of-stock feedback can leave paying customers uncertain what happens next.

Software can likewise restrict data types and situations while retaining the errors that situation needs handled. This course uses three synthetic fields, one local user and explicit missing-input rules. A missing field still must not produce a report marked complete.

sections.heading: Test Risky Assumptions Before Adding Features
paragraphs: GOV.UK’s alpha guidance uses prototypes to test the riskiest assumptions; discovery guidance allows continuing, changing direction or stopping based on understood constraints. The course adopts evidence-based decisions without treating UK service phases, schedules or administrative requirements as rules for this Taiwan-based course.

For the synthetic case, ask whether required-field rules are explicit and feedback lets people correct omissions independently. If the rule owner has not confirmed fields, adding model features cannot resolve that uncertainty. Retain the question and decide whether to practice with teaching rules or await confirmation before working on an official process.

sections.heading: Record Three Scope States
paragraphs: First-version work is what will be accepted now. Deferred work may be needed but requires activation conditions before inclusion. Excluded work defines responsibilities or capabilities outside this version. These are the course’s recording categories, not a universal team standard.

Deferring shared use should include new role interviews, isolation and retention requirements, then verification design. Access from another computer does not establish a completed shared system. Changes involving real data, official acceptance or permissions require revisiting the original boundary.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Scope States
blocks.description: These are parallel categories, not stages through which every item will eventually be released.

items.title: First version
items.body: Synthetic input, missing-field feedback, correction and rechecking, current preview and export; accept through cases and task operation.

items.title: Deferred
items.body: Shared use and historical queries: confirm roles, data responsibilities and needs before deciding whether to design them.

items.title: Excluded from this version
items.body: Official acceptance, actual personal data and automatic external messages are outside this teaching prototype’s responsibilities.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Explain Scope Decisions
rows: Correction and rechecking after omissions
First version
The core task cannot finish without this path.
Complete reports match current input
First-version constraint
Prevent stale exports after edits; this is not a decorative feature to remove.

Deferred
Confirm roles, authorization, storage and operations, then establish verification.

Excluded
A separate business responsibility; redefine the project and acceptance if requested later.

sections.heading: Discuss Trade-offs and Verification for New Features
paragraphs: If a peer asks to “also add batch import,” clarify batch size, per-record missing-input feedback, partial-failure recovery and whether each record still needs preview. Answers may change the data model and interface; “one extra button” is not a sufficient estimate.

Record a proposed change with affected flows, specifications and tests. Ask the scope owner to include it, exchange other work for it or defer it. With fixed teaching time, make trade-offs visible. Do not quietly remove negative scenarios to make the addition appear feasible.

sections.heading: Use Completion Conditions to Retain a Complete Flow
paragraphs: Opening a web page demonstrates startup only. Use missing-input, completed-input and post-edit recheck cases to establish export restrictions and input consistency. Ask a participant to perform a specified task and record whether feedback and recovery are clear. Retain functional evidence and usability observations separately.

A common mistake is assuming an MVP can ignore security. Reduce responsibility and risk by excluding real data, networking or shared use. Still follow the processing and export constraints included in scope. If a core constraint cannot be met, record the gap and stop claiming that task is complete.

blocks.heading: Scope and Reopening Conditions for problem.md
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records the core question, first-version flow, missing-input/stale-result constraints, conditional deferrals for history and ten-user sharing, exclusions, evidence, change ownership and a question about when to revise or stop. Adapt it for the class; it is not an actual business rule or finding.

sections.heading: 先問成功是誰完成了什麼
paragraphs: 「程式產生了很多行」「Agent 用了很多工具」「大家覺得很先進」都不能單獨回答收件工作是否改善。本課要看必要欄位缺漏是否被發現、報告是否對應目前輸入，以及試用者能否找到問題並完成修正。
功能指標描述程式行為，任務指標描述人完成工作的情況。程式通過所有預設案例，仍可能讓第一次使用的人找不到檢查按鈕；試用者完成一次任務，也不證明所有邊界案例都正確。兩種證據應各自記錄。

sections.heading: 量時間之前先決定從哪裡算
paragraphs: 比較兩次煮飯時間，若一次從洗米開始、另一次從按下電鍋開始，數字即使精確也不公平。收件任務也要固定起點、終點與測試材料，否則「快兩分鐘」可能只是把補件時間移到另一位同仁身上。
GOV.UK 的指標指南建議從服務目的與假設選擇量測，給數字基準及情境，並搭配使用者研究。本課只採這些方法，不要求課堂套用英國政府的強制 KPI，也不把示範門檻當成各產業通用標準。

sections.heading: 把指標寫到別人也能照著量
paragraphs: 每項指標至少要交代對象、計算方式、資料來源與條件。「缺漏阻擋率」若不說分母，可能把完整資料也混進去；「完成率」若只算最後留下來的人，會漏掉中途無法繼續的情況。樣本小時可先報原始分子／分母，不急著用百分比包裝結果。
下表是待執行的量測設計。案例門檻只對指定合成資料成立，並非整個系統可靠度。尚未做真人任務前，基準與觀察結果都應填「未測量」，不能把預期值抄到結果欄。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜三種不同的成功證據
rows: 缺漏完整匯出阻擋
指定缺漏案例中，沒有完整報告出口的筆數／缺漏案例總數
以固定合成案例驗證；本版要求列出的缺漏案例均阻擋，不代表所有輸入已測
無提示完成修正
指定任務中，未受主持人提示便補齊並取得當次報告的人次／開始任務的人次
記錄提示、放棄與障礙；真人試用尚未執行，沒有現成分數
任務時間
從看到指定合成資料開始，到取得正確當次報告為止
同時記錄失敗與放棄；維持任務條件，不以單次時間宣稱因果改善

sections.heading: 用合成數字練習計算與解讀
paragraphs: 假設教學卡有四個缺漏案例，其中三個被阻擋、一個仍能匯出；另有兩個完整案例可匯出。缺漏阻擋率應為 3／4＝75%，不能拿全部六筆作分母。本版要求指定缺漏案例全數阻擋，所以這組合成結果未通過；不是平均看起來還好就可以發布。
再假設兩位合成參與者都完成修正，但其中一位需要提示。若指標定義是「無提示完成」，就是 1／2；不能為了分數好看把需要提示的人改算無提示。這些數字是紙上算例，沒有真人、程式執行或效能量測。
若某輪根本沒有缺漏案例，分母為零時應記為「不適用／未測得」，不能填 100%。樣本與情境不同也不直接比較。要評估真實效率改善，還需適當的基準、研究設計與分析；本章不以算例宣稱因果效果。

sections.heading: 將未知改成能驗證的假設
paragraphs: 「顯示缺少欄位的名稱，可能讓收件者自行修正」是設計假設；「每次缺件都由收件者補」是工作流程假設。可以依失敗代價與目前不確定性，決定先驗哪個。這是本課的討論方式，沒有把主觀分數當成客觀風險計算。
GOV.UK 的研究規劃指南建議把未有依據的意見改寫成研究問題。你可以為每個假設加上反證條件：例如試用者看到欄位名稱仍不知道資料從何取得，就表示提示可能不足，需要重新訪談或設計，而非直接怪罪使用者。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜需求紀錄如何形成下一輪工作
blocks.description: 每輪都可能維持、修正或撤回候選要求；「測試通過」只限本次條件。

items.title: 假設與來源
items.body: 寫出未知、合成卡或已確認資料，避免把推論寫成事實。

items.title: 可觀察條件
items.body: 定義任務、案例、指標與如何判斷結果。

items.title: 結果與限制
items.body: 如實填通過、失敗或未測量，保留原始分子／分母。

items.title: 決定與修訂
items.body: 由適當角色確認修改理由，更新 problem.md，再連到規格與測試。

sections.heading: 留下需求與變更的來回路徑
paragraphs: 需求紀錄可以先用 Markdown 表格，不必引入大型工具。每項候選需求有一個穩定代號、來源、適用條件、狀態、確認角色與證據位置。M05 會把它接到 spec.md 的驗收情境；此時不要為了填滿欄位而假造不存在的檔案或測試結果。
例如原候選只寫「檢查後可匯出」，合成走讀發現修改後可能沿用舊結果，就記一項變更：「輸入修改後舊結果失效，重新檢查才可匯出」。保留原要求與新增原因，而非悄悄改字讓人無法理解決策過程。
常見誤解是所有欄位有值就能結案。本課驗的是欄位完整性；文件內容正確、真人任務改善、多人權限與正式受理都需要各自的證據。完成本章的紀錄，只代表需求已能被討論與驗證。

blocks.heading: problem.md 指標與需求紀錄
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 problem.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。

exercise.environment: problem.md、文字編輯器與本章合成算例；不收集真人成績或計時。
steps: 選一項功能指標與一項任務指標，各寫分母、起終點、資料來源與未測量欄位。
用四筆缺漏、三筆阻擋的合成卡計算，再解釋為何完整案例不進該分母；另處理分母為零。
新增 H-01、R-01 與一筆變更，保留來源、確認角色與理由，請同儕指出下一個仍待驗證的主張。
exercise.expected: problem.md 有可重做的指標定義、假設、需求候選與變更紀錄，結果欄如實保留未測量。
exercise.check: 能算出 3／4＝75% 並判定本版缺漏阻擋要求未通過；不把合成算例當真人或實際軟體結果。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成標記與原始定義，不公開真人任務記錄；未測量項目保持未測量。

en.summary: Turn “more efficient” into observable measures, label assumptions and data sources, and connect requirement changes with test evidence and subsequent decisions.
objectives: Define observable success conditions for both program behavior and user tasks.
Specify denominators, measurement methods, baselines and scope for metrics.
Bring assumptions, proposed requirements, confirmed decisions and revision reasons back to problem.md.

readingGuide.goal: Define observable success conditions for both program behavior and user tasks.
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md, a text editor and this lesson’s synthetic arithmetic. Do not collect actual participant scores or timing.
readingGuide.route: Read the scenario and principles, compare examples, then expand problem.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: Reproducible metric definitions, assumptions, proposed requirements and change records in problem.md, with results honestly left unmeasured.

sections.heading: Define Who Completes What
paragraphs: Lines of code, agent tool-call counts and impressions of advanced technology do not individually establish improved intake work. Look at whether omissions are found, reports match current input and participants can locate and correct problems.

Functional measures describe program behavior; task measures describe people doing the work. Passing every predefined case may still leave a first-time user unable to find the check button. Completing one task does not establish correctness across every boundary case. Record both evidence types separately.

sections.heading: Fix Timing Boundaries Before Comparing Durations
paragraphs: Two rice-cooking durations are not comparable if one starts at washing rice and the other at pressing the cooker button. Fix intake-task starts, endpoints and materials too. “Two minutes faster” might otherwise mean moving correction time to another colleague.

GOV.UK’s metrics guidance recommends choosing measures around service purpose and hypotheses, giving numbers a baseline and context and combining them with user research. The course adopts these methods without importing mandatory UK government KPIs or treating demonstration thresholds as universal industry standards.

sections.heading: Define Measures That Another Person Can Repeat
paragraphs: Each metric needs its target, calculation, data source and conditions. An undefined missing-input blocking rate might include complete inputs in the denominator. A completion rate counting only people who remain at the end excludes those unable to continue. With small samples, report raw numerator and denominator before emphasizing percentages.

The table is a measurement plan, not executed results. Case thresholds apply only to specified synthetic data, not overall system reliability. Before actual participant tasks, keep baseline and observations “unmeasured”; do not copy expected values into result fields.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Three Different Forms of Success Evidence
rows: Blocking complete-report export for missing input
Specified missing-input cases with no complete-report export / all specified missing-input cases.
Use fixed synthetic cases. All listed missing-input cases must block export; this does not cover every possible input.
Unprompted correction completion
Task attempts completed by filling missing data and obtaining the current report without moderator hints / all started task attempts.
Record hints, abandonment and barriers. Actual participant testing has not run; there is no existing score.
Task duration
From seeing the assigned synthetic data to obtaining the correct report for current input.
Record failure and abandonment too; hold task conditions consistent. A single duration does not establish causal improvement.

sections.heading: Practice Calculation and Interpretation with Synthetic Numbers
paragraphs: Suppose teaching cards contain four missing-input cases: three block export and one still allows it. Two additional complete-input cases allow export. The missing-input blocking rate is 3/4 = 75%, not a fraction of all six. This version requires every specified missing-input case to block, so these synthetic results fail the requirement; an acceptable-looking average cannot justify release.

Suppose two synthetic participants finish correction but one needs a hint. For “unprompted completion,” the result is 1/2. Do not reclassify the prompted attempt to improve the score. These are tabletop numbers, with no actual participants, program execution or performance measurement.

If a round has no missing-input cases, its zero denominator means “not applicable / not measured,” not 100%. Do not directly compare different samples or conditions. Actual efficiency evaluation also needs an appropriate baseline, research design and analysis; this arithmetic establishes no causal effect.

sections.heading: Turn Unknowns into Testable Assumptions
paragraphs: “Naming missing fields may help intake workers correct them independently” is a design assumption. “Intake workers always supply missing information” is a workflow assumption. Decide what to test first using the cost of failure and current uncertainty. This is a course discussion method, not an objective risk calculation from subjective scores.

GOV.UK’s research-planning guidance recommends turning unsupported opinions into research questions. Add conditions that would challenge each assumption. If a participant sees the field name but still cannot locate the required data, the feedback may be insufficient. Revisit research or design instead of immediately blaming the user.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | How Requirement Records Guide the Next Round
blocks.description: A round may retain, revise or withdraw a proposed requirement. A test pass applies only to that round’s conditions.

items.title: Assumptions and sources
items.body: Record unknowns, synthetic cards or confirmed data without presenting inferences as facts.

items.title: Observable conditions
items.body: Define tasks, cases, metrics and how results will be judged.

items.title: Results and limitations
items.body: Record pass, fail or unmeasured honestly, retaining raw numerators and denominators.

items.title: Decisions and revisions
items.body: Have the appropriate role confirm reasons, update problem.md and connect specifications and tests.

sections.heading: Leave a Trace Between Requirements and Changes
paragraphs: A Markdown table is enough to begin; a large management tool is unnecessary. Give each proposed requirement a stable code, source, conditions, status, confirming role and evidence location. M05 will connect these to spec.md acceptance scenarios. Do not invent nonexistent files or test results to fill every field.

If the original proposal says “allow export after checking,” a synthetic walkthrough may reveal that edits could reuse a stale result. Record a change: “Input edits invalidate results; rechecking is required before export.” Retain the original request and reason instead of silently rewriting the decision history.

Complete fields do not close every responsibility. This course checks field completeness. Content correctness, improvement in actual participant tasks, shared-user permissions and official acceptance each need their own evidence. Finishing this record makes requirements discussable and verifiable.

blocks.heading: Metrics and Requirement Records for problem.md
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records H-01, M-01/M-02 denominators, unmeasured baseline/participant results, proposed R-01, synthetic source, scope owner, edit-invalidation change C-01, its walkthrough reason, pending M05/M08 links and evidence limits. Adapt it for class; it is not an actual business rule or research finding.

exercise.environment: problem.md, a text editor and this lesson’s synthetic arithmetic. Do not collect actual participant scores or timing.
steps: Choose one functional and one task metric. Define denominators, start/end conditions, sources and unmeasured fields.
Calculate the synthetic result with four missing-input cases and three blocked exports. Explain why complete inputs are excluded and handle a zero denominator separately.
Add H-01, R-01 and one change with sources, confirming role and reason. Ask a peer to identify the next claim needing verification.
exercise.expected: Reproducible metric definitions, assumptions, proposed requirements and change records in problem.md, with results honestly left unmeasured.
exercise.check: Calculate 3/4 = 75% and identify failure to meet this version’s blocking requirement. Do not treat synthetic arithmetic as actual participant or software results.
exercise.cleanup: Retain synthetic labels and original definitions. Do not publish actual participant task records. Keep unmeasured items unmeasured.

zh.prompt: 四筆缺漏案例只有三筆被阻擋，另兩筆完整案例可匯出。缺漏阻擋率是多少？
options: 3／4＝75%，且未達本版指定缺漏案例全數阻擋要求
5／6，因為完整案例也成功
100%，因為大部分正常
rationales: 完整案例不屬這個指標的分母。
分母是缺漏案例；一筆漏阻擋就未達本課指定要求。
混合不同目標會隱藏缺漏失敗。
大部分正常不能改寫為全部通過。

en.prompt: Three of four missing-input cases block export; two complete-input cases export successfully. What is the blocking rate?
options: 3/4 = 75%, failing this version’s requirement to block every specified missing-input case.
5/6, because complete cases succeed too.
100%, because most behavior is normal.
rationales: Complete inputs are outside this metric’s denominator.
The denominator is missing-input cases; one unblocked case fails the specified requirement.
Mixing different goals hides the missing-input failure.
Mostly normal cannot be recorded as all passed.

zh.prompt: 沒有缺漏案例的測試輪，缺漏阻擋率應記為何？
options: 0%，並宣稱全部失敗
任意填前一輪分數
不適用／未測得，說明分母為零
rationales: 沒有案例不能證明全數阻擋。
也不能據此宣稱全部失敗。
沿用舊分數會混淆這輪證據。
保留分母為零的界線，另補需要的案例。

en.prompt: A round contains no missing-input cases. How should its blocking rate be recorded?
options: 0%, claiming every case failed.
Any score copied from the previous round.
Not applicable / not measured, explaining the zero denominator.
rationales: No cases cannot establish all were blocked.
It cannot establish universal failure either.
Old scores confuse this round’s evidence.
Retain the zero-denominator boundary and add necessary cases.

zh.prompt: 任務改善還沒有真人量測，需求紀錄最適合怎麼寫？
options: 填入預期節省時間，當作已完成結果
只寫程式能啟動，所以效率已證明
保留假設、定義、來源與未測量狀態，規劃如何取得證據
把算例參與者改成真人代號
rationales: 預期值與觀察值需要分開。
啟動只能證明啟動。
這讓後續研究與修訂可追溯，又不誇大現有證據。
改代號不能把虛構情境轉成真人研究。

en.prompt: Task improvement has not been measured with actual participants. What should the requirements record say?
options: Record expected time savings as completed results.
Program startup proves efficiency.
Retain assumptions, definitions, sources and unmeasured status, planning how to obtain evidence.
Give fictional participants real-looking codes.
rationales: Expected and observed values must remain separate.
Startup establishes startup only.
This supports traceable research and revision without overstating evidence.
Changing identifiers does not turn fiction into participant research.

zh.summary: 用同一收件任務區分人機互動、介面與整體使用經驗，找到該改善的問題與需要的證據。
objectives: 以工作情境區分 HCI、UI 與 UX 的分析範圍。
指出美觀、易用與整體任務結果之間的差異。
為一個介面困難提出可觀察的修改假設。

readingGuide.goal: 以工作情境區分 HCI、UI 與 UX 的分析範圍。
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md、文字編輯器與合成收件情境；不需要改程式或接觸真人。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 wireframe-notes.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: 一份包含三種分析觀點、具體修改假設及待驗方法的 wireframe-notes.md。

sections.heading: 用不同問題看同一個系統
paragraphs: HCI（Human–Computer Interaction，人機互動）研究人如何與互動技術一起工作，也包含設計與評估方法。SIGCHI 將這個領域描述為跨學科的研究與實務，涉及資訊、心理、設計等專業。本課用它提醒自己：人的理解、情境、操作限制與技術行為都要一起考慮。
UI（User Interface，使用者介面）是人用來操作與接收回饋的介面，例如欄位標籤、按鈕、閱讀順序與錯誤訊息；它不只包含配色。UX（User Experience，使用者經驗）則看使用者接觸服務與產品的整體經驗，可能從準備文件開始，直到匯出後交接。本課以三種觀點教學，不把它們當成互斥職稱或固定先後階段。

sections.heading: 像看自助寄件的不同層面
paragraphs: 自助寄件機的輸入欄位、按鈕和付款提示屬於介面。研究戴手套的人能否操作觸控、寄件者如何理解重量與費用，是人機互動可以處理的問題。即使機器很好按，若包裹交付後沒有收件確認，整段寄件經驗仍可能讓人困惑。
三者彼此影響。改按鈕文字是 UI 修改；選擇文字要根據對使用者理解的研究；是否改善寄件結果，還要看操作前後的服務。不能把三個名稱直接換成「研究、畫圖、滿意度」就認為責任已分清。

sections.heading: 把收件困難轉成三種可追問問題
paragraphs: NN/G 的 UX 定義強調整體接觸經驗，也明確區別 UI 與 UX。本課據此查看收件任務：即使表單易讀，若使用者不知道該去哪裡取得文件類型，仍可能無法完成工作。加入更漂亮的圖示不會自動提供缺少的資料。
下面的問題都是教學假設，還沒有真人研究。你可以先選一個最影響任務的困難，再用訪談、任務觀察或介面測試取得適當證據。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜同一收件任務的三種觀點
blocks.description: 三張卡並列比較分析問題，沒有先研究完 HCI 才能開始 UI 的固定順序。

items.title: HCI：理解互動
items.body: 第一次使用的人，如何判斷「欄位齊全」與「正式受理」的差別？需要觀察其理解與操作。

items.title: UI：安排操作
items.body: 欄位有持續可見的名稱嗎？缺漏訊息是否指向文件類型與修正動作？

items.title: UX：看整段任務
items.body: 資料從哪裡準備、缺件由誰補、報告交給誰？畫面以外的交接也可能是阻礙。

sections.heading: 將外觀、易用與工作結果分開檢查
paragraphs: 視覺一致、文字清楚能幫助閱讀，但「看起來專業」不能代替使用者能否發現缺漏、回復錯誤與取得正確當次報告的證據。易用性關心人在特定情境中是否能學會、操作並完成任務；整體 UX 還包含其他接觸與期待。
NN/G 的易用性原則可以協助檢查系統狀態、使用者語言與錯誤復原；它們是啟發式方向，不是保證通過的評分公式。套用原則後仍應做任務試用，不以設計者覺得好看就結案。

sections.heading: 選與問題相符的證據
paragraphs: 若問題是「文件類型」名稱難懂，可請使用者解釋他認為這欄要填什麼，並觀察他找資料的過程。若問題是表單不能用鍵盤送出，就直接測試鍵盤路徑。若問題是交接後仍需重填，則需看報告接收者的工作。
同一方法不會回答所有問題。功能測試可以證明指定缺件案例被阻擋，不能證明人知道怎麼補；一次訪談可以揭露一種說法，不能證明每個人都如此。保留任務、情境與證據範圍，再決定下一個修改。

sections.heading: 留下一個能驗證的設計假設
paragraphs: 常見誤解是「UX 就是 UI 美化」。可以改用具體目標：「讓第一次使用者在看到缺漏後，能找到文件類型欄並知道要補什麼。」這個目標把文字、位置與行為接在一起，也能指向下一次任務觀察。
將候選設計寫進 wireframe-notes.md，再帶到 M04-02 的任務分析。下面示範只有設計假設，沒有宣稱觀察已發生。

en.summary: Use one intake task to distinguish human–computer interaction, the interface and the overall user experience, identifying problems to improve and the evidence needed.
objectives: Distinguish the scope of HCI, UI and UX through a work situation.
Identify differences among appearance, usability and overall task outcomes.
Propose an observable design hypothesis for an interface difficulty.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish the scope of HCI, UI and UX through a work situation.
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md, a text editor and a synthetic intake scenario; no code changes or actual participants are needed.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand wireframe-notes.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: wireframe-notes.md with three analytical perspectives, a concrete design hypothesis and a planned verification method.

sections.heading: Ask Different Questions About the Same System
paragraphs: Human–Computer Interaction (HCI) studies how people work with interactive technology, including methods for design and evaluation. SIGCHI describes an interdisciplinary research and practice community involving computing, psychology and design, among other fields. Here, that perspective reminds us to consider understanding, context, operating constraints and technical behavior together.

The User Interface (UI) is how people act and receive feedback: field labels, buttons, reading order and errors, not just colors. User Experience (UX) covers the broader experience with a service or product, potentially from preparing documents through handoff after export. These are teaching perspectives, not mutually exclusive job titles or fixed successive phases.

sections.heading: Examine Different Aspects of a Self-Service Parcel Kiosk
paragraphs: The kiosk’s fields, buttons and payment feedback belong to its interface. Whether gloved users can operate the touchscreen and how senders understand weight and charges are HCI questions. Even with easy controls, a missing receipt confirmation can leave the overall parcel-sending experience confusing.

The perspectives interact. Changing button wording is a UI change; choosing wording should draw on research into understanding. Assessing the shipping outcome also requires examining the surrounding service. Relabeling the three terms as “research, drawing and satisfaction” does not fully define responsibilities.

sections.heading: Turn an Intake Difficulty into Three Investigable Questions
paragraphs: NN/G’s UX definition covers the overall interaction experience and explicitly distinguishes UI from UX. Apply that distinction: a readable form may still leave users unable to obtain document-type information. More attractive icons do not supply the missing data.

The questions below are teaching assumptions without actual participant research. Choose a difficulty that materially affects the task, then obtain suitable evidence through interviews, task observation or interface testing.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Perspectives on One Intake Task
blocks.description: The cards compare analytical questions in parallel. UI work need not wait for a separate, completed HCI phase.

items.title: HCI: understanding interaction
items.body: How does a first-time user distinguish complete fields from official acceptance? Observe understanding and operation.

items.title: UI: arranging actions
items.body: Do fields have persistent names? Does missing-input feedback identify document type and how to correct it?

items.title: UX: examining the whole task
items.body: Where is data prepared, who supplies missing information and who receives the report? Handoffs outside the screen may be barriers.

sections.heading: Check Appearance, Usability and Outcomes Separately
paragraphs: Consistent visuals and clear wording aid reading, but a professional appearance cannot establish that people find omissions, recover from errors and obtain a correct report matching current input. Usability concerns learning, operation and task completion in a context; UX also includes other interactions and expectations.

NN/G’s heuristics help inspect status, user language and recovery. They are broad inspection principles, not a scoring formula guaranteeing success. Test tasks after applying them instead of accepting a design because the designer likes its appearance.

sections.heading: Choose Evidence That Answers the Question
paragraphs: If “document type” is unclear, ask users to explain what they think belongs there and observe how they find it. If keyboard submission fails, test that keyboard path. If handoff still requires re-entry, examine the report recipient’s work.

No single method answers everything. Functional tests can establish blocking of specified missing-input cases, not whether people know how to correct them. One interview reveals an account, not a universal experience. Retain task, context and evidence limits before selecting the next change.

sections.heading: Retain a Verifiable Design Hypothesis
paragraphs: A common mistake is equating UX with visual UI polish. Use a concrete goal: “After seeing missing-input feedback, first-time users can locate document type and understand what to provide.” This connects wording, position and behavior to a later task observation.
Record the candidate in wireframe-notes.md for M04-02 task analysis. The example contains design hypotheses only; it does not claim observations have occurred.

blocks.heading: Notes from Three Perspectives
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records the completeness/acceptance HCI question, a UI wording change from “success” to “three required fields are complete,” a UX handoff question, planned task/interview methods, synthetic evidence status and the next analysis step. Adapt it in wireframe-notes.md; it is not an actual rule or research finding.

zh.prompt: 哪個例子最能表達 UX 比畫面更廣？
options: 表單配色已統一，所以整段服務必定好用
按鈕加陰影就完成 UX

只有程式碼行數影響 UX

en.prompt: Which example best shows that UX extends beyond the screen?
options: Consistent form colors guarantee an easy overall service.
Adding shadows to buttons completes UX.
The form is clear, but the next worker still cannot use its report; examine the whole handoff.
Only code line counts affect UX.
rationales: Visual consistency does not establish end-to-end task completion.
Visual effects cannot replace task and context evidence.
Handoffs before and after interaction are part of the overall experience.
Line counts alone do not describe user experience.

zh.prompt: 下列哪個 UI 問題可直接檢查？

這不是直接的介面檢查。

options: Does everyone like this organization?
Does the error identify missing document type and explain correction?
How did the entire industry’s information culture develop?
Does research always guarantee success?
rationales: This is too broad to determine from the interface alone.
Wording, association and correction guidance are concrete interface decisions.
This is not a direct interface inspection.
Research reduces unknowns but guarantees no universal design success.

完整性檢查與正式受理不同。

zh.summary: 把「完成收件檢查」拆成目標、動作、判斷與回復路徑，找出介面必須支援的工作。
objectives: 為操作任務定義起訖、前置條件與成功結果。
區分人的動作、資訊需求、系統回饋與例外。
用任務走讀找出草圖與流程的缺口。

readingGuide.goal: 為操作任務定義起訖、前置條件與成功結果。
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md、文字編輯器、缺件與修改兩張合成事件卡；不需安裝分析工具。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 wireframe-notes.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: wireframe-notes.md 具有任務拆解表、條件及一項待確認資訊，能接回 problem.md。

sections.heading: 先寫目標，暫時不列元件
paragraphs: Task Analysis（任務分析）研究使用者為達成目標需要做什麼，以及各工作之間的順序、條件與負擔。本課接續 M03 的 User Flow，把「補齊後匯出」再拆細，找出每一步需要的資訊、判斷及回饋。
「一個輸入框、兩個按鈕、一張表」是元件清單；「發現缺漏、找到資料來源、補上、重新檢查、確認報告」才在描述工作。先理解工作，才能知道哪些元件有必要。

sections.heading: 像拆解如何完成一道料理
paragraphs: 食譜的目標是完成可食用的餐點，不是碰過鍋子、盤子和瓦斯爐。洗菜、判斷熟度與處理缺少食材各有條件；如果只記錄用了哪些器具，就無法教下一位如何完成。
表單也有看不見的判斷：使用者如何知道文件類型、怎麼確認已補齊、為什麼修改後需重查。這些不一定對應一次點擊，卻可能決定任務能否完成。

sections.heading: 在每一步加上所需資訊與出口
paragraphs: 下面是合成任務分析，沒有假裝已觀察實際收件人員。前置條件為取得三欄合成資料及本課規則；起點是開始處理這筆資料，終點是取得與目前輸入一致的完整性報告，或明確取消。
每列都要問「人此時需要知道什麼」。如果文件類型根本無法取得，就不應由模型猜一個值讓流程通過；需要回到 M03 確認補件責任，或暫停這筆任務。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜從目標拆到可設計的工作
rows: 準備資料
理解本課三欄定義並取得合成值
說明必填與範例；資料未知時保留缺件
輸入並檢查
輸入資料，啟動目前資料的檢查
標籤持續可見，顯示檢查結果
修正缺漏
找到缺少欄位，取得值後補填
保留已填資料；缺件不能完整匯出
確認結果
核對預覽是否為目前資料
修改後使舊結果失效，重新檢查
完成或退出
取得當次報告，或取消本次任務
清楚表示結果與限制；取消與失敗不是完成

sections.heading: 拆解層次與執行順序要分開
paragraphs: 階層式拆解回答「這個目標包含哪些子任務」；執行計畫回答「何時做哪些子任務」。例如「處理缺件」可以包括辨識欄位、取得資料及補填，但只有缺件時才需要走這條支線。不能因為列在第三項，就要求每個人都先遇到錯誤。
NN/G 的任務分析文章將資料蒐集與分析分開，也說明子任務的順序、層次與條件。本課圖只呈現一次走讀的分析順序，不冒稱完整 HTA（階層式任務分析）圖或通用任務模型。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜分析一項操作的走讀順序
blocks.description: 這是分析者依序提問的路線，不代表使用者每次操作都必經缺件。

items.title: 目標與情境
items.body: 誰在何時，需要得到什麼結果？先固定起點與終點。

items.title: 動作與判斷
items.body: 要輸入、尋找、比較或決定什麼？每步需要哪些資訊？

items.title: 條件與回復
items.body: 缺件、修改、取消時，如何保留進度並回到正確位置？

items.title: 介面與證據
items.body: 把必要回饋標到草圖，規劃如何確認人能完成工作。

sections.heading: 看操作負擔，也看思考負擔
paragraphs: 如果使用者必須先記住錯誤清單，再捲回上方找欄位，負擔不只是捲動次數，還包括記住哪欄缺漏。讓提示靠近欄位並保留整體結果，可能降低來回核對的需要，但效果仍需用任務試用確認。
NN/G 建議不能只依自述或模擬推定真實工作，還應理解實際使用情境。本課的紙上走讀只找明顯缺口；正式分析若要量化時間、頻率或認知負擔，需另外蒐集合適證據，不能填入猜測秒數當作量測。

sections.heading: 用事件卡檢查下一步是否完整
paragraphs: 請同儕先拿缺文件類型的合成資料，再依草圖指出如何補回與重新檢查。接著給他「已完成檢查後又修改」的事件卡，問哪些結果需要失效。記錄是缺資訊、找不到動作，還是業務規則未明。
常見誤解是把分析變成逐個元件點選。若任務無法取得必要資料，單純把按鈕放大並不能解決。把觀察到的阻礙接回 problem.md，將介面候選留在 wireframe-notes.md，再交由下一篇安排資訊。

blocks.heading: 任務分析工作表
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 wireframe-notes.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。

目標：修正缺件並取得當次完整性報告
前置：有合成資料及本課欄位規則

steps: 寫出任務目標、前置條件、起訖及完成結果，避免先列按鈕。

en.summary: Break “complete the intake check” into goals, actions, judgments and recovery paths to identify the work the interface must support.
objectives: Define task boundaries, preconditions and a successful outcome.
Distinguish human actions, information needs, system feedback and exceptions.
Use a task walkthrough to find gaps in sketches and flows.

readingGuide.goal: Define task boundaries, preconditions and a successful outcome.
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md, a text editor and two synthetic event cards for missing information and edits; no analysis tool installation is needed.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand wireframe-notes.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A task-decomposition table, conditions and one pending information question in wireframe-notes.md, connected to problem.md.

sections.heading: Define the Goal Before Listing Components
paragraphs: Task analysis studies what users need to do to achieve goals, including order, conditions and effort. Building on M03 User Flow, break “correct and export” into smaller actions to identify each step’s information, judgments and feedback.

“One input, two buttons and a table” lists components. “Find the omission, locate the information, fill it in, recheck and confirm the report” describes work. Understanding that work helps determine which components are needed.

sections.heading: Analyze How to Complete a Dish
paragraphs: A recipe aims at an edible meal, not merely touching a pot, plate and stove. Washing ingredients, judging doneness and handling unavailable ingredients have conditions. Recording utensils alone cannot teach the next person to cook.

Forms also involve less visible judgments: how users find document type, recognize completion and understand rechecking after edits. These need not correspond to individual clicks, yet can determine completion.

sections.heading: Add Information Needs and Exits to Every Step
paragraphs: This is synthetic task analysis, not observation of actual intake staff. Preconditions are three synthetic fields and the course rules. The task starts with processing that record and ends with a completeness report matching current input, or explicit cancellation.

For every row, ask what the person needs to know. If document type cannot be obtained, do not have a model guess a value to pass the flow. Return to M03 to clarify correction responsibility or pause that record’s task.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | From a Goal to Work You Can Design For
rows: Prepare data
Understand the three course fields and obtain synthetic values.
Explain requirements and examples; retain missing status for unknown data.
Enter and check
Enter data and start checking current input.
Keep labels identifiable and show results.
Correct omissions
Locate the missing field and fill it after obtaining the value.
Retain entered values; missing input cannot export as complete.
Confirm results
Check that the preview matches current data.
Edits invalidate old results and require rechecking.
Finish or exit
Obtain the current report or cancel this task.
State results and limits; cancellation and failure are not completion.

sections.heading: Separate Decomposition from Execution Order
paragraphs: Hierarchical decomposition asks which subtasks belong to a goal; an execution plan asks when to perform them. Missing-information handling may include locating the field, obtaining data and filling it in, but applies only when data is missing. Third position in a list does not require every user to encounter an error.

NN/G separates data collection from analysis and discusses subtask order, levels and conditions. The course diagram shows an analyst’s walkthrough sequence, not a complete Hierarchical Task Analysis (HTA) diagram or universal task model.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | A Walkthrough Sequence for Analyzing an Action
blocks.description: This is the analyst’s questioning sequence, not a requirement that users encounter missing information on every attempt.

items.title: Goal and context
items.body: Who needs which result, and when? Fix the start and endpoint.

items.title: Actions and judgments
items.body: What must they enter, find, compare or decide? What information does each step need?

items.title: Conditions and recovery
items.body: For omissions, edits or cancellation, how is progress retained and the correct point regained?

items.title: Interface and evidence
items.body: Annotate necessary feedback on the sketch and plan how to check task completion.

sections.heading: Consider Mental Effort Alongside Physical Actions
paragraphs: If users must memorize errors and scroll upward to locate fields, the burden includes remembering omissions, not just scrolling. Nearby field feedback plus an overall result may reduce repeated comparisons, but task testing must establish the effect.

NN/G recommends understanding actual work context rather than relying solely on reported behavior or simulations. This tabletop walkthrough finds obvious gaps only. Quantifying time, frequency or cognitive effort requires additional suitable evidence; guessed seconds are not measurements.

sections.heading: Check Next Steps with Event Cards
paragraphs: Give a peer synthetic input missing document type and ask them to identify correction and rechecking on the sketch. Then give the “edit after checking” card and ask which results become invalid. Record whether information, discoverable actions or clear business rules are missing.

A common mistake is reducing analysis to clicking components. Enlarging a button cannot obtain unavailable data. Bring identified barriers back to problem.md and keep interface candidates in wireframe-notes.md for the next lesson’s information arrangement.

blocks.heading: Task Analysis Worksheet
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records the correction/report goal, synthetic-data preconditions, start and endpoint, subtasks, conditional correction/rechecking, the document-type information gap, candidate feedback and tabletop evidence limits. Adapt it for class; it is not actual rules or findings.
blocks.code:
# 任務分析（合成）
目標：修正缺件並取得當次完整性報告
前置：有合成資料及本課欄位規則
起點：開始處理這筆資料
終點：下載當次報告，或明確取消

objectives: 區分資訊架構、導覽元件與視覺優先序。
依收件任務排列輸入、檢查、結果與次要資訊。
檢查手機閱讀順序及非顏色提示是否仍傳達相同意思。

readingGuide.goal: 區分資訊架構、導覽元件與視覺優先序。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器與四狀態收件草圖；只使用合成欄位名稱與資料。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 wireframe-notes.md 並用檢核題自查。

sections.heading: 先整理內容關係，再選外觀
paragraphs: 資訊架構（Information Architecture，IA）處理內容與功能如何分組、命名及建立關係。導覽是讓人找到它們的介面方式，例如章節目錄或分頁。視覺優先序則用標題、位置、間距與對比，讓人辨識目前重點；三者有關，但不等同。
NN/G 的 IA 與導覽文章強調，內容組織會影響介面，卻不只是選擇一種導覽外觀。對本課單頁表單而言，先分清楚資料、動作與結果，再決定如何呈現；並非一定要新增側欄或多個分頁。

sections.heading: 像替文件櫃分類並貼上名稱
paragraphs: 文件櫃把資料按用途分類，是組織關係；抽屜名稱幫人知道去哪找；常用抽屜放在易取位置，則影響操作優先序。只有把所有抽屜塗上不同顏色，仍可能不知道文件屬於哪一類。
收件畫面也需要能理解的名稱。「處理」「執行」「進階」若包了不同責任，使用者可能一直猜。可以用「申請資料」「檢查結果」「匯出報告」等與任務相關的名稱，再觀察使用者是否理解；這些是本課候選命名，不是通用標準。

sections.heading: 把資訊放進可說明用途的群組
paragraphs: 本課候選分為任務說明、資料輸入、檢查與結果、次要說明。必要欄位與主要動作保持靠近，結果要說明對應哪次輸入。只有不影響當前決定的補充資訊才延後呈現，不能把錯誤藏進「進階」造成猜測。
主要動作可以隨狀態改變：未檢查時是檢查資料，缺件時是補填後重新檢查，完成時才出現當次預覽與匯出。不要同時擺出多個看似等價的完成按鈕，讓人誤以為所有動作都能隨時執行。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜依用途分組的畫面資訊
blocks.description: 卡片表示資訊群組，不是四個可互換的畫面；手機仍需保持合理閱讀順序。

items.title: 任務與限制
items.body: 說明此工具檢查三個合成欄位，完整不代表正式受理。

items.title: 資料與標籤
items.body: 申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型，各有可辨識名稱及必要說明。

items.title: 動作與結果
items.body: 目前可做的主要動作、缺漏與修正方式、當次預覽和匯出。

items.title: 次要資訊
items.body: 範例或技術診斷另有位置；影響當前工作的錯誤不放在此處。

sections.heading: 比較能支援決定的安排
paragraphs: 下表是本課的文字版介面對照，供畫線框稿時參考，並非測試後的最佳版。你仍需依實際使用者的資料取得方式與裝置調整。
表單欄位需要持續可辨識的名稱；placeholder（輸入提示字）可能在輸入後消失，不能當作唯一的欄位說明。W3C 的表單指南還要求標籤與控制項具有程式可辨識的關聯，這要在實作時核對，光畫在旁邊不會自動完成。

任務說明後直接提供必要欄位
現在可以開始輸入什麼
只有輸入框內的提示字
保留可見欄位名稱，必要時補範例

哪裡出錯、怎麼回復
檢查與匯出一直並列且同等強調

目前應檢查還是可匯出
診斷設定比結果更顯眼
診斷移到次要區，結果直接可見

sections.heading: 手機重排也要保留意思
paragraphs: 桌面並排輸入與說明，手機通常會上下堆疊。如果畫面順序與文件中的閱讀順序互相矛盾，鍵盤或輔助科技使用者可能在看到說明之前就進入動作。對有先後意義的內容，要讓程式可辨識的閱讀順序仍合理。
W3C 的 Meaningful Sequence 說明適用於順序會影響意思的情況，不要求所有獨立卡片都只有唯一順序。本課先以任務→輸入→結果安排，再實測窄版、鍵盤與線性閱讀；CSS 排列看起來正確，不代表所有操作順序都正確。

sections.heading: 先做內容清單，再畫位置
paragraphs: 將所有資訊寫成清單，為每項標用途、重要條件與群組。刪掉與任務無關的內容之前，先確認是否有別的角色需要；必要的狀態與復原資訊即使不常發生，也不能因為使用頻率低就藏起來。
常見誤解是「主要按鈕一定靠右」。位置不是跨所有裝置與使用者的固定答案；更重要的是名稱、狀態與前後文可理解，而且鍵盤能依合理順序到達。把具體假設留在草圖，讓走讀與實作驗證能回應它。

blocks.heading: 資訊分組筆記
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 wireframe-notes.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。

en.summary: Group and name information around work goals, then use headings, order and action hierarchy to help users find what matters now.
objectives: Distinguish information architecture, navigation components and visual hierarchy.
Arrange input, checking, results and secondary information around the intake task.
Check that mobile reading order and non-color cues retain the same meaning.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish information architecture, navigation components and visual hierarchy.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor and four-state intake sketches, using synthetic field names and data only.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand wireframe-notes.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: wireframe-notes.md with a content inventory, groups, primary actions and mobile reading order.

sections.heading: Organize Relationships Before Choosing Appearance
paragraphs: Information Architecture (IA) concerns grouping, naming and relationships among content and functions. Navigation is how an interface helps people reach them, such as a contents list or tabs. Visual hierarchy uses headings, placement, spacing and contrast to identify priorities. They relate but are not equivalent.

NN/G distinguishes content organization from navigation appearance. For this single-page form, first separate data, actions and results before choosing presentation; adding a sidebar or multiple tabs is not mandatory.

sections.heading: Classify and Label a Filing Cabinet
paragraphs: Grouping documents by purpose establishes organization. Drawer labels tell people where to look, while frequently used drawers within reach affect access priority. Giving every drawer a different color may still leave document categories unclear.

Intake screens also need understandable names. “Process,” “Execute” and “Advanced” can make users guess when they hide different responsibilities. Try task-related labels such as “Application data,” “Check results” and “Export report,” then observe understanding. These are course candidates, not universal names.

sections.heading: Give Each Group an Explainable Purpose
paragraphs: The course proposes task guidance, data input, checking/results and secondary information. Keep required fields near the primary action and identify which input produced a result. Defer only information irrelevant to the current decision; do not hide errors under “Advanced.”

Primary actions can change with state: check initially, recheck after correction, then preview and export current results only when complete. Several equally emphasized completion buttons can imply that all actions are always available.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Information Grouped by Purpose
blocks.description: These cards represent information groups, not four interchangeable screens. Preserve sensible reading order on mobile.

items.title: Task and limits
items.body: Explain that the tool checks three synthetic fields and completeness does not mean official acceptance.

items.title: Data and labels
items.body: Application number, applicant code and document type each have an identifiable name and necessary guidance.

items.title: Actions and results
items.body: Available primary action, omissions and correction, current preview and export.

items.title: Secondary information
items.body: Examples or diagnostics have a separate place; errors affecting current work do not belong here.

sections.heading: Compare Arrangements That Support Decisions
paragraphs: The table is a textual interface comparison for wireframing, not a tested optimum. Adjust it for intended users’ data sources and devices.

Fields need identifiable names that remain understandable after entry. Placeholder text can disappear and must not be the only explanation. W3C’s forms guidance also calls for programmatic label/control associations. Verify these in implementation; drawing a label nearby does not establish the association.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Two Arrangements of the Same Work Content
rows: Large welcome image before fields hidden below
Provide required fields after task guidance.
What can I enter now?
Only placeholder text inside inputs
Retain visible field names and add examples where needed.
What is each entered value for?
Missing-input result says only red INVALID
Name missing document type and explain correction in text.
What went wrong and how can I recover?
Checking and export are always equally prominent
Offer actions and limits according to actual state.
Should I check now or can I export?
Diagnostics are more prominent than results
Move diagnostics to a secondary area; keep results visible.
Has the current task finished?

sections.heading: Retain Meaning When Mobile Layout Reflows
paragraphs: Desktop input and guidance may sit side by side and stack on mobile. If visual and document reading order conflict, keyboard or assistive-technology users may reach an action before its explanation. Where sequence matters, keep a sensible programmatically determinable reading order.

W3C’s Meaningful Sequence explanation applies when order affects meaning; independent cards need not have only one valid order. Start with task → input → results, then test narrow layouts, keyboards and linear reading. Correct-looking CSS alone does not establish correct operation order.

sections.heading: Inventory Content Before Positioning It
paragraphs: List information with its purpose, important conditions and group. Before removing material irrelevant to one task, check whether another role needs it. Rare but necessary status and recovery information must not be hidden just because it is infrequent.

A common mistake is prescribing right-aligned primary buttons universally. Placement is not fixed across every device and user. Understandable names, state and context, plus a sensible keyboard path, matter more. Record concrete hypotheses in the sketch for walkthrough and implementation checks.

blocks.heading: Information Grouping Notes
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template lists the task, three labeled synthetic inputs, state-dependent primary action, results/correction/completeness definition, secondary information excluding errors, reading order and pending label/mobile/focus checks. Adapt it in wireframe-notes.md; it is not actual rules or research results.

readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器、瀏覽器及工作坊 ZIP 的 reference/wireframe.svg；只用合成文字，紙筆可先排演。
