sections.heading: 線框稿要讓人說出下一步
paragraphs: Wireframe（線框稿）是用簡單形狀、文字與排列，表達介面內容與操作關係的草圖。低保真指暫時降低視覺細節，好讓團隊討論欄位、資訊與行為，不表示可以省略必要狀態。
本課草圖至少表達輸入、處理中、缺漏或失敗、完成四種狀態。處理中只適用真正需要等待的操作；同步檢查很快時，不為了配合草圖加入假的延遲。每種狀態要回答現在發生什麼、哪些動作可做、接著如何前進或復原。

sections.heading: 像先排演一段場景
paragraphs: 排演先確認演員從哪裡進場、看到什麼訊號、何時換場，之後再決定佈景顏色。如果所有人只在討論窗簾樣式，卻不知道發生錯誤時誰接話，正式演出仍會卡住。
線框稿也先安排工作資訊與狀態。可以用紙卡替換畫面，模擬缺件後回到輸入；不必等每個按鈕都寫好，才發現原來沒有回復方法。但排演不是程式執行，不能據此宣稱檢核規則已實作。

sections.heading: 畫面旁邊寫下觸發與限制
paragraphs: 下列卡片可作為四格草圖的文字替代。它們是不同情境，不表示每次操作必經缺件或失敗；技術失敗還需另寫回復註記，不與資料缺漏混為一談。
完成狀態要標明只通過本課三欄完整性規則。使用者修改任一欄時，舊結果應失效；這個條件寫在完成格旁，再連到 spec.md，而不是只在程式作者腦中保留。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜四格草圖要傳達的內容
blocks.description: 各卡片對應畫面狀態；轉換由檢查結果及輸入事件決定，並非固定四步。

items.title: 輸入
items.body: 三個持續可見的欄位名稱、必填與合成資料說明、檢查資料。

items.title: 處理中（條件適用）
items.body: 真有等待才顯示；保留輸入、避免重複提交，另訂逾時或失敗出口。

items.title: 缺漏／失敗
items.body: 缺漏指向欄位並提供補填方法；技術失敗另說明可採動作，不假稱缺件。

items.title: 完成
items.body: 顯示當次預覽與匯出，解釋完整性界線；修改後回到待重查。

sections.heading: 從下載包製作自己的 SVG 草圖
paragraphs: 開啟本課「工作坊資源」頁，下載 aase-v1-workshop.zip 並解壓縮。reference/wireframe.svg 是教師四狀態參考；將它複製到自己的專案並命名 wireframe.svg，保留參考原檔。用瀏覽器開啟副本可看草圖，用文字編輯器開啟則可修改文字。
先只修改 text 元素中的文字，保留 SVG 標記、座標與 viewBox，儲存後重新整理瀏覽器。若出現 XML 錯誤，回到尚未修改的副本，重做一處文字修改；不要為修圖加入腳本或外部內容。較長的註記放進 wireframe-notes.md，避免超出格子。
若暫時不能下載，可先用紙筆畫四格並依上節內容註記；正式交付仍需完成 wireframe.svg。SVG 是靜態參考圖，按鈕文字不會真的檢查資料，也不因為有四格就自動具備響應式或無障礙表單行為。

sections.heading: 依要回答的問題選保真程度
paragraphs: GOV.UK 的原型指南區分紙筆草圖與接近真實互動的程式原型，建議依當下需要選擇。草圖可以快速討論內容與操作概念；要觀察真實鍵盤、焦點、輸入保留或動態通知，需進入可操作原型。
本課不要求套用 GOV.UK 的外觀或工具包。沿 CEH 的教材版型閱讀，在工作坊自行設計收件工具；教學網站的閱讀版型與學生作品的應用程式是兩個不同對象。

sections.heading: 走讀後留下修改理由
paragraphs: 給同儕缺件卡，請他指出要看哪格、改哪欄、什麼情況能匯出。只記錄他的理解，不先替他指出下一步。再給「已檢查後修改」卡，確認草圖是否說明結果失效。單人自學可逐卡核對，但不把自查填成真人試用。
常見誤解是「黑白稿不用考慮可近用」。草圖仍應規劃標籤、錯誤文字、主要動作與合理閱讀順序，只是尚未證明程式關聯或鍵盤行為。把一項修改原因留在註記，進入 M04-05 與 M04-06 檢查資訊揭露和復原。

blocks.heading: 四格草圖的行為註記
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 wireframe-notes.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# wireframe.svg 行為附註（合成設計）
輸入 → 檢查：以目前三欄資料為準
處理中：只在耗時操作適用，不刻意增加延遲
缺漏 → 補填：保留已填值，指出欄位，重新檢查
技術失敗：另說明失敗與可採動作，不宣告完成
完成 → 匯出：僅表示本次完整性檢查通過
完成後修改：舊結果失效，回到待重查
取消：不產生本次報告；資料處理另依需求確認
走讀修改：填實際觀察或自查理由，不虛構真人
待驗：程式規則、鍵盤、焦點與動態通知

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器、瀏覽器及工作坊 ZIP 的 reference/wireframe.svg；只用合成文字，紙筆可先排演。
steps: 從工作坊頁下載並解壓 ZIP，複製 reference/wireframe.svg 為專案 wireframe.svg，以瀏覽器確認可開啟。
用編輯器修改一處 text 文字，重新整理確認未裁切；在 wireframe-notes.md 加上觸發、允許動作、輸入保留與回復路徑。
用缺件及修改兩張卡走讀，記錄一項修正理由；核對四格標題與靜態圖界線，保留尚待程式實測的項目。
exercise.expected: 可在瀏覽器開啟的四狀態 wireframe.svg，以及能重演缺件與修改路徑的 wireframe-notes.md。
exercise.check: 同儕或自查能指出各狀態下一步；SVG 按鈕不是實際功能，鍵盤與程式行為仍待實作驗證。
exercise.cleanup: 保留原始參考與自己的修訂版，不加入真實資料、外部圖片或腳本；紙筆替代尚未轉 SVG 時如實標記。

en.summary: Use low-fidelity four-state sketches to explain actions, conditions and feedback, revise through walkthroughs, then refine visual details.
objectives: Represent screen content, primary actions and state transitions in a wireframe.
Create an editable wireframe.svg and notes from the existing four-state SVG.
Explain what a static sketch can investigate and what behavior remains unproven.

readingGuide.goal: Represent screen content, primary actions and state transitions in a wireframe.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor, browser and reference/wireframe.svg from the workshop ZIP. Use synthetic text only; paper can support initial rehearsal.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand wireframe-notes.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A browser-readable four-state wireframe.svg and wireframe-notes.md that supports replaying missing-input and edit paths.

sections.heading: Make the Next Step Explainable
paragraphs: A wireframe uses simple shapes, text and arrangement to show interface content and interaction relationships. Low fidelity temporarily reduces visual detail to focus discussion on fields, information and behavior. It does not justify omitting necessary states.

The course sketch includes input, processing, missing information or failure, and completion. Processing applies only when an operation genuinely takes time; do not delay a fast synchronous check to match a sketch. Each state should explain what is happening, available actions and how to proceed or recover.

sections.heading: Rehearse the Scene Before Decorating It
paragraphs: Rehearsal establishes entrances, signals and scene changes before choosing scenery colors. Discussing curtains while leaving error responses unassigned can still make the performance stall.

A wireframe similarly arranges work information and states first. Paper cards can simulate returning to input after omissions before every button is coded. That rehearsal does not execute a program or establish implemented checking rules.

sections.heading: Annotate Triggers and Restrictions Beside Screens
paragraphs: These cards are textual alternatives to the four panels. They show different situations, not mandatory errors on every attempt. Technical failures need separate recovery notes rather than being confused with missing data.

Completion means only passing this course’s three-field completeness rules. Any input edit should invalidate the result. Write that condition beside the completion panel and connect it to spec.md instead of leaving it only in the programmer’s memory.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | What the Four Panels Need to Communicate
blocks.description: Each card is a screen state. Check results and input events determine transitions; these are not four fixed steps.

items.title: Input
items.body: Three persistent field names, required/synthetic-data guidance and a check action.

items.title: Processing, when applicable
items.body: Only for a real wait: retain input, prevent duplicate submission and define timeout/failure exits.

items.title: Missing information / failure
items.body: For omissions, identify fields and correction. For technical failure, explain available actions separately.

items.title: Complete
items.body: Show current preview/export and completeness limits. Edits return the task to needing a recheck.

sections.heading: Make Your SVG Copy from the Download
paragraphs: Open the workshop resources page, download aase-v1-workshop.zip and extract it. reference/wireframe.svg is the teacher’s four-state reference. Preserve it and copy it into your project as wireframe.svg. Open the copy in a browser to view it and a text editor to edit its text.

Initially change only text inside text elements, preserving SVG markup, coordinates and viewBox. Save and refresh the browser. For an XML error, return to an unmodified copy and repeat one text change. Do not add scripts or external content. Put longer annotations in wireframe-notes.md to avoid overflowing panels.

If download is temporarily unavailable, rehearse four annotated panels on paper. The final artifact still needs wireframe.svg. This static reference’s button labels do not check data. Four panels do not automatically supply responsive or accessible form behavior.

sections.heading: Choose Fidelity for the Question You Need to Answer
paragraphs: GOV.UK’s prototype guidance distinguishes paper sketches from code prototypes with closer-to-real interactions, choosing according to current needs. Sketches support quick content and action discussions; actual keyboard, focus, input retention and dynamic notifications need an operable prototype.

This course does not require GOV.UK’s visual style or toolkit. Read through the CEH-based teaching layout and design your intake application in the workshop. The learning website’s reading frame and the student’s application are different objects.

sections.heading: Record Reasons for Changes After a Walkthrough
paragraphs: Give a peer a missing-input card and ask which panel applies, which field to change and when export is possible. Record understanding without first pointing out the next action. Follow with the edit-after-check card to examine result invalidation. Independent learners may check cards themselves without recording self-review as participant testing.

A common mistake is ignoring accessibility in a monochrome sketch. Plan labels, error text, primary actions and sensible reading order while retaining programmatic relationships and keyboard behavior as unproven. Record one change reason before M04-05 and M04-06 examine disclosure and recovery.

blocks.heading: Behavior Notes for Four Panels
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records current-input checking, conditional processing, missing-input recovery, separate technical failure, limited completion/export, edit invalidation, cancellation, actual walkthrough/self-review reasons and pending program/keyboard/focus/notification tests. Adapt it for class; it is not actual rules or findings.
blocks.code:
# wireframe.svg 行為附註（合成設計）
輸入 → 檢查：以目前三欄資料為準
處理中：只在耗時操作適用，不刻意增加延遲
缺漏 → 補填：保留已填值，指出欄位，重新檢查
技術失敗：另說明失敗與可採動作，不宣告完成
完成 → 匯出：僅表示本次完整性檢查通過
完成後修改：舊結果失效，回到待重查
取消：不產生本次報告；資料處理另依需求確認
走讀修改：填實際觀察或自查理由，不虛構真人
待驗：程式規則、鍵盤、焦點與動態通知

exercise.environment: A text editor, browser and reference/wireframe.svg from the workshop ZIP. Use synthetic text only; paper can support initial rehearsal.
steps: Download and extract the workshop ZIP, copy reference/wireframe.svg to your project as wireframe.svg and confirm it opens in a browser.
Edit one text element, refresh and check for clipping. Add triggers, allowed actions, input retention and recovery to wireframe-notes.md.
Walk through missing-input and edit cards and record one change reason. Check four-panel titles and static-image limits, retaining pending program tests.
exercise.expected: A browser-readable four-state wireframe.svg and wireframe-notes.md that supports replaying missing-input and edit paths.
exercise.check: A peer or self-review can identify the next action for each state. SVG buttons are not working features; keyboard and program behavior remain to be verified.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the original reference and your revision. Add no real data, external images or scripts. Label a paper substitute honestly until converted to SVG.

zh.prompt: 低保真草圖最應先確認什麼？
options: 品牌色是否流行
所有動畫是否完成
介面內容、動作、狀態與回復路徑是否可理解
伺服器效能已達標
rationales: 配色可後續細化，不能取代行為。
本章不需先完成動畫。
這是草圖能協助討論的核心工作。
靜態草圖不測伺服器效能。

en.prompt: What should a low-fidelity sketch establish first?
options: Whether brand colors are fashionable.
Whether all animations are complete.
Whether content, actions, states and recovery paths are understandable.
Whether server performance meets targets.
rationales: Color refinement cannot replace behavior design.
Animation need not be completed first.
These are core questions a sketch can support.
A static sketch does not test server performance.

zh.prompt: 四格中有處理中狀態，實作應如何處理？
options: 只有真有等待才顯示，並設計失敗或逾時出口
每次強制延遲以便看動畫
收到輸入就先顯示完成
處理中可遺失已填資料
rationales: 狀態回饋應對應真實行為。
假的延遲會增加無必要等待。
未取得結果不應宣告完成。
需設計進度保留與復原。

en.prompt: The sketch has a processing panel. How should implementation handle it?
options: Show it only for an actual wait, defining failure or timeout exits.
Always delay execution to show animation.
Show completion as soon as input arrives.
Lose entered data during processing.
rationales: State feedback should match actual behavior.
Artificial delay creates unnecessary waiting.
Do not declare completion before results exist.
Plan progress retention and recovery.

zh.prompt: 同儕看懂 SVG 並指出匯出位置，能證明什麼？
options: 應用程式支援所有鍵盤操作
所有檢核規則已通過測試
正式上線安全已驗證
本次草圖中的理解線索可被指出，程式與實際操作仍待驗
rationales: SVG 沒有真實表單的鍵盤路徑。
沒有執行檢核程式。
草圖不驗證上線安全。
結論限於靜態草圖走讀範圍。

en.prompt: A peer understands the SVG and locates export. What does this establish?
options: The application supports every keyboard action.
Every checking rule passed tests.
Production security is verified.
The peer identified understanding cues in this sketch; code and actual operation remain to be verified.
rationales: An SVG has no real form keyboard path.
No checking program was executed.
A sketch does not verify deployment security.
The conclusion stays within the static walkthrough’s scope.

zh.summary: 依照使用者當下的決策安排資訊：主畫面保留必要欄位、檢核結果與復原方法，次要設定延後展開。
objectives: 區分可延後呈現的設定與必須直接顯示的工作狀態。
為輸入、處理中、缺漏及完成狀態設計下一步。
用同儕任務觀察檢查介面簡化是否真的有幫助。

sections.heading: 主畫面要幫使用者做哪個決定
paragraphs: 收件人員打開檢核網站，當下要決定的是資料能否交接。他需要看到必要欄位、檢查按鈕、缺漏與修正方式，以及完成後的預覽。輪詢間隔、除錯輸出與模型參數通常不影響這個工作決定，可以放在次要設定或教學開發環境。
但「處理中」影響他是否應再次點擊，「失敗」影響他是否需要重試，這些資訊要直接顯示。簡化畫面時，先畫出使用者要做的決定，再安排資訊位置。

sections.heading: 像自助取票機的主要畫面
paragraphs: 取票時，你需要選目的地、張數並知道付款是否完成。機器維護者可能需要交易紀錄與連線診斷；把兩者一起攤在首頁，乘客就得從大量無關資訊中尋找下一步。反過來，如果機器把付款失敗也藏進設定，乘客可能不知道是否已扣款。
漸進揭露是將較少使用或較複雜的選項延後呈現。它的條件是：被延後的資訊不妨礙使用者判斷目前狀態、風險與下一步。使用者需要立即知道的錯誤不符合這個條件。

sections.heading: 四種狀態，各有一個明確下一步
paragraphs: 下圖比較各狀態應該保留的訊息。四張卡是互斥的畫面情境，不代表每次操作都會先發生錯誤再完成。沒有耗時操作時，不必為了展示而加入假的等待時間。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜同一個表單的四種狀態；每種狀態都要回答「現在發生什麼、接著能做什麼」。
blocks.description: 各卡片為並列比較，依標題辨識情境。

items.title: 輸入
items.body: 直接標示三個必要欄位與檢查按鈕；說明僅使用合成資料。

items.title: 處理中
items.body: 若操作確實需要等待，顯示正在檢查；避免重複提交，並提供適當的失敗或逾時處理。

items.title: 缺漏或失敗
items.body: 指出缺少文件類型，保留已填內容，讓人補齊；程式失敗則另說明可重試，不混稱資料不完整。

items.title: 完成
items.body: 說明三個必要欄位已齊全，提供預覽與匯出；不將此狀態宣稱為正式受理。

sections.heading: 用原則檢查資訊安排
paragraphs: NN/G 的易用性原則包含系統狀態可見、錯誤預防、極簡設計與錯誤復原。套用到本課時，可以問：人是否知道檢查結果？缺漏時能否避免錯誤匯出？畫面是否有和當前任務無關的資訊？錯誤提示是否說明如何修正？
例如「ERROR: INVALID」只顯示失敗；「缺少文件類型，請補填後重新檢查」則提供可行動的資訊。這是本課的原創例子；原則提供檢查方向，實際用詞仍需和目標使用者測試。

sections.heading: 兩種容易造成問題的簡化
paragraphs: 第一種是只留下綠色按鈕與打勾圖示。色覺、光線或閱讀習慣不同的人可能無法確定意義；應加上可讀文字，讓完成狀態與按鈕目的清楚。欄位也要有持續可辨識的名稱，不只依賴輸入後就消失的提示字。
第二種是把所有說明都放進收合區。補充範例適合收合，但缺漏欄位、匯出限制與系統失敗要在工作區直接看見。使用者不應為了知道為什麼無法繼續而猜測哪個設定需要展開。

sections.heading: 輸入變更後，舊結果怎麼辦
paragraphs: 假設使用者先填齊三欄，得到完整預覽，接著刪掉文件類型。如果舊報告仍可下載，介面的完成狀態已經落後於目前輸入。可以讓任何輸入變更都使舊結果失效，直到重新檢查；或在匯出時重新驗證目前資料。
選定的策略要寫進 spec.md 並加入測試。光是隱藏匯出按鈕不會自動建立後端規則；處理匯出的程式也必須拒絕缺漏輸入。UX 與業務規則要一起維持相同承諾。

sections.heading: 觀察任務，不替試用者操作
paragraphs: 給同儕一筆缺少文件類型的合成資料，請他「確認能否交接，若不行請修正並匯出」。不要先指著錯誤區告訴他答案。記錄他第一次點哪裡、是否發現缺漏、是否誤認為正式受理，以及需要哪些提示。
若他卡住，先記下發生位置與原話，再問他以為按鈕會做什麼。這些觀察可形成下一次修改假設。一次同儕試用可找出具體問題，不能據此宣稱所有人都容易使用。

exercise.environment: 紙筆或繪圖工具；使用三個合成欄位的表單。
steps: 畫出輸入、處理中、缺漏或失敗、完成四種狀態，逐一寫出使用者下一步。
把診斷設定放到次要區，保留缺漏提示與完成定義；設計輸入變更後舊結果失效的方式。
請同儕依缺漏資料完成任務，只觀察並記錄阻礙，再修正一項介面設計。
exercise.expected: 四狀態 wireframe 與至少一項有觀察依據的修正；可用 SVG 作為交付格式。
exercise.check: 請試用者用自己的話說出目前狀態與下一步；核對是否可不靠顏色、懸停或他人指引完成。
exercise.cleanup: 保留去識別化觀察與修正前後版本；丟棄真實個資及非必要錄影。

readingGuide.goal: 區分可延後呈現的設定與必須直接顯示的工作狀態。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 紙筆或繪圖工具；使用三個合成欄位的表單。
readingGuide.route: 先讀原理與例子，再完成最小實作，最後核對理解檢核與參考解析。
readingGuide.output: 四狀態 wireframe 與至少一項有觀察依據的修正；可用 SVG 作為交付格式。

en.summary: Arrange information around the user’s current decision: keep required fields, checking results and recovery visible, while deferring secondary settings.
objectives: Distinguish deferrable settings from work states that must remain directly visible.
Design next actions for input, processing, missing information and completion.
Observe peer tasks to check whether simplification helps.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish deferrable settings from work states that must remain directly visible.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Paper or a drawing tool and a form with three synthetic fields.
readingGuide.route: Read the principles and examples, complete the small exercise, then compare your understanding with the checks and reference explanations.
readingGuide.output: A four-state wireframe and at least one observation-based revision, optionally delivered as SVG.

sections.heading: Identify the Decision the Main Screen Supports
paragraphs: An intake worker opening the checking site needs to decide whether data is ready for handoff. Show required fields, a check button, omissions and corrections, then a preview after completion. Polling intervals, debug output and model parameters usually do not affect that decision and can belong in secondary settings or the teaching development environment.
Processing affects whether to click again; failure affects whether to retry. Keep those states directly visible. Map decisions before positioning information when simplifying a screen.

sections.heading: Like the Main Screen of a Ticket Machine
paragraphs: Buying a ticket requires a destination, quantity and payment status. Maintenance staff may need transaction logs and connection diagnostics. Showing everything on the home screen makes passengers search through unrelated information. Hiding payment failure in settings, however, can leave them unsure whether they were charged.

Progressive disclosure defers less-used or complex options. Deferral is appropriate only when it does not obstruct judgment of current state, risk and next action. An error users need now does not meet that condition.

sections.heading: Give Each State a Clear Next Action
paragraphs: The cards compare information to retain for each state. They are mutually exclusive screen situations, not a requirement to pass through an error before completion. Do not add an artificial wait when no operation takes time.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Four States of the Same Form
blocks.description: Each state should explain what is happening and what can happen next. The cards compare alternative situations.

items.title: Input
items.body: Label the three required fields and check button directly, explaining that only synthetic data is used.

items.title: Processing
items.body: For a genuine wait, show checking status, prevent duplicate submission and provide suitable failure or timeout handling.

items.title: Missing information or failure
items.body: Identify missing document type, retain other input and allow correction. Explain retryable program failure separately from incomplete data.

items.title: Complete
items.body: State that three required fields are complete and offer preview/export. Do not imply official acceptance.

sections.heading: Use Principles to Inspect Information Arrangement
paragraphs: NN/G’s heuristics include visible system status, error prevention, minimalist design and recovery. Ask whether people know the result, missing-input export is prevented, unrelated content competes with the task and feedback explains correction.

“ERROR: INVALID” communicates failure only; “Document type is missing. Fill it in and check again” gives an action. This is an original course example. Principles guide inspection, while wording still needs testing with intended users.

sections.heading: Two Simplifications That Can Cause Problems
paragraphs: Keeping only a green button and check mark may leave people uncertain under different color perception, lighting or reading habits. Add readable text explaining completion and button purpose. Keep field names identifiable rather than relying only on placeholders that disappear after entry.

Putting every explanation in collapsible areas creates another problem. Supplementary examples may be deferred, but missing fields, export restrictions and system failures must be visible in the work area. Users should not have to guess which setting explains why they cannot continue.

sections.heading: Decide What Happens to Results After Input Changes
paragraphs: Suppose the user completes three fields, receives a complete preview and then deletes document type. An old downloadable report would make completion lag behind current input. Invalidate old results on any edit until rechecking, or revalidate current input when exporting.

Record the chosen strategy in spec.md and tests. Hiding an export button alone does not enforce a backend rule: export-processing code must also reject missing input. UX and business rules need to maintain the same promise.

sections.heading: Observe the Task Without Operating for the Participant
paragraphs: Give a peer synthetic data missing document type and ask them to check readiness for handoff, correct it if necessary and export. Do not point at the error area first. Record their first action, whether they notice the omission, confuse completeness with official acceptance or need hints.

If they become stuck, record the location and their actual words before asking what they expected the button to do. Those observations can inform the next hypothesis. One peer session can expose concrete problems, not establish usability for everyone.

exercise.environment: Paper or a drawing tool and a form with three synthetic fields.
steps: Draw input, processing, missing-information/failure and complete states, specifying the user’s next action for each.
Move diagnostics to a secondary area while retaining errors and the completion definition. Design invalidation of old results after input edits.
Have a peer perform the missing-input task. Observe and record barriers, then revise one interface decision.
exercise.expected: A four-state wireframe and at least one observation-based revision, optionally delivered as SVG.
exercise.check: Ask the participant to explain current state and next action in their own words. Check whether completion can rely on more than color, hover or another person’s guidance.
exercise.cleanup: Retain de-identified observations and before/after versions. Discard real personal data and unnecessary recordings.

zh.prompt: 為了讓主畫面簡潔，哪一項安排最合適？
options: 把缺漏錯誤藏進進階設定
只以紅色邊框表示失敗
直接顯示缺漏與修正方法，將除錯設定放到次要區
收到檢查結果前先顯示完成
rationales: 缺漏影響當下工作決定，應直接呈現。
僅靠顏色不清楚，也未說明如何修正。
當前任務所需的資訊可見，較少使用的設定延後呈現。
應依真實狀態回饋，避免誤導人提早交接。

en.prompt: Which arrangement best simplifies the main screen?
options: Hide missing-input errors in advanced settings.
Indicate failure with a red border only.
Show omissions and correction directly, placing debug settings in a secondary area.
Show completion before check results arrive.
rationales: Omissions affect the current decision and need direct feedback.
Color alone is unclear and explains no correction.
Information needed now remains visible while less-used settings are deferred.
Feedback should match actual state to avoid premature handoff.

zh.summary: 設計能找到問題、保留進度並回到任務的錯誤處理，並以鍵盤、文字標籤與實際任務檢查可近用性。
objectives: 區分資料缺漏、程式失敗與結果過期的復原方式。
為欄位標籤、焦點、鍵盤與非顏色提示寫出待驗條件。
保留自動檢查、人工操作與真人易用性測試各自的證據範圍。

readingGuide.goal: 區分資料缺漏、程式失敗與結果過期的復原方式。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 先用四狀態草圖；有自己的本機原型或教師示範環境後，再用瀏覽器與鍵盤操作。未啟動原型不填實測結果。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 wireframe-notes.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: 具有復原設計及如實區分草圖、鍵盤實測與待驗項目的 wireframe-notes.md。

sections.heading: 錯誤訊息要讓任務繼續
paragraphs: 錯誤復原要回答哪裡出錯、使用者現在能做什麼，以及先前工作是否還在。「發生錯誤」通常不夠；本課缺少文件類型時，應指出該欄、保留另外兩欄，讓使用者補填後重新檢查。
資料缺漏、程式失敗與結果過期需要不同回饋。缺漏要補資料；技術失敗要說明目前未完成並提供適當重試或求助方式；結果過期則要以目前輸入重新檢查。不能把三者都顯示成「請重新輸入全部資料」。

sections.heading: 像道路封閉時提供可用的繞行方式
paragraphs: 道路封閉標示若只寫「錯誤」，駕駛仍不知道去哪裡。清楚指出封閉路段、可走路線與返回主線的位置，才支援繼續行程。介面也需要具體回復動作，而不只是警示圖示。
同時，指示要能被不同方式感知與操作。只以紅色標出缺件，對無法辨識該顏色的人可能不足；只在滑鼠移上去才出現說明，也不一定能由鍵盤取得。這些都應在設計時先列入待驗條件。

sections.heading: 以文字把位置、原因與動作連起來
paragraphs: W3C 的表單通知指南建議提供清楚的成功與錯誤回饋，錯誤內容要能指出相關欄位並說明如何修正。若用錯誤摘要，可讓其中項目協助使用者到達欄位；欄位旁的提示也需與控制項在程式中建立關聯。
動態訊息還要讓輔助科技能得知適當更新，不能只依視覺插入一段紅字。實作時需依訊息急迫性與元件選擇合適通知方式，並測試避免重複或打斷；本章不以任意加上 ARIA 就宣稱通過。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜三種問題，三條復原路徑
blocks.description: 卡片是不同問題的對照，不是固定發生順序；訊息必須符合實際狀態。

items.title: 資料缺漏
items.body: 缺少文件類型，請補填後重新檢查；保留其他已填內容，沒有完整匯出。

items.title: 程式失敗
items.body: 本次檢查未完成；保留輸入，依實際原因提供可行重試或求助。

items.title: 結果過期
items.body: 輸入已修改，請重新檢查；撤銷舊完成狀態與舊報告出口。

sections.heading: 可近用要落在操作與程式關係
paragraphs: 可近用性關心不同能力與輔助方式的使用者能否感知、理解及操作內容。W3C 的鍵盤說明要求功能可透過鍵盤介面操作，並明列以移動路徑為必要輸入的例外；本課的填寫、檢查與匯出不屬自由手繪，應有鍵盤路徑。焦點也需可見，讓人知道下一次按鍵作用在哪裡。
標籤與欄位要有程式關聯，視覺上的靠近不能取代它；顏色可輔助強調，但錯誤、完成與必要欄位的意思不只靠色相。這些是不同檢查面向，不能只測 Tab 能走完就宣稱整頁符合 WCAG。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜把設計承諾寫成待驗條件
rows: 標籤
輸入後仍知道欄位用途，控制項有可辨識名稱
檢查實際 DOM／可近用名稱；草圖位置不能代替
鍵盤與焦點
不用滑鼠可填寫、檢查、修正及匯出，知道目前焦點
人工或瀏覽器操作；也要檢查能離開元件
錯誤與進度
缺漏指出欄位，已填值保留，補齊後可重查
重演缺件情境；不等於所有錯誤都已涵蓋
非顏色訊息
文字或其他線索能識別錯誤與完成
檢查不只依賴顏色，輔助科技另需核對語意
動態狀態
更新能被適當感知且不無故搶焦點
依實作測試通知與輔助科技；不可由截圖判定

sections.heading: 用可重演的任務檢查恢復能力
paragraphs: 在自己的本機原型或教師示範環境，先用鍵盤輸入申請編號與申請人代號，保留文件類型空白後啟動檢查。觀察錯誤是否指出欄位、已填值是否還在、能否到達並修正。補齊與重新檢查後，再修改欄位，確認舊完成狀態不能繼續使用。
本課提供的 Streamlit 參考程式可供練習，但這段文字本身不是該程式的完整無障礙驗收。若發現焦點不可見、訊息沒被感知或某動作無法完成，記錄瀏覽器、步驟與觀察；尚未實作原型時先完成草圖檢查，實際鍵盤與輔助科技保持待驗。

sections.heading: 分開可近用、易用與通過證據
paragraphs: 可近用與易用彼此相關，但不能互相取代。通過一組技術檢查仍可能讓使用者不懂欄位；一次同儕順利操作，也不證明所有使用者或輔助科技可用。自動檢查、人工操作與真人任務觀察要各自寫明範圍。
常見誤解是「補一個說明頁就解決錯誤」。若當前畫面沒有指出缺哪欄，使用者仍需自己猜。先讓必要回饋與復原方法在任務位置可得，再將額外說明作補充；將確認的行為接到 M05 規格與 M08 驗證。

blocks.heading: 復原與可近用觀察表
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 wireframe-notes.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# 復原觀察（合成任務）
環境：填寫實際瀏覽器與版本；尚未執行則填待驗
路徑：缺件 → 補齊 → 重查 → 修改 → 再重查
輸入保留：觀察值，不填預期值當結果
欄位名稱／錯誤關聯：實際核對或待驗
鍵盤／焦點：可達、可操作、可離開、可見
狀態：文字能辨識，不只靠顏色
輔助科技與真人任務：未執行則填待驗
發現與下一步：記錄阻礙、修改假設與重測條件
界線：這份觀察不等於完整 WCAG 認證

exercise.environment: 先用四狀態草圖；有自己的本機原型或教師示範環境後，再用瀏覽器與鍵盤操作。未啟動原型不填實測結果。
steps: 在草圖上分別標記缺漏、技術失敗與結果過期的訊息、進度保留及回復動作。
若原型可用，將滑鼠放旁邊，以 Tab／Shift+Tab、文字輸入及適合元件的按鍵重演缺件修正；觀察焦點與可離開性。
將實際結果或待驗狀態寫入 wireframe-notes.md，另列輔助科技、真人任務與未覆蓋錯誤；選一項阻礙安排修改與重測。
exercise.expected: 具有復原設計及如實區分草圖、鍵盤實測與待驗項目的 wireframe-notes.md。
exercise.check: 三類問題有不同出口；不把缺少原型時的紙上檢查、單次鍵盤操作或截圖當完整可近用認證。
exercise.cleanup: 只用合成資料，保留環境與重演步驟；不公開非必要個資或未授權錄影。

en.summary: Design error handling that locates problems, preserves progress and returns users to their task, then check accessibility through keyboards, text labels and actual tasks.
objectives: Distinguish recovery for missing input, program failure and stale results.
Define pending checks for labels, focus, keyboard operation and non-color feedback.
Retain separate evidence scopes for automated checks, manual operation and actual participant usability tests.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish recovery for missing input, program failure and stale results.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Begin with four-state sketches. Use a browser and keyboard once your local prototype or a teacher demonstration is available; record no runtime results before starting it.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand wireframe-notes.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: wireframe-notes.md with recovery design and honest distinctions among sketches, actual keyboard checks and pending items.

sections.heading: Make Error Feedback Support Continued Work
paragraphs: Recovery should explain what failed, what users can do and whether previous work remains. “An error occurred” is usually insufficient. For missing document type, identify that field, retain the other two and allow correction followed by rechecking.

Missing input, technical failure and stale results need different feedback. Omissions require data; failures require an honest unfinished state with suitable retry/help; stale results need current-input rechecking. Do not reduce all three to “re-enter everything.”

sections.heading: Provide a Usable Diversion Around a Closed Road
paragraphs: A closure sign saying only “error” gives drivers no route. Identifying the closure, alternative and return point helps them continue. An interface similarly needs specific recovery actions beyond a warning icon.

Guidance also needs different ways to perceive and operate it. Red-only missing-input feedback may be insufficient for someone who cannot distinguish that color. Hover-only explanations may be unavailable by keyboard. List such conditions for verification during design.

sections.heading: Connect Location, Cause and Action in Text
paragraphs: W3C’s forms notification guidance recommends clear success/error feedback identifying relevant fields and correction. An error summary can help users reach fields; nearby feedback also needs a programmatic relationship with controls.

Assistive technology must be able to receive appropriate dynamic updates, not just a newly inserted red paragraph. Choose notification mechanisms for urgency and component behavior, then test for duplication or interruption. Arbitrarily adding ARIA does not establish a pass.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Problems with Different Recovery Paths
blocks.description: The cards compare problems, not a fixed occurrence sequence. Messages must match actual state.

items.title: Missing information
items.body: Document type is missing. Retain other values, explain correction and rechecking, and offer no complete-report export.

items.title: Program failure
items.body: This check did not finish. Keep input and provide feasible retry or help based on the actual cause.

items.title: Stale results
items.body: Input changed. Recheck it, withdrawing old completion status and report access.

sections.heading: Verify Actual Operation and Programmatic Relationships
paragraphs: Accessibility concerns whether people with different abilities and support methods can perceive, understand and operate content. W3C’s keyboard explanation requires keyboard operation, with an exception for functions inherently dependent on movement paths. Filling, checking and exporting here are not freehand drawing and need keyboard paths. Visible focus identifies where the next keystroke acts.

Labels and controls need programmatic association; visual proximity cannot substitute. Color can reinforce meaning, but errors, completion and required fields must not rely on hue alone. These are separate aspects: tabbing through controls does not establish whole-page WCAG conformance.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Turn Design Promises into Pending Checks
rows: Labels
Purpose remains clear after entry; controls have identifiable names.
Inspect actual DOM/accessibility names; sketch placement is insufficient.
Keyboard and focus
Enter, check, correct and export without a mouse, knowing current focus.
Manual or browser operation; verify that controls can also be exited.
Errors and progress
Identify missing fields, retain values and recheck after correction.
Replay the case without claiming coverage of every error.
Non-color feedback
Text or other cues identify errors and completion.
Check meaning beyond color; verify assistive-technology semantics separately.
Dynamic status
Updates are perceivable appropriately without unjustified focus changes.
Test notifications and assistive technology in implementation; screenshots cannot establish this.

sections.heading: Use Replayable Tasks to Check Recovery
paragraphs: In your local prototype or the teacher environment, use the keyboard to enter application number and applicant code, leaving document type blank before checking. Observe field-specific feedback, retained input and correction access. After completing and rechecking, edit a field again and confirm that old completion cannot still be used.

The Streamlit reference supports practice, but this description is not its complete accessibility acceptance. Record browser, steps and observations for invisible focus, imperceptible feedback or unavailable actions. Without an implemented prototype, complete sketch review and leave actual keyboard/assistive-technology checks pending.

sections.heading: Separate Accessibility, Usability and Evidence of Passing
paragraphs: Accessibility and usability relate without replacing each other. Technical checks may pass while field meaning remains unclear. One successful peer task does not establish access for all users or assistive technologies. State the scope of automated checks, manual operation and actual participant observation separately.

A common mistake is assuming a help page resolves errors. Without field-specific feedback on the current screen, users still guess. Keep necessary feedback and recovery available at the task, with additional guidance as support. Connect confirmed behavior to M05 specifications and M08 verification.

blocks.heading: Recovery and Accessibility Observation Record
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records actual browser/version or pending status, correction/recheck/edit paths, observed retention, label/error association, reachable/operable/exitable/visible focus, non-color status, pending assistive-technology/participant work, barriers and retest conditions. It explicitly is not full WCAG certification; adapt it for class without inventing findings.
blocks.code:
# 復原觀察（合成任務）
環境：填寫實際瀏覽器與版本；尚未執行則填待驗
路徑：缺件 → 補齊 → 重查 → 修改 → 再重查
輸入保留：觀察值，不填預期值當結果
欄位名稱／錯誤關聯：實際核對或待驗
鍵盤／焦點：可達、可操作、可離開、可見
狀態：文字能辨識，不只靠顏色
輔助科技與真人任務：未執行則填待驗
發現與下一步：記錄阻礙、修改假設與重測條件
界線：這份觀察不等於完整 WCAG 認證

exercise.environment: Begin with four-state sketches. Use a browser and keyboard once your local prototype or a teacher demonstration is available; record no runtime results before starting it.
steps: Annotate separate feedback, progress retention and recovery for omissions, technical failure and stale results on the sketch.
If a prototype is available, set the mouse aside. Replay correction with Tab/Shift+Tab, text input and appropriate component keys, observing focus and ability to leave controls.
Record actual results or pending status in wireframe-notes.md. List assistive-technology tests, participant tasks and uncovered errors separately; select one barrier for revision and retesting.
exercise.expected: wireframe-notes.md with recovery design and honest distinctions among sketches, actual keyboard checks and pending items.
exercise.check: The three problems have different exits. Do not treat tabletop review without a prototype, one keyboard path or screenshots as complete accessibility certification.
exercise.cleanup: Use synthetic data only. Keep environment and replay steps; publish no unnecessary personal information or unauthorized recordings.

zh.prompt: 缺少文件類型時，哪種安排最能支援復原？
options: 只顯示紅色邊框
保留已填值，以文字指出缺少欄位、補填方法與重新檢查
清空全部欄位但不說原因
讓使用者下載仍標完整的舊報告
rationales: 缺少文字與動作，也只依賴顏色。
能定位、修正並繼續任務。
增加重填且沒有解釋。
過期或缺件資料不能沿用完整結果。

en.prompt: What best supports recovery when document type is missing?
options: A red border alone.
Retain entered values and identify the missing field, correction and rechecking in text.
Clear every field without explanation.
Allow the stale report still marked complete.
rationales: This lacks wording/action and relies only on color.
Users can locate, correct and continue the task.
This adds re-entry without explanation.
Stale or missing input cannot reuse a complete result.

zh.prompt: 鍵盤可以 Tab 到所有元件後，還應檢查什麼？
options: 只要能到就完全符合 WCAG
所有按鈕必須同時觸發
焦點可見、可操作、可離開、順序合理，其他可近用面向也需分別核對
把焦點框全部隱藏讓畫面乾淨
rationales: 可達只是一部分，不能代表整頁合規。
會造成未預期行為。
檢查涵蓋實際操作，也保留不同面向。
隱藏焦點會讓鍵盤使用者不知道目前位置。

en.prompt: After Tab reaches every control, what else needs checking?
options: Reachability alone fully satisfies WCAG.
Every button must trigger simultaneously.
Visible focus, operation, exits and sensible order, plus other accessibility aspects separately.
Hide all focus outlines for simplicity.
rationales: Reachability is only one aspect, not whole-page conformance.
That creates unexpected behavior.
This covers actual operation while retaining separate aspects.
Hidden focus leaves keyboard users uncertain of their location.

zh.prompt: 尚無可操作原型時，本章練習結果應如何記錄？
options: 全部標通過，因為草圖有文字
虛構瀏覽器與測試紀錄
宣稱螢幕閱讀器能理解圖片
完成草圖復原設計，實際鍵盤與輔助科技保持待驗
rationales: 草圖無法證明實際操作。
環境與結果需如實記錄。
圖片文字不會自動建立表單關聯。
把設計與實測分開，下一步驗證才可追溯。

en.prompt: No operable prototype exists yet. How should results be recorded?
options: Mark everything passed because the sketch has text.
Invent browser and test records.
Claim a screen reader understands the image.
Complete sketch recovery design while leaving actual keyboard and assistive-technology tests pending.
rationales: A sketch cannot establish operation.
Record environment and results honestly.
Image text does not automatically create form relationships.
Separating design from execution keeps later verification traceable.

zh.summary: 分開本次交給 Agent 的工作指令與系統必須符合的行為，讓換工具、換人或重新對話後仍有共同驗收依據。
objectives: 區分 Prompt 的任務安排與 Spec 的系統行為責任。
將模糊要求改寫成有輸入、結果、例外與界線的規格。
為 Agent 指令指定規格來源、修改範圍與停止條件。

readingGuide.goal: 區分 Prompt 的任務安排與 Spec 的系統行為責任。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器、problem.md 與現有 spec.md 工作表；不需啟動 Agent 或安裝工具。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 spec.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: spec.md 有可驗收的系統承諾，另有一段清楚引用它的 Agent 任務草案。

sections.heading: 先分清楚要誰做什麼
paragraphs: Prompt 是本次對模型或 Agent 的輸入，可以包含目標、背景、規則、文件位置及工作方式。Spec（Specification，規格）記錄系統需要符合的行為與限制，用來討論、實作及驗收。Prompt 可以引用 Spec，也可以包含一部分規格；兩者差別在責任，不是字數或副檔名。
例如「先讀 spec.md，只修改缺漏檢核，完成後回報 Diff 與測試」安排本次工作；「文件類型缺漏時，拒絕完整匯出並指出該欄」描述系統承諾。即使開發工具從 Coding Agent 換成同事，後者仍應成立。

sections.heading: 像施工交辦與驗收圖說
paragraphs: 施工交辦可以說今天先處理哪個區域、避免動到哪裡、遇到問題先回報。圖說與驗收條件則定義交付物要符合什麼。只交代「做漂亮一點」，每個人可能都努力做了，卻沒有共同標準判斷結果。
軟體工作也需要把任務安排與交付承諾接起來。很長的對話可能累積許多決定，但如果只留在聊天裡，新一輪 Agent 不一定取得相同內容；將已確認要求放到可版本控制的文件，讓本次指令明確引用它。

sections.heading: 將模糊要求拆成可判斷的承諾
paragraphs: NASA 的需求撰寫檢查表要求清楚、可追溯、可驗證，並區分需要的結果與實作細節。本課只採這些寫作原則，不套用航太專案流程，也不要求初學者一次寫完所有文件。
本課「完整」限定三個必要欄位符合教學規則，不能推論資料內容真實或正式受理。規格應明列輸入、允許與禁止的結果、錯誤回復及不做事項；工具與框架如果是教學環境限制，另列設計約束，不假裝是使用者價值。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜同一要求的三種責任
blocks.description: 卡片表示相互連結的責任，並非固定先後階段；同一規格可由不同實作者共同遵守。

items.title: 問題陳述
items.body: 收件者需要在交接前發現必要欄位缺漏；用來判斷：為誰改善哪項工作，假設是否成立。

items.title: 規格條款
items.body: 必要欄位無有效值時，拒絕完整匯出並指出欄位；用來判斷：系統外部結果是否符合要求。

items.title: Agent 任務指令
items.body: 先讀指定版本規格，列影響，再修改指定檔案與驗證；用來判斷：本次協作的範圍、工具及回報方式。

sections.heading: 交辦時引用規格，也保留停止出口
paragraphs: 有效的 Agent 任務可寫明：先讀哪份規格、要處理哪個情境、允許修改哪些檔案、如何驗證，以及遇到衝突如何停止。不要只說「照前面做」，也不要讓模型自行把未確認的業務規則寫成定案。
以下是可改寫的指令範例，不代表已呼叫 Agent：「請先讀本專案 spec.md 的缺漏與結果過期情境，列出受影響檔案。確認沒有規則衝突後，只處理該範圍；執行可用測試並回報真實結果。若規格缺少定義、需新增依賴或改變資料邊界，先列出問題，停止相關修改。」本課的人類仍需審查規格與變更。

sections.heading: 規格與測試之間還需要連結
paragraphs: 寫出「缺漏不得完整匯出」並不會自動產生正確程式。需用具體輸入形成情境，再連到測試或人工觀察；測試也要確認禁止的結果沒有發生。M05-03 會練習 Given／When／Then，M08 再分辨不同驗證層次。
Cucumber 的 BDD 文件強調跨角色討論具體例子，再使文件與行為相互核對。本課借用這個協作觀點，不將 BDD、Gherkin 與所有 SDD 工具當成同義詞，也不因為文件看似完整就宣稱軟體已通過。

sections.heading: 遇到矛盾時修訂正本
paragraphs: 常見誤解是「Prompt 越長就越像規格」。長度不能解決矛盾。例如聊天要求忽略空白，spec.md 卻規定去除首尾空白後判斷，應先確認「忽略」的意思與決策角色，再更新正本與情境，而不是默默挑容易實作的一句。
保留變更理由與目前版本，讓 Prompt 引用新的要求。規格也可能寫錯，並非不可更改；修正時需知道改了什麼、為何改、影響哪些測試與交付。這會接到 M05-04 的變更流程。

blocks.heading: 規格與本次交辦的分欄紀錄
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 spec.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# 規格承諾（合成教學）
R-01：必要欄位缺漏時，拒絕完整匯出並指出欄位
R-02：輸入修改後，舊完成結果失效
界線：只檢查欄位完整性，不代表正式受理
驗收：連到缺漏、空白與結果過期情境

# 本次 Agent 任務（尚未執行）
讀取：本專案 spec.md 的目前已確認版本
範圍：先列影響，經確認後只改對應檢核與測試
停止：規則衝突、未定義要求或資料邊界改變
回報：Diff、實際命令、結果、未驗項
審查：人類核對規格、修改與驗證證據

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器、problem.md 與現有 spec.md 工作表；不需啟動 Agent 或安裝工具。
steps: 將「做一個好用的收件表單」改寫成一條功能承諾、一條負向限制及完成定義。
另寫一段 Agent 交辦，指定規格來源、修改範圍、驗證與停止條件。
假設換用另一個工具，核對系統承諾仍能用相同情境驗收；把歧義與確認角色留在 spec.md。
exercise.expected: spec.md 有可驗收的系統承諾，另有一段清楚引用它的 Agent 任務草案。
exercise.check: 能說出哪句定義外部結果、哪句安排本次工作；沒有把工具回覆當成驗收。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成資料、未執行標記及規則來源，移除真實案件或帳號內容。

en.summary: Separate the instructions given to an agent now from behavior the system must satisfy, retaining shared acceptance criteria across tools, people and conversations.
objectives: Distinguish a prompt’s task arrangement from a specification’s responsibility for system behavior.
Turn vague requests into specifications with inputs, outcomes, exceptions and boundaries.
Give agent instructions a specification source, change scope and stop conditions.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish a prompt’s task arrangement from a specification’s responsibility for system behavior.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor, problem.md and the existing spec.md worksheet; no agent or tool installation is required.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand spec.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: Verifiable system commitments in spec.md and a separate draft agent task that explicitly references them.

sections.heading: Identify Who Must Do What
paragraphs: A prompt is input to a model or agent for this interaction, potentially including goals, context, rules, document locations and working methods. A specification records required system behavior and limits for discussion, implementation and acceptance. Prompts can reference or contain specifications. The distinction is responsibility, not length or filename.

“Read spec.md first, change only missing-field checking and report the diff and tests” arranges work. “When document type is missing, reject complete-report export and identify the field” defines a system commitment that should hold whether an agent or colleague develops it.

sections.heading: Like Work Instructions and Acceptance Drawings
paragraphs: A construction assignment can identify today’s area, protected areas and when to report problems. Drawings and acceptance conditions define the deliverable. “Make it attractive” may produce sincere effort without a shared way to judge results.

Software work likewise connects assignments to delivery commitments. Decisions may accumulate in a long chat, but a later agent round may not receive the same content. Put confirmed requirements in version-controlled documents and explicitly reference them in the current task.

sections.heading: Turn Vague Requests into Assessable Commitments
paragraphs: NASA’s requirements checklist calls for clarity, traceability and verifiability, distinguishing required outcomes from implementation details. The course adopts those writing principles without importing aerospace processes or requiring beginners to complete every document upfront.

“Complete” here means the three required fields satisfy teaching rules, not that data is true or officially accepted. Specify inputs, allowed and forbidden outcomes, recovery and exclusions. If tools or frameworks are teaching-environment limits, record them as design constraints rather than user value.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Responsibilities Around One Request
blocks.description: The cards show related responsibilities, not fixed phases. Different implementers can follow the same specification.

items.title: Problem statement
items.body: Intake workers need to find missing required fields before handoff. Assess whose work needs improvement and whether assumptions hold.

items.title: Specification clause
items.body: When a required field lacks a valid value, reject complete export and identify it. Assess observable system outcomes.

items.title: Agent task
items.body: Read the specified version, identify impacts, change named files and verify. Assess collaboration scope, tools and reporting.

sections.heading: Reference the Specification and Retain Stop Exits
paragraphs: An agent task can identify the specification, target scenario, permitted files, verification and how to stop for conflicts. Avoid “follow the earlier discussion,” and do not let a model turn unconfirmed business rules into settled decisions.

A draft instruction could say: “Read this project’s spec.md scenarios for missing input and stale results. List affected files. If no rule conflicts remain, work only in that scope, run available tests and report actual results. For undefined requirements, new dependencies or changed data boundaries, list questions and stop related edits.” This is an example, not an executed agent call. People still review specifications and changes.

sections.heading: Connect Specifications to Test Evidence
paragraphs: Writing “missing data must not export as complete” does not create correct code. Give concrete inputs, form scenarios and connect them to tests or observation. Check that forbidden outcomes do not occur. M05-03 practices Given/When/Then, while M08 separates verification layers.

Cucumber’s BDD guidance emphasizes cross-role discussion of concrete examples and checking documentation against behavior. The course adopts that collaboration perspective while distinguishing BDD, Gherkin and SDD tools. Complete-looking documents do not establish passing software.

sections.heading: Revise the Authoritative Record When Rules Conflict
paragraphs: A long prompt is not automatically a better specification. If chat says “ignore whitespace” but spec.md requires trimming leading and trailing whitespace before checking, clarify “ignore” with the decision-owning role, then update the record and scenarios. Do not silently pick the easier sentence.

Keep change reasons and the current version so subsequent prompts reference updated requirements. Specifications can be wrong and revised; retain what changed, why and its effects on tests and delivery. M05-04 develops this change flow.

blocks.heading: Separate System Commitments from the Current Assignment
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records R-01 missing-input blocking, R-02 edit invalidation, the completeness boundary and scenarios, then an unexecuted agent task with source, scope, stops, evidence reporting and human review. Adapt it in spec.md; it is not an actual rule or research result.
blocks.code:
# 規格承諾（合成教學）
R-01：必要欄位缺漏時，拒絕完整匯出並指出欄位
R-02：輸入修改後，舊完成結果失效
界線：只檢查欄位完整性，不代表正式受理
驗收：連到缺漏、空白與結果過期情境

# 本次 Agent 任務（尚未執行）
讀取：本專案 spec.md 的目前已確認版本
範圍：先列影響，經確認後只改對應檢核與測試
停止：規則衝突、未定義要求或資料邊界改變
回報：Diff、實際命令、結果、未驗項
審查：人類核對規格、修改與驗證證據

exercise.environment: A text editor, problem.md and the existing spec.md worksheet; no agent or tool installation is required.
steps: Replace “make a usable intake form” with a functional commitment, a negative restriction and a completion definition.
Write a separate agent assignment specifying source, edit scope, verification and stop conditions.
Assume a different tool is used and check that the same system scenarios remain applicable. Record ambiguity and the confirming role in spec.md.
exercise.expected: Verifiable system commitments in spec.md and a separate draft agent task that explicitly references them.
exercise.check: Identify which sentence defines an external outcome and which arranges current work. A tool response is not acceptance evidence.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic data, unexecuted labels and rule sources. Remove actual case or account information.

zh.prompt: 哪一句最適合放在系統規格？
options: 請 Agent 用最快速度完成
必要欄位缺漏時，系統拒絕完整匯出並指出欄位
先讀兩份文件再回覆
請改完後整理 Diff
rationales: 這是模糊的工作要求。
條件與可觀察結果可供不同實作者驗收。
這安排本次閱讀工作。
這安排協作回報。

en.prompt: Which sentence best belongs in a system specification?
options: Ask the agent to finish as fast as possible.
When a required field is missing, the system rejects complete-report export and identifies the field.
Read two documents before responding.
Summarize the diff after editing.
rationales: This is a vague work request.
The condition and observable outcome can be accepted across implementers.
This arranges reading for the current task.
This arranges collaboration reporting.

zh.prompt: Prompt 與 spec.md 對同一規則互相矛盾，應怎麼做？
options: 採最後出現的句子，不需記錄
讓模型選較容易的版本
保留衝突，向適當角色確認後修訂正本與情境
兩種行為隨機切換
rationales: 時間順序不能單獨確認規則權威。
實作難易不能代替需求決定。
確認與可追溯修訂可維持共同依據。
會產生不一致且無法驗收的結果。

en.prompt: A prompt and spec.md contradict each other about a rule. What should happen?
options: Use the last sentence without recording a decision.
Let the model select the easier version.
Retain the conflict, confirm with the appropriate role and revise the authoritative record and scenarios.
Randomly alternate behaviors.
rationales: Sequence alone does not establish rule authority.
Implementation difficulty cannot decide requirements.
Confirmation and traceable revision retain a shared basis.
This creates inconsistent behavior without usable acceptance criteria.

zh.prompt: 換用另一個 Coding Agent 時，哪項應持續成立？
options: 相同系統行為仍依規格與情境驗收
所有工具命令必須一模一樣
以前的聊天摘要自動取代規格
工具說完成即可結案
rationales: 工具可以改變，外部承諾仍需有共同依據。
不同工具可能有不同操作方式。
摘要可能遺漏規則，需核對正本。
完成宣告需要相應證據支持。

en.prompt: What should remain true after switching Coding Agents?
options: The same system behavior is accepted against specifications and scenarios.
All tool commands must be identical.
An old chat summary automatically replaces the specification.
The tool’s completion statement closes the task.
rationales: Tools may change while external commitments retain a shared basis.
Tools may have different operating methods.
Summaries can omit rules; check the authoritative record.
Completion claims need corresponding evidence.

zh.summary: 先以 User Story 表達角色與價值，再補齊功能、品質及約束，讓需求能對應具體情境與驗證。
objectives: 以角色、工作目標與理由撰寫一則 User Story。
分開功能、品質特性與設計約束，指出它們的關聯。
將模糊的好用、安全或快速改成可觀察條件或待確認事項。

readingGuide.goal: 以角色、工作目標與理由撰寫一則 User Story。
readingGuide.startingPoint: spec.md 工作表與合成收件案例；不需要安裝測試工具。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 spec.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: spec.md 具有Story、功能／品質／約束、情境連結與待確認事項。

sections.heading: 讓故事先交代使用者價值
paragraphs: User Story（使用者故事）可用一句話開啟討論：「身為收件人員，我希望在匯出前看到缺少哪些必要欄位，以便補齊後交接。」角色、想完成的工作與理由都出現，但這句話還沒有定義所有規則。
Agile Alliance 提醒故事不是一份文件，也不通常對應單一畫面或元件；它包含逐步形成的理解。本課使用角色／目標／理由作為練習句型，不要求所有需求都硬套同一個句式。

sections.heading: 像點餐需求與餐點條件
paragraphs: 「午休想吃完再回辦公室」說出目的；點哪道餐、是否可外帶是功能選擇；食材限制與包裝不能漏則是需要滿足的條件。只寫一個目的，不足以告訴廚房怎樣的餐點才算符合。
軟體的 Story 也要補問題。例如哪些欄位必要、什麼值算缺漏、修改後舊結果怎麼處理、使用者如何恢復。這些回答才會形成可驗收的規格，不能由故事句型自動推導。

sections.heading: 分類是協助討論，不是劃出互斥盒子
paragraphs: 功能需求描述系統做什麼，例如列出缺漏欄位與提供符合契約的報告。非功能需求常用來表達品質特性，例如可近用性、效能、可靠性與可維護性；此外也會有環境、資料或技術約束。不同團隊分類可能不同，重點是條件清楚、責任與驗證可追溯。
不要把所有資安要求一律放進模糊的非功能欄。例如拒絕未授權讀取是可觀察行為，資料保存限制又可能跨架構與治理。本課先限單人、合成資料及無持久儲存，不把這些限制宣稱成多人系統安全已解決。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜同一故事需要補上的三類條件
blocks.description: 三張卡是討論面向，可能互相影響；分類名稱不能取代具體要求。

items.title: 功能
items.body: 哪個輸入、動作與結果要成立？缺漏時不能產生完整報告。

items.title: 品質
items.body: 在什麼情境下要可操作、可靠或可理解？為鍵盤與錯誤復原列出待驗行為。

items.title: 約束
items.body: 哪些資料、環境與責任是本版邊界？只用合成資料，單人本機，不正式受理。

sections.heading: 從抽象品質走向可檢查條件
paragraphs: NASA 的需求檢查表指出「快速、易用、安全」等詞如果沒有定義，就難以驗證。本課據此要求每條寫清楚適用情境與證據方式；未知的效能目標先指定需要確認的環境與角色，不任意填一個秒數假裝已有基準。
例如「支援鍵盤」可展開成填寫、檢查、修正與匯出皆有鍵盤路徑，並確認焦點可見與可離開。W3C 的鍵盤說明也有適用條件與例外；本課的表單任務不屬自由手繪，應實際驗證，不能把一張草圖當成通過。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜將故事補成需求候選
rows: FR-01 功能
空字串或僅空白的必要欄位，檢查時列為缺漏並拒絕完整匯出
固定合成案例；連到M05-03負向情境
FR-02 功能
完整匯出僅含規定欄位、狀態與範圍說明
檢查JSON欄位與輸入一致；未實作時待驗
NFR-01 品質
以鍵盤完成填寫、檢查、修正與匯出，焦點可見且可離開
實際瀏覽器任務；非完整可近用認證
C-01 約束
使用合成資料，單人本機，不連接真實業務服務
檔案／設定與操作核對；不代表所有網路活動都已被沙箱禁止
P-01 待確認
效能目標須補裝置、資料量、量測起訖與門檻
尚未確認，不宣稱達標

sections.heading: 把故事、規則與情境連起來
paragraphs: Story 可以連到多條規則，每條規則也可能需要正常與負向情境。以 FR-01 為例，空字串、僅空白與缺少鍵值是不同輸入；畫面提示與匯出函式拒絕也屬不同驗證層次。先把連結寫清楚，再由 M05-03 練習細化。
代號只為了穩定引用，不代表優先順序或完成。請保留來源、理由、確認角色與狀態；有測試名稱但還沒執行，就寫待驗。若特性尚未實作，不能因為加入 NFR 欄就宣稱已具備。

sections.heading: 檢查句型之外的需求缺口
paragraphs: 常見誤解是「寫成身為／我想要／以便就已經是完整規格」。試著讓同儕用同一故事設計不同實作，再問如何判斷缺件、何時允許匯出；如果答案不同，就還需要規則與例子。
另一個誤解是非功能需求等到最後再管。鍵盤、資料保存與效能限制可能影響架構與操作方式，應在本版範圍內一起釐清。無法確認的要求要明列，而不是藏在「系統應安全好用」裡。

blocks.heading: Story與條款連結
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 spec.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# User Story（合成）
身為收件人員，我希望在匯出前知道必要欄位缺漏，
以便補齊後交接。

FR-01：必要欄位空白時列出缺漏，拒絕完整匯出
NFR-01：核心任務有鍵盤路徑，焦點可見且可離開
C-01：合成資料、單人本機、不正式受理
情境：FR-01連到缺漏／空白／補齊／結果過期
證據：功能案例、瀏覽器任務，各記實際結果或待驗
待確認：效能的環境、資料量與門檻
來源與確認角色：依本課情境填寫，不虛構業務定案

exercise.environment: spec.md 工作表與合成收件案例；不需要安裝測試工具。
steps: 撰寫一則收件人員故事，確認角色、工作結果與理由都有出現。
補兩條功能需求、一條品質要求及一條本版約束，為每條指定驗證方法與狀態。
把「快速」改寫成需要確認的量測條件，核對至少一條功能可連到正常與負向情境，再請同儕找缺口或自行逐項檢查。
exercise.expected: spec.md 具有Story、功能／品質／約束、情境連結與待確認事項。
exercise.check: 條款可觀察且不靠句型充數；未確認門檻與未執行結果沒有被填成通過。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成標記、來源與決策角色；移除沒有依據的百分比、時間或正式規定宣稱。

en.summary: Use a User Story to express role and value, then add functions, qualities and constraints connected to concrete scenarios and verification.
objectives: Write a User Story with role, work goal and reason.
Separate functional requirements, quality attributes and design constraints while identifying their relationships.
Replace vague usability, security or speed claims with observable conditions or explicit unknowns.

readingGuide.goal: Write a User Story with role, work goal and reason.
readingGuide.startingPoint: The spec.md worksheet and synthetic intake case; no testing-tool installation is needed.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand spec.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: spec.md with a story, functional/quality/constraint clauses, scenario links and pending questions.

sections.heading: Start the Story with User Value
paragraphs: A User Story can begin discussion: “As an intake worker, I want to see missing required fields before export so I can complete them before handoff.” It identifies role, work and reason, without defining every rule.

Agile Alliance explains that stories are not merely documents or generally individual screens/components; understanding evolves. The course uses role/goal/reason as an exercise pattern without forcing every requirement into that wording.

sections.heading: Like a Meal Goal and Its Conditions
paragraphs: “Finish lunch before returning to the office” states a purpose. Meal choice and takeaway support are functions; ingredient restrictions and leak-free packaging add conditions. Purpose alone cannot tell the kitchen what counts as satisfactory.

A software story likewise needs questions: which fields are required, which values count as missing, what happens to results after edits and how users recover. Answers form verifiable specifications; a story template cannot derive them automatically.

sections.heading: Use Categories for Discussion, Not Exclusive Boxes
paragraphs: Functional requirements describe what the system does, such as listing omissions and producing a conforming report. Nonfunctional requirements often express qualities such as accessibility, performance, reliability and maintainability. Environment, data and technology also impose constraints. Teams may classify differently; explicit conditions, responsibilities and traceable verification matter.

Do not put every security requirement into a vague nonfunctional field. Rejecting unauthorized reads is observable behavior; retention limits may span architecture and governance. This course’s single-user, synthetic-data, nonpersistent scope does not establish shared-system security.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Kinds of Conditions to Add to a Story
blocks.description: These are interacting discussion aspects. Category labels cannot replace concrete requirements.

items.title: Function
items.body: Which input, action and outcome must hold? Missing data must not create a complete report.

items.title: Quality
items.body: In which context must work be operable, reliable or understandable? Define keyboard and recovery checks.

items.title: Constraint
items.body: Which data, environment and responsibilities bound this version? Synthetic data, one local user and no official acceptance.

sections.heading: Turn Abstract Qualities into Inspectable Conditions
paragraphs: NASA’s checklist identifies undefined terms such as “fast,” “usable” and “safe” as difficult to verify. State context and evidence methods. For unknown performance targets, identify the environment and confirming role rather than inventing seconds as a baseline.

“Keyboard support” can mean entering, checking, correcting and exporting with visible focus and a way to exit controls. W3C’s keyboard explanation includes conditions and exceptions. This form task is not freehand drawing: verify actual operation instead of treating a sketch as a pass.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Requirements Proposed Around a Story
rows: FR-01 Function
Empty or whitespace-only required fields are listed as missing on checking and cannot export as complete.
Fixed synthetic cases linked to M05-03 negative scenarios.
FR-02 Function
Complete exports contain only specified fields, status and scope guidance.
Inspect JSON fields and consistency with input; pending if unimplemented.
NFR-01 Quality
Core tasks work by keyboard with visible focus and control exits.
Actual browser tasks, not complete accessibility certification.
C-01 Constraint
Synthetic data, one local user and no connection to actual business services.
Inspect files, configuration and operation; this does not establish sandbox prevention of all networking.
P-01 Pending
Performance targets need device, data volume, timing boundaries and threshold.
Unconfirmed; no claim that targets are met.

sections.heading: Connect Stories, Rules and Scenarios
paragraphs: A story may connect to several rules, and each rule may need normal and negative cases. For FR-01, an empty string, whitespace-only value and absent key differ. UI feedback and rejection by export functions are different layers. Record links before M05-03 develops them.

Codes provide stable references, not priority or completion. Retain source, reason, confirming role and status. A named but unexecuted test remains pending. Adding a nonfunctional requirement field does not implement that quality.

sections.heading: Look Beyond the Story Template for Gaps
paragraphs: A common mistake is treating “As a / I want / so that” as a complete specification. Ask peers to propose different implementations, then determine what counts as missing and when export is allowed. Different answers expose needed rules and examples.

Do not defer every quality requirement until the end. Keyboard paths, retention and performance constraints may shape architecture and interaction. Clarify them within this version’s scope and list unknowns explicitly rather than hiding them in “secure and usable.”

blocks.heading: Story and Clause Links
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records the intake story, FR-01 missing-input blocking, NFR-01 keyboard/focus behavior, C-01 scope, scenario/evidence links, pending performance conditions and source/confirming role. Adapt it in spec.md without inventing actual business decisions or research.

NFR-01：核心任務有鍵盤路徑，焦點可見且可離開
C-01：合成資料、單人本機、不正式受理
情境：FR-01連到缺漏／空白／補齊／結果過期

exercise.environment: The spec.md worksheet and synthetic intake case; no testing-tool installation is needed.
steps: Write an intake-worker story containing role, work outcome and reason.
Add two functional requirements, one quality requirement and one version constraint, each with a verification method and status.
Replace “fast” with measurement conditions needing confirmation. Link at least one function to normal and negative cases, then have a peer find gaps or review each item yourself.
exercise.expected: spec.md with a story, functional/quality/constraint clauses, scenario links and pending questions.
exercise.check: Clauses are observable rather than template filler. Unconfirmed thresholds and unexecuted results are not marked passed.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic labels, sources and decision roles. Remove unsupported percentages, times or claims of official rules.

zh.prompt: 一則User Story寫完後，通常還需要什麼？
options: 條件、規則、例外、約束與可驗收情境
只要換成英文
把每個按鈕都命名為故事
立刻宣稱所有品質達標
rationales: 故事開啟價值討論，細節仍需共同確認。
語言轉換不會補足需求。
元件清單不等同使用者價值。
要求寫下與實際通過不同。

en.prompt: What is usually needed after writing a User Story?
options: Conditions, rules, exceptions, constraints and acceptance scenarios.
Only an English translation.
Name every button as a story.
Declare all quality targets met immediately.
rationales: The story starts value discussion; details still need confirmation.
Translation does not fill requirement gaps.
A component list is not user value.
Writing a requirement and passing it are different states.

zh.prompt: 「系統必須很快」尚未有量測條件，應如何處理？
options: 任意填一個秒數
刪除所有效能要求
寫測試全綠就算快速
列出待確認的環境、資料量、起訖、門檻與確認角色
rationales: 會製造沒有依據的精確度。
效能可能重要，應釐清而非默默刪除。
未定義或未測效能不能由其他測試推論。
讓未知可追溯，才有可執行的後續驗證。

en.prompt: “The system must be fast” lacks measurement conditions. What next?
options: Invent a duration in seconds.
Remove all performance requirements.
Treat unrelated green tests as proof of speed.
List the environment, volume, start/end boundaries, threshold and confirming role to establish.
rationales: This creates unsupported precision.
Performance may matter; clarify it rather than silently deleting it.
Other tests do not establish undefined or unmeasured performance.
Traceable unknowns support executable later verification.

zh.prompt: 拒絕未授權讀取的需求應如何看待？
options: 所有資安都只能寫成模糊非功能口號
它有可觀察行為，需具體定義與驗證；分類不能取代規則
有登入畫面就自然通過
單人原型可直接證明多人隔離
rationales: 資安要求也可能包含具體功能與架構條件。
依情境與結果驗收，比只貼類別更重要。
登入與授權需要分別處理。
原型範圍不包含完整多人授權。

en.prompt: How should rejection of unauthorized reads be specified?
options: All security must be vague nonfunctional slogans.
Define and verify observable behavior; classification cannot replace rules.
A login screen guarantees it passes.
A single-user prototype proves shared-user isolation.
rationales: Security requirements can include concrete behavior and architectural conditions.
Scenario/outcome acceptance matters more than category labels.
Authentication and authorization need separate treatment.
The prototype lacks full shared-user authorization.

zh.summary: 以 Given／When／Then 把工作承諾寫成可觀察的情境，補上缺漏、空白與輸入變更等負向案例。
objectives: 區分前置條件、觸發動作與可觀察結果。
為完整性檢核寫出正常與負向驗收情境。
說明驗收情境與可執行測試之間仍需要哪些連結。

sections.heading: 讓兩個人對同一個結果有相同理解
paragraphs: 「表單要好用，資料要正確」不容易驗收。設計者可能以為正確表示欄位有值，使用者卻以為已經查驗內容真實。你可以先將承諾縮小成一個情境：缺少文件類型時，按下檢查會列出缺漏，且不能輸出完整報告。
Given／When／Then 將這個情境分成背景、動作與結果。它有助於領域工作者、開發者與測試者討論同一件事；即使先寫在 Markdown，也可以用來人工檢查。

sections.heading: 三段各自負責什麼
paragraphs: Given 說明情境開始前已成立的條件；When 說明觸發行為；Then 說明可觀察的預期結果。Cucumber 的 Gherkin 語法使用這些關鍵字描述情境，並由 step definitions 將步驟連結到可執行程式。本課先練習情境表達，不需要安裝 Cucumber。
用點餐比喻：已選餐點但沒有配送地址，是前置條件；按下送出，是動作；系統指出地址缺漏並保留已選餐點，是結果。結果要能觀察，不只寫「系統應正確處理」。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜一個驗收情境由條件經過動作，走向可觀察結果。
blocks.description: 依編號閱讀各步驟。

items.title: Given：條件
items.body: 申請編號與申請人代號已填，文件類型空白。

items.title: When：動作
items.body: 收件人員要求檢查或匯出。

items.title: Then：結果
items.body: 顯示文件類型缺漏，拒絕完整匯出，保留已填內容。

sections.heading: 四個情境涵蓋不同風險
paragraphs: 第一個正常情境確認三欄皆有值時可以預覽及匯出；第二個缺漏情境確保沒有文件類型就不能標記完整。第三個使用只含空白的文字，避免把看似有輸入的字串當成有效值。第四個從完整變成缺漏，確認舊結果不會繼續被使用。
這四個情境是本課自訂的驗收契約，不等於完整安全測試。字串長度、允許字元、資料保存與正式授權規則仍需要另外定義。

blocks.heading: 範例
paragraphs: 以下範例可複製到文字編輯器，依本節說明核對。
blocks.code:
情境 A：完整資料
Given 三個必要欄位皆有非空白值
When 按下檢查並要求匯出
Then 顯示完整性通過，提供同一筆資料的報告

情境 B：缺漏
Given 文件類型為空字串
When 要求檢查或匯出
Then 指出文件類型缺漏，拒絕完整匯出，保留其他欄位

情境 C：空白文字
Given 申請人代號只有空白
When 按下檢查
Then 視為缺漏，不能標記完整

情境 D：結果過期
Given 先前檢查完整，之後清空文件類型
When 嘗試匯出
Then 不得匯出先前標記完整的結果；要求重新檢查目前資料

sections.heading: 負向情境要檢查禁止發生的事
paragraphs: 負向驗收不只要求畫面顯示錯誤，也要求錯誤狀態下不能造成不當結果。在缺漏情境中，「顯示紅字」只是回饋；「拒絕完整匯出」才對應不能將缺漏資料誤交接的規則。
多人系統還需要另一類負向情境，例如登入者 B 嘗試讀取只授權給 A 的資料時應被拒絕，回應不得包含內容。單人工作坊原型沒有正式登入與儲存層，這一題只能先寫成未實作需求，不得標為安全驗證通過。

sections.heading: 從情境連到測試證據
paragraphs: 將 B、C 的字串規則放進不依賴 UI 的函式，使用 pytest 輸入缺漏與空白值，檢查回傳的缺漏清單。再用 AppTest 模擬填表、按下檢查與修改欄位，檢查提示及結果失效。AppTest 是程式化模擬，實際瀏覽器下載與鍵盤流程仍需另外操作。
在 spec.md 每條情境旁記錄對應測試名稱、最近執行命令與結果。若只有規格而沒有執行結果，狀態就是待驗證；若只有測試名稱卻找不到該測試，也不能宣稱通過。

sections.heading: 規格變更也要重新審查情境
paragraphs: 假設領域負責人新增第四個必要欄位，你需要更新正常資料、所有缺漏情境、表單標籤與測試資料。修改應在同一次可審查變更中串起來，避免 spec.md 說四欄，程式卻只檢查三欄。
讓 Agent 執行這項工作時，可要求它先列出受影響的情境，再修改指定檔案並執行測試。人類審查者需確認新欄位確實獲得授權、情境覆蓋了新規則，而非只接受測試全綠的摘要。

sections.heading: 別把步驟寫得太細或太模糊
paragraphs: 「Given 按鈕在第 20 像素、When 點第三個元件、Then 顏色變綠」依賴容易變動的外觀，沒有直接描述工作承諾。優先寫「使用者要求檢查，收到缺漏欄位」，再由介面測試處理實際操作。
相反地，「Then 系統安全且好用」又太模糊。把它拆成具體結果，例如回應不包含未授權資料、錯誤提示指出可修正欄位。情境要足夠明確，讓另一位同事能判斷結果是否符合。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器，沿用 problem.md 的合成案例。
steps: 建立 spec.md，寫四條 Given／When／Then，涵蓋完整、缺漏、空白及結果過期。
在每條情境旁列出輸入資料、預期提示及允許或禁止的動作。
和同儕交換規格，請他挑一條只靠文字重演；對有歧義的詞補上定義，記錄測試層次與待驗項。
exercise.expected: 至少四條可以重演的驗收情境，包含負向結果與對應證據欄位。
exercise.check: 同儕不需問你「正確是什麼」就能判斷結果；尚未執行的情境保持待驗證。
exercise.cleanup: 保留修訂紀錄；只用合成輸入，不填入真實帳號或業務資料。

readingGuide.goal: 區分前置條件、觸發動作與可觀察結果。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器，沿用 problem.md 的合成案例。
readingGuide.route: 先讀原理與例子，再完成最小實作，最後核對理解檢核與參考解析。
readingGuide.output: 至少四條可以重演的驗收情境，包含負向結果與對應證據欄位。

en.summary: Use Given/When/Then to express work commitments as observable scenarios, including negative cases for missing values, whitespace and input changes.
objectives: Distinguish preconditions, triggering actions and observable outcomes.
Write normal and negative acceptance scenarios for completeness checking.
Explain the links still needed between acceptance scenarios and executable tests.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish preconditions, triggering actions and observable outcomes.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor and the synthetic case in problem.md.
readingGuide.route: Read principles and examples, complete the small exercise, then compare your understanding with checks and reference explanations.
readingGuide.output: At least four replayable acceptance scenarios with negative outcomes and corresponding evidence fields.

sections.heading: Give Two People the Same Understanding of an Outcome
paragraphs: “Make the form usable and the data correct” is hard to accept. A designer may mean populated fields while a user expects verified content. Narrow the commitment: when document type is missing, checking lists the omission and prevents a complete report.
Given/When/Then separates background, action and outcome for domain workers, developers and testers to discuss together. Scenarios in Markdown can support manual checks before automation.

sections.heading: Give Each Part a Distinct Responsibility
paragraphs: Given states conditions established before the scenario; When describes the trigger; Then describes an observable expected result. Cucumber’s Gherkin uses these keywords and step definitions to connect steps to executable code. Here, practice expression without installing Cucumber.

For a meal order, selected food with no delivery address is the precondition; submitting is the action; identifying the missing address while retaining the food is the outcome. Results must be observable, beyond “handle correctly.”

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | From Conditions Through Action to an Observable Outcome
blocks.description: Read the numbered parts as one acceptance scenario.

items.title: Given: conditions
items.body: Application number and applicant code are entered; document type is blank.

items.title: When: action
items.body: The intake worker requests checking or export.

items.title: Then: outcome
items.body: Identify missing document type, reject complete export and retain entered values.

sections.heading: Four Scenarios Address Different Risks
paragraphs: The normal case permits preview/export with three populated fields. The missing-value case prevents marking a record complete without document type. Whitespace-only input tests apparent entry without a valid value. Changing complete input to missing checks that stale results cannot still be used.
These four scenarios are the course’s acceptance contract, not comprehensive security testing. Define length, allowed characters, retention and formal authorization rules separately.

blocks.heading: Example
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese scenarios A–D specify complete data and matching export; empty document type with blocking and retained values; whitespace-only applicant code treated as missing; and clearing document type after a pass, which must block stale export and require current-input rechecking. Copy them into an editor and review against this section; these are teaching scenarios, not executed Gherkin tests.
blocks.code:
情境 A：完整資料
Given 三個必要欄位皆有非空白值
When 按下檢查並要求匯出
Then 顯示完整性通過，提供同一筆資料的報告

情境 B：缺漏
Given 文件類型為空字串
When 要求檢查或匯出
Then 指出文件類型缺漏，拒絕完整匯出，保留其他欄位

情境 C：空白文字
Given 申請人代號只有空白
When 按下檢查
Then 視為缺漏，不能標記完整

情境 D：結果過期
Given 先前檢查完整，之後清空文件類型
When 嘗試匯出
Then 不得匯出先前標記完整的結果；要求重新檢查目前資料

sections.heading: Check That Forbidden Outcomes Do Not Occur
paragraphs: Negative acceptance requires more than an error message: inappropriate outcomes must remain unavailable. Red text is feedback; rejecting complete export enforces the rule against handing off missing data as complete.

A shared system needs additional cases, such as user B attempting data authorized only for A, with denial and no content in the response. This single-user prototype has no formal login/storage layer. Record that as unimplemented, not passed security verification.

sections.heading: Connect Scenarios to Evidence
paragraphs: Put B/C string rules into UI-independent functions and use pytest with missing/whitespace inputs to inspect returned omissions. Use AppTest to simulate form entry, checking and edits, examining feedback and invalidation. AppTest is programmatic simulation; real browser downloads and keyboard paths still require separate operation.
Beside each spec.md scenario, record the corresponding test, latest command and result. Specifications without execution remain pending. Naming a nonexistent test cannot establish a pass.

sections.heading: Review Scenarios Again When Requirements Change
paragraphs: If the domain owner adds a fourth required field, update normal input, all missing-field scenarios, labels and test data together in one reviewable change. Avoid a four-field spec.md with code still checking three.

Ask an agent to list affected scenarios before changing named files and running tests. Human review must confirm authorization for the new field and scenario coverage rather than accepting a green-test summary alone.

sections.heading: Avoid Fragile Detail and Unobservable Generalities
paragraphs: “Given a button at pixel 20, When clicking the third component, Then it turns green” depends on mutable appearance rather than work commitments. Prefer requests for checking and receipt of missing-field feedback; interface tests handle concrete controls.

Conversely, “Then the system is secure and usable” is vague. State concrete outcomes, such as no unauthorized content in responses and errors identifying correctable fields. Another colleague should be able to judge the result.

exercise.environment: A text editor and the synthetic case in problem.md.
steps: Create spec.md with four Given/When/Then scenarios covering complete data, missing input, whitespace and stale results.
For each, list inputs, expected feedback and allowed or forbidden actions.
Exchange specifications with a peer and have them replay one from text alone. Define ambiguous terms and record test layers and pending items.
exercise.expected: At least four replayable acceptance scenarios with negative outcomes and corresponding evidence fields.
exercise.check: A peer can judge outcomes without asking what “correct” means. Unexecuted scenarios remain pending verification.
exercise.cleanup: Retain revision history. Use synthetic inputs, not actual accounts or business data.

zh.prompt: 哪個 Then 最能驗收「資料不齊不能匯出完整報告」？
options: 系統應正常運作
顯示美觀的紅色提示
顯示缺漏欄位並拒絕完整匯出，其他已填內容保留
測試工具成功啟動
rationales: 這沒有定義可觀察結果。
只有視覺提示，未限制匯出，也依賴主觀美觀。
同時檢查回饋、禁止行為與復原所需資料，直接對應需求。
工具啟動只證明環境的一部分，未驗證業務承諾。

en.prompt: Which Then best accepts “incomplete data cannot export a complete report”?
options: The system works normally.
Show an attractive red message.
Identify missing fields, reject complete export and retain other entered values.
The test tool starts successfully.
rationales: This defines no observable outcome.
Visual feedback alone neither restricts export nor avoids subjective appearance.
This checks feedback, forbidden behavior and recovery data against the requirement.
Tool startup establishes part of the environment, not the business commitment.

zh.summary: 把一項需求變更串到規格、設計、程式與驗證，保留修改理由及原本仍要成立的承諾。
objectives: 以小步變更說明本課規格驅動開發的工作方式。
為新增必要欄位盤點規格、介面、輸出及測試影響。
區分要求改變、實作修正與尚未驗證的結果。

readingGuide.goal: 以小步變更說明本課規格驅動開發的工作方式。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器、spec.md及工作坊reference/檔案，可先只閱讀；不需實際新增第四欄。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 spec.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: 一份可審查的C-02變更計畫，能由候選要求追到受影響檔案與待驗情境。

sections.heading: 規格要參與變更，而非寫完就封存
paragraphs: SDD（Spec-Driven Development，規格驅動開發）在本課指：以可討論、可版本控制的規格引導變更，再用實作與證據回頭核對。這是課程的工作定義，不宣稱所有工具採同一個標準流程，也不表示必須先寫完整套規格才能開始小步實作。
Cucumber的BDD方法強調具體例子與持續協作；OpenSpec也讓規格與變更文件在迭代中修訂。本課借這些方法說明如何維持一致，但保留它們各自的名稱、目的與工具差異。

sections.heading: 像修改食譜後同步採購與檢查
paragraphs: 如果餐點改為不含某項食材，食譜、採購單、製作步驟與出餐檢查都要相應更新。只改菜單名稱，廚房仍可能照舊製作；只換食材卻不改標示，也會造成誤解。
需求變更同樣會跨文件與程式。小步不是只改一個檔案，而是讓一項可說明的變更，在合理範圍內維持規格、介面、規則與驗證一致。

sections.heading: 先把第四欄視為候選變更
paragraphs: 合成提案C-02希望新增「收件批次代號」作第四個必要欄位。先確認用途、資料來源、型別、有效值與舊資料如何處理；本章只做影響分析，不修改三欄參考解答，也不宣稱提案已獲真實單位核准。
若課堂決定採用，可暫定沿既有字串規則作練習，但需在提案寫明這是教學決定，並確認輸出允許清單是否增加該欄。原本缺漏、空白、結果過期與不正式受理的約束仍要成立。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜候選第四欄的影響分析
rows: problem.md／spec.md
新增欄位的理由、定義、舊資料策略、正常與負向情境
只在聊天新增一行要求
wireframe.svg／介面
欄位名稱、必要提示、三欄完成文案及回復方式
只改欄位數字，漏掉說明
rules.py／輸出
必要欄位集合、型別與長度、匯出允許清單
只加文字輸入框
app.py／狀態
輸入變更使結果失效、預覽及下載仍對應目前資料
沿用可能過期的完成結果
tests/／交接
完整案例加入新欄、缺少新欄案例、舊情境回歸、README限制
把原測試刪掉或只更新預期值求綠燈

sections.heading: 由規格到驗證，再回到決定
paragraphs: 先記變更目的與影響，再修訂對應情境；實作時留下Diff（差異）供審查，執行針對性測試與仍受影響的回歸。發現規格不清時，可以回頭修改候選與設計，但要保留理由，不讓模型默默擴大責任。
NASA需求檢查表重視可追溯與驗證。本課用穩定需求代號連到情境、檔案與真實結果；連結存在本身還不是通過，必須能找到證據且範圍相符。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜一項規格變更的工作迴圈
blocks.description: 依序處理以便審查；學到新資訊時可回修，這不是一次通過後永不更改的瀑布階段。

items.title: 目的與影響
items.body: 記錄候選變更、負責角色、資料與相依範圍，保留尚未定義事項。

items.title: 條款與情境
items.body: 描述新行為及舊承諾，列完整、缺漏與過期結果案例。

items.title: 實作與審查
items.body: 在允許範圍修改，檢查Diff是否真的涵蓋規則與輸出。

items.title: 驗證與決定
items.body: 記真實測試結果及限制，決定接受、修正或暫緩，回填目前規格。

sections.heading: 分辨規格錯誤與程式偏離
paragraphs: 如果規格已確認「缺件不得完整匯出」，程式卻仍可下載，這是實作偏離，不能把規格改成允許缺件來消除失敗。若領域需求確實改變，才以明確提案修訂承諾，並重新檢查影響與責任。
測試全綠也可能因測錯、少測或預期值被改錯。審查者需核對情境、測試及程式的關係。例如新增第四欄後，原完整資料可能變成缺件；應區分要更新的測試資料與刻意保留的舊資料負向情境。

sections.heading: 留下可以追到實際檔案的紀錄
paragraphs: 現有參考專案確實有spec.md、rules.py、app.py與tests/test_rules.py／test_app.py；它們可用來練習影響盤點。下例寫的是計畫，不表示這些檔案已改成四欄，也沒有新增不存在的測試名稱來冒充通過證據。
常見誤解是「規格寫好了，Agent之後全部負責」。人類仍需確認規則、審查Diff及判斷證據是否足夠；Agent可協助編輯與執行，但不能自行把未知需求變成正式責任。

blocks.heading: 第四欄變更的紙上計畫
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 spec.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# C-02 候選：新增收件批次代號（未實作）
目的／來源：合成課堂情境，實際用途待確認
待決：有效值、舊資料策略、輸出欄位、確認角色
規格：補正常、缺少第四欄、空白、修改後過期情境

既有約束：拒絕缺件完整匯出，結果對應目前輸入

界線：本課三欄參考解答沒有因這份計畫而改變

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器、spec.md及工作坊reference/檔案，可先只閱讀；不需實際新增第四欄。
steps: 為C-02寫目的、未決規則與確認角色，標為候選提案。
逐一盤點規格、線框稿、規則、介面、輸出與測試影響，補一條缺少第四欄的候選負向情境。
比較哪些既有資料需更新、哪些應保留為舊資料負向案例，將未執行的驗證計畫留在變更紀錄。
exercise.expected: 一份可審查的C-02變更計畫，能由候選要求追到受影響檔案與待驗情境。
exercise.check: 沒有把三欄參考解答誤寫為已修改；能區分需求變更與為求測試通過而改要求。
exercise.cleanup: 保留原始參考專案，紙上計畫使用合成資料；未授權或未決項目不自行啟用。

en.summary: Connect a requirement change to specification, design, code and verification, retaining its reason and commitments that must still hold.
objectives: Explain the course’s spec-driven workflow through a small change.
Identify specification, interface, output and test impacts of an added required field.
Distinguish changed requirements, implementation corrections and unverified results.

readingGuide.goal: Explain the course’s spec-driven workflow through a small change.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor, spec.md and workshop reference/ files, initially read-only; no fourth-field implementation is required.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand spec.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A reviewable C-02 change plan connecting a candidate requirement to affected files and pending scenarios.

sections.heading: Keep the Specification Involved in Changes
paragraphs: In this course, Spec-Driven Development (SDD) uses discussable, version-controlled specifications to guide changes, then checks them against implementation and evidence. This is a course working definition, not a universal tool standard or a requirement to finish every specification before implementing a small slice.

Cucumber’s BDD emphasizes examples and continued collaboration; OpenSpec also revises specification and change artifacts iteratively. The course uses these ideas for consistency while retaining their separate names, purposes and tools.

sections.heading: Update Purchasing and Checks When a Recipe Changes
paragraphs: Removing an ingredient from a meal affects the recipe, purchase list, preparation and serving checks. A changed menu alone may leave old cooking practices; swapping ingredients without labeling also confuses people.

Requirement changes likewise span documents and code. A small step is one explainable, reasonably bounded change keeping specification, interface, rules and verification consistent, not necessarily one edited file.

sections.heading: Treat the Fourth Field as a Candidate First
paragraphs: Synthetic proposal C-02 adds “intake batch code” as a fourth required field. Clarify purpose, source, type, valid values and old-data treatment first. This lesson analyzes impact only: it does not change the three-field reference or claim actual organizational approval.

If the class adopts it, existing string rules can be a provisional teaching choice. Record that decision and confirm whether the output allowlist gains the field. Missing-input, whitespace, stale-result and no-official-acceptance constraints still apply.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Impact Analysis for a Proposed Fourth Field
rows: problem.md / spec.md
Reason, definition, old-data policy, normal and negative scenarios.
A new sentence in chat only.
wireframe.svg / interface
Name, required guidance, three-field completion wording and recovery.
Changing the field count without explanations.
rules.py / output
Required-field set, types, lengths and output allowlist.
Only adding a text input.
app.py / state
Edits invalidate results; preview/download match current input.
Reusing potentially stale completion.
tests/ / handoff
New field in valid input, a missing-new-field case, regressions and README limits.
Deleting old tests or changing expected values solely for green results.

sections.heading: Move from Specification to Verification and Back to Decisions
paragraphs: Record purpose/impact, revise scenarios, then retain the implementation diff for review. Run targeted tests and affected regressions. Unclear specifications can lead back to proposal/design changes, with reasons retained rather than silent model expansion of responsibility.

NASA’s checklist emphasizes traceability and verification. Stable requirement IDs connect scenarios, files and actual results. Links alone are not a pass: evidence must exist and match the claim’s scope.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | The Work Loop for One Specification Change
blocks.description: The order supports review; new information can lead back to revisions. These are not immutable waterfall phases.

items.title: Purpose and impact
items.body: Record candidate change, responsible role, data/dependency scope and unresolved definitions.

items.title: Clauses and scenarios
items.body: Describe new behavior and retained commitments through complete, missing-input and stale-result cases.

items.title: Implementation and review
items.body: Change within allowed scope and inspect the diff for rules and output coverage.

items.title: Verification and decision
items.body: Record actual results and limits; accept, revise or defer, updating the current specification.

sections.heading: Distinguish Specification Errors from Implementation Drift
paragraphs: If confirmed rules prohibit complete export for missing input but code permits download, fix implementation drift. Do not rewrite the requirement to erase failure. Actual domain changes need explicit proposals, review and renewed impact/responsibility checks.

Green tests can result from incorrect, missing or wrongly updated checks. Review links among scenarios, tests and code. After adding a fourth field, formerly valid input may become incomplete: distinguish fixtures needing updates from old-data negative cases deliberately retained.

sections.heading: Connect the Plan to Actual Files
paragraphs: The reference contains spec.md, rules.py, app.py and tests/test_rules.py / test_app.py for impact review. The plan below does not claim four-field edits or invent test names as passing evidence.

A common mistake is transferring every responsibility to the agent once a specification exists. People still confirm rules, review diffs and assess evidence. Agents can edit and execute without authority to turn unknown needs into official responsibilities.

blocks.heading: Tabletop Plan for the Fourth Field
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese C-02 template records an unimplemented synthetic proposal, purpose/source, unresolved values/old-data/output/owner decisions, new scenarios, affected files, retained constraints, planned verification and an unexecuted status. The three-field reference remains unchanged; adapt this plan without inventing actual approvals or findings.

待決：有效值、舊資料策略、輸出欄位、確認角色
規格：補正常、缺少第四欄、空白、修改後過期情境
