exercise.environment: A text editor, spec.md and workshop reference/ files, initially read-only; no fourth-field implementation is required.
steps: Write C-02 purpose, unresolved rules and confirming role, labeling it a candidate proposal.
Review specification, wireframe, rules, interface, output and test impacts; add a proposed negative case missing the fourth field.
Distinguish data to update from old-data negative cases to retain. Keep unexecuted verification plans in the change record.
exercise.expected: A reviewable C-02 change plan connecting a candidate requirement to affected files and pending scenarios.
exercise.check: Do not describe the three-field reference as modified. Distinguish a real requirement change from weakening commitments to make tests pass.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the original reference project. Use synthetic data and do not activate undecided or unauthorized work.

zh.prompt: 本章SDD最主要維持哪種關係？
options: 只要規格字數越多越好
規格、實作與驗證隨變更保持可追溯的一致
先把所有功能一次產生
文件與測試可以互不相關
rationales: 數量不能代替可驗收性。
變更目的、行為與證據需要互相核對。
不符合小步修正與審查。
會讓偏離難以被發現。

en.prompt: What relationship does this lesson’s SDD maintain?
options: More specification words are always better.
Specifications, implementation and verification stay traceably consistent through changes.
Generate all features at once.
Documentation and tests need not relate.
rationales: Volume cannot replace verifiability.
Purpose, behavior and evidence must be checked together.
This bypasses small changes and review.
Drift becomes difficult to detect.

zh.prompt: 新增第四個必要欄位，最需要避免什麼？
options: 保留變更理由
補新欄缺漏案例
檢查輸出允許清單
只加輸入框，卻未更新規則、完成文案與測試
rationales: 理由有助追溯。
負向情境支援驗收。
輸出契約也可能受影響。
介面出現欄位不代表規格與驗證已同步。

en.prompt: What should be avoided when adding a fourth required field?
options: Retain the change reason.
Add a missing-new-field case.
Inspect the output allowlist.
Add only an input without updating rules, completion wording and tests.
rationales: Reasons support traceability.
Negative scenarios support acceptance.
The output contract may also change.
A visible field does not synchronize specification and verification.

zh.prompt: 程式違反已確認的缺件匯出規則時，應如何處理？
options: 直接把規格改成允許缺件
刪掉失敗測試
先辨識實作偏離並修正；真正需求改變另走明確提案與審查
只更新README寫已完成
rationales: 不能用改承諾掩蓋程式錯誤。
失敗可能指出真實偏離，不應為綠燈刪除。
分開問題類型，才能保留規則與變更責任。
文件宣告不會改變實際行為。

en.prompt: Code violates a confirmed missing-input export rule. What next?
options: Rewrite the spec to permit missing data.
Delete the failing test.
Identify and correct implementation drift; actual requirement changes need separate explicit proposals and review.
Only update README to say complete.
rationales: Changing commitments must not conceal code errors.
Failure may reveal real drift; do not remove it for green results.
Separating problem types retains rule and change responsibility.
A documentation claim does not change behavior.

zh.summary: 以同一需求比較OpenSpec的文件關係與輕量Markdown流程，選擇能清楚維護規格、變更與驗證的做法。
objectives: 分開OpenSpec的目前規格、候選變更、設計與任務清單。
用同一缺件需求對照輕量Markdown與OpenSpec文件。
依協作、變更與維護成本選工具，保留格式檢查與行為驗證的差異。

readingGuide.goal: 分開OpenSpec的目前規格、候選變更、設計與任務清單。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器、spec.md與本篇文件對照表；無需OpenSpec、Node或Agent帳號，本章不執行CLI。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 spec.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: spec.md附有兩種流程的文件關係對照、採用理由及明確的未執行界線。

sections.heading: 工具協助維護關係，不能替你決定規則
paragraphs: OpenSpec是協助AI協作規格驅動開發的工具。它把目前規格與候選變更分開，讓提案、規格差異、設計及任務能一起被檢視。本課將它放在線上延伸；十小時工作坊可先用Markdown完成可驗收的規格。
本篇固定查核提交3e4d5f0769e2857c8eb54f149cbf5e4f703fa04c；該提交package.json標示1.16.0。這是文件與原始碼查核基準，不表示本次已安裝、初始化或執行其CLI，之後的命令與整合方式仍需按實際版本核對。

sections.heading: 像一個有分類的修訂資料夾
paragraphs: 目前有效的作業說明與「打算修改」的提案，不應混成同一份已核准文件。提案寫為何改，設計寫如何做，任務列待做工作；完成後，保留變更歷史，再讓有效說明反映已接受的結果。
小組也能用簡單資料夾做到類似分工。需要的是清楚的正本、狀態與連結，不是檔案越多越專業。若同一規則複製到很多地方卻沒有同步責任，導入工具仍會造成規格漂移。

sections.heading: 先讀懂文件各自負責什麼
paragraphs: 查核版本將openspec/specs/作為目前規格，openspec/changes/放候選變更。候選內的proposal.md交代目的與範圍、design.md交代技術做法、tasks.md列工作，規格差異放在該變更的specs/。資料夾是關係示意，不代表本repo已啟用OpenSpec。
Delta（差異）規格可描述新增、修改與移除；修改既有要求時要能看懂修改後完整意思，而非只寫一句「同前但更安全」。彙整與封存讓變更進入目前規格，也仍需人類核對接受條件及驗證，不會替軟體行為背書。

sections.heading: 分清終端機、Agent對話與測試
paragraphs: 固定版本文件將openspec init與openspec validate等列為終端機命令，/opsx:propose、/opsx:apply、/opsx:archive等在支援的AI助理對話使用；可用指令也與profile（工作流程設定）有關。看到斜線指令不代表可直接貼進作業系統終端機。
本章只辨識這些責任，不提供未實測的安裝成功畫面。要做完整工具操作，先由教師在隔離練習專案核對版本、支援助理及產生檔案，再按該版本文件執行。格式驗證能檢查文件結構，不能取代pytest、AppTest、瀏覽器與任務證據；封存也不能被當成所有測試通過的證明。

sections.heading: 依維護問題選擇流程
paragraphs: 若是單人、單一收件原型且變更少，spec.md加變更與證據欄位可能已足夠。若多人需要共同審查多項候選變更、追蹤不同規格差異，可評估OpenSpec是否降低同步成本，同時考慮團隊是否能維護其格式與工具環境。這是本課的選擇框架，沒有宣稱任何工具普遍較好。
採用之前先用同一要求試走一輪：誰確認規則、誰審查變更、證據放哪裡、何時更新目前規格。若這些答案還不清楚，先補協作責任；安裝工具不會自動決定業務權威、執行權限或資料可公開範圍。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜兩種做法都要維持的責任
blocks.description: 兩張卡並列比較文件管理方式；右邊不是左邊完成後必然升級的階段。

items.title: 輕量Markdown
items.body: 用一份明確正本、變更紀錄與證據連結支援小型專案；避免只有聊天決定。

items.title: OpenSpec
items.body: 用目前規格與候選變更的結構管理協作；仍核對內容、Diff、任務及真實驗證。

sections.heading: 不用安裝，也能先練文件對照
paragraphs: 本篇練習採同一個已出現的規則：輸入修改後不能沿用舊完整結果。建立紙上C-01，分別標示目前承諾、候選差異、設計、任務與待驗證據；若目前規格已包含這條，寫成檢查是否有實作偏離，不虛構一次新增功能。
常見誤解是「tasks.md全部打勾就代表驗收」。任務勾選只有工作狀態，仍需對照實際檔案與執行結果。完成本章代表理解文件分工與工具選擇，不等於已會所有OpenSpec命令或完成真實Agent協作。

blocks.heading: 同一規則的輕量變更紀錄
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 spec.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。

目前承諾：修改輸入後舊結果失效

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器、spec.md與本篇文件對照表；無需OpenSpec、Node或Agent帳號，本章不執行CLI。
steps: 選用修改輸入後舊結果失效的規則，列目前承諾、實作問題或候選變更，避免重複新增已存在要求。
在紙上將目的、差異、設計、任務與證據各對到OpenSpec路徑及輕量Markdown位置。
依一人原型與多人協作兩種情境選擇流程，說明維護成本、確認者與未驗工具操作，不把勾選或格式檢查當行為通過。

en.summary: Compare OpenSpec’s artifact relationships with lightweight Markdown for the same requirement, choosing a maintainable way to connect specifications, changes and verification.
objectives: Distinguish OpenSpec current specifications, candidate changes, design and task lists.
Map one missing-input requirement across lightweight Markdown and OpenSpec artifacts.
Choose tools around collaboration, change and maintenance costs, separating format checks from behavior verification.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish OpenSpec current specifications, candidate changes, design and task lists.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor, spec.md and the comparison table. No OpenSpec, Node or agent account is required; no CLI commands are executed.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand spec.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: spec.md with an artifact-relationship comparison, adoption reasons and explicit unexecuted-tool boundaries.

sections.heading: Use Tools to Maintain Relationships, Not Decide Rules
paragraphs: OpenSpec supports AI-assisted spec-driven development, separating current specifications from proposed changes so proposals, deltas, design and tasks can be reviewed together. This is an online extension; the ten-hour workshop can first produce verifiable Markdown specifications.

This lesson pins source review to commit 3e4d5f0769e2857c8eb54f149cbf5e4f703fa04c, whose package.json reports 1.16.0. This is a documentation/source baseline, not evidence of installation, initialization or CLI execution. Check later commands and integrations against the actual version.

sections.heading: Like an Organized Revision Folder
paragraphs: Current instructions should remain distinct from proposed revisions. A proposal explains why, design explains how and tasks list work. After completion, preserve history and update current instructions to reflect accepted outcomes.

A small team can organize similar responsibilities with simple folders. Clear authoritative records, states and links matter more than file count. Tools still permit drift if copied rules lack synchronization ownership.

sections.heading: Understand Each Artifact’s Responsibility
paragraphs: The reviewed version keeps current specifications in openspec/specs/ and candidate changes in openspec/changes/. Within a change, proposal.md explains purpose/scope, design.md explains technical approach, tasks.md lists work and specs/ holds specification deltas. These paths illustrate relationships, not an OpenSpec installation in this repository.

Delta specifications describe additions, modifications and removals. A modified requirement needs its full updated meaning, not “same as before but safer.” Merging and archiving integrate changes into current specifications, still requiring human acceptance and verification rather than certifying software behavior.

sections.heading: Distinguish Terminals, Agent Chat and Tests
paragraphs: In the pinned documentation, openspec init and openspec validate are terminal commands. /opsx:propose, /opsx:apply and /opsx:archive run in supported AI assistant conversations; available commands also depend on workflow profiles. A slash command is not automatically an operating-system terminal command.

This lesson identifies responsibilities without inventing successful installation screenshots. Before full tool practice, the teacher should verify version, supported assistant and generated files in an isolated practice project, then follow that version’s documentation. Format validation checks structure, not pytest, AppTest, browser or task outcomes. Archiving is not proof that every test passed.

sections.heading: Choose a Workflow for the Maintenance Problem
paragraphs: For one person, one intake prototype and few changes, spec.md plus change/evidence fields may suffice. With several collaborators reviewing multiple proposals and deltas, assess whether OpenSpec reduces synchronization work and whether the team can maintain formats and tooling. This is a course decision framework, not a universal tool ranking.

Before adoption, walk one requirement through rule confirmation, change review, evidence storage and current-spec updates. If responsibilities are unclear, resolve them first. Installation does not decide business authority, execution permissions or data publication scope.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Responsibilities Shared by Both Approaches
blocks.description: The cards compare artifact management in parallel. OpenSpec is not an inevitable next stage after lightweight Markdown.

items.title: Lightweight Markdown
items.body: Use an explicit authoritative specification, change history and evidence links for a small project instead of chat-only decisions.

items.title: OpenSpec
items.body: Structure current specifications and candidate changes for collaboration, still reviewing content, diffs, tasks and actual verification.

sections.heading: Map Artifacts Before Installing Tools
paragraphs: Use the existing rule that edited input cannot reuse old complete results. Draft tabletop C-01 with current commitment, candidate delta, design, tasks and pending evidence. If the specification already includes it, investigate implementation drift rather than inventing a new feature.

Checking every tasks.md box is not acceptance. Checklists report work status and still need actual files/results. Finishing this lesson establishes artifact understanding and tool-selection reasoning, not mastery of every OpenSpec command or actual agent collaboration.

blocks.heading: Lightweight Change Record for One Rule
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese tabletop C-01 template records the existing edit-invalidation commitment, potential implementation drift, consistency goal, whether R-02 already exists, snapshot/export design notes, tasks, actual-or-pending evidence, acceptance/history updates and tool-selection reasons. OpenSpec is not enabled by this exercise; adapt the record without inventing actual results.

zh.summary: 用操作流程回答使用者如何完成任務，再用架構回答軟體由什麼組成、資料如何移動及誰負責控制。
objectives: 分開User Flow的操作順序與架構的結構關係。
指出瀏覽器、Python程序、程序內規則及下載檔的不同位置。
為架構假設標記依據、邊界與仍需驗證的問題。

readingGuide.goal: 分開User Flow的操作順序與架構的結構關係。
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md、wireframe-notes.md及工作坊reference/；可只閱讀與畫圖，不需啟動程式。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 architecture.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: architecture.md能與User Flow互相對照，又清楚分開操作順序與軟體結構。

sections.heading: 一個流程，還有另一組問題
paragraphs: M03與M04的User Flow描述填寫、檢查、補件、預覽及匯出，幫你理解使用者如何前進或回復。系統架構則描述軟體單位、資料儲存、外部依賴與通訊關係，讓你知道這些操作在哪裡發生。
同一條操作流程可以由不同架構支援：單人本機程式、多人網站或外部API整合，都可能提供類似表單。但資料保存、權限、錯誤處理與維運責任不同，不能由按鈕相似就推定同樣安全或可部署。

sections.heading: 像旅客路線與車站設施圖
paragraphs: 旅客路線說明進站、買票、驗票與到月台，設施圖則說明票機、閘門、供電與維修區的位置和連接。路線能指出卡在哪一步，卻不會自動交代票機資料由哪裡處理。
收件程式也需要這兩種視角。畫出「按檢查→結果」後，還要問：結果在哪個程序計算？是否送到外部模型？資料是否存下來？誰能讀取匯出的檔案？

sections.heading: 同一件事放在不同視角中
paragraphs: C4官方將Context與Container分別用來看外部關係及系統內的高層結構。本課先用這兩層，不把按鈕、頁籤或操作步驟當成軟體容器。
例如rules.py在本課由同一個Python程序呼叫，並不是因為有獨立檔名就成為獨立服務。架構圖中的邊要有目的或資料，還需分辨它表示結構關係，還是某次操作的實際時序。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜同一收件任務的兩種視角
blocks.description: 卡片並列不同問題；兩者互相核對，不是只能選一種文件。

items.title: 操作流程
items.body: 收件者輸入→檢查→缺件補填→重查→預覽與匯出；關心條件與回復。

items.title: 系統架構
items.body: 瀏覽器與Python／Streamlit程序互動，程序內規則驗證，當次JSON下載到操作者裝置；關心責任與資料去向。

sections.heading: 先核對正在使用的參考專案
paragraphs: 本課參考程式以Streamlit執行，瀏覽器呈現介面，Python程序處理規則與匯出。Streamlit文件說明其用戶端／伺服器架構與WebSocket連線；本課沒有自行設計的REST端點，也沒有在執行時呼叫模型判斷欄位完整性。
沒有持久資料庫不等於沒有資料位置：輸入及檢查快照在工作階段記憶體，下載檔留在操作者裝置。關閉頁面、重新連線或刪除下載檔是不同事件；不能用「本機」二字代替資料生命週期說明。

sections.heading: 讓操作能追到處理位置
paragraphs: 用一筆缺少文件類型的合成資料，先在User Flow指出缺件回復，再在架構標記瀏覽器輸入、程序驗證與結果回傳。若架構圖出現資料庫或AI服務，請確認有實際依賴，或明寫它是未採用的候選，而非把常見元件全部加進來。
這種紙上追蹤可找出需要查核的地方，不等於封包擷取、正式安全測試或實際部署證據。你仍需檢查程式與環境；不確定的通訊與保存方式先註記，下一篇再確定系統範圍。

sections.heading: 把不同視角留在不同段落
paragraphs: 常見誤解是「畫了User Flow就已經有架構」。請將兩者放到各自檔案或段落，用相同任務與規則相互連結；當需求變成十人共用時，操作可能只改一點，架構責任卻可能大幅增加。
下面是本課目前參考架構的簡短核對表，不表示正式多人版已實作。

blocks.heading: 架構與流程的分欄紀錄

en.summary: Use a user flow to explain task completion, then architecture to explain software structure, data movement and control responsibilities.
objectives: Separate User Flow action order from architectural structure.
Locate the browser, Python process, in-process rules and downloaded files separately.
Label architectural assumptions with evidence, boundaries and unresolved questions.

readingGuide.goal: Separate User Flow action order from architectural structure.
readingGuide.startingPoint: problem.md, wireframe-notes.md and workshop reference/ files. Reading and drawing are sufficient; no program startup is required.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand architecture.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: architecture.md connected to the User Flow while clearly separating action order from software structure.

sections.heading: A Flow Leaves Another Set of Questions
paragraphs: M03/M04 User Flows describe entry, checking, correction, preview and export so you can understand progress and recovery. Architecture describes software units, stores, external dependencies and communication, locating where those actions occur.

A local program, shared website and external API integration can support similar forms. They differ in retention, permissions, errors and operations. Similar buttons do not establish equivalent security or deployment readiness.

sections.heading: Like a Passenger Route and a Station Facilities Plan
paragraphs: A passenger route explains entry, ticket purchase, validation and platform access. A facilities plan shows connections among machines, gates, power and maintenance areas. The route can locate a difficult step without explaining where ticket data is processed.

Intake software needs both perspectives. After drawing check → result, ask which process computes it, whether an external model receives data, whether anything is stored and who can read downloaded files.

sections.heading: Examine One Task Through Different Perspectives
paragraphs: C4 Context covers external relationships; Container covers high-level internal structure. Start with these levels rather than treating buttons, tabs or action steps as software containers.

Here, rules.py is called inside one Python process. A separate filename does not make a service. Label architecture relationships with purpose or data and distinguish structure from the timing of one operation.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Two Perspectives on One Intake Task
blocks.description: The cards compare questions. Cross-check both documents rather than choosing only one.

items.title: User flow
items.body: Entry → check → correct omissions → recheck → preview/export, focusing on conditions and recovery.

items.title: Architecture
items.body: Browser interaction with Python/Streamlit, in-process validation and current JSON downloaded to the operator’s device, focusing on responsibilities and destinations.

sections.heading: Check the Reference Project Actually in Use
paragraphs: The reference runs through Streamlit: the browser presents the interface, while Python handles rules and export. Streamlit documents client/server architecture and WebSocket communication. This course builds no custom REST endpoint and calls no runtime model to judge completeness.

No persistent database does not mean no data locations. Input and checked snapshots exist in session memory; downloads remain on the operator’s device. Closing a page, reconnecting and deleting a downloaded file are different events. “Local” alone is not a data-lifecycle explanation.

sections.heading: Trace Actions to Processing Locations
paragraphs: For synthetic data missing document type, locate recovery in the User Flow, then browser input, process validation and returned results in the architecture. Check any database or AI-service dependency against evidence, or label it an unadopted candidate rather than adding familiar components automatically.

Tabletop tracing identifies questions; it is not packet capture, formal security testing or deployment evidence. Inspect code and environment too, noting unknown communication/retention details before the next lesson defines system scope.

sections.heading: Keep the Perspectives in Separate Sections
paragraphs: A User Flow is not a complete architecture. Put them in separate files or sections and connect the same task/rules. Sharing with ten people may change actions slightly while greatly increasing architectural responsibilities.
This short reference-architecture checklist does not describe an implemented production shared version.

blocks.heading: Separate Flow and Structure Records
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records actions, browser responsibility, Python/Streamlit processing, in-process rules.py, session/download locations, absent database/model/login/authorization and pending shared-version responsibilities. Adapt it in architecture.md using synthetic material, not actual organizational rules or research.

zh.summary: 以C4 Context確定正在設計的系統、使用角色及外部依賴，為每條關係標明資料與目的。
objectives: 以單一系統為範圍辨識人與直接外部系統。
用有標籤、方向的關係說明輸入與產出。
分開系統範圍、網路位置及安全信任邊界。

readingGuide.goal: 以單一系統為範圍辨識人與直接外部系統。
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md與本課合成案例；用紙筆或文字編輯器即可。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 architecture.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: 一張Context草圖及相同內容的architecture.md節點／關係紀錄。

sections.heading: 先決定圖中哪個系統是主角
paragraphs: C4 System Context（系統情境圖）從系統外側看：誰使用它、與哪些外部軟體系統直接互動。官方建議關注人與軟體系統，先不要塞入函式、資料庫欄位與低層通訊細節，讓非技術角色也能討論。
本課主角是「本機收件完整性檢核系統」。收件人員是外部角色；瀏覽器及Python內部如何分工，留給Container層。本課沒有運行時模型API或業務系統依賴，就不為了填滿圖而新增。

sections.heading: 像先看一間店與顧客的關係
paragraphs: 第一次介紹一間店，可以先說誰來購買、店提供什麼、是否與配送公司往來，不需要立即展示收銀台內每根電線。這個範圍有助讓顧客、店員與維運者先說同一件事。
如果店根本沒有配送服務，就不要因為別家都有而畫上配送系統。架構圖同樣需要實際依據；候選依賴可以另畫並標為未採用，不與目前架構混在一起。

sections.heading: 看範圍，再讀有方向的關係
paragraphs: 下圖以節點分組加關係列呈現C4 Context的資訊。每列箭頭都有來源、目標與用途；它不是每次操作必然照編號發生的時序圖。版面重排時，方向與標籤仍保留為HTML文字。
外框表示本次說明的系統範圍，不代表網路防火牆或安全隔離；收件人員可能坐在同一台電腦前，仍是系統的使用角色。下載報告在此視為交付給操作者的產出，實際儲存位置下一層再說明。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜本機收件系統的Context
blocks.description: 先讀範圍內外的節點，再讀每條方向關係。沒有外部業務系統或模型API；外框不是安全信任邊界。
blocks.boundary: 本機收件完整性檢核系統

nodes.title: 收件人員
nodes.body: 準備合成資料、操作檢查並管理取得的報告。

nodes.title: 收件完整性檢核系統
nodes.body: 依本課三欄規則提供缺漏、預覽與當次匯出；不正式受理。

relations.label: 輸入合成資料，要求檢查或匯出。
回饋缺漏與修正資訊，提供當次完整性報告。

sections.heading: 用動詞與資料說明關係
paragraphs: 「使用」「連接」可以當初稿，但通常還要說明做什麼。例如「輸入合成資料，要求檢查」與「回饋缺漏，提供報告」，比雙向線只寫「資料」更能讓人追問責任。方向相反時，確認傳送內容是否也不同。
如果未來真的加入規則服務，應標記系統送出哪些資料、取得哪些回應，以及是否有未確認依賴。不要把「計畫串接」當成已完成整合，也不要把傳到外部的內容藏在一個模糊雲朵裡。

sections.heading: Coding Agent放在哪裡
paragraphs: 本課Coding Agent協助開發者讀規格、改檔案與驗證；參考應用程式運行時不呼叫它。因此它不屬於這張運行時Context的直接依賴，可以另在開發工具圖記錄其檔案與網路權限。
這個決定依目前範圍而來。若產品運行時真的呼叫模型，就應把模型服務及資料外送關係納入，並重新檢視資料、失敗、權限與成本；不能因為課名有AI就假設每個執行步驟都有模型。

sections.heading: 逐條核對有沒有偷換範圍
paragraphs: 常見誤解是「Context就是所有東西都畫在一張圖」。細節太多會讓人無法辨識主角，也容易把規格、部署與實作混在一起。先讓同儕指出主系統、使用者及兩條不同方向的關係，再追問缺少哪項外部依賴的依據。
把目前圖的文字節點與關係寫入architecture.md。若沒有外部系統，明寫沒有即可；沒有訪談過的角色需求則保留待確認，不虛構完整組織圖。

blocks.heading: Context文字正本
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 architecture.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。

外部角色：收件人員
收件人員 → 系統：合成輸入與檢查／匯出要求
系統 → 收件人員：缺漏回饋與當次報告
外部運行時系統：無
Coding Agent：開發工具，非本圖的運行時依賴
界線：系統範圍不等於網路位置或安全隔離

exercise.cleanup: 只保留合成名稱與公開可用依據，不貼真實內部系統名稱或架構。

en.summary: Use C4 Context to identify the system, user roles and external dependencies, labeling each relationship with data and purpose.
objectives: Identify people and direct external systems around one system.
Explain inputs and outputs with labeled, directed relationships.
Distinguish system scope, network location and security trust boundaries.

readingGuide.goal: Identify people and direct external systems around one system.
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md and the synthetic case; paper or a text editor is sufficient.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand architecture.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A Context sketch and matching architecture.md node/relationship record.

sections.heading: Choose the System at the Center
paragraphs: A C4 System Context diagram looks from outside: who uses a system and which external software directly interacts with it. C4 recommends people and software systems rather than functions, database fields or low-level protocols so nontechnical roles can discuss it.

The focus is this local intake completeness-checking system, with the intake worker outside its scope. Browser/Python responsibilities belong at Container level. No runtime model or business-system dependency exists here; do not add one to fill space.

sections.heading: Introduce a Shop and Its Customers First
paragraphs: First explain who buys from a shop, what it offers and whether it uses a delivery company, before showing every wire inside the till. This scope lets customers, staff and operations discuss the same object.

If there is no delivery service, do not draw one because other shops have it. Architecture needs evidence too. Draw candidate dependencies separately and mark them unadopted rather than mixing them into current architecture.

sections.heading: Read Scope, Then Directed Relationships
paragraphs: The diagram presents Context information through node groups and relationship rows. Each arrow has a source, target and purpose. It is not an operation sequence that must follow row numbers. Direction and labels remain HTML text after reflow.

The boundary defines the system being explained, not a firewall or security isolation. An operator on the same computer is still a user role. Here the report is an output delivered to that operator; its storage location is examined at the next level.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Context of the Local Intake System
blocks.description: Read nodes inside/outside scope, then directed relationships. There is no external business system or model API; the boundary is not a security trust boundary.

nodes.title: Intake worker
nodes.body: Prepares synthetic data, performs checks and manages received reports.

nodes.title: Intake completeness-checking system
nodes.body: Uses the course’s three-field rules for omissions, preview and current export; no official acceptance.

relations.label: Enter synthetic data and request checking or export.
Return omission/correction feedback and the current completeness report.

sections.heading: Describe Relationships with Verbs and Data
paragraphs: “Uses” or “connects” can start a draft but usually need purpose. “Enter synthetic data and request checking” and “return omissions and a report” support responsibility questions better than “data” on a two-way line. Opposite directions may carry different information.

If a rule service is genuinely added later, identify outgoing data, responses and unconfirmed dependencies. Planned integration is not completed integration; do not conceal egress in a vague cloud symbol.

sections.heading: Locate the Coding Agent Separately
paragraphs: The Coding Agent helps developers read specifications, edit files and verify. The reference does not call it at runtime, so it is not a direct dependency in this runtime Context. Record its file/network permissions in a separate development-tools view.

This follows current scope. A product that calls a model at runtime needs that service and outgoing data relationships included, with renewed review of data, errors, permissions and cost. An AI course title does not put a model in every execution step.

sections.heading: Check for Scope Substitution
paragraphs: Context does not mean putting everything into one picture. Excess detail obscures the focus and mixes specification, deployment and implementation. Ask a peer to locate the system, user and two opposite relationships, then examine evidence for missing dependencies.
Keep matching node and relationship text in architecture.md. If external systems are absent, say so. Leave unresearched role needs pending instead of inventing an organization chart.

blocks.heading: Context Text Record
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records the local system scope, external intake role, input and feedback directions, no external runtime systems, the agent as a development tool and the distinction between scope, network position and security. Adapt it in architecture.md; it is not actual organizational rules or findings.

範圍：收件完整性檢核系統
外部角色：收件人員
收件人員 → 系統：合成輸入與檢查／匯出要求
系統 → 收件人員：缺漏回饋與當次報告
外部運行時系統：無
Coding Agent：開發工具，非本圖的運行時依賴
界線：系統範圍不等於網路位置或安全隔離

steps: Draw one focal system and the intake role without Python functions or interface steps.

zh.summary: 由Context往內看應用程式與資料儲存，理解C4四個層級，避免把檔案、Docker與架構容器混為一談。
objectives: 說明Context、Container、Component、Code四種抽象層級。
以Container標示本課前端、Python程序與資料位置。
分開邏輯架構、部署實例與程序內元件。

readingGuide.goal: 說明Context、Container、Component、Code四種抽象層級。
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md與工作坊reference/，紙筆或文字編輯器即可；不需安裝Docker。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 architecture.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: Container草圖與architecture.md文字正本，能對照實際參考程式與資料位置。

sections.heading: 四層是放大視角，不是四台機器
paragraphs: C4以Context、Container、Component、Code逐步放大：外部關係、應用程式與資料儲存、容器內的元件、較低層的程式結構。四層不是固定四層部署，也不要求每個專案都畫到Code。
官方Container定義包含應用程式與資料儲存，例如伺服器程式、瀏覽器內應用與檔案儲存。這個詞不是Docker專用名稱；同一架構容器可能有多個部署實例，部署細節應另說明。

sections.heading: 像由校園一路放大到教室設備
paragraphs: 先看學校與師生、外部機構的關係，再看校內教學與行政單位，接著放大某單位的內部分工，最後才看一件設備如何組成。這個比喻只幫忙理解視角，不代表軟體層級與實體建築一一對應。
若你只想討論資料在哪個程式被處理，Container可能已足夠；若要理解rules.py的責任，再進入程序內元件與程式碼。不需為了湊四層而產生沒有教學用途的圖。

sections.heading: 把實際參考系統拆開
paragraphs: 本圖將系統放大為瀏覽器內的Streamlit前端及Python／Streamlit程序。前端接收操作，伺服器處理規則與結果，兩者通訊由Streamlit管理；圖中的關係不是自行建立REST端點的宣稱。
操作者裝置上的下載資料夾列為系統外的資料位置，因為報告離開應用程式後由操作者管理。本課沒有持久資料庫。圖中未將rules.py畫成Container，因為它由同一Python程序載入；其函式仍需測試。

sections.heading: 區分記憶體狀態與持久儲存
paragraphs: 輸入與checked快照在工作階段記憶體，與下載檔的存續方式不同。將資料庫符號移除不代表資料完全不留痕；若未來新增歷史查詢，需重新確認儲存、存取、備份、刪除與維運責任。
同樣地，兩個瀏覽器分頁有各自的框架工作階段，不等於兩個人已經有正式身分與授權隔離。Session的安全責任會在M06-05處理，不能由架構容器數量推定。

sections.heading: 用四層導覽定位問題
paragraphs: Context問誰與系統互動；Container問哪個應用或儲存負責；Component問容器內如何分工；Code再看函式、類別等實作。各層需要一致名稱與可追溯關係，但不必把所有資訊塞進同一張圖。
常見誤解是「前端、後端、資料庫就是所有專案固定三層」。本課沒有資料庫，rules.py也不是額外後端。選層級是為了回答問題，不是套用元件清單。

sections.heading: 讓圖與文字能互相核對
paragraphs: 在architecture.md保留節點名稱、責任、主要技術及關係，再註記哪些部署資訊尚未決定。例如綁定127.0.0.1是本機執行設定，不等於正式共用部署；若移到遠端，需重新檢視網路與資料控制。
請同儕找出圖中的程式、資料位置及兩條相反方向關係，確認沒有把箭頭讀成所有節點依序執行。

en.summary: Zoom from Context into applications and data stores, using C4 levels without confusing containers with source files, Docker or deployed instances.
objectives: Explain Context, Container, Component and Code as four abstraction levels.
Identify the frontend, Python process and data locations at Container level.
Separate logical architecture, deployment instances and in-process components.

readingGuide.goal: Explain Context, Container, Component and Code as four abstraction levels.
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md and workshop reference/; paper or a text editor is enough. Docker is not required.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand architecture.md and review the checks.
readingGuide.output: A Container sketch and matching architecture.md record checked against the actual reference program and data locations.

sections.heading: Four Levels of Zoom, Not Four Machines
paragraphs: C4 moves from Context to Container, Component and Code: external relationships, applications and data stores, components within a container, and lower-level code structure. These are abstraction levels, not four deployment tiers. Not every project needs a Code diagram.

C4 containers include applications and data stores, such as server applications, browser applications and file storage. The term is not specific to Docker. One architectural container may have several deployed instances; describe deployment separately.

sections.heading: Zoom from a Campus into Its Equipment
paragraphs: Begin with a school, its students and external organizations; then examine teaching and administration, responsibilities within one department, and finally the construction of a piece of equipment. This analogy explains changing viewpoints, without mapping software levels directly onto buildings.

Container level may suffice to discuss where data is processed. To examine rules.py responsibilities, zoom into in-process components and code. Draw another level when it answers a question, rather than producing diagrams just to complete a set.

sections.heading: Separate the Actual Reference System
paragraphs: The diagram zooms into the browser’s Streamlit frontend and the Python/Streamlit process. The frontend receives actions; the server handles rules and results. Streamlit manages communication, so these relationships do not claim that the course created custom REST endpoints.

The operator’s download folder is outside the application scope because the operator manages reports after download. The course has no persistent database. rules.py is loaded by the same Python process and is not a separate container; its functions still need tests.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Container View of the Local Intake System
blocks.description: Nodes describe responsibilities and data locations. Relationship rows show actions or data direction, not instance counts or captured packets.

nodes.body: Operates the local interface and manages downloaded reports.

nodes.title: Operator’s download folder
nodes.body: Keeps downloaded JSON; it is not the course’s persistent business database.

nodes.title: Streamlit frontend in the browser
nodes.body: Displays fields, receives actions and presents results.

nodes.title: Python/Streamlit process
nodes.body: Runs rules.py in the same process, retains session data and produces reports.

relations.label: Enter synthetic fields and initiate checking or download.
Streamlit manages connections and action events using mechanisms including HTTP and WebSocket.
The framework returns interface updates and the downloadable current report.
After the user initiates download, the browser saves JSON on the device.

sections.heading: Distinguish Memory State from Persistent Storage
paragraphs: Input and the checked snapshot live in session memory, with a different lifecycle from downloaded files. Removing a database symbol does not establish that data leaves no traces. Adding history later requires decisions about storage, access, backup, deletion and operations.
Two browser tabs can have separate framework sessions without establishing two authenticated people or authorization isolation. M06-05 examines session security; container counts cannot establish it.

sections.heading: Choose the Level That Answers the Question
paragraphs: Context asks who interacts with the system. Container asks which application or store is responsible. Component examines responsibilities within a container. Code examines functions, classes and implementation. Keep names and relationships traceable across levels without cramming everything into one diagram.

A common mistake is to prescribe frontend, backend and database as three fixed tiers for every project. This course has no database, and rules.py is not another backend. Choose a level to answer a question, then check the actual system.

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Questions at Each C4 Level

sections.heading: Cross-check the Diagram and Its Text
paragraphs: Keep node names, responsibilities, main technologies and relationships in architecture.md, then mark undecided deployment details. Binding to 127.0.0.1 is a local execution setting, not a production shared deployment. Moving to a remote host requires revisiting network and data controls.
Ask a peer to identify the applications, data locations and two opposite-direction relationships. Confirm that arrows are not being read as a sequence in which every node must execute.

blocks.heading: Container Text Record
paragraphs: The unchanged Traditional Chinese template lists the frontend and Python process, in-process rules.py, framework input/result directions, downloaded JSON, absent persistent business storage, separate session/download lifecycles and unverified remote/shared deployment. Adapt these fields in architecture.md using synthetic information; they are not organizational rules or research findings.

zh.summary: 追蹤瀏覽器操作如何成為請求、處理與回應，分清一般HTTP／API概念與Streamlit實際採用的框架通訊。
objectives: 說明瀏覽器、HTTP與API在資料交換中的不同角色。
以同一筆合成資料追到驗證、回應、預覽與下載。
區分HTTP狀態、業務結果與尚未觀察的通訊細節。

readingGuide.goal: 說明瀏覽器、HTTP與API在資料交換中的不同角色。
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md及reference/原始碼；可先只閱讀。若觀察網路，只用自己的本機合成原型。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 architecture.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: 一份不虛構端點、能區分傳輸與業務結果的資料流紀錄。

sections.heading: 介面點擊後，還有資料交換
paragraphs: Browser（瀏覽器）呈現頁面、執行用戶端程式並與伺服器通訊。HTTP是Web常用的請求／回應協定；API（Application Programming Interface，應用程式介面）是軟體互動契約，不一定走網路，也不一定是REST。
例如rules.py中的函式可供同程序程式呼叫；若另外設計HTTP API，才需定義端點、方法、輸入、回應與錯誤。本課沒有自行建立/api/check，不能因為看到檢查按鈕就推定存在這個網址。

sections.heading: 像窗口、傳遞方式與服務約定
paragraphs: 瀏覽器像使用者面前的窗口，HTTP像窗口與處理單位交換訊息的方式，API則說明哪些請求可被接受、要給什麼資料、會回什麼。這個比喻只幫忙分工，實際系統可能有多種協定與中介。
按鈕只是觸發點；想理解資料去向，要追輸入、通訊、處理、結果及保存。畫面顯示一個綠色完成訊息，無法單獨說明伺服器是否真的拒絕不完整匯出。

sections.heading: 一般HTTP請求要讀哪些部分
paragraphs: MDN的HTTP概覽說明用戶端送出請求、伺服器產生回應；方法、目標、標頭及可能的本文共同傳達意圖。回應包含狀態碼、標頭與可能的內容。HTTP本身無狀態，應用程式可透過額外機制維持工作階段。
HTTP 200通常表示該HTTP請求成功處理，不能直接推論欄位完整、正式受理或授權正確。業務結果與安全規則要看契約及實際內容；網路成功也不等於使用者已收到或理解最終報告。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜一次資料檢查的概念追蹤
blocks.description: 這是教學分析順序，非Streamlit封包格式；不指定不存在的REST端點。

items.title: 目前輸入
items.body: 辨識本次合成欄位及使用者要求，避免沿用舊快照。

items.title: 通訊與處理
items.body: 確認由哪個機制傳送、在哪個程序驗證，不能只信任介面限制。

items.title: 回應與狀態
items.body: 區分傳輸或框架成功、業務缺漏與技術失敗。

items.title: 預覽與下載
items.body: 結果對應目前輸入；下載後另有裝置保存責任。

sections.heading: 對照Streamlit，而非套用假想端點
paragraphs: Streamlit官方架構文件說明前端與伺服器的HTTP及WebSocket使用；WebSocket可維持雙向連線以傳遞更新與工作階段互動。本課沿框架機制，不把每次按鈕操作都改說成向自訂REST API送一次POST。
Python程序內呼叫validate與export_report是另一層關係。圖可以標「框架管理的事件與結果」，需要更細資料時，再在自己的合成環境用瀏覽器開發工具確認，不編造未擷取的封包或回應範例。

sections.heading: 每個邊界都要問誰重新檢查
paragraphs: 使用者介面的max_chars有助輸入，但程式端仍需檢查型別、空白與長度；匯出函式也要驗證目前資料，而不是只信任畫面曾顯示完整。相同規則在不同入口的責任要明確。
修改輸入後，應知道哪個快照失效、哪個預覽或下載出口不再可用。重跑畫面與重新授權是不同問題；本原型沒有正式多人存取控制，不用這段流程宣稱授權已完成。

sections.heading: 區分文件推理與實際觀察
paragraphs: 常見誤解是「Network分頁看到成功，就證明整個任務通過」。觀察應記錄你看的是哪個資源、連線或資料交換，並核對業務與下載結果；不要把網路紀錄中的憑證、cookie或真實資料公開。

en.summary: Trace browser actions through communication, processing and responses, separating general HTTP/API concepts from Streamlit’s actual framework communication.
objectives: Explain the different roles of the browser, HTTP and APIs in data exchange.
Trace one synthetic record through validation, response, preview and download.
Separate HTTP status, business outcomes and unobserved communication details.

readingGuide.goal: Explain the different roles of the browser, HTTP and APIs in data exchange.
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md and reference/ source; reading alone is sufficient initially. Observe network activity only in your own local synthetic prototype.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand architecture.md and review the checks.
readingGuide.output: A data-flow record that separates transport from business outcomes without inventing endpoints.

sections.heading: A Click Also Involves Data Exchange
paragraphs: A browser presents pages, executes client-side code and communicates with servers. HTTP is a request/response protocol commonly used on the Web. An API (Application Programming Interface) defines software interaction; it need not use a network or REST.

For example, functions in rules.py can be called within the same process. A separately designed HTTP API would need endpoints, methods, inputs, responses and errors. This course creates no /api/check endpoint; a check button does not establish that such a URL exists.

sections.heading: A Counter, Message Exchange and Service Agreement
paragraphs: Think of the browser as a service counter, HTTP as a way to exchange messages with a processing office, and the API as an agreement about accepted requests, required data and responses. The analogy separates responsibilities; actual systems can involve multiple protocols and intermediaries.

A button is just a trigger. Trace input, communication, processing, results and retention to understand destinations. A green completion message alone does not show that server-side code actually rejects incomplete exports.

sections.heading: Read the Parts of an HTTP Request
paragraphs: MDN describes a client sending a request and a server producing a response. The method, target, headers and optional body convey the request; the response includes a status code, headers and optional content. HTTP is stateless, while applications can maintain sessions through additional mechanisms.

HTTP 200 usually indicates successful handling of that HTTP request. It does not establish complete fields, official acceptance or correct authorization. Inspect the contract and content for business and security outcomes; network success also does not establish that the user received or understood the final report.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Conceptual Trace of One Data Check
blocks.description: This is an analysis sequence, not a Streamlit packet format. It specifies no nonexistent REST endpoint.

items.title: Current input
items.body: Identify the current synthetic fields and requested action; avoid reusing a stale snapshot.

items.title: Communication and processing
items.body: Identify the transport mechanism and validating process; interface limits alone are insufficient.

items.title: Response and status
items.body: Separate transport/framework success, business omissions and technical failures.

items.title: Preview and download
items.body: Match results to current input; downloaded files have separate device-retention responsibilities.

sections.heading: Check Streamlit Instead of Assuming Endpoints
paragraphs: Streamlit’s architecture documentation explains HTTP and WebSocket use between frontend and server. WebSocket maintains a two-way connection for updates and session interaction. This course uses framework mechanisms; do not describe every button as a POST to a custom REST API.

Calling validate and export_report within Python is a different relationship. Label the diagram “framework-managed events and results.” If finer detail is needed, inspect your own synthetic environment with browser developer tools rather than inventing uncaptured packets or responses.

sections.heading: Ask Who Rechecks at Each Boundary
paragraphs: The interface’s max_chars helps input, but program-side code still checks types, blanks and length. Export must validate current data rather than trusting an earlier complete result. Make rule responsibilities explicit at each entry point.

After an edit, identify which snapshot is invalid and which preview/download paths become unavailable. Rerendering and reauthorization are separate concerns. This prototype has no formal multiuser access control, so this flow does not demonstrate completed authorization.

sections.heading: Separate Document Reasoning from Observation
paragraphs: A successful entry in the Network panel does not establish that the whole task passed. Record which resource, connection or exchange you observed, then check business and download results. Do not publish credentials, cookies or real data from network records.

Without starting the prototype, you can trace documents and mark protocol detail as documented or awaiting observation. This differs from capturing an actual request; keep those evidence levels in the record.

blocks.heading: Data-flow Trace Record
paragraphs: The unchanged Traditional Chinese template records current three-field input and events, the browser frontend, Streamlit-managed HTTP/WebSocket communication, Python validation/export, omission feedback or current JSON, session/download retention, no custom /api/check backend and the difference between document/code review and unobserved traffic. Adapt it in architecture.md with synthetic information.

zh.summary: 分清身分、存取權限與工作階段，為十人共用的候選架構寫出存取處的控制及負向情境。
objectives: 區分Authentication、Authorization與Session各自的責任。
為資料讀取與匯出指定伺服器端授權檢查。
將單人原型與未實作的多人安全需求分開記錄。

readingGuide.goal: 區分Authentication、Authorization與Session各自的責任。
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md及合成A／B角色卡；不建立真實帳號、不存真實資料。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 architecture.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: architecture.md中獨立的共用版候選控制及負向情境。

sections.heading: 先知道是誰，再確認能做什麼
paragraphs: Authentication（身分驗證）確認宣稱的身分；Authorization（授權）判斷該身分能否對某項資料做某個動作；Session（工作階段）協助多次互動維持相關狀態。三者互相關聯，但不是同一件事。
Session也可能用於匿名偏好，不必然代表已登入。st.session_state可保留本課互動狀態，不能因此被視為正式帳號、權限管理或完整工作階段安全。本機原型尚未實作這些多人責任。

sections.heading: 像大樓證件、樓層權限與暫時通行
paragraphs: 核對證件是身分確認，允許進哪個樓層是授權，暫時通行證則需要發放、效期與撤銷等管理。拿到一張證並不代表可進所有房間，也不代表證件永遠有效。
網站類似：知道使用者是A之後，每次讀取或匯出資料仍要確認A是否獲准。將A的資料按鈕藏起來，不能阻止B直接要求同一筆資料；真正存取的位置需要執行規則。

sections.heading: 為同一筆資料分配不同控制
paragraphs: OWASP授權指南建議預設拒絕、最小權限，並在每次請求核對權限。本課十人版先作候選需求：資料有負責人或明確關係，讀取與匯出都在伺服器端依規則檢查，拒絕時不回傳資料內容。
這不是已採用的組織權限模型。複核者能看哪些案件、代理交接如何處理、權限何時失效，仍要由適當角色確認，不能直接猜成「管理員看全部」。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜共用版需要分開的三種控制
blocks.description: 三張卡為責任對照，不代表一次登入就完成後續所有檢查；本原型均未實作正式控制。

items.title: 身分驗證
items.body: 確認誰在提出要求；選擇身分來源與驗證方式，另核對安全需求。

items.title: 資料授權
items.body: 對讀取、修改或匯出核對身分、資料關係與動作；拒絕不回傳內容。

items.title: 工作階段治理
items.body: 管理憑證或token的建立、更新、逾時與失效；狀態不是永久信任。

sections.heading: 持續互動需要生命週期
paragraphs: OWASP說明工作階段識別符外洩可能造成冒用，因此工作階段需要適當保護、到期與登出失效等設計。生命週期不能只靠使用者關閉分頁來推定；權限或風險改變時，也需重新判斷相關互動是否仍有效。
本章不指定一套通用token格式或隨意秒數。未來共用版要依使用情境定義閒置、絕對期限、撤銷與重新驗證，再以實際框架驗證；純粹把使用者代號存進session_state不會自動建立這些控制。

sections.heading: 先寫拒絕情境，再談共用上線
paragraphs: 用合成帳號A與B思考：B要求只授權A的資料時，讀取與匯出都要拒絕，回應不得包含該內容。再測未登入、已失效工作階段及權限被撤回；每種情況需有明確結果及驗證位置。
本課沒有登入與資料庫，因此只能先寫候選規格與檢查位置，不能在原型上捏造通過結果。保留「待實作／待驗證」，下一階段再連到架構、程式及測試。

sections.heading: 把控制放到資料路徑上
paragraphs: 常見誤解是「HTTPS加登入畫面就能十人共用」。傳輸保護、身分確認、資料授權與保存是不同責任；每項都需要與實際資料路徑連結。
在architecture.md另建共用版候選段落，不覆蓋目前單人架構。請讀者指出控制在哪裡執行、誰確認規則，以及哪些證據還不存在。

en.summary: Separate identity, access permissions and sessions, then specify access-point controls and negative scenarios for a candidate ten-user architecture.
objectives: Distinguish authentication, authorization and session responsibilities.
Specify server-side authorization checks for reading and exporting data.
Record the single-user prototype separately from unimplemented multiuser security needs.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish authentication, authorization and session responsibilities.
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md and synthetic A/B role cards; create no real accounts and store no real data.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand architecture.md and review the checks.
readingGuide.output: A separate candidate shared-version control and negative-scenario section in architecture.md.

sections.heading: Establish Identity, Then Check Permission
paragraphs: Authentication verifies a claimed identity. Authorization decides whether that identity may perform an action on particular data. A session maintains related state across interactions. They interact but carry different responsibilities.

Sessions can also maintain anonymous preferences and need not imply login. st.session_state retains this course’s interaction state; it does not establish formal accounts, permission management or complete session security. The local prototype has not implemented those multiuser responsibilities.

sections.heading: Identification, Floor Access and a Temporary Pass
paragraphs: Checking identification establishes identity; permitted floors express authorization. A temporary pass also needs issuance, expiry and revocation management. Receiving a pass does not grant access to every room or make it valid forever.

Likewise, after identifying user A, each read or export still needs a permission decision. Hiding the button for A’s record cannot prevent B from directly requesting it. Enforce the rule where access actually occurs.

sections.heading: Assign Controls to the Same Data
paragraphs: OWASP recommends denying by default, applying least privilege and checking permissions on every request. For the candidate ten-user version, assign an owner or explicit relationship to records and check rules server-side for both reads and exports. Rejection must return no record content.

This is not an adopted organizational permission model. Appropriate roles must still confirm reviewer scope, delegated handover and permission expiry. Do not assume an administrator may see everything.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Separate Shared-version Controls
blocks.description: The cards compare responsibilities. One login does not complete every later check; the prototype implements none of these formal controls.

items.title: Authentication
items.body: Identify who is requesting access; choose an identity source and verification mechanism, then check security needs.

items.title: Data authorization
items.body: Check identity, record relationship and action for reads, changes or exports; return no content when denying access.

items.title: Session governance
items.body: Manage credential/token creation, renewal, timeout and invalidation; retained state is not permanent trust.

sections.heading: Continuing Interaction Needs a Lifecycle
paragraphs: OWASP explains that leaked session identifiers can enable impersonation. Design protection, expiry and logout invalidation rather than assuming a closed browser tab ends a session. Changes in permissions or risk also require reconsidering whether interactions remain valid.

This lesson prescribes neither a universal token format nor arbitrary timeout seconds. Define idle and absolute expiry, revocation and reauthentication for the future shared context, then verify the actual framework. Saving a user code in session_state does not create these controls.

sections.heading: Specify Rejection Before Shared Deployment
paragraphs: Use synthetic accounts A and B: if B requests data authorized only for A, both read and export must reject without including that content. Also specify unauthenticated requests, invalid sessions and revoked permissions, with explicit outcomes and verification locations.

This course has no login or database. Write candidate requirements and control locations first; do not fabricate passing prototype results. Keep them “not implemented / not verified” until architecture, code and tests provide actual evidence.

sections.heading: Place Controls on the Data Path
paragraphs: HTTPS and a login screen alone do not establish ten-user readiness. Transport protection, identity verification, data authorization and retention need distinct responsibilities linked to the actual data path.
Add a candidate shared-version section to architecture.md while retaining the current single-user architecture. Ask readers to locate execution points, rule owners and missing evidence.

blocks.heading: Candidate Ten-user Controls
paragraphs: The unchanged Traditional Chinese template records an unimplemented shared version: undecided identity source, role-confirmed read/change/export relationships, server-side access/export checks, denial of B reading A-only data without content, session lifecycle still to design, absent formal prototype controls and no executed results. Adapt it with synthetic roles; it is not organizational policy or research evidence.

zh.summary: 在資料流上標記傳輸保護、秘密保管與信任邊界，確認HTTPS之外仍有哪些安全責任。
objectives: 說明TLS保護的通道與身分範圍，找出終結位置。
分開公開憑證、私密金鑰與應用程式秘密的保管責任。
為輸入、匯出與外部依賴標記信任邊界及待驗控制。

readingGuide.goal: 說明TLS保護的通道與身分範圍，找出終結位置。
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md與合成架構；不申請憑證、不建立外部帳號、不輸入真實key。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 architecture.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: architecture.md具逐段傳輸、秘密責任及信任邊界附錄，清楚區分目前與假想部署。

sections.heading: TLS保護通道，不替你判斷資料權限
paragraphs: TLS（Transport Layer Security，傳輸層安全）在正確配置與驗證下，提供通訊機密性與完整性，並讓用戶端確認伺服器身分。一般HTTPS不等於確認終端使用者身分；雙向TLS又有不同的用戶端憑證責任。
TLS保護的是它的兩個端點之間。若在反向代理終結TLS，代理到應用程式是另一段連線，必須另外說明保護方式。網址有HTTPS，不能推論所有內部通道、資料保存與授權都已正確。

sections.heading: 像上鎖運送與收件權限
paragraphs: 上鎖運送箱可降低運送途中被看見或改動的風險，但箱子到達後由誰開、內容該交給誰、鑰匙放在哪裡，仍是不同責任。把鑰匙貼在箱外，也不會因為運送上鎖就變安全。
這個比喻只幫忙區分通道、端點與存取，不代表加密箱等同TLS。軟體仍需處理端點身分驗證、秘密保管、輸入驗證與資料授權。

sections.heading: 逐段標示終結與待確認事項
paragraphs: 下面是假想共用部署的分析表，不是本課已部署架構。每段都要能說出來源、接收端、保護方式及誰負責設定。中介看得到解密後資料時，也需納入資料與秘密責任。
本課實作仍為127.0.0.1本機教學，沒有因為這張表就新增TLS或正式網路防護。切換到遠端或組織環境時，需重新確認身分、授權、網路及保存需求。

候選HTTPS；TLS在代理終結

反向代理 → 應用程序
需另決定TLS與其他網路控制，不假設內網自然可信
該段實際協定、設定與存取限制
應用程序 → 儲存或外部服務
若日後納入，另定傳輸與憑證／秘密責任
資料範圍、秘密保管、權限及失敗處理
報告 → 操作者下載檔
下載後超出通道保護的範圍
裝置存取、保存與分享責任另確認

sections.heading: 知道什麼能公開，什麼必須保護
paragraphs: 伺服器憑證本身通常可公開，與它配對的私密金鑰則需要保護；API key、資料庫密碼、session token等也不能混入教材、程式庫、前端資源或公開日誌。本課沒有要求讀者提供任何真實秘密。
OWASP秘密管理指南涵蓋存放、授權、稽核、輪替及生命週期。環境變數或.env只是注入與存放方式之一，不會自動解決讀取權限、洩漏日誌或撤銷問題。若秘密外洩，刪除文字不等於使秘密失效，需依實際服務處理撤銷／輪替與影響調查。

sections.heading: 信任邊界依資料與控制責任判斷
paragraphs: 信任邊界是資料或操作跨越不同信任、權限或控制責任的地方。瀏覽器到程序、應用到外部服務、程序到報告下載，都值得追問輸入是否可信、誰驗證、哪些資料能離開。它不必與C4系統外框或機器邊界重合。
OWASP威脅建模指南將資料流、儲存、外部實體與信任邊界放在同一分析脈絡。本課只先找出控制問題，沒有完成威脅評估或正式安全認證；圖上的虛線也不會自動建立沙箱或防火牆。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜三種需要分開核對的責任
blocks.description: 卡片並列控制問題，不能由其中一項通過就推論全部安全。

items.title: 傳輸與終結
items.body: TLS保護哪兩端？中介在哪裡解密？下一段如何保護？

items.title: 秘密與身分
items.body: 私密金鑰、token與API key由誰保管、能被誰讀取、如何失效？

items.title: 資料與權限
items.body: 跨邊界輸入誰驗證？匯出哪些欄位？誰可讀取與保存？

sections.heading: 在架構旁記錄控制與未驗證範圍
paragraphs: 常見誤解是「有鎖頭就是安全系統」。瀏覽器通道提示無法代替授權、資料最小化、依賴與維運檢查。把每項主張連到實際設定、測試或待確認者，才能知道還缺什麼。
請沿合成資料標出至少三個邊界問題，保留目前單人本機與假想共用設計的差異。若沒有TLS設定或秘密，不需為練習新增真實服務或憑證，只寫適用條件與待驗控制。

en.summary: Mark transport protection, secret custody and trust boundaries on the data flow, identifying security responsibilities beyond HTTPS.
objectives: Explain TLS channel and identity scope and locate termination points.
Separate custody of public certificates, private keys and application secrets.
Mark trust boundaries and unverified controls for input, export and external dependencies.

readingGuide.goal: Explain TLS channel and identity scope and locate termination points.
readingGuide.startingPoint: architecture.md and a synthetic architecture; request no certificates, create no external accounts and enter no real keys.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand architecture.md and review the checks.
readingGuide.output: An architecture.md appendix covering each transport hop, secret responsibilities and trust boundaries, distinguishing current from hypothetical deployment.

sections.heading: TLS Protects a Channel, Not a Data Permission Decision
paragraphs: With correct configuration and verification, TLS (Transport Layer Security) provides communication confidentiality and integrity and lets clients verify the server’s identity. Ordinary HTTPS does not verify the end user’s identity; mutual TLS introduces different client-certificate responsibilities.

TLS protects communication between its two endpoints. If it terminates at a reverse proxy, the proxy-to-application connection is a separate hop whose protection needs explanation. An HTTPS URL does not establish correct protection for every internal channel, retention rule or authorization decision.

sections.heading: Locked Transport and Permission to Receive
paragraphs: A locked shipping box can reduce exposure or tampering in transit. Who opens it at arrival, who should receive its contents and where the key is kept remain separate responsibilities. Attaching the key outside the box undermines protection.
This analogy separates channels, endpoints and access; a physical lock is not TLS. Software still needs endpoint verification, secret custody, input validation and data authorization.

sections.heading: Mark Termination and Questions for Each Hop
paragraphs: This table analyzes a hypothetical shared deployment, not an architecture already deployed by the course. For each hop, identify source, recipient, protection and configuration owner. An intermediary that decrypts content also carries data and secret responsibilities.

The practical project remains local teaching on 127.0.0.1. This table adds neither TLS nor production network controls. Moving remotely or into an organization requires revisiting identity, authorization, network and retention needs.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Per-hop Review of a Hypothetical Deployment
rows: Browser → reverse proxy
Candidate HTTPS; TLS terminates at the proxy.
Certificate/hostname verification, actual configuration and connection checks.
Reverse proxy → application process
Decide TLS and other network controls separately; do not assume an internal network is trusted.
The actual protocol, configuration and access restrictions for this hop.
Application → storage or external service
If introduced later, specify transport and credential/secret responsibilities separately.
Data scope, secret custody, permissions and failure handling.
Report → operator’s download
After download, channel protection no longer covers file retention.
Separate decisions about device access, retention and sharing.

sections.heading: Distinguish Public Information from Secrets
paragraphs: A server certificate is generally public; its matching private key needs protection. API keys, database passwords and session tokens must not enter teaching material, repositories, frontend assets or public logs. This course requests no actual secrets.

OWASP secret-management guidance covers storage, authorization, audit, rotation and lifecycle. Environment variables or .env are injection/storage mechanisms, not automatic solutions to read permissions, log leaks or revocation. Deleting leaked text does not invalidate a secret; handle revocation/rotation and impact investigation through the actual service.

sections.heading: Locate Changes in Trust and Control Responsibility
paragraphs: A trust boundary occurs where data or actions cross different trust, permission or control responsibilities. At browser-to-process, application-to-external-service and process-to-download transitions, ask whether input is trusted, who validates it and what may leave. Such boundaries need not match C4 scope or machine boundaries.

OWASP threat modeling examines data flows, stores, external entities and trust boundaries together. This course identifies control questions first; it does not complete a threat assessment or security certification. A dashed line implements neither a sandbox nor a firewall.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Responsibilities to Review Separately
blocks.description: These cards compare control questions. Passing one does not establish security for all three.

items.title: Transport and termination
items.body: Which endpoints does TLS protect? Where does an intermediary decrypt, and how is the next hop protected?

items.title: Secrets and identity
items.body: Who holds private keys, tokens and API keys, who can read them and how are they invalidated?

items.title: Data and permissions
items.body: Who validates cross-boundary input, which fields may be exported and who may read or retain them?

sections.heading: Record Controls and Unverified Scope Beside Architecture
paragraphs: A browser padlock does not establish a secure system. Channel indicators do not replace authorization, data minimization, dependency or operations checks. Link each claim to actual settings, tests or a responsible person who must still confirm it.

Trace synthetic data and mark at least three boundary questions, preserving the difference between the current single-user local project and hypothetical shared design. With no TLS configuration or secrets, write conditions and pending controls; creating real services or certificates is unnecessary.

blocks.heading: Security-boundary Appendix
paragraphs: The unchanged Traditional Chinese template records current local execution without new TLS, browser/process type/blank/length validation, allowlisted exports revalidated before download, hypothetical proxy and application hops reviewed separately, future secret custody/authorization/revocation, missing formal identity/storage/operations controls and design-only evidence. Adapt it in architecture.md using synthetic information.

exercise.environment: architecture.md and a synthetic architecture; request no certificates, create no external accounts and enter no real keys.
steps: Mark at least three data or responsibility boundaries along browser, process and downloads; identify validation and management owners.
Draw a separate hypothetical TLS proxy chain with each channel and termination point; mark undecided protection pending confirmation.

exercise.expected: An architecture.md appendix covering each transport hop, secret responsibilities and trust boundaries, distinguishing current from hypothetical deployment.
exercise.check: Do not equate TLS with authorization, .env with complete secret management or a C4 frame with a firewall. Report no passing control without execution.

en.prompt: How should you identify a trust boundary?

A dashed line means isolation is implemented.

sections.heading: 開始前先找到正確的工作位置
paragraphs: 下載工作坊 ZIP 後解壓到自己的新目錄。README、requirements.txt、starter/、slices/ 與 reference/ 應在同一層；本篇命令以這個根目錄為起點。終端機目前目錄決定相對路徑如何解讀，編輯器開著 app.py 並不代表終端機也在那裡。
Python 執行程式，Streamlit 提供畫面與重跑機制，pytest 執行測試，Coding Agent 協助讀寫檔案及呼叫允許的命令。先確認每個角色，遇到錯誤才知道要查哪一層。

sections.heading: 像為一道料理準備獨立工作臺
paragraphs: 食譜是規格，食材清單是依賴套件，爐具是執行環境，完成的餐點才是功能結果。找到食材只證明可以開始，還要真的做出指定餐點並檢查。
虛擬環境把本專案的 Python 套件分開管理，方便依清單重建。它不會自動提供檔案或網路隔離，也不取代 M02 的 Sandbox 權限設定。不要把 .venv 當作可攜式備份或提交到 Git。

sections.heading: 沿著環境到行為逐層核對
paragraphs: 本包採 Python 3.11／3.12，固定 Streamlit 1.51.0 與 pytest 8.4.2。這是教學重現組合；requirements.txt 固定直接依賴，沒有宣稱鎖住全部間接依賴或所有作業系統。
每個階段都記下實際輸出。若 pip 安裝失敗，先保留退出結果與錯誤訊息；不要接著把未執行的測試寫成通過。

sections.heading: 看到畫面後還要確認停止方式
paragraphs: 瀏覽器開啟終端機列出的本機網址。starter/app.py 應顯示起始骨架，並說明尚未實作完整性檢核或匯出。這就是此步預期結果；看不到下載按鈕並非環境故障。
回終端機按 Ctrl+C 停止本次服務。若埠號已被占用，先辨識既有程序與用途，不任意結束別人的工作；也不要為了讓網頁可開啟，就把綁定位址改為所有網卡。

sections.heading: 常見誤解與環境紀錄
paragraphs: 「同學能執行，所以我的環境一定相同」忽略了版本、平台與工作目錄。請記錄自己實際使用的環境，讓下一位能依證據排查。
「安裝好了就完成切片一」則少了表單與行為驗收。把環境、功能、學員理解分成獨立狀態，M07-03 才開始建立可用表單。

blocks.heading: 建議紀錄欄位
paragraphs: 另建本機 environment-notes.md，只填已觀察結果。
blocks.code:

exercise.environment: 解壓後工作坊根目錄、Python 3.11／3.12、終端機與瀏覽器。
steps: 建立並啟用獨立環境，安裝 requirements.txt，記錄實際版本。
啟動 starter/app.py，在瀏覽器核對骨架訊息，再停止服務。
將成功、失敗與尚未執行的步驟分開記入 environment-notes.md。
exercise.expected: environment-notes.md 可讓同儕找到同一入口，並清楚知道骨架尚無哪些功能。
exercise.check: 能指出工作目錄與 Python 的差別；不把環境建置當成功能驗收。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Locate the project, selected Python and packages before starting the skeleton; record installation outcomes separately from feature acceptance.
objectives: Start the skeleton in a separate environment and record actual versions.
Distinguish working directory, interpreter, packages and execution entry point.
Preserve environment-failure diagnostics without claiming completed implementation.

readingGuide.goal: Start the skeleton in a separate environment and record actual versions.
readingGuide.startingPoint: The extracted workshop root, Python 3.11/3.12, a terminal and a browser.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: environment-notes.md lets a peer find the same entry point and identify features absent from the skeleton.

sections.heading: Locate the Right Working Directory
paragraphs: Extract the workshop ZIP into a new directory of your own. README, requirements.txt, starter/, slices/ and reference/ should be at the same level; commands in this lesson start there. Relative paths depend on the terminal’s current directory, even when an editor has app.py open elsewhere.

Python runs code, Streamlit supplies the interface and rerun mechanism, pytest runs tests, and a Coding Agent helps read/write files and call permitted commands. Distinguish these roles so errors can be investigated at the right layer.

sections.heading: Prepare a Separate Workbench for a Recipe
paragraphs: The recipe is the specification, the ingredients list is the package list, the cooking equipment is the runtime, and the meal is the functional result. Finding ingredients establishes preparation; you still have to cook and check the requested meal.

A virtual environment manages project Python packages separately so they can be recreated from a list. It does not automatically isolate files or networks or replace M02 sandbox permissions. Do not treat .venv as a portable backup or commit it to Git.

sections.heading: Check Environment Before Behavior
paragraphs: The package targets Python 3.11/3.12 with Streamlit 1.51.0 and pytest 8.4.2 pinned for teaching reproducibility. requirements.txt pins direct dependencies; it does not claim to lock every transitive dependency or support every operating system.
Record actual output at each stage. If pip installation fails, retain the exit outcome and error. Do not report subsequent unexecuted tests as passed.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Establish the Environment, Then Observe Features
blocks.description: Each check has its own evidence. Leave the final task unverified until it has actually run.

items.title: Locate the project
items.body: Check README and relative paths.

items.title: Confirm the environment
items.body: Record Python/package versions and installation outcomes.

items.title: Start the skeleton
items.body: Observe its starting screen in the browser.

items.title: Accept a task
items.body: Operate against the specification; the skeleton has no completeness feature yet.

sections.heading: Start the Project Skeleton
paragraphs: Run the commands in order from the extracted root. The activation command below is for POSIX shells. Windows PowerShell uses .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1 under existing system policy; do not lower security settings for installation.

Use python -m so installation, tests and startup follow the selected Python. If python3 is unavailable or venv creation fails, resolve the environment first rather than asking the Agent to change app.py to hide it.

blocks.heading: Environment and Startup Commands
paragraphs: Read the root README first and preserve commands and real outcomes. Copy no credentials or keys.
blocks.code:
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python --version
python -m streamlit version
python -m pytest --version
python -m streamlit run starter/app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: Confirm How to Stop After Seeing the Screen
paragraphs: Open the local URL printed by the terminal. starter/app.py should identify itself as a skeleton without completeness checks or export. That is the expected result here; an absent download button is not an environment failure.

Press Ctrl+C in the terminal to stop this service. If the port is occupied, identify the existing process and its purpose before acting. Preserve other people’s work and keep the local binding rather than exposing all interfaces just to make the page open.

sections.heading: Record the Environment and Its Limits
paragraphs: A classmate’s successful run does not establish identical versions, platforms or working directories. Record your own actual environment so the next person can investigate with evidence.

Installation does not complete slice one: the form and its behavior still need implementation and acceptance. Track environment, features and learner understanding separately; M07-03 begins the usable form.

blocks.heading: Suggested Record Fields
paragraphs: Create local environment-notes.md and fill only observed results. The unchanged Traditional Chinese template records working directory, OS/Python, Streamlit/pytest, installation command/exit, skeleton startup/shutdown, the absent form/check/export features and next steps.
blocks.code:

Streamlit／pytest：
安裝命令與退出結果：
骨架啟動／停止：

未完成及下一步：
