steps: Create and activate a separate environment, install requirements.txt and record actual versions.
Start starter/app.py, check its skeleton message in the browser, then stop the service.
Record successes, failures and unexecuted steps separately in environment-notes.md.
exercise.expected: environment-notes.md lets a peer find the same entry point and identify features absent from the skeleton.
exercise.check: Distinguish working directory from Python, and environment setup from feature acceptance.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.prompt: 虛擬環境最直接提供什麼？
options: 本專案獨立套件環境
完整網路隔離
自動功能驗收
正式多人授權
rationales: 便於依專案管理及重建套件。
網路權限需另外控制。
仍需執行驗收。
與業務授權不同。

en.prompt: What does a virtual environment most directly provide?
options: A separate package environment for this project.
Complete network isolation.
Automatic feature acceptance.
Formal multiuser authorization.
rationales: It helps manage and recreate project packages.
Network permissions need separate controls.
Acceptance still needs execution.
Business authorization is a different concern.

zh.prompt: starter 畫面指出尚無匯出，應如何記錄？
options: 測試全部通過
已完成三次切片
骨架啟動成功，匯出尚未實作
直接改成顯示成功
rationales: 啟動不等於所有測試。
骨架不是完成品。
分清環境與功能狀態。
會造成不實回饋。

en.prompt: The starter screen says export is absent. How should you record this?
options: All tests passed.
All three slices are complete.
The skeleton started successfully; export is not implemented.
Change the screen to claim success.
rationales: Startup is not every test.
A skeleton is not the finished product.
Keep environment and feature status distinct.
That would give false feedback.

zh.prompt: pip 失敗後最合適的下一步？
options: 刪除測試
保留錯誤與實際環境，先排除安裝問題
回報 Agent 已完成
更改正式業務規則
rationales: 無法解決環境問題。
先定位失敗層次。
缺乏執行證據。
與安裝錯誤無關。

en.prompt: What should follow a failed pip installation?
options: Delete the tests.
Preserve the error and actual environment, then resolve installation.
Report that the Agent finished.
Change official business rules.
rationales: That does not solve installation.
Locate the failed layer first.
There is no execution evidence for that claim.
Those rules are unrelated to installation errors.

zh.summary: 把已確認規格、允許範圍、驗證命令與停止條件交給 Agent，讓每次修改可審查、可驗收。
objectives: 撰寫只涵蓋一個切片的 Agent 任務。
明確指定可改檔案、可用工具及歧義處理。
用實際 Diff 與命令結果判斷完成狀態。

readingGuide.goal: 撰寫只涵蓋一個切片的 Agent 任務。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的 starter 專案、已確認 problem.md／spec.md／architecture.md，以及教師事先測試可用的 Agent。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份可重用任務與對應審查紀錄，能指出至少一項需要人類決定的歧義。

sections.heading: 把「幫我做網站」縮成一次可驗收任務
paragraphs: M03–M06 已留下 problem.md、spec.md 與 architecture.md。交給 Agent 前先確認這些檔案反映你接受的規則；未確認的領域要求要有負責人，不能讓模型從案例名稱推定正式 SOP。
本次先做表單，後兩次才處理規則及匯出。將完整規格提供作為上下文，再明確指出本次實作哪些情境與不做事項，避免 Agent 一次擴張成多人平台。

sections.heading: 像交付一張有尺寸與驗收方法的施工單
paragraphs: 施工單要交代做哪一區、可動哪些設備、如何量測及何時停下來。只說「做漂亮一點」會讓工班自行補充假設；只給一張成品圖，也無法交代內部的驗收規則。
Agent 任務同樣需要目標、輸入、邊界與證據。這是協作契約；真正的檔案及命令限制還要由工具與執行環境落實，文字要求本身不會撤銷工具權限。

sections.heading: 一個任務包含哪些資訊
paragraphs: 先說可觀察結果，再列出來源、允許範圍、驗收與停止條件。對尚未獲得的權限或缺少的資料，要求回報並等待負責人判斷；不要要求 Agent 自行搜尋真實業務資料補洞。
starter/AGENTS.md 是包內的協作約束，可在選定工具支援的指令入口使用；各工具讀取方式由教師課前確認，不能假定所有產品都自動採用同一檔名。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜可核對的委派閉環
blocks.description: 確認本次工作後才執行，審查與驗收回到人類負責人。

items.title: 規格與範圍
items.body: 指出已確認需求、允許路徑與不做事項。

items.title: Agent 執行
items.body: 使用允許工具，保留實際操作紀錄。

items.title: 證據審查
items.body: 查看 Diff、命令及可觀察結果。

items.title: 人類判斷
items.body: 接受本次切片或要求小範圍修正。

sections.heading: 第一個任務範例
paragraphs: 以下範例用於你自己的 starter 專案，不直接改教師快照。若規格路徑或允許目錄不同，先改成實際值；沒有提供的來源不能聲稱已讀。
此任務限制本機合成資料表單；測試工具若未安裝或沒有執行權限，要回報待驗。這不是要求自動批准後續部署或付費服務。

blocks.heading: 表單切片任務
paragraphs: 將此任務貼入已確認可用的 Agent，保留原任務與回報。
blocks.code:
先讀本專案 problem.md、spec.md、architecture.md 與 AGENTS.md。
本次只做切片一：三個具標籤欄位及查看未檢核輸入的動作。
允許修改：本專案 app.py 與 tests/；不要修改教師 reference/。
不做：完整性判定、報告下載、登入、資料庫、外部 API。
驗收：三個欄位可輸入；查看輸入明示未檢核；不顯示完整成功。
遇到必要欄位或正式規則歧義，列出問題並停止相關修改。
回報：修改檔案、Diff 重點、實際執行命令與結果、待驗事項。

sections.heading: 把需求歧義與程式錯誤分開
paragraphs: 若 Agent 問「文件類型要固定選項嗎」，先查 spec。規格目前只要求文字欄位，不能自行加入單位正式文件清單；真的需要新增選項時，先由領域負責人確認並更新規格。
若欄位名稱寫錯且規格已明確，則可直接要求修正。對已授權、可回復的實作細節，Agent 可在既定範圍內繼續；需要停的是未決且會改變要求或權限的部分。

sections.heading: 把完成回報拆成可以驗證的主張
paragraphs: 「我已經完成並測試」需要對應到檔案與命令結果。未實際跑過的測試應列為未執行，測試失敗不能靠修改回報文字變成通過。
下一篇會真正建立表單。你可以使用不同品牌 Agent，但要保留選定工具、版本、權限與操作證據；本篇範例任務不代表任何指定產品已完成全程驗收。

exercise.environment: 自己的 starter 專案、已確認 problem.md／spec.md／architecture.md，以及教師事先測試可用的 Agent。
steps: 寫出表單切片的範圍、允許檔案、驗收與停止條件。
交給 Agent，查看它是否先讀來源並只修改允許路徑。
核對回報與 Diff；命令未執行時保留待驗，不進入下一切片。
exercise.expected: 一份可重用任務與對應審查紀錄，能指出至少一項需要人類決定的歧義。
exercise.check: 文字範圍與實際工具權限都需確認；不把規劃、執行與驗收混為一談。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Give the Agent confirmed specifications, allowed scope, verification commands and stop conditions so each change can be reviewed and accepted.
objectives: Write an Agent task covering one slice only.
Specify editable files, available tools and handling of ambiguity.
Judge completion from actual diffs and command results.

readingGuide.goal: Write an Agent task covering one slice only.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your starter project, confirmed problem.md/spec.md/architecture.md, and an Agent tested by the teacher before class.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A reusable task and review record identifying at least one ambiguity requiring a human decision.

sections.heading: Turn “Build a Website” into One Acceptable Task
paragraphs: M03–M06 produced problem.md, spec.md and architecture.md. Before delegating, confirm that they reflect accepted rules. Assign unresolved domain requirements to an owner; do not let a case name prompt the model to invent an official SOP.

This task builds the form; rules and export follow in later slices. Supply the full specification as context, then identify this task’s scenarios and exclusions so the Agent does not expand it into a multiuser platform.

sections.heading: A Work Order with Dimensions and Inspection Methods
paragraphs: A work order identifies the area, equipment that may change, measurements and stopping points. “Make it look better” leaves assumptions to the crew; a finished-product picture alone does not define internal acceptance rules.

Agent tasks likewise need goals, inputs, boundaries and evidence. The task is a collaboration agreement; tools and execution environments must enforce actual file/command restrictions. Written requests alone do not revoke tool permissions.

sections.heading: What Information Belongs in a Task?
paragraphs: State the observable result, then sources, allowed scope, acceptance and stop conditions. Missing permission or data should be reported for the responsible person to decide. Do not ask the Agent to fill gaps by searching for real business data.

starter/AGENTS.md contains workshop collaboration constraints. Use it through an instruction entry point supported by the selected tool; teachers must verify that mechanism before class. Do not assume every product automatically reads the same filename.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | A Verifiable Delegation Loop
blocks.description: Confirm the work before execution; review and acceptance return to the human owner.

items.title: Specification and scope
items.body: Identify confirmed requirements, allowed paths and exclusions.

items.title: Agent execution
items.body: Use permitted tools and retain actual operation records.

items.title: Evidence review
items.body: Inspect diffs, commands and observable outcomes.

items.title: Human decision
items.body: Accept this slice or request a bounded correction.

sections.heading: The First Task Example
paragraphs: Use this example in your own starter project, preserving teacher snapshots. Replace specification paths and allowed directories with actual values. Do not claim to have read sources that were never supplied.
The task is a local synthetic-data form. Report verification as pending when tools are unavailable or execution is not permitted. This task does not authorize subsequent deployment or paid services.

blocks.heading: Form-slice Task
paragraphs: The unchanged Traditional Chinese task says: read problem.md, spec.md, architecture.md and AGENTS.md; implement only three labeled fields and an explicitly unvalidated input preview; edit this project’s app.py and tests/ only; preserve reference/. Exclude completeness decisions, downloads, login, databases and external APIs. Accept three editable fields with an unvalidated preview and no complete-success claim. Stop affected changes for unresolved required fields or official rules. Report changed files, diff highlights, actual commands/results and pending checks. Submit it to the confirmed Agent and retain the task and response.
blocks.code:
先讀本專案 problem.md、spec.md、architecture.md 與 AGENTS.md。
本次只做切片一：三個具標籤欄位及查看未檢核輸入的動作。
允許修改：本專案 app.py 與 tests/；不要修改教師 reference/。
不做：完整性判定、報告下載、登入、資料庫、外部 API。
驗收：三個欄位可輸入；查看輸入明示未檢核；不顯示完整成功。
遇到必要欄位或正式規則歧義，列出問題並停止相關修改。
回報：修改檔案、Diff 重點、實際執行命令與結果、待驗事項。

sections.heading: Separate Requirement Ambiguity from Code Errors
paragraphs: If the Agent asks whether document types must be fixed choices, check spec first. It currently specifies a text field; do not add an official organizational document list. If choices are genuinely needed, a domain owner must confirm them and update the specification.

A misspelled field with an explicit specification can be corrected directly. The Agent may continue reversible implementation details within existing authorization. Stop the unresolved part when it would change requirements or permissions.

sections.heading: Break Completion Reports into Verifiable Claims
paragraphs: “Implemented and tested” needs matching files and command results. Mark unexecuted tests as unexecuted; rewriting a report cannot turn a test failure into a pass.

The next lesson builds the form. Different Agent brands may be used, with the selected tool, version, permissions and operations retained as evidence. This example task does not establish end-to-end acceptance of any named product.

exercise.environment: Your starter project, confirmed problem.md/spec.md/architecture.md, and an Agent tested by the teacher before class.
steps: Write the form slice’s scope, allowed files, acceptance criteria and stop conditions.
Give it to the Agent; inspect whether it reads sources and edits only allowed paths.
Compare its report with the diff. Keep unexecuted commands pending and do not advance to the next slice.
exercise.expected: A reusable task and review record identifying at least one ambiguity requiring a human decision.
exercise.check: Confirm both written scope and actual tool permissions. Separate planning, execution and acceptance.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.prompt: Agent 想新增登入與資料庫，但本次只做表單，應如何處理？
options: 一併加入以免落後
先維持已確認範圍，另記需求與決策
刪掉 spec
讓 Agent 自訂正式權限
rationales: 擴張了未確認範圍。
新增要求應另行確認。
失去共同驗收依據。
權限決策需明確負責人。

en.prompt: The Agent proposes login and a database during a form-only task. What should you do?
options: Add them now to keep up.
Keep confirmed scope and record new requirements and decisions separately.
Delete spec.
Let the Agent invent official permissions.
rationales: That expands unconfirmed scope.
New requirements need their own confirmation.
That removes the shared acceptance basis.
Permission decisions need an explicit owner.

zh.prompt: AGENTS.md 的限制文字能否獨自提供檔案隔離？
options: 可以，自動改作業系統權限
可以，檔名足以保證
不能，還需工具與執行環境限制
不能，所以不需寫任務
rationales: 文字不等同系統權限。
不同工具也未必自動讀取。
契約與執行控制需要配合。
明確任務仍幫助協作。

en.prompt: Can AGENTS.md text alone provide file isolation?
options: Yes; it changes operating-system permissions automatically.
Yes; the filename guarantees it.
No; tool and execution-environment restrictions are also needed.
No; therefore tasks need no written scope.
rationales: Text does not change system permissions.
Tools may not even read it automatically.
The agreement and enforcement controls must work together.
Clear tasks still support collaboration.

zh.prompt: 哪份回報最容易核對？
options: 全部完成
應該沒問題
檔案清單、Diff、實際命令與結果及待驗事項
只貼成品截圖
rationales: 缺乏依據。
是推測。
可逐項對照執行證據。
無法涵蓋規則及工具行為。

en.prompt: Which report is easiest to verify?
options: Everything is complete.
It should be fine.
File list, diff, actual commands/results and pending checks.
Only a screenshot of the product.
rationales: It lacks evidence.
It is a guess.
Each claim can be compared with execution evidence.
A screenshot cannot cover rules and tool behavior.

zh.summary: 完成從輸入欄位到未檢核預覽的最小任務，先驗證操作與狀態，再增加業務規則。
objectives: 建立三個具標籤欄位與單一主要動作。
說明垂直切片如何連起畫面、程式與觀察結果。
避免在規則尚未實作時顯示完整或成功。

readingGuide.goal: 建立三個具標籤欄位與單一主要動作。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 已啟用環境的工作坊；自己的 starter 專案與 slices/01-form/ 分開。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 可執行表單及一次從輸入到預覽的驗收紀錄，清楚標示規則尚未實作。

sections.heading: 讓一個小任務可以從頭走到尾
paragraphs: 垂直切片是把一項使用者任務穿過需要的程式層次，得到可觀察結果。本次是「填入三欄後查看自己輸入了什麼」；不先做所有畫面，也不先把所有底層函式寫完才讓人操作。
工作坊 slices/01-form/ 提供這一階段的教師快照。學員先在自己的 starter 專案依規格實作，再用快照比較；保留原作品，才能知道自己卡在哪一個行為。

sections.heading: 像先開通一條可試走的短路線
paragraphs: 短路線有入口、路標與可到達的終點，讓人試走並回報問題。它還沒通往所有目的地，告示就要清楚說明範圍。
表單切片的終點是未檢核輸入預覽。若按鈕已叫「產生完整報告」，使用者會把尚不存在的判定當成真的，後續補規則也無法消除當下誤導。

sections.heading: 欄位名稱、識別鍵與畫面回饋
paragraphs: 申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型是人看的標籤；application_id、applicant_code、document_type 是程式用的穩定鍵。標籤要能指出用途，不依賴會在輸入後消失的提示文字。
快照用 st.text_input 接收文字，按主要動作後 st.json 顯示當次字典。畫面標示「必填」只是告知要求；第一階段還沒有執行必填判定，不能宣稱通過。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜第一切片的最短操作
blocks.description: 依畫面順序前進；本次預覽不具完整性判定。

items.title: 填寫三欄
items.body: 以合成值測試，可保留一欄空白。

items.title: 查看本次輸入
items.body: 按鈕明示未檢核。

items.title: 核對內容
items.body: 看見當次值與空白，沒有完整報告下載。

sections.heading: 在獨立目錄執行教師快照
paragraphs: 先完成 M07-01 的環境準備，回到解壓根目錄，再執行以下命令。pytest 與 Streamlit 各自有結果；服務啟動後需要在瀏覽器完成任務，不能只看命令沒報錯。
輸入 SYN-001 與 DEMO-A，文件類型留空，啟動「查看本次輸入（未檢核）」。應看見未檢核提示與空白欄位，不出現完整成功或報告下載。

blocks.heading: 執行切片一
paragraphs: 下列命令僅啟動教師快照；自己的專案在另外的目錄。
blocks.code:
cd slices/01-form
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: 檢查鍵盤與過期預覽
paragraphs: 用 Tab 移動到三欄及主要按鈕，確認焦點可見且順序合理，以 Enter 或 Space 啟動按鈕。視覺上看見欄位不代表鍵盤一定能完成操作。
變更申請編號並讓輸入提交重跑，先前預覽應消失；重新按按鈕才顯示新值。這一階段沒有保存通過狀態，快照的測試也確認沒有下載按鈕。

sections.heading: 把這次改動留成下一次的起點
paragraphs: 「一次產生完整網站比較快」會讓初學者難以分清哪個變更造成失敗。先審查表單切片的 Diff，保留命令、操作與尚未實作範圍，再開始規則切片。
若 Agent 提早加入完整標記或下載，回到本次 spec 移除這些行為；不要把多做功能自動列為通過。圖、程式與畫面都應反映同一階段。

exercise.environment: 已啟用環境的工作坊；自己的 starter 專案與 slices/01-form/ 分開。
steps: 在自己的專案完成三欄及查看未檢核輸入的動作。
留一欄空白，用鍵盤查看輸入，確認提示與沒有完整下載。
修改一欄並重跑，核對舊預覽消失；與教師快照比較並記錄 Diff。
exercise.expected: 可執行表單及一次從輸入到預覽的驗收紀錄，清楚標示規則尚未實作。
exercise.check: 能區分欄位標示與實際驗證，不將空白資料標為完整。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Complete a minimal path from fields to an unvalidated preview, checking interaction and state before adding business rules.
objectives: Create three labeled fields and one primary action.
Explain how a vertical slice connects interface, code and observable results.
Avoid complete/success claims before rules exist.

readingGuide.goal: Create three labeled fields and one primary action.
readingGuide.startingPoint: The workshop with its environment activated; keep your starter project separate from slices/01-form/.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A runnable form and an input-to-preview acceptance record clearly identifying absent rules.

sections.heading: Make One Small Task Work from End to End
paragraphs: A vertical slice takes one user task through the necessary program layers to an observable outcome. Here the task is entering three fields and viewing those values. You need neither every screen first nor every low-level function before anyone can interact.

slices/01-form/ is the teacher snapshot for this stage. Implement the agreed behavior in your own starter project first, then compare the snapshot. Keep your work so you can identify the behavior that caused difficulty.

sections.heading: Open a Short Route People Can Try
paragraphs: A short route has an entrance, signs and a reachable destination so people can try it and report problems. Since it does not reach every destination, signs must explain its scope.

The form slice ends at an unvalidated input preview. Naming the button “Generate complete report” would imply a decision that does not yet exist; adding rules later cannot undo misleading feedback already given.

sections.heading: Field Labels, Stable Keys and Feedback
paragraphs: Application ID, applicant code and document type are human-readable labels. application_id, applicant_code and document_type are stable program keys. Labels should explain purpose without relying on placeholder text that disappears after entry.

The snapshot collects text with st.text_input, then presents the current dictionary with st.json after the primary action. “Required” labels communicate a requirement; the first stage does not enforce required-field validation and must not claim it passed.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | The Shortest Interaction in Slice One
blocks.description: Follow interface order. This preview makes no completeness decision.

items.title: Fill three fields
items.body: Use synthetic values; one field may remain blank.

items.title: View current input
items.body: The action explicitly says the values are unvalidated.

items.title: Check the content
items.body: See current values and blanks, without a complete-report download.

sections.heading: Run the Teacher Snapshot in Its Own Directory
paragraphs: Finish M07-01 environment preparation, return to the extracted root, then run these commands. pytest and Streamlit have separate results. After startup, perform the browser task; a command returning no error is insufficient.

Enter SYN-001 and DEMO-A, leaving document type blank. Activate “查看本次輸入（未檢核）” (view current input, unvalidated). Expect the unvalidated notice and blank field, with neither a complete-success message nor report download.

blocks.heading: Run Slice One
paragraphs: These commands start the teacher snapshot only. Keep your own project in another directory.
blocks.code:
cd slices/01-form
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: Check the Keyboard and Stale Previews
paragraphs: Use Tab to reach all three fields and the primary button. Check visible focus and meaningful order, then activate the button with Enter or Space. Visible fields alone do not establish that the task works by keyboard.

Change the application ID and commit the input change to trigger a rerun. The previous preview should disappear; press the button again to see the new value. This stage stores no passed status, and its tests also assert that no download button exists.

sections.heading: Keep This Change as the Next Starting Point
paragraphs: Generating the whole website at once makes it harder for beginners to identify which change caused a failure. Review the form-slice diff and retain commands, operations and unimplemented scope before starting validation.

If the Agent adds a complete marker or download early, remove those behaviors against this task’s spec. Extra features do not automatically pass acceptance. Diagram, code and interface should describe the same stage.

exercise.environment: The workshop with its environment activated; keep your starter project separate from slices/01-form/.
steps: Implement three fields and the action to view unvalidated input in your project.
Leave one field blank and use the keyboard to view input; verify the notice and absence of a complete download.
Change a field and rerun; verify the old preview disappears, then compare with the snapshot and record the diff.
exercise.expected: A runnable form and an input-to-preview acceptance record clearly identifying absent rules.
exercise.check: Distinguish a required label from executed validation. Do not mark blank data complete.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.summary: 把完整性規則抽離畫面，直接用資料測試空白、型別、缺鍵與長度，再讓介面呈現可修正的結果。
objectives: 撰寫不依賴 Streamlit 的 validate 函式。
用正常與負向資料驗證三個必要欄位。
讓錯誤提示保留輸入並支持修正。

readingGuide.goal: 撰寫不依賴 Streamlit 的 validate 函式。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的表單切片、已確認 spec.md 與工作坊 slices/02-validation/。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: rules.py、對應測試與操作紀錄可證明第二切片符合三欄規則。

sections.heading: 畫面限制之外，規則也要站得住
paragraphs: M05 已規定三欄去除首尾空白後須非空，且不超過 80 字元；這些是合成教學規則。畫面 max_chars 限制輸入長度，但其他程式仍可能直接呼叫函式，規則要在函式層保護自己的契約。
slices/02-validation/rules.py 只負責資料判定，不呼叫 Streamlit。這讓測試可以直接傳入 None、數字、超長字串或缺少鍵，而不必先開瀏覽器製造每種輸入。

sections.heading: 像收件臺與檢查清單分工
paragraphs: 收件臺幫人填寫、指出缺漏，檢查清單則定義哪些條件必須符合。換一個櫃臺不該讓清單規則消失；畫面變漂亮也不會使缺件自動變完整。
程式用 validate(record) 接收資料，回傳錯誤訊息列表。空列表表示本次三欄通過，並不涵蓋真實文件內容、身分或正式業務資格。

sections.heading: 先寫可觀察的正反案例
paragraphs: 正常資料可用 SYN-001、DEMO-A、合成申請表。負向案例依每一個必要鍵測空字串、純空白、None、數字、81 字元及缺鍵；另測 80 字元可通過與首尾空白處理。
將案例寫成測試，先觀察未實作時的失敗，再做最小實作。失敗應源自預期的規則差距，語法錯誤或套件未安裝還不能證明驗收測試有抓到需求。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜讓測試跨過畫面限制

無錯誤

sections.heading: 從函式結果回到可修正的畫面
paragraphs: 按「檢查資料」才取得本次 validate 的結果。有錯誤時列出缺少什麼及重新檢查方式，原本已填值保留；無錯誤時說明三欄通過，但尚未提供報告與匯出。
第二階段成功訊息只在這次按鈕觸發的重跑出現。下一次輸入變更提交後，畫面重跑並清除先前結果；重新按檢查才產生當次結果。

blocks.description: 同一規則函式可由介面及測試呼叫，以下呈現使用者操作循環。

items.body: 保留三欄目前值。

items.title: 呼叫 validate
items.body: 檢查必要、型別、空白與長度。

items.title: 呈現結果
items.body: 有錯則提示並保留輸入；否則說明本次通過。

items.title: 修正後重查

sections.heading: 執行第二切片與針對性測試
paragraphs: 先停止先前服務、回解壓根目錄，再進入此階段。各階段分開執行 pytest，避免同名 rules 模組在同一次測試程序互相混用。
直接閱讀 tests/test_rules.py 的每組輸入與斷言，再閱讀 tests/test_app.py 的缺漏、補正及結果消失情境。測試數量不能取代檢查它到底驗證什麼。

blocks.heading: 執行第二切片
paragraphs: 整組測試通過後啟動介面，重演缺漏與補正。
blocks.code:
cd slices/02-validation
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: 規則與驗收都需要留下依據
paragraphs: 常見誤解是「有星號、有字數限制就不需函式驗證」。將規則限制在 UI 會讓直接函式呼叫繞過要求，也難以確認負向情境。
另一個誤解是「通過就能匯出」。本階段還沒實作報告契約與匯出邊界，成功訊息需清楚說明範圍。下一篇才把當次通過資料接到預覽與下載。

exercise.environment: 自己的表單切片、已確認 spec.md 與工作坊 slices/02-validation/。
steps: 先列出正常、空白、缺鍵、型別與長度案例，觀察未實作時的失敗原因。
實作獨立 validate 函式並接回畫面，執行規則與介面測試。
在瀏覽器重演缺漏、補正與變更，記錄保留輸入及沒有下載。
exercise.expected: rules.py、對應測試與操作紀錄可證明第二切片符合三欄規則。
exercise.check: 直接呼叫函式也拒絕負向資料，畫面不把當次通過誤作正式受理。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Separate completeness rules from the interface, test blanks, types, missing keys and lengths directly, then present results that support correction.
objectives: Write validate without depending on Streamlit.
Verify three required fields with normal and negative data.
Preserve input while showing errors that support correction.

readingGuide.goal: Write validate without depending on Streamlit.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your form slice, confirmed spec.md and workshop slices/02-validation/.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: rules.py, matching tests and operation records demonstrating slice two’s three-field rules.

sections.heading: Rules Must Hold Beyond Interface Limits
paragraphs: M05 specifies three nonempty text fields after trimming leading/trailing whitespace, each at most 80 characters. These are synthetic teaching rules. max_chars limits interface entry, but other code may call functions directly; the function must protect its contract.

slices/02-validation/rules.py evaluates data without calling Streamlit. Tests can therefore pass None, numbers, overlong strings or missing keys directly without manufacturing every input in a browser.

sections.heading: Separate the Intake Counter from Its Checklist
paragraphs: The counter helps people enter data and correct omissions; the checklist defines required conditions. Changing counters should not remove rules, and a better-looking screen does not make missing material complete.
validate(record) returns a list of errors. An empty list means this record passed the three-field rules, without establishing document truth, identity or official eligibility.

sections.heading: Define Observable Positive and Negative Cases
paragraphs: Use SYN-001, DEMO-A and a synthetic application-form label for a valid record. For each required key, test an empty string, whitespace only, None, a number, 81 characters and absence of the key. Also test acceptance at 80 characters and trimming.

Write tests, observe the unimplemented behavior failing, then make the smallest implementation. Failure should expose the expected rule gap. A syntax error or missing package does not establish that the acceptance test detects the requirement.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Test Beyond Interface Restrictions
rows: Valid text in all three fields
No errors.
Rule function
Whitespace-only document type
Identify missing document type.
Rules + interface
Missing application_id key
Identify missing application ID.
Rule function
80/81 characters
Accept 80, reject 81.
Rule function
Fill the missing field and check again
Preserve existing values and show the current pass.
Interface

sections.heading: Turn Function Results into Correctable Feedback
paragraphs: Pressing “檢查資料” (check data) obtains the current validate result. Errors identify what is missing and how to recheck while preserving filled values. With no errors, state that the three fields passed, while report preview/export remain absent.

The stage-two success message appears only in the rerun triggered by that check. Committing the next input change reruns the page and removes the prior result; another check generates the current result.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Responsibilities of Rules and Interface
blocks.description: The interface and tests can call the same rule function. This figure shows the user’s correction cycle.

items.title: Read input
items.body: Keep the three current field values.

items.title: Call validate
items.body: Check required values, types, blanks and length.

items.title: Present results
items.body: On errors, explain and retain input; otherwise state this check passed.

items.title: Correct and recheck
items.body: Do not reuse a prior result after changing data.

sections.heading: Run Slice Two and Inspect Focused Tests
paragraphs: Stop the previous service, return to the extracted root, then enter this stage. Run pytest separately per stage to prevent same-named rules modules from being mixed within one test process.

Read each input and assertion in tests/test_rules.py, then the missing-field, correction and disappearing-result scenarios in tests/test_app.py. A test count cannot replace examining what behavior it covers.

blocks.heading: Run Slice Two
paragraphs: After the full test group passes, start the interface and repeat omission and correction.
blocks.code:
cd slices/02-validation
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: Keep Evidence for Both Rules and Acceptance
paragraphs: A required marker or character limit does not replace function validation. UI-only rules can be bypassed by direct function calls and make negative behavior harder to verify.

A passed check does not yet permit export in this stage. Report contracts and export boundaries are unimplemented, so success feedback must state its scope. The next lesson connects currently passed data to preview and download.

exercise.environment: Your form slice, confirmed spec.md and workshop slices/02-validation/.
steps: List normal, blank, missing-key, type and length cases; observe why they fail before implementation.
Implement an independent validate function, connect the interface, and run rule/interface tests.
Repeat omission, correction and input change in a browser; record retained input and the absent download.
exercise.expected: rules.py, matching tests and operation records demonstrating slice two’s three-field rules.
exercise.check: Direct function calls reject negative data too, and the screen does not present a current pass as official acceptance.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

因為畫面永遠不會錯
只為增加測試數
rationales: 仍需不同層次驗證。
保護函式邊界且便於測試。
介面也需檢查。
應由需求決定案例。

en.prompt: Why test rules.py directly?
options: To replace every user test.
To enforce rules on invalid data arriving outside the interface path.
Because the interface is never wrong.
Only to increase the test count.
rationales: Verification still needs different layers.
This protects the function boundary and supports testing.
The interface also needs checks.
Requirements should determine cases.

zh.prompt: 文件類型是純空白時應得到什麼？
options: 完整
直接匯出
缺少文件類型，保留其他已填值
自動猜測正式文件
rationales: 不符合非空規則。
尚無合格報告。
支持修正且遵守規格。
不應推定業務內容。

en.prompt: What should whitespace-only document type produce?
options: Complete.
Immediate export.
A missing-document-type error, preserving other filled values.
A guessed official document.
rationales: It violates the nonempty rule.
There is no valid report yet.
This supports correction and follows the specification.
Do not infer business content.

zh.prompt: 第二切片成功後修改輸入，應如何處理？
options: 沿用舊成功
再次輸入不影響結果
先下載舊資料
使舊結果消失，重新檢查
rationales: 結果不再代表目前輸入。
值已經改變。
本階段尚無下載。
符合當次結果的生命週期。

en.prompt: After slice two succeeds, the user changes input. What should happen?
options: Keep the old success.
Further input cannot affect the result.
Download the old data first.
Remove the old result and require a fresh check.
rationales: It no longer describes current input.
The value has changed.
This stage has no download.
This follows the lifecycle of a current result.

zh.summary: 讓完整結果屬於確切的一份輸入；變更後重新檢查，匯出端再次驗證並只輸出允許欄位。
objectives: 用已檢查快照約束預覽與下載。
在輸入變更時使舊結果失效。
驗證匯出資料結構與負向輸入。

readingGuide.goal: 用已檢查快照約束預覽與下載。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 工作坊 reference/、瀏覽器、pytest 與自己的第二切片。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: app.py、rules.py、測試與下載驗收可追溯到同一份目前輸入。

sections.heading: 成功結果也有適用的資料範圍
paragraphs: 三欄完整後，使用者可能立即清空文件類型。如果程式只記住 complete=True，舊成功狀態就可能繼續顯示，讓目前缺件資料取得完整報告。
reference/ 是第三切片的教師解答。它保存通過時的資料副本，只有副本與目前輸入相同且規則仍通過時，才呈現完整預覽及下載。

sections.heading: 像簽名要對應那一版文件
paragraphs: 簽名確認的是當時那份內容；文件修改後，原簽名不能自動替新內容背書。檢查結果也應連到實際受檢的資料，而非只留下沒有對象的綠燈。
本機教學快照是字典副本與相等比較，不是密碼學簽章、正式稽核軌跡或多人一致性機制。需求若擴及資料庫與多人操作，要重新設計版本與授權。

sections.heading: 狀態保存、失效與重新檢查
paragraphs: Streamlit 的 Session State 可在同一使用者工作階段的重跑之間保存值。參考程式按檢查且無錯誤時保存 record.copy()；輸入提交變更時，on_change 回呼清掉 checked。
顯示端仍比較 checked 與 record 並再次檢查規則。這裡的快照與相等比較處理本課三個文字欄位，不推廣成所有物件或多人並行資料的通用解法。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜結果必須跟著資料版本
blocks.description: 流程含重新檢查條件；輸入變更後回到未檢查狀態。

items.title: 未檢查
items.body: 填寫或修改資料，只顯示操作指引。

items.title: 按檢查
items.body: 失敗列缺漏；通過保存目前值副本。

items.title: 預覽與匯出
items.body: 目前值等於快照且規則通過才可顯示。

items.title: 輸入變更
items.body: 清除快照與下載入口，回到重新檢查。

sections.heading: 匯出邊界不信任舊畫面旗標
paragraphs: rules.py 的 export_report 呼叫 report，report 先 validate；不合法就拋出 ValueError，無法僅憑畫面曾顯示成功就產生報告。匯出只取 FIELDS 允許的三鍵，避免把除錯或未約定欄位一起寫入下載。
下載 JSON 包含 status、scope、data；complete 僅代表教學三欄完整，scope 明寫不代表正式受理。三欄值先去除首尾空白，報告以 UTF-8 中文內容匯出；下載檔存在操作者裝置。

blocks.heading: 受控匯出範例
paragraphs: 結構是本課設計，並非正式單位格式。

sections.heading: 以完整、清空、再補正驗收
paragraphs: 從解壓根目錄進 reference，先跑測試，再啟動 app.py。先輸入三個有效合成值、按檢查，核對預覽並下載；接著清空文件類型、讓變更提交，確認舊完整結果與下載消失。
重新補齊後仍需按檢查。AppTest 檢查狀態與元素，真實瀏覽器另外核對下載位元組、中文及檔名；只看按鈕出現不能證明檔案內容正確。

blocks.heading: 執行第三切片
paragraphs: 和前兩階段分開執行，不覆蓋學員專案。
blocks.code:
cd reference
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: 完整狀態不能擴張成正式保證
paragraphs: 「前端禁用按鈕就夠了」漏掉直接匯出呼叫；「清掉 checked 就代表所有下載已刪除」則混淆工作階段狀態與裝置檔案。使用者已下載的資料仍需自行管理。
本課沒有登入、多人授權、持久儲存或安全刪除機制。將這些限制寫入驗收與交接，讓接手者知道本機原型目前能證明什麼。

exercise.environment: 工作坊 reference/、瀏覽器、pytest 與自己的第二切片。
steps: 新增快照、輸入變更失效、受控報告與匯出重新驗證。
測試完整後清空欄位，以及直接對不合法資料呼叫匯出；確認不能產生完整報告。
在真實瀏覽器下載 JSON，核對允許欄位、中文及範圍說明，記錄實際結果。
exercise.expected: app.py、rules.py、測試與下載驗收可追溯到同一份目前輸入。
exercise.check: 舊成功不能授權新資料匯出；額外鍵不進報告；已下載檔另行管理。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Bind a complete result to exact input, require rechecking after edits, and revalidate at export while emitting only allowed fields.
objectives: Constrain preview and download with a checked snapshot.
Invalidate the old result when input changes.
Verify the export structure and negative inputs.

readingGuide.goal: Constrain preview and download with a checked snapshot.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Workshop reference/, a browser, pytest and your second slice.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: app.py, rules.py, tests and download acceptance traceable to the same current input.

sections.heading: A Successful Result Applies to Particular Data
paragraphs: After all three fields pass, a user may immediately clear document type. If the program stores only complete=True, an old success may remain and let currently incomplete data obtain a complete report.
reference/ is the teacher solution for slice three. It keeps a copy of the passed data and presents complete preview/download only when the copy equals current input and the rules still pass.

sections.heading: A Signature Refers to That Version of a Document
paragraphs: A signature confirms particular content at a point in time. Editing the document does not make the old signature endorse the new content. A check result likewise needs an identifiable input rather than an unattached green light.

The teaching snapshot is a dictionary copy and equality comparison. It is not a cryptographic signature, formal audit trail or multiuser consistency mechanism. Database or concurrent-user needs require redesigned versioning and authorization.

sections.heading: Retain, Invalidate and Recheck State
paragraphs: Streamlit Session State retains values between reruns within a user session. After a check with no errors, the reference stores record.copy(); committing an input change invokes an on_change callback that clears checked.

The display condition also compares checked with record and checks the rules again. This snapshot/equality mechanism addresses three text fields; it is not a universal solution for arbitrary objects or concurrent multiuser data.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Results Must Follow the Data Version
blocks.description: The flow includes a recheck condition. Input changes return the record to an unchecked state.

items.title: Unchecked
items.body: Enter or edit data; show interaction guidance only.

items.title: Press check
items.body: List omissions on failure; store a copy of current values on success.

items.title: Preview and export
items.body: Show them only when current values equal the snapshot and rules pass.

items.title: Input changes
items.body: Clear the snapshot and download entry point; require a fresh check.

sections.heading: Do Not Trust an Old Interface Flag at Export
paragraphs: In rules.py, export_report calls report, which first calls validate. Invalid data raises ValueError, so earlier interface success cannot by itself produce a report. Export selects only the three FIELDS keys, excluding debug or unagreed extra fields.

The downloaded JSON contains status, scope and data. complete means only teaching-field completeness; scope explicitly disclaims official intake acceptance. Values are trimmed, and the report exports Chinese content as UTF-8 to a file on the operator’s device.

blocks.heading: Controlled Export Example
paragraphs: This course-defined structure is not an official organizational format. The unchanged JSON uses status=complete, scope meaning “teaching-field completeness only, not official acceptance,” and data with application_id=SYN-001, applicant_code=DEMO-A and a synthetic application-form document_type.

sections.heading: Accept Complete, Clear and Correct Again
paragraphs: From the extracted root, enter reference, run tests, then start app.py. Enter three valid synthetic values, check, inspect the preview and download. Next clear document type and commit the change: the old complete result and download must disappear.

After correcting the field, check again. AppTest inspects state and elements; a real browser separately verifies download bytes, Chinese text and filename. A visible button alone does not establish correct file contents.

blocks.heading: Run Slice Three
paragraphs: Run separately from the first two stages, preserving the learner’s project.
blocks.code:
cd reference
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: Do Not Expand Completeness into an Official Guarantee
paragraphs: Disabling a frontend button alone misses direct export calls. Clearing checked does not delete every downloaded file: session state and device files have different lifecycles. The operator still manages files already downloaded.

This course implements no login, multiuser authorization, persistent storage or secure-deletion mechanism. Record these limits in acceptance and handoff so successors know exactly what the local prototype demonstrates.

exercise.environment: Workshop reference/, a browser, pytest and your second slice.
steps: Add the snapshot, input-change invalidation, controlled report and export revalidation.
Test a complete record followed by clearing a field, plus direct export of invalid data; verify no complete report can be produced.
Download JSON in a real browser, check allowlisted fields, Chinese text and scope, and record actual results.
exercise.expected: app.py, rules.py, tests and download acceptance traceable to the same current input.
exercise.check: Old success cannot justify exporting new input. Extra keys stay out of reports, and downloaded files need separate management.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.prompt: 為何只有 complete=True 不足？
options: 布林值不能存入狀態
未指出成功對應哪份輸入
JSON 不支援布林
表單不需要狀態
rationales: 可保存，問題是語意。
修改資料後無法確認對應關係。
JSON 支援布林。
需要明確狀態責任。

en.prompt: Why is complete=True alone insufficient?
options: Boolean values cannot be stored in state.
It does not identify the input that passed.
JSON cannot contain Booleans.
Forms need no state.
rationales: They can be stored; the problem is meaning.
After an edit, the relationship to input is unknown.
JSON supports Booleans.
State responsibilities need an explicit design.

zh.prompt: 匯出函式收到缺件資料應怎麼做？
options: 相信舊成功
補猜文件類型
重新驗證並拒絕產生完整報告
隱藏 scope
rationales: 舊狀態可能過期。
違反規格。
守住匯出邊界。
不能解決不合法資料。

en.prompt: What should export do with incomplete data?
options: Trust the old success.
Guess the document type.
Revalidate and refuse to produce a complete report.
Hide scope.
rationales: The old state may be stale.
That violates the specification.
This protects the export boundary.
That does not make invalid data valid.

zh.prompt: 清除 Session State 的 checked 後，可以推定什麼？
options: 所有下載已刪除
正式身分已驗證
多人權限已完成
本次工作階段不再持有該檢查快照
rationales: 裝置檔案另有生命週期。
不是身分機制。
本課未實作多人控制。
推論限於被清除的狀態。

en.prompt: What follows from clearing checked in Session State?
options: Every downloaded file is deleted.
Formal identity is verified.
Multiuser permissions are complete.
This session no longer holds that checked snapshot.
rationales: Device files have their own lifecycle.
This is not an identity mechanism.
This course has not implemented those controls.
Keep the inference limited to the state removed.

zh.summary: 從規格、Diff 與實際工具結果交叉核對 Agent 的工作，為每次接受或退回留下可追溯理由。
objectives: 分清工作區、暫存區與未追蹤檔案的審查。
核對工具命令、工作目錄、結果及未執行事項。
依規格記錄接受、修正或延後的決策。

readingGuide.goal: 分清工作區、暫存區與未追蹤檔案的審查。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的 Git 專案、三次切片規格、Agent 回報與實際工具紀錄。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: review-notes.md 能將至少一條要求連到具體 Diff 與實測結果。

sections.heading: 審查的是修改與行為
paragraphs: Agent 摘要幫助定位重點，實際 Diff 才顯示檔案如何改變。從本次 spec 的驗收情境出發，逐項查哪些修改實作它、哪些測試驗證它，以及是否加入本次未授權的服務或檔案。
不要只數新增行數。幾行改動也可能移除匯出重新驗證；大量格式變更則可能遮住一個關鍵條件，讓審查更難。

sections.heading: 像核對估價單、施工差異與試運轉
paragraphs: 估價單說明約定工作，施工紀錄指出實際改動，試運轉結果顯示能否達成要求。三者任一缺少，都無法單憑承包者的完成說明接受成果。
軟體審查也要連起要求、變更與證據。決策紀錄要寫出為何接受或退回，讓下一個人能重現判斷，而非只留下「看起來可以」。

sections.heading: 依 Git 的資料位置查看差異
paragraphs: git diff 預設看工作區相對暫存區的差異；git diff --cached 看已暫存、準備提交的差異。兩者都可能需要看，否則只檢查其中一邊會漏掉內容。
git status --short 另指出未追蹤檔案。新建 tests/ 若還未加入追蹤，不能期待普通 diff 自動列出完整內容；先打開它們檢查，再決定是否逐路徑暫存。

blocks.heading: 唯讀審查命令
paragraphs: 在自己的 Git 專案執行；尚未建立 Git 時先人工比對副本，不假裝命令已成功。
blocks.code:
git status --short
git diff --stat
git diff -- app.py rules.py tests/
git diff --cached -- app.py rules.py tests/

sections.heading: 工具紀錄需要足以定位執行
paragraphs: 記錄命令、工作目錄、退出結果及有用輸出。測試全綠仍需確認跑的是哪個階段；在 slices/01-form 跑過測試，不能作為 reference 匯出已驗證的證據。
工具可能因權限或環境被拒絕，也可能命令成功卻只跑到無關測試。把實際執行與 Agent 推論分欄；對未執行、失敗、通過及仍待驗的狀態保持原意。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜審查的三種依據
blocks.description: 三張卡片是交叉核對的材料，並非自動通過程序。

items.title: 規格
items.body: 驗收情境、範圍與不做清單。

items.title: 變更
items.body: 追蹤及未追蹤檔案、Diff 與依賴。

items.title: 證據
items.body: 實際命令、結果、操作與限制。

sections.heading: 遇到超出範圍的修改如何處理
paragraphs: 若 Agent 加入外部 API，先查本次是否授權；本課沒有這項需求。要求移除本次新增內容，同時保留其他人的既有修改，不用整個目錄還原來省略審查。
有些變更是合理的實作細節，有些則改了需求。前者在既定範圍核對後接受，後者由負責人更新規格或延後。不要讓一次 Diff 審查默默改變課程的單人合成資料邊界。

sections.heading: 留下簡短但足夠的決策紀錄
paragraphs: 每次切片保留驗收情境、修改路徑、命令與結果、差距及決定。不要把完整私人對話、憑證或真實資料複製進公開紀錄；保留能支持判斷的必要資訊即可。
下一篇會利用這些紀錄縮小錯誤範圍，並在保留其他工作的前提下修復或復原。

blocks.heading: 審查紀錄欄位
paragraphs: 放入自己的 review-notes.md，依實際結果填寫。
blocks.code:
切片與驗收情境：
修改與新增檔案：
審查的 Diff 範圍：
命令／工作目錄／退出結果：
操作結果：
發現差距與未執行事項：
接受／要求修正／延後及理由：

exercise.environment: 自己的 Git 專案、三次切片規格、Agent 回報與實際工具紀錄。
steps: 分別查看工作區、暫存區與未追蹤檔案，列出本次修改範圍。
挑一條匯出驗收情境，對照程式改動與實際測試。
寫下接受或退回的理由；對超範圍變更另列決策，不覆蓋無關工作。
exercise.expected: review-notes.md 能將至少一條要求連到具體 Diff 與實測結果。
exercise.check: 不把 Agent 摘要當執行證據；能說明兩種 diff 與未追蹤檔案的差別。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Cross-check Agent work against specifications, diffs and actual tool outcomes, retaining traceable reasons to accept or return each change.
objectives: Review working-tree, staged and untracked files separately.
Check tool commands, working directories, results and unexecuted work.
Record acceptance, correction or deferral against the specification.

readingGuide.goal: Review working-tree, staged and untracked files separately.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your Git project, specifications for the three slices, Agent reports and actual tool records.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: review-notes.md links at least one requirement to a specific diff and executed result.

sections.heading: Review Changes and Behavior
paragraphs: An Agent summary helps locate work; the actual diff shows what changed. Start with this task’s acceptance scenarios and identify implementing changes, verifying tests and any service/file outside the authorized scope.
Do not judge by added line count. A few lines can remove export revalidation, while large formatting changes can obscure one crucial condition and make review harder.

sections.heading: Compare the Work Order, Changes and Trial Run
paragraphs: A work order describes the agreement, construction records show actual changes, and a trial run shows whether requirements are met. If any is absent, a contractor’s completion report alone cannot support acceptance.
Software review also connects requirements, changes and evidence. Record why you accept or return the work so the next person can reproduce the judgment rather than relying on “looks fine.”

sections.heading: Inspect the Different Locations in Git
paragraphs: By default, git diff compares the working tree with the staging area. git diff --cached shows staged changes prepared for commit. Review both where relevant; inspecting only one can miss content.

git status --short also identifies untracked files. Ordinary diff does not automatically show the full content of newly created untracked tests/. Open those files, inspect them, then decide which paths to stage.

blocks.heading: Read-only Review Commands
paragraphs: Run in your own Git project. Before Git is initialized, compare copies manually rather than claiming these commands succeeded.
blocks.code:
git status --short
git diff --stat
git diff -- app.py rules.py tests/
git diff --cached -- app.py rules.py tests/

sections.heading: Tool Records Must Identify the Execution
paragraphs: Record command, working directory, exit outcome and useful output. Even green tests need a stage check: tests run in slices/01-form cannot demonstrate verified reference export.

Tools can be denied by permissions or environment; a successful command can also run irrelevant tests. Keep actual execution separate from Agent inference, preserving the meanings of unexecuted, failed, passed and still pending.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Sources for Review
blocks.description: These cards are cross-checking materials, not an automatic acceptance procedure.

items.title: Specification
items.body: Acceptance scenarios, scope and exclusions.

items.title: Changes
items.body: Tracked and untracked files, diffs and dependencies.

items.title: Evidence
items.body: Actual commands, results, interactions and limitations.

sections.heading: Handle Changes Beyond the Agreed Scope
paragraphs: If the Agent adds an external API, check authorization first; this course needs none. Remove only the newly introduced scope while preserving other people’s existing edits. Do not restore an entire directory to avoid reviewing it.

Some changes are reasonable implementation details; others alter requirements. Review and accept the former within existing scope. The responsible person must update the specification or defer the latter. One diff review must not silently change the course’s single-user synthetic-data boundary.

sections.heading: Keep a Short, Sufficient Decision Record
paragraphs: For each slice, retain acceptance scenarios, changed paths, commands/results, gaps and decisions. Keep only information supporting the judgment; copy no complete private conversations, credentials or real data into public records.
The next lesson uses these records to narrow faults and repair or restore changes while preserving other work.

blocks.heading: Review Record Fields
paragraphs: Fill your own review-notes.md from actual results. The unchanged Traditional Chinese template records slice/scenario, changed/new files, diff scope, command/directory/exit, observed behavior, gaps/unexecuted work and acceptance/correction/deferral with reasons.
blocks.code:
切片與驗收情境：
修改與新增檔案：

命令／工作目錄／退出結果：

exercise.environment: Your Git project, specifications for the three slices, Agent reports and actual tool records.
steps: Inspect working-tree, staged and untracked files separately and list this task’s changes.
Choose one export acceptance scenario and connect code changes to actual tests.
Record why you accept or return it; give out-of-scope changes a separate decision and preserve unrelated work.
exercise.expected: review-notes.md links at least one requirement to a specific diff and executed result.
exercise.check: Do not treat an Agent summary as execution evidence. Explain both diff views and untracked files.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.summary: 先重現、再縮小、用測試固定問題，最後小步修復；需要復原時只回復已確認的變更範圍。
objectives: 將模糊故障轉成有起點與觀察結果的重現步驟。
區分環境錯誤、測試錯誤與功能回歸。
保留其他工作並驗證修復或復原結果。

readingGuide.goal: 將模糊故障轉成有起點與觀察結果的重現步驟。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的第三切片練習副本、完整後清空欄位的介面測試，以及已保留的程式與 Diff。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: debugging-notes.md 留下舊報告問題的人工重現、失敗及修復通過證據，保留其他工作。

sections.heading: 從「下載怪怪的」寫出可重現情境
paragraphs: 先記錄使用哪份程式、工作目錄、版本、輸入及步驟。例如「三欄完整→檢查→清空文件類型→提交變更，仍出現下載」就指出了狀態轉換及不符規格的觀察。
這是要驗證的故障情境，不表示目前教師 reference 存在該錯誤。若自己的專案無法重現，保留環境與結果，別先改一大批程式碰運氣。

sections.heading: 像修理前先找到哪個開關失效
paragraphs: 房間沒亮可能是燈泡、開關或供電問題。先確認條件再測局部，才能避免把整間配線換掉卻沒有解決原因。
軟體也先分層：命令找不到套件是環境，測試找不到 app.py 是測試設定，資料變更後仍用舊結果才可能是功能狀態問題。各層要有對應證據。

sections.heading: 一次只驗證一個修復假設
paragraphs: 先讓測試抓住預期錯誤，再做最小修正，確認原失敗轉為通過，最後跑會受影響的既有情境。測試若只因語法或 import 失敗，先修正測試環境，不能當作需求已被測到。
舊報告問題可從回呼是否清狀態、顯示條件是否比對快照、匯出端是否重新驗證逐一檢查。不要同時更換框架、資料模型與頁面設計，否則難以知道哪個變更有效。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜帶證據的小步修復
blocks.description: 每一步都可回到觀察；沒有重現或測試結果時，狀態保留待確認。

items.title: 重現
items.body: 固定輸入、操作、版本與預期。

items.title: 固定失敗
items.body: 加入會抓住該行為的回歸測試。

items.title: 最小修正
items.body: 只改目前假設需要的範圍。

items.title: 驗證與審查
items.body: 跑原案例及受影響測試，核對 Diff。

sections.heading: 在自己的專案做一個受控練習
paragraphs: 先保留程式副本及現有 Diff，在自己的第三切片練習副本製造「舊報告仍可見」：暫時移除輸入的 on_change 失效回呼，將顯示條件改成只檢查 checked 是否存在，預覽與匯出也故意使用舊 checked。這是一個合成故障，完成練習後需修回，不能留在正常作品。
重新執行完整後清空欄位的 AppTest，應在「不該再有成功訊息或下載」處失敗。修回快照失效、目前值比較及匯出目前資料後，同一測試應通過，再跑 reference 的整組規則與介面測試。若人工錯誤仍通過，先補足斷言，不以綠燈當作正確保證。

blocks.heading: 定位原有介面測試
paragraphs: 在自己的第三切片練習副本執行；不要修改公開教師解答。
blocks.code:
python -m pytest -q tests/test_app.py
python -m pytest -q

sections.heading: 復原前先辨識要保留什麼
paragraphs: 復原不是丟掉整個工作目錄。先保留尚未提交的修改、新檔與測試結果，再確認已知良好版本及欲回復路徑；若一個檔案混有其他工作，應分段修回或從副本取回本次部分。
Git restore 可從指定來源回復工作區或暫存區，可能覆蓋內容；預設來源也隨選項不同。操作前要說明來源、目的位置及路徑。本課不提供對整個專案一鍵強制重設的捷徑。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜三種不同的復原決策
rows: 本次一小段邏輯錯誤
局部修回並保留其他段落
原失敗測試與 Diff
新功能尚未完成
保留分支或副本，恢復已知可用行為
啟動及核心情境
依賴安裝失敗
先確認環境與版本
安裝及版本輸出；功能仍待驗

sections.heading: 修好後保留為什麼與沒涵蓋什麼
paragraphs: 記錄故障條件、原失敗、修正理由、通過結果與未驗範圍。修復一個本機表單問題不會同時完成多人授權或正式部署；把需要後續處理的事項留給下一個明確任務。
M08 會擴展規則、介面、易用性與安全驗證，M09 再整理版本與交接。M07 的收束是三次可操作切片，加上能核對的修改與驗收紀錄。

exercise.environment: 自己的第三切片練習副本、完整後清空欄位的介面測試，以及已保留的程式與 Diff。
steps: 記錄原測試結果，在副本暫停 on_change 失效，顯示只看 checked 存在，並故意使用 checked 產生預覽與匯出。
在瀏覽器重演完整、檢查、清空欄位、提交變更；執行介面測試，確認它抓到舊成功或下載仍存在。
修回失效回呼、快照與目前值比較，以及匯出目前資料；重跑同一測試及全套，留下根因與 Diff。
exercise.expected: debugging-notes.md 留下舊報告問題的人工重現、失敗及修復通過證據，保留其他工作。
exercise.check: 故障只在練習副本；失敗確實是輸入變更後舊結果仍存在，不是 import 或環境錯誤。
exercise.cleanup: 修回人工故障並停止本次服務，保留合成證據與其他工作；不要發布故障副本。

en.summary: Reproduce a fault, narrow it, capture it with a regression test and repair incrementally; restore only confirmed change scope when recovery is needed.
objectives: Turn a vague failure into reproduction steps with a starting state and observations.
Distinguish environment errors, test errors and feature regressions.
Preserve other work and verify the repair or recovery.

readingGuide.goal: Turn a vague failure into reproduction steps with a starting state and observations.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your slice-three practice copy, the complete-then-clear interface test, and preserved code/diffs.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: debugging-notes.md records manual reproduction, failure and successful repair of a stale-report fault while preserving other work.

sections.heading: Turn “The Download Is Odd” into a Reproducible Scenario
paragraphs: Record the program copy, directory, version, input and steps. For example: fill three fields → check → clear document type → commit the change → download remains visible. This identifies both the state transition and the observation violating spec.

This is a fault scenario to investigate, not a claim that the current teacher reference contains it. If your project does not reproduce it, preserve the environment and result instead of changing large amounts of code speculatively.

sections.heading: Locate the Failed Switch Before Rewiring
paragraphs: A dark room may have a failed bulb, switch or power supply. Establish conditions and test locally before replacing all wiring without identifying the cause.

Software investigation also separates layers: an unavailable package is an environment issue; tests unable to locate app.py have a configuration issue; stale results after input changes may indicate functional state behavior. Each needs corresponding evidence.

sections.heading: Test One Repair Hypothesis at a Time
paragraphs: First make a test detect the expected failure, then apply a minimal repair, confirm the original failure becomes a pass and run affected existing scenarios. A syntax/import failure needs environment or test correction; it does not establish requirement coverage.

For stale reports, inspect the invalidation callback, snapshot equality in the display condition and revalidation at export one by one. Changing framework, data model and page design together obscures which change works.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Incremental Repair with Evidence
blocks.description: Return to observations at each step. Without reproduction or test results, keep the issue unconfirmed.

items.title: Reproduce
items.body: Fix input, actions, version and expectations.

items.title: Capture failure
items.body: Add a regression test that detects this behavior.

items.title: Minimal repair
items.body: Change only what the current hypothesis needs.

items.title: Verify and review
items.body: Run the original case and affected tests; inspect the diff.

sections.heading: Perform a Controlled Exercise in Your Own Copy
paragraphs: Preserve code and existing diffs first. In your slice-three practice copy, deliberately keep a stale report visible: temporarily remove input on_change invalidation callbacks, make the display condition check only for the existence of checked, and deliberately preview/export old checked data. This is a synthetic fault to repair after practice; keep it out of the normal project.

Rerun the complete-then-clear AppTest. It should fail where success or download should have disappeared. Restore invalidation, current-value comparison and export of current data; the same test should pass, followed by the full reference rule/interface suite. If the deliberately faulty behavior still passes, strengthen assertions instead of treating green as correctness.

blocks.heading: Locate the Existing Interface Test
paragraphs: Run in your own slice-three practice copy; preserve the public teacher solution.
blocks.code:
python -m pytest -q tests/test_app.py
python -m pytest -q

sections.heading: Identify What to Preserve Before Recovery
paragraphs: Recovery does not mean discarding the whole working directory. Preserve uncommitted edits, new files and test results; identify the known-good source and paths to recover. If a file contains other work, repair selected sections or retrieve only your task’s portion from a copy.

Git restore can replace working-tree or staged content from a selected source and may overwrite data. Its default source changes with options. Identify source, destination and paths before running it; this course offers no one-click whole-project forced reset.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Three Different Recovery Decisions
rows: A small logic error in this task
Repair locally, preserving other sections.
Original failing test and diff.
An unfinished feature
Preserve a branch/copy and recover known-working behavior.
Startup and core scenarios.
Dependency installation failure
Check environment and versions first.
Installation/version output; features remain unverified.

sections.heading: Retain Why It Was Fixed and What Remains Unchecked
paragraphs: Record fault conditions, original failure, repair rationale, passing results and unverified scope. Repairing a local form does not complete multiuser authorization or production deployment. Put remaining responsibilities into a separate explicit task.
M08 broadens rule, interface, usability and security verification; M09 organizes versions and handoff. M07 concludes with three operable slices and verifiable change/acceptance records.

exercise.environment: Your slice-three practice copy, the complete-then-clear interface test, and preserved code/diffs.
steps: Record the baseline tests. In a copy, suspend on_change invalidation, show results when checked exists, and deliberately preview/export checked.
In a browser, fill, check, clear a field and commit the change. Run interface tests and verify detection of stale success or download.
Restore invalidation, snapshot/current-value comparison and export of current data. Rerun the same test and full suite, retaining the root cause and diff.
exercise.expected: debugging-notes.md records manual reproduction, failure and successful repair of a stale-report fault while preserving other work.
exercise.check: The fault exists only in a practice copy. Failure must concern stale results after input change, not an import or environment error.
exercise.cleanup: Repair the injected fault and stop your service. Preserve synthetic evidence and other work; do not publish the faulty copy.

zh.prompt: 找不到 pytest 與舊結果未失效，應如何看待？
options: 都是同一個 UI bug
都先重寫框架
分別定位環境與功能層次
都可直接標通過
rationales: 失敗層次不同。
會增加不必要變更。
先依證據定位原因。
沒有驗證依據。

en.prompt: How should unavailable pytest and missing stale-result invalidation be investigated?
options: Both are the same UI bug.
Rewrite the framework for both.
Locate environment and functional layers separately.
Mark both passed directly.
rationales: They fail at different layers.
That adds unnecessary changes.
Use evidence to locate the cause first.
There is no verification basis.

zh.prompt: 人工讓舊 checked 報告繼續顯示後，回歸測試仍綠，代表什麼？
options: 功能更可靠
至少該測試未抓住此規格差距，應補斷言
不需要介面測試
直接刪除規格
rationales: 已知錯誤未被抓到。
檢查涵蓋行為再改善測試。
應改善而非放棄。
不能迎合錯誤行為改規格。

en.prompt: After deliberately keeping old checked reports visible, regression tests remain green. What follows?
options: The feature is more reliable.
At least this test misses the specified gap; improve its assertions.
Interface tests are unnecessary.
Delete the specification.
rationales: A known fault was missed.
Review covered behavior and improve detection.
Improve rather than abandon testing.
Do not change requirements to accommodate a fault.

zh.prompt: 同一檔案混有其他人的修改，復原時應怎麼做？
options: 整份丟掉
只保留 Agent 的修改
先保留現況，再局部回復本次範圍並驗證
只改完成摘要
rationales: 會遺失無關工作。
無權任意丟棄他人內容。
來源與範圍清楚才能安全復原。
沒有修正實際行為。

en.prompt: A file also contains another person’s edits. How should you restore it?
options: Discard the entire file.
Keep only Agent edits.
Preserve the current state, recover only this task’s scope and verify.
Change only the completion summary.
rationales: That loses unrelated work.
You cannot arbitrarily discard others’ content.
Clear source and scope support safe recovery.
That does not repair behavior.

zh.summary: 把啟動、規則、介面、任務與安全證據逐項對照主張，清楚說明已驗證與仍待驗的範圍。
objectives: 區分服務啟動與需求驗收。
為品質主張選擇足夠且相關的證據。
記錄實際結果與尚未執行的驗證。

readingGuide.goal: 區分服務啟動與需求驗收。
readingGuide.startingPoint: spec.md、三次切片、既有測試結果與可編輯的驗證紀錄。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: verification-notes.md 能區分已證明、失敗及仍待驗的範圍。

sections.heading: 讓「完成」有可核對的意思
paragraphs: 本機程式可以啟動，只說明某個環境能跑到入口。資料缺漏時是否拒絕匯出、使用者是否看懂錯誤、不同承辦人是否隔離，都還需要各自的驗證。先把「系統完成了」拆成具體主張，才知道要蒐集什麼證據。
M07 留下三次切片與 Diff；M08 要回答這些變更如何支持 spec.md。未執行的步驟寫待驗，失敗保留實際結果，不能用 Agent 的完成摘要替代操作或測試輸出。

sections.heading: 像車輛能發動，還要檢查不同使用條件
paragraphs: 引擎發動、煞車有效、駕駛能看懂儀表，各有不同的檢查。發動成功不能替煞車測試背書，一次試駕也無法證明所有道路條件都安全。
軟體同樣需要分層證據。測試的價值在於涵蓋哪項行為與條件，不在於報告看起來有多少個綠色勾號。

sections.heading: 依問題選擇驗證方式
paragraphs: 規則測試直接呼叫 validate、export_report，能快速檢查不合法資料。AppTest 檢查 Streamlit 的輸入與顯示狀態；真實瀏覽器再驗鍵盤與下載內容。
同儕任務觀察則檢查人如何理解與完成流程。多人授權需要已實作的身分、資源與資料存取控制；本課單人原型沒有這些控制，不能用其他測試的通過來補足。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜品質證據的不同視角
blocks.description: 這些是互補的驗證視角，平行卡片不表示先後或相互取代。

items.title: 規則
items.body: 直接輸入正常、缺漏與邊界資料。

items.title: 介面與瀏覽器
items.body: 核對提示、狀態、鍵盤及下載位元組。

items.title: 使用者任務
items.body: 觀察找路、修正與完成，不只問喜不喜歡。

items.title: 安全邊界
items.body: 確認已實作控制；沒有控制時先記未實作。

sections.heading: 把每條驗收連到最小證據
paragraphs: 先從 spec.md 取一條「缺漏不得產生完整報告」，至少需要匯出函式拒絕缺漏的結果，以及畫面不提供完整下載的觀察。若主張中文下載可讀，還要讀實際檔案，不能只看元件存在。
紀錄中保留版本或提交、環境、命令、輸入、預期、觀察及限制。同一測試在別的階段或別的版本通過，不會自動證明目前這份程式。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜證據要對得上主張
rows: 本機骨架可啟動
啟動輸出與瀏覽器畫面

sections.heading: 用證據表取代模糊狀態
paragraphs: 例如「pytest 通過」還需指出在哪個目錄、執行哪組測試；「同儕試用完成」要有任務及實際觀察。若同儕尚未來試用，先備妥任務，不填入想像結果。
以下工作表由學員填寫；空白欄與待驗狀態是用來保留真實邊界，不代表測試已完成。

blocks.heading: 驗證紀錄欄位
paragraphs: 另建 verification-notes.md，以自己的實際結果填寫。

sections.heading: 通過的範圍保持原樣
paragraphs: 「測試全綠，所以安全」漏掉了未實作或未測試的控制；「使用者說不錯，所以規則正確」也缺少資料行為證據。把不同層次相互連結，同時保留各自限制。
接下來先用 TDD 練習可失敗的回饋，再深入規則、介面、任務與安全案例。課程閱讀與測驗答案不會被自動記成學員實作通過。

exercise.environment: spec.md、三次切片、既有測試結果與可編輯的驗證紀錄。
steps: 挑三條完成主張，分別寫出條件與對應規格。
將啟動、規則、介面、任務及多人安全證據分欄，填入實際已有結果。
指出至少一項尚無足夠證據的主張與下一個驗證動作。
exercise.expected: verification-notes.md 能區分已證明、失敗及仍待驗的範圍。
exercise.check: 每項通過都能連到相同程式版本與相關驗證，不把未測量事項推成完成。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Match startup, rule, interface, task and security evidence to specific claims, identifying what is verified and what remains untested.
objectives: Distinguish service startup from requirements acceptance.
Choose sufficient, relevant evidence for quality claims.
Record actual results and verification not yet performed.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish service startup from requirements acceptance.
readingGuide.startingPoint: spec.md, the three slices, existing test results and an editable verification record.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: verification-notes.md distinguishes demonstrated, failed and still-unverified scope.

sections.heading: Give “Complete” a Verifiable Meaning
paragraphs: A local program starting shows that an environment can execute an entry point. Rejection of incomplete exports, understandable errors and isolation between staff require separate verification. Break “the system is complete” into specific claims to identify the evidence needed.

M07 produced three slices and diffs; M08 connects those changes to spec.md. Mark unexecuted steps pending and preserve failures. An Agent’s completion summary cannot replace operations or test output.

sections.heading: A Vehicle Starting Does Not Test Every Condition
paragraphs: Engine startup, working brakes and readable instruments need different checks. A running engine cannot stand in for a brake test, and one drive does not establish safety on every road.
Software likewise needs evidence at different layers. Judge tests by the behavior and conditions covered rather than the number of green marks in a report.

sections.heading: Choose Verification for the Question
paragraphs: Rule tests call validate and export_report directly to check invalid data quickly. AppTest checks Streamlit input/display states; a real browser separately checks keyboard operation and downloaded content.

Peer task observation examines how people understand and complete the flow. Multiuser authorization requires implemented identity, resource and data-access controls. This single-user prototype lacks them; passing other tests cannot fill that gap.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Different Views of Quality Evidence
blocks.description: These complementary views are parallel cards, not a sequence or substitutes for one another.

items.title: Rules
items.body: Provide valid, missing and boundary inputs directly.

items.title: Interface and browser
items.body: Check feedback, states, keyboard operation and download bytes.

items.title: User tasks
items.body: Observe navigation, correction and completion, beyond stated preferences.

items.title: Security boundaries
items.body: Check implemented controls; record absent controls as unimplemented.

sections.heading: Connect Each Acceptance Criterion to Needed Evidence
paragraphs: For “incomplete data cannot produce a complete report” in spec.md, obtain at least a rejecting export-function result and an interface observation showing no complete download. To claim Chinese downloads are readable, inspect an actual file rather than only the component’s presence.
Retain version/commit, environment, command, input, expectation, observation and limits. A test passing at another stage or version does not automatically establish the current program’s behavior.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Match Evidence to the Claim
rows: The local skeleton starts.
Startup output and browser screen.
Correct rules and export.
Incomplete input cannot be exported.
Rule exception tests and negative interface scenarios.
Resolution of every security risk.
Download content meets the contract.
Actual JSON file and allowlisted fields.
Official intake eligibility.
A user can correct omissions independently.
Peer observation with a task.
Ease of use for every user.
Staff cannot read others’ unauthorized data.
Cross-identity negative tests of implemented authorization.
This single-user prototype currently has no such evidence.

sections.heading: Replace Vague Status with an Evidence Record
paragraphs: “pytest passed” still needs a working directory and test selection. “Peer trial completed” needs a task and actual observations. Prepare tasks before a peer arrives, without filling in imagined outcomes.
Learners fill the worksheet below. Blank fields and pending status preserve the actual evidence boundary; they do not mean testing is complete.

blocks.heading: Verification Record Fields
paragraphs: Create verification-notes.md from actual results. The unchanged Traditional Chinese template records version/commit/environment, specification/claim, verification layer/command/task, input/expectation, observation/exit, pass/fail/unexecuted status and uncovered conditions/next steps.
blocks.code:
版本／提交與環境：
對應規格與主張：
驗證層次及命令／任務：
輸入與預期：
實際觀察與退出結果：
通過／失敗／未執行：
未涵蓋條件與下一步：

sections.heading: Keep a Pass Within Its Tested Scope
paragraphs: “All tests are green, so it is secure” ignores absent or untested controls. “Users liked it, so rules are correct” lacks data-behavior evidence. Connect layers while keeping their distinct limits.

The following lessons begin with TDD feedback capable of detecting failure, then examine rules, interface, tasks and security. Reading lessons or answer explanations does not automatically record a learner’s practical acceptance.

exercise.environment: spec.md, the three slices, existing test results and an editable verification record.
steps: Choose three completion claims and specify their conditions and corresponding requirements.
Separate startup, rule, interface, task and multiuser-security evidence; enter actual existing results.
Identify at least one insufficiently supported claim and the next verification action.
exercise.expected: verification-notes.md distinguishes demonstrated, failed and still-unverified scope.
exercise.check: Every pass links to the same program version and relevant verification. Do not mark unmeasured matters complete.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.summary: 先讓測試抓到缺漏仍匯出的錯誤，再做最小修正，最後在相同行為下整理程式。
objectives: 區分預期需求失敗與環境失敗。
操作 Red、Green、Refactor 的小步循環。
保留每次命令及結果，不放寬測試迎合錯誤。

readingGuide.goal: 區分預期需求失敗與環境失敗。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 獨立 tdd-lab/、已安裝 pytest 8.4.2 的 Python；不修改工作坊參考解答。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份可重現 Red、Green、Refactor 的小型規則練習與真實執行紀錄。

sections.heading: 讓一項要求先成為可失敗的測試
paragraphs: 測試驅動開發（TDD）先把一項要求寫成測試，執行後確認它因缺少該行為而失敗，再寫足夠的程式讓它通過，最後整理內部結構。Red、Green、Refactor 是回饋循環，不是三份成果狀態貼紙。
本篇在獨立 tdd-lab/ 練習「文件類型缺漏不得產生完整報告」這一小條要求。它不是整份 reference 解答，尚未涵蓋另兩欄、長度、欄位白名單與介面。不要用此練習取代完整程式。

sections.heading: 像先用量具確認缺口，再修到合格
paragraphs: 量具要能分辨不合格與合格；若不合格材料也過關，就先修正量測方法。把測試跑紅的目的，是確認回饋確實連到你要保護的行為。
語法錯誤、找不到 pytest 或測試未被收集，都不是此處要觀察的缺漏匯出失敗。先看失敗訊息，再決定修程式、測試或環境。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜TDD 的小步回饋
blocks.description: 每次只推進目前要求，完成後再選下一個情境。

items.title: Red
items.body: 測試因缺少預期行為而失敗。

items.title: Green
items.body: 最小修改使相同測試通過。

items.title: Refactor
items.body: 維持行為，改善命名或結構後再測。

sections.heading: Red：先確認錯誤能被抓到
paragraphs: 在獨立目錄建立 export_gate.py，放入以下故意缺少驗證的起點；再建立 test_export_gate.py。這份起點是人工練習，不是目前公開 reference 的缺陷。
執行 python -m pytest -q，負向情境應因沒有拋出 ValueError 而失敗，正常資料案例通過。請保留輸出與原因，不能只把紅色畫面當作達成 TDD。

blocks.heading: export_gate.py｜練習起點
paragraphs: 只放在新建 tdd-lab/，不覆蓋原型 rules.py。
blocks.code:
def build_report(record):
    return {"status": "complete", "data": dict(record)}

blocks.heading: test_export_gate.py｜固定驗收行為
paragraphs: 兩個檔案放在同一目錄，用已安裝 pytest 的 Python 執行。

sections.heading: Green：修正行為，維持原測試
paragraphs: 將 export_gate.py 改成以下版本，再執行同一命令。輸入不是字串或去除首尾空白後為空，就拒絕產生完整報告；有效文字先去除首尾空白。
不要刪掉負向測試或把預期改成一律完整。測試通過後仍只證明這幾組輸入，還需要下一篇補足三欄與邊界。

blocks.heading: export_gate.py｜最小修正
paragraphs: 保留原測試，觀察負向案例是否由失敗轉成通過。

sections.heading: Refactor：讓行為保持、結構更清楚
paragraphs: 以下把文件類型的正規化與錯誤處理抽成具名函式，外部 build_report 介面及結果保持原樣。這只是本練習的整理方式；若目前程式已清楚，也可以先不增加抽象層。
重跑相同測試，再增加缺鍵、首尾空白與原資料不變的案例，檢查這次整理是否意外改變行為。增加新的業務要求應另外開始下一輪，不藏在重構中。

blocks.heading: export_gate.py｜整理後版本
paragraphs: 每次只改一個小範圍，保留對外契約。

sections.heading: 留下三個階段的證據
paragraphs: 紀錄測試內容、Red 的預期失敗、Green 的相同測試通過，以及 Refactor 後的回歸結果。若 Agent 一次提供整包答案，仍要核對它是否真的執行過這些步驟，不能由最終程式倒推開發過程。
此處是單一規則的練習。整合回三欄原型前，依原 spec 與完整測試核對，不將局部成功寫成全系統或資安完成。

exercise.environment: 獨立 tdd-lab/、已安裝 pytest 8.4.2 的 Python；不修改工作坊參考解答。
steps: 依序建立起點與測試，執行 python -m pytest -q，保存缺少例外的失敗。
使用最小修正版本重跑相同測試，再使用整理版本重跑。
補測缺鍵、首尾空白及輸入未被修改，記錄每階段結果與範圍。
exercise.expected: 一份可重現 Red、Green、Refactor 的小型規則練習與真實執行紀錄。
exercise.check: Red 必須因需求行為失敗；重構不放寬測試或增加未確認要求。
exercise.cleanup: 保留三階段程式與結果，別把人工缺陷起點誤放入正常專案。

en.summary: First make tests detect export despite missing data, then make a minimal repair and refactor while preserving behavior.
objectives: Distinguish expected requirement failures from environment failures.
Run a small Red, Green, Refactor cycle.
Preserve commands and results without weakening tests to fit faults.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish expected requirement failures from environment failures.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A separate tdd-lab/ and Python with pytest 8.4.2 installed; preserve the workshop reference solution.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A reproducible small rule exercise with actual Red, Green and Refactor execution records.

sections.heading: Make One Requirement a Test That Can Fail
paragraphs: Test-driven development (TDD) expresses one requirement in a test, runs it to confirm failure from missing behavior, adds enough code to pass, then improves internal structure. Red, Green and Refactor form a feedback cycle, not three status stickers.

In separate tdd-lab/, practice one rule: missing document type must not produce a complete report. This is not the reference solution; it omits the other two fields, length, output allowlisting and interface. Do not replace the complete program with this exercise.

sections.heading: Use a Gauge to Find the Gap Before Repair
paragraphs: A gauge must distinguish acceptable from unacceptable material. If defective material passes, improve the measurement. Running a test red checks whether its feedback detects the behavior you intend to protect.
Syntax errors, missing pytest and uncollected tests are not the missing-data export failure sought here. Read the failure before choosing to repair code, tests or environment.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Small TDD Feedback Steps
blocks.description: Advance only the current requirement, then select another scenario.

items.title: Red
items.body: The test fails because expected behavior is absent.

items.title: Green
items.body: A minimal change makes the same test pass.

items.title: Refactor
items.body: Preserve behavior, improve naming/structure and test again.

sections.heading: Red: Confirm Detection of the Fault
paragraphs: Create export_gate.py in a separate directory with the deliberately unvalidated starting code, then create test_export_gate.py. This is an injected exercise, not a defect in the public reference.
Run python -m pytest -q. Negative cases should fail because no ValueError is raised, while valid data passes. Preserve output and reasons; a red screen alone does not establish useful TDD feedback.

blocks.heading: export_gate.py | Exercise Starting Point
paragraphs: Use only a new tdd-lab/; preserve the prototype’s rules.py.
blocks.code:
def build_report(record):
    return {"status": "complete", "data": dict(record)}

blocks.heading: test_export_gate.py | Fix the Acceptance Behavior
paragraphs: Put both files in the same directory and run with Python containing pytest. The expected exception text means “missing document type”; the valid synthetic label and exact output are retained.

sections.heading: Green: Repair Behavior, Keep the Tests
paragraphs: Replace export_gate.py with this version and run the same command. Reject non-string values and text empty after trimming, and trim valid document text before output.
Keep negative tests and their expectations rather than accepting every input as complete. Passing covers these inputs only; the next lesson adds the three-field rules and boundaries.

blocks.heading: export_gate.py | Minimal Repair
paragraphs: Keep the original tests and observe negative cases changing from failure to pass.

sections.heading: Refactor: Keep Behavior and Clarify Structure
paragraphs: This version extracts document-type normalization and error handling into a named function, preserving build_report’s external interface and results. It is one way to organize this exercise; no extra abstraction is necessary if the existing code is already clear.

Rerun the same tests, then add missing-key, surrounding-whitespace and unchanged-input cases to check for unintended behavior changes. A new business requirement starts another cycle rather than hiding within refactoring.

blocks.heading: export_gate.py | Refactored Version
paragraphs: Change one small area at a time, preserving the external contract.

sections.heading: Retain Evidence from All Three Stages
paragraphs: Record test contents, expected Red failures, the same tests passing at Green and regression results after Refactor. If an Agent supplies a finished package, check whether these steps actually ran; final code cannot establish its development history.
This exercise covers one rule. Before integration with the three-field prototype, check original spec and full tests. Local success does not establish the whole system or completed security.

exercise.environment: A separate tdd-lab/ and Python with pytest 8.4.2 installed; preserve the workshop reference solution.
steps: Create the starting code and tests, run python -m pytest -q and preserve missing-exception failures.
Run the same tests with the minimal repair and then with the refactored version.
Add missing-key, trimming and unchanged-input tests; record each stage’s results and scope.
exercise.expected: A reproducible small rule exercise with actual Red, Green and Refactor execution records.
exercise.check: Red must fail on required behavior. Refactoring neither weakens tests nor adds unconfirmed requirements.
exercise.cleanup: Keep all three program stages and results; do not put the deliberately faulty starting code into the normal project.

rationales: 保持回饋短且聚焦。

options: The smallest repair that passes the current tests.

rationales: Keep feedback short and focused.

刪除必填規則
改為所有資料完整
保留輸入輸出契約，抽出具名驗證函式
rationales: 是新功能。
改變行為。
改變要求。
結構改變而行為保持。

options: Add official login.

rationales: That is a new feature.
That changes behavior.
That changes requirements.
