zh.summary: 用參數化測試覆蓋三欄的有效、無效與長度邊界，直接驗證規則及匯出契約。
objectives: 把驗收情境寫成輸入、動作與結果。
用 pytest 參數化及例外斷言檢查業務規則。
核對匯出內容與函式沒有意外改動輸入。

readingGuide.goal: 把驗收情境寫成輸入、動作與結果。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的第三切片副本、rules.py、pytest 8.4.2，與已確認 spec.md。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: tests/test_rules_contract.py 與實際結果覆蓋三欄規則及受控匯出。

sections.heading: 先找出不依賴畫面的規則
paragraphs: reference/rules.py 的 validate 接收字典、回傳錯誤列表；export_report 在產生 JSON 前重新驗證，不合法時拋出 ValueError。直接呼叫這兩個函式，就能檢查畫面輸入限制以外的資料。
三個必要鍵是 application_id、applicant_code、document_type。去除首尾空白後須為非空字串且最多 80 字元；這是教學合成規則，不是正式文件受理條件。

sections.heading: 像用同一張檢查表逐一量測不同樣本
paragraphs: 每個樣本換一個條件，其餘維持已知有效，才能看清楚哪個條件造成失敗。若一次把所有欄位都清空，只知道整體有錯，難以確認每一欄的規則都受到保護。
參數化讓同一組斷言套用到多筆資料。案例數增加要來自有意義的條件組合，不能用大量重複資料營造已驗證所有情況的印象。

sections.heading: 正常、無效、邊界與輸出契約
paragraphs: 必要欄位要測空字串、純空白、缺鍵與錯誤型別；長度要測剛好 80 與 81。正常匯出再核對去除首尾空白、固定結構與允許欄位，避免只測拒絕而漏掉可用路徑。
測試期望應從 spec 推得，不直接把函式目前回傳值複製成答案。規則若有歧義，先回到規格與負責人，不任意放寬測試。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜一份測試需要哪些資訊
blocks.description: 依輸入、執行與斷言閱讀，每一案例都能回答哪個要求受到保護。

items.title: Arrange｜準備
items.body: 建立有效基準，只替換本次要測的欄位。

items.title: Act｜執行
items.body: 直接呼叫 validate 或 export_report。

items.title: Assert｜斷言
items.body: 確認錯誤、例外或匯出結果符合規格。

sections.heading: 可加入自己專案的完整測試範例
paragraphs: 在自己的第三切片副本建立 tests/test_rules_contract.py。以下兩個參數化裝飾器組合三個欄位與六種無效值；每例都應有錯誤且拒絕匯出。
正常案例核對 JSON 資料完全等於允許的三欄，並檢查原輸入未被改寫。這仍不是全部正式系統契約，其他業務需求需另外定義。

blocks.heading: tests/test_rules_contract.py
paragraphs: 檔案需能 import 同專案 rules.py；不要把不同階段的 rules 放在同一測試程序。

sections.heading: 執行與閱讀失敗
paragraphs: 在自己的第三切片根目錄執行 python -m pytest -q tests/test_rules_contract.py。若測試失敗，先讀案例參數、斷言及實際值，再查規則；若是 import 或環境錯誤，先修正執行位置。
範例可通過時，再執行該專案整組測試。記錄實際數量與退出結果，不預填固定成功數；日後新增測試後，數量會隨內容改變。

blocks.heading: 規則測試命令
paragraphs: 先確認已啟用工作坊環境，並在自己的第三切片目錄。
blocks.code:
python -m pytest -q tests/test_rules_contract.py
python -m pytest -q

sections.heading: 通過不代表測過所有資料
paragraphs: UI 不讓輸入 81 字元，仍需測函式拒絕超長直接呼叫；例外測試只寫「有任何錯誤」也可能把程式缺陷當成正確拒絕。使用預期 ValueError，必要時再核對錯誤訊息或類型。
規則測試無法判斷錯誤提示是否好找、鍵盤是否能完成任務或 JSON 真實下載是否正確。下一篇接著測介面，之後再安排人的任務觀察。

exercise.environment: 自己的第三切片副本、rules.py、pytest 8.4.2，與已確認 spec.md。
steps: 加入完整範例並執行，逐一說明無效、邊界與正常案例。
核對一筆失敗時顯示的參數與斷言，確認不是環境問題。
執行整組測試，保存命令、版本、結果與未涵蓋情境。
exercise.expected: tests/test_rules_contract.py 與實際結果覆蓋三欄規則及受控匯出。
exercise.check: 有效路徑、例外類型、80／81 邊界與允許欄位都有斷言，未把測試數量當成完整性保證。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Use parametrized tests for valid, invalid and length-boundary values in three fields, directly checking rules and the export contract.
objectives: Express acceptance scenarios as input, action and result.
Use pytest parametrization and exception assertions for business rules.
Check exported content and absence of unintended input mutation.

readingGuide.goal: Express acceptance scenarios as input, action and result.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your slice-three copy, rules.py, pytest 8.4.2 and confirmed spec.md.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: tests/test_rules_contract.py and actual results covering three-field rules and controlled export.

sections.heading: Locate Rules Independent of the Interface
paragraphs: reference/rules.py validate accepts a dictionary and returns errors. export_report revalidates before JSON generation and raises ValueError on invalid data. Direct calls check inputs beyond interface restrictions.

The required keys are application_id, applicant_code and document_type. Each must be a nonempty string after trimming, at most 80 characters. These are synthetic teaching rules, not official document-acceptance conditions.

sections.heading: Measure Different Samples with the Same Checklist
paragraphs: Change one sample condition while keeping the others valid to see which condition causes failure. Clearing every field at once shows an overall error but makes it harder to verify protection for each field.
Parametrization applies the same assertions to several inputs. Add cases for meaningful combinations, without using repeated data to imply that all conditions were tested.

sections.heading: Normal, Invalid, Boundary and Output-contract Cases
paragraphs: Test empty strings, whitespace-only values, missing keys and wrong types, plus lengths exactly 80 and 81. Also check successful export, trimming, fixed structure and allowed fields so rejection tests do not omit the usable path.
Derive expectations from spec rather than copying current function outputs as answers. Resolve ambiguous rules with the specification and owner; do not arbitrarily weaken tests.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Information Needed in a Test
blocks.description: Read preparation, execution and assertions; identify the requirement each case protects.

items.title: Arrange
items.body: Create a valid baseline and replace only the field being tested.

items.title: Act
items.body: Call validate or export_report directly.

items.title: Assert
items.body: Check errors, exceptions or export results against the specification.

sections.heading: A Complete Test Example for Your Project
paragraphs: Create tests/test_rules_contract.py in your slice-three copy. The two stacked parametrization decorators combine three fields with six invalid values. Every case must report errors and reject export.
The normal case checks that JSON data equals exactly the three allowed fields and that input is unchanged. This is not a complete production-system contract; define other business needs separately.

blocks.heading: tests/test_rules_contract.py
paragraphs: The file must import this project’s rules.py. Keep different stages’ rules out of the same test process. The unchanged synthetic document label and program keys match the reference.

sections.heading: Execute and Read Failures
paragraphs: From your slice-three root, run python -m pytest -q tests/test_rules_contract.py. On failure, read parameters, assertion and actual values before investigating rules. For import/environment errors, check the execution location first.
Once the example passes, run all tests in that project. Record actual counts and exit outcomes rather than prefilled success totals; counts change as tests are added.

blocks.heading: Rule-test Commands
paragraphs: Confirm the workshop environment is activated and you are in your own slice-three directory.
blocks.code:
python -m pytest -q tests/test_rules_contract.py
python -m pytest -q

sections.heading: Passing Does Not Mean Every Input Was Tested
paragraphs: The UI preventing 81 characters does not replace a function test rejecting an overlong direct call. Asserting “any error” may also mistake a program defect for correct rejection. Expect ValueError, checking messages or more specific conditions where needed.
Rule tests cannot establish discoverable feedback, a keyboard-completable task or correct real downloads. The next lesson tests the interface, followed by observation of people doing tasks.

exercise.environment: Your slice-three copy, rules.py, pytest 8.4.2 and confirmed spec.md.
steps: Add and run the complete example, explaining invalid, boundary and normal cases.
Inspect the parameters and assertion shown by a failure, confirming it is not an environment issue.
Run the full suite and preserve command, version, results and uncovered scenarios.
exercise.expected: tests/test_rules_contract.py and actual results covering three-field rules and controlled export.
exercise.check: Assert valid paths, exception types, 80/81 boundaries and allowed fields. A test count is not a completeness guarantee.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.summary: 以 AppTest 重演缺漏、補正與輸入變更，檢查 Streamlit 元件和狀態；實際下載與鍵盤另外驗證。
objectives: 用 AppTest 建立並重跑 Streamlit 情境。
檢查錯誤、成功、保留輸入及下載元件狀態。
分清模擬測試與真實瀏覽器驗證範圍。

readingGuide.goal: 用 AppTest 建立並重跑 Streamlit 情境。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的第三切片副本，含 app.py、rules.py、tests/ 及 Streamlit 1.51.0。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份 AppTest 回歸腳本，加上分開記錄的真實瀏覽器驗證。

sections.heading: 規則正確，還要確認畫面有接對
paragraphs: rules.py 拒絕缺件，不代表 app.py 一定顯示正確提示。按鈕可能沒呼叫規則、成功訊息可能沒清除，或修改輸入後仍留下下載入口。介面測試把使用者操作與畫面結果連起來。
AppTest 模擬 Streamlit app，可設定 widget 值、執行程式並檢查顯示內容與 Session State。本課採固定 1.51.0；實際支援行為以該版本與本次執行結果為準。

sections.heading: 像用操作腳本反覆走一條櫃臺流程
paragraphs: 操作腳本會指出先填哪個欄位、何時按檢查、應看到什麼。只檢查櫃臺存在，無法知道填錯時是否有人告知如何修正。
AppTest 幫你重複執行這條腳本，但它不是站在實際瀏覽器前的使用者；畫面排版、鍵盤焦點與下載位元組需要另外觀察。

sections.heading: 輸入、重跑與觀察要連在一起
paragraphs: 建立 AppTest 後呼叫 run() 產生初始畫面；變更 widget 或按按鈕後，再明確 run()，才檢查該次結果。不要把上一個重跑留下的值當成本次操作已執行。
範例以穩定 key 找三個欄位；按鈕只有一個主要檢查動作，因此使用 at.button[0]。如果你的專案新增多個按鈕，先調整定位方式，不讓測試誤按另一個動作。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜三個連續的驗收狀態
blocks.description: 每一步都更新輸入並重跑，觀察當次結果。

items.title: 缺漏
items.body: 只填兩欄，按檢查後有缺漏提示，無完整下載。

items.title: 補正
items.body: 補齊第三欄並檢查，出現成功與下載元件。

items.title: 變更
items.body: 清空第三欄並重跑，舊成功、下載與快照失效。

sections.heading: 完整的介面測試範例
paragraphs: 在自己的第三切片副本建立 tests/test_app_contract.py，與 app.py 及 rules.py 保持同一專案結構。Path 依測試檔位置尋找 app.py，避免依啟動 shell 的偶然位置猜測入口。
每階段都檢查不應出現的狀態；只有正向成功斷言，無法保護缺漏拒絕或過期結果失效。

blocks.heading: tests/test_app_contract.py
paragraphs: 使用已安裝 Streamlit 1.51.0 與 pytest 的環境執行。
blocks.code:
from pathlib import Path
from streamlit.testing.v1 import AppTest


def test_input_change_invalidates_report():
    app = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "app.py")
    at = AppTest.from_file(app).run()
    assert not at.exception
    at.text_input(key="application_id").input("SYN-001")
    at.text_input(key="applicant_code").input("DEMO-A")
    at.button[0].click().run()
    assert "缺少文件類型" in at.error[0].value
    assert at.text_input(key="application_id").value == "SYN-001"
    assert not at.success
    assert not at.get("download_button")
    at.text_input(key="document_type").input("合成申請表").run()
    at.button[0].click().run()
    assert not at.exception
    assert at.success
    assert len(at.get("download_button")) == 1
    at.text_input(key="document_type").input("").run()
    assert not at.exception
    assert not at.success
    assert not at.get("download_button")
    assert "checked" not in at.session_state

sections.heading: 從元件驗證走到真實瀏覽器
paragraphs: 在專案根目錄執行 python -m pytest -q tests/test_app_contract.py，再啟動 app.py，用鍵盤完成相同任務。下載 JSON 後讀取檔名、中文、status、scope 與允許欄位。
AppTest 中下載元件出現只是狀態證據，未證明檔案真的送到裝置。真實瀏覽器也不會替代人是否理解提示的任務觀察；三者要各自留下結果。

sections.heading: 先看失敗原因，再決定修哪裡
paragraphs: 若 AppTest 出現例外，先檢查路徑、依賴與程式輸出；若只是定位不到元件，確認目前階段真的有該元件。不要把第一切片拿來跑第三切片下載情境，再把差距當作錯誤修掉。
測試腳本的行為與自己的規格不同時，先確認需求差異。不得為了讓測試變綠，把未確認的欄位、登入或外部服務偷偷加入作品。

en.summary: Replay omissions, correction and input changes with AppTest to inspect Streamlit components and state; verify real downloads and keyboard behavior separately.
objectives: Create and rerun Streamlit scenarios with AppTest.
Check errors, success, retained input and download-component state.
Separate simulation coverage from real-browser verification.

readingGuide.goal: Create and rerun Streamlit scenarios with AppTest.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your slice-three copy with app.py, rules.py, tests/ and Streamlit 1.51.0.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: An AppTest regression script with separately recorded real-browser verification.

sections.heading: Correct Rules Still Need the Right Interface Connection
paragraphs: rules.py rejecting incomplete input does not establish correct feedback in app.py. A button may fail to call rules, success may remain stale or input changes may leave a download available. Interface tests connect operations to displayed results.

AppTest simulates a Streamlit app, allowing widget values, script execution, display inspection and Session State checks. This course pins 1.51.0; rely on that version’s supported behavior and actual execution.

sections.heading: Replay a Counter-service Script
paragraphs: An operation script says which field to fill, when to check and what should appear. Merely establishing that a counter exists says nothing about correction guidance after invalid input.
AppTest repeats this script but is not a person using a real browser. Observe layout, keyboard focus and download bytes separately.

sections.heading: Connect Input, Rerun and Observation
paragraphs: After creating AppTest, call run() for the initial screen. After changing widgets or pressing a button, explicitly run() before checking the new result. Values retained from an earlier rerun do not establish that the new action executed.

The example locates three fields by stable keys. With one primary check action, it uses at.button[0]. If your project has more buttons, adjust targeting first so the test does not trigger another action.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Consecutive Acceptance States
blocks.description: Update input and rerun at each step, observing the current result.

items.title: Omission
items.body: Fill two fields and check; expect missing-data feedback without complete download.

items.title: Correction
items.body: Fill the third field and check; expect success and a download component.

items.title: Change
items.body: Clear the third field and rerun; old success, download and snapshot become invalid.

sections.heading: A Complete Interface Test
paragraphs: Create tests/test_app_contract.py in your slice-three copy, retaining app.py and rules.py in the same project structure. Path locates app.py relative to the test file instead of guessing from the launching shell’s directory.
Assert absent states at each stage too. Positive success assertions alone do not protect omission rejection or stale-result invalidation.

blocks.heading: tests/test_app_contract.py
paragraphs: Run with Streamlit 1.51.0 and pytest installed. The retained Chinese omission text, synthetic input and stable keys match the actual reference interface.
blocks.code:
from pathlib import Path
from streamlit.testing.v1 import AppTest


def test_input_change_invalidates_report():
    app = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "app.py")
    at = AppTest.from_file(app).run()
    assert not at.exception
    at.text_input(key="application_id").input("SYN-001")
    at.text_input(key="applicant_code").input("DEMO-A")
    at.button[0].click().run()
    assert "缺少文件類型" in at.error[0].value
    assert at.text_input(key="application_id").value == "SYN-001"
    assert not at.success
    assert not at.get("download_button")
    at.text_input(key="document_type").input("合成申請表").run()
    at.button[0].click().run()
    assert not at.exception
    assert at.success
    assert len(at.get("download_button")) == 1
    at.text_input(key="document_type").input("").run()
    assert not at.exception
    assert not at.success
    assert not at.get("download_button")
    assert "checked" not in at.session_state

sections.heading: Move from Components to a Real Browser
paragraphs: From the project root, run python -m pytest -q tests/test_app_contract.py, then start app.py and perform the same task by keyboard. Download JSON and inspect filename, Chinese content, status, scope and allowed fields.

A download component in AppTest is state evidence, not proof of file delivery to a device. A real browser also cannot replace observing whether a person understands feedback; keep separate results for all three.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | This Tool’s Verification Scope
rows: Errors/success and Session State
Assert with a script.
Whether the specification itself is correct.
Download-component visibility
Check presence or absence.
Actual file bytes and filename.
Keyboard and mobile layout
Not established by this test.
Real-browser and viewport checks.
User understanding of feedback
Not established by component presence.
Task observation.

sections.heading: Read the Failure Before Choosing the Repair
paragraphs: For AppTest exceptions, inspect paths, dependencies and output. For an unlocated component, check whether the current stage includes it. A third-slice download test is not appropriate for slice one; do not “repair” that intentional difference.
If a test differs from your specification, clarify requirements first. Do not silently add unconfirmed fields, login or external services just to make tests green.

exercise.environment: Your slice-three copy with app.py, rules.py, tests/ and Streamlit 1.51.0.
steps: Add the complete test, run it from the project root and retain results.
Identify assertions protecting omission, correction and change at each step.
Replay in a real browser and read the downloaded JSON separately, recording keyboard/download outcomes.
exercise.expected: An AppTest regression script with separately recorded real-browser verification.
exercise.check: Each operation has an explicit rerun. Check removal of stale results/downloads; simulated components are not real-download evidence.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.summary: 用有明確目標、但不透露操作答案的任務觀察使用者，將觀察、推論與改版假設分開。
objectives: 設計缺漏、補正與匯出的目標任務。
記錄操作與提示介入，不把推論當觀察。
用小範圍改善與再試用檢驗設計假設。

readingGuide.goal: 設計缺漏、補正與匯出的目標任務。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 可操作的本機第三切片、一位自願同儕、合成任務卡與空白紀錄表。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份匿名任務觀察紀錄與可再測的設計假設；尚未有人試用時保留未執行。

sections.heading: 測試的是使用者能否完成工作
paragraphs: 程式測試已確認按鈕與規則，仍要知道人是否看懂欄位、發現缺漏並取得可用報告。任務導向易用性測試觀察參與者實際做什麼，比只問「好不好用」更容易定位問題。
先決定要研究的問題，例如「缺漏提示是否讓人知道如何補正」。課堂同儕可以幫忙找初步差距，但未必代表真實領域使用者；一次順利不能推成所有人皆可用。

sections.heading: 像請人依路標找到目的地
paragraphs: 如果你一路說「走這邊、按那裡」，到達終點只能證明對方能跟著指示，無法知道路標是否清楚。任務應交代目的與可用資料，讓參與者自行選擇操作。
需要協助時可以提供，但要記錄何時及提示內容，將獨立完成與協助完成分開。不要為了得到漂亮結果，把卡住的過程從紀錄刪除。

sections.heading: 給目標，保留探索空間
paragraphs: 以下任務只用合成資料，分階段提供資料。主持人不要預先說出按鈕名稱、缺漏提示的位置或操作順序；這些正是要觀察的設計。
任務結束再詢問參與者當時如何理解訊息，避免在進行中用暗示問題誘導答案。測的是服務，不評判參與者能力。

blocks.heading: 同儕任務卡
paragraphs: 先給第一段，參與者處理完後才給補充資料；不預填觀察結果。
blocks.code:
任務一：你收到 SYN-001 的合成申請，申請人代號 DEMO-A，
目前沒有文件類型。請判斷這筆資料能否產生完整報告，並處理你發現的問題。

任務二：現在補充文件類型為「合成申請表」。
請取得一份可交給同事核對的報告。

任務三：這筆資料的文件類型剛被撤回。
請更新資料，判斷先前結果現在是否仍適用。

sections.heading: 先記發生什麼，再討論為什麼
paragraphs: 觀察可寫「看到缺漏後回到文件類型欄，補值後未重新檢查」；推論可寫「可能以為補值就會自動更新結果」。兩者分欄，後者需要詢問或再測，不能寫成參與者一定怎麼想。
記錄任務是否完成、是否得到協助、卡住位置與錯誤復原。若量時間，要先定義起訖及協助如何處理；本課不預設秒數門檻或宣稱已量得改善率。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜從觀察形成可測的改善
blocks.description: 這是研究與修改循環，沒有真人觀察時不要補上假結果。

items.title: 觀察任務
items.body: 保留操作、停頓、錯誤及介入。

items.title: 形成假設
items.body: 區分看見的行為與可能原因。

items.title: 小步改善
items.body: 選一項與觀察相關的文案或流程修改。

items.title: 重新試用
items.body: 用一致目標觀察是否改善，保留限制。

sections.heading: 一份可供課堂使用的觀察表
paragraphs: 先說明目的與紀錄方式，取得參與者同意；課堂可用匿名代號，不記個資或真實業務資料。錄影不是完成此練習的必要條件，若需錄製另先確認同意與保存方式。
以下工作表為空白模板，請填真實事件。主持人自己的自測另標為準備或流程檢查，不寫成另一位使用者的結果。

sections.heading: 把結果轉成下一次可驗證修改
paragraphs: 「大家都覺得簡單」缺少參與者、任務與觀察範圍。請改寫為本次何種情境、出現哪個行為及接下來要驗什麼，讓後續設計有依據。
M08 的十五分鐘實作包含規則、介面與同儕任務的短練習。時間不足時留下未完成及課後安排，不能把備妥任務卡或出席記成真人試用已通過。

exercise.environment: 可操作的本機第三切片、一位自願同儕、合成任務卡與空白紀錄表。
steps: 說明目的與紀錄方式，取得同意後提供任務，不透露按鈕操作答案。
觀察缺漏、補正與變更，記錄協助、完成情況及實際行為。
分開觀察與推論，提出一項改善假設；修改後再安排一致目標的試用。
exercise.expected: 一份匿名任務觀察紀錄與可再測的設計假設；尚未有人試用時保留未執行。
exercise.check: 不編造參與者或結果，不把同儕單次觀察推成所有使用者結論。
exercise.cleanup: 停止測試服務，依已說明方式保存匿名紀錄，刪除不需要的合成下載。

en.summary: Observe users through goal-based tasks without giving away actions, separating observations, interpretations and redesign hypotheses.
objectives: Design goal-based tasks for omissions, correction and export.
Record actions and facilitator assistance without treating inference as observation.
Test design hypotheses through bounded changes and another trial.

readingGuide.goal: Design goal-based tasks for omissions, correction and export.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A working local third slice, one voluntary peer, synthetic task cards and a blank record.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: An anonymous task-observation record and testable design hypothesis; mark unexecuted if no person has tried it.

sections.heading: Test Whether People Can Complete Their Work
paragraphs: Program tests verify buttons and rules, but people must still understand fields, notice omissions and obtain usable reports. Task-based usability testing observes what participants actually do, making problems easier to locate than asking only whether they like the app.

Choose a research question first, such as whether omission feedback explains how to correct input. Classroom peers can reveal initial gaps but may not represent domain users. One smooth trial does not establish usability for everyone.

sections.heading: Ask Someone to Find a Destination Using the Signs
paragraphs: If you keep saying “this way” and “press here,” reaching the destination shows the participant can follow directions, not whether signs are clear. Give the goal and available information, leaving the actions to the participant.
You may help when needed, recording when and what you said. Separate independent from assisted completion and preserve moments of difficulty rather than deleting them to improve the reported result.

sections.heading: Give the Goal and Leave Room to Explore
paragraphs: The following tasks use synthetic data supplied in stages. Do not reveal button names, error locations or action order in advance; those are part of the design being observed.
After the task, ask how the participant understood messages. Avoid leading questions during the task. You are testing the service rather than judging participant ability.

blocks.heading: Peer Task Card
paragraphs: Give the first part before the supplemental information and fill no observation in advance. The unchanged Traditional Chinese card sets three goals: for SYN-001 and DEMO-A without document type, determine whether a complete report is possible and address problems; next, receive document type “合成申請表” (synthetic application form) and obtain a report for a colleague to inspect; finally, the type is withdrawn, so update the record and decide whether the previous result still applies.
blocks.code:
任務一：你收到 SYN-001 的合成申請，申請人代號 DEMO-A，
目前沒有文件類型。請判斷這筆資料能否產生完整報告，並處理你發現的問題。

任務二：現在補充文件類型為「合成申請表」。
請取得一份可交給同事核對的報告。

任務三：這筆資料的文件類型剛被撤回。
請更新資料，判斷先前結果現在是否仍適用。

sections.heading: Record What Happened Before Explaining Why
paragraphs: An observation might be “after seeing the omission, the participant filled document type but did not recheck.” A separate interpretation might be “they may expect automatic result updates.” Ask or retest before treating the interpretation as established understanding.

Record completion, assistance, points of difficulty and error recovery. If measuring time, define start/end and handling of assistance first. This course supplies no arbitrary time threshold or measured improvement percentage.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Turn Observation into a Testable Improvement
blocks.description: This is a research/change cycle. Supply no invented findings when human observation has not happened.

items.title: Observe a task
items.body: Retain actions, pauses, errors and interventions.

items.title: Form a hypothesis
items.body: Separate observed behavior from possible causes.

items.title: Make a small improvement
items.body: Choose one related wording or flow change.

items.title: Try again
items.body: Observe the same goal, preserving limitations.

sections.heading: A Classroom Observation Worksheet
paragraphs: Explain purpose and recording methods and obtain participant agreement first. Use anonymous codes, retaining no personal or real business data. Recording video is unnecessary; if you choose to record, confirm agreement and retention separately beforehand.
The worksheet is blank for actual events. Label the facilitator’s self-test as preparation or a flow check, rather than reporting it as another user’s result.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Task-observation Record Fields
rows: Program version and task
Identify the program and goal tested.
Visible behavior and actual words
Record only observations; quote faithfully.
Assistance
Record whether/when you intervened and the prompt given.
Completion
Independent / assisted / incomplete.
Interpretation and unknowns
Explicitly mark possible causes.
Change hypothesis and retest
One change and its subsequent verification method.

sections.heading: Turn Findings into the Next Verifiable Change
paragraphs: “Everyone found it simple” lacks participants, tasks and observation scope. Describe the actual situation, behavior and next check so design decisions have evidence.

M08’s fifteen practical minutes include short rule, interface and peer-task exercises. If time runs out, record unfinished work and follow-up. Prepared task cards or attendance do not establish successful human trials.

exercise.environment: A working local third slice, one voluntary peer, synthetic task cards and a blank record.
steps: Explain purpose and recording, obtain agreement, then give tasks without revealing button actions.
Observe omission, correction and change; record assistance, completion and actual behavior.
Separate observations from interpretations and propose one improvement hypothesis; after changing it, arrange another trial with the same goal.
exercise.expected: An anonymous task-observation record and testable design hypothesis; mark unexecuted if no person has tried it.
exercise.check: Invent no participants or results. Do not generalize one peer observation to all users.
exercise.cleanup: Stop the test service, retain anonymous records as explained and delete unnecessary synthetic downloads.

zh.prompt: 哪個任務較適合觀察易用性？

先點綠色按鈕
請取得可交給同事核對的合成報告
照主持人每一步操作
rationales: 直接透露操作。
引導到指定控制。
給目標並保留操作選擇。
主要測跟隨指示。

Press the green button first.
Obtain a synthetic report a colleague can inspect.

That directs the participant to a control.
It gives a goal while leaving action choices open.
That mainly tests following directions.

程式測試結果
全部人的結論
rationales: 沒有直接觀察依據。
應先記行為再確認理解。
不是函式行為。
範圍過度擴張。

en.prompt: “The participant definitely does not understand completeness” is what kind of statement?

An interpretation requiring confirmation.
A program test result.
A conclusion about everyone.
rationales: There is no direct observational basis.
Record behavior first, then check understanding.
It is not function behavior.

Delete the assistance.
Assume no help was used.

zh.summary: 以無效輸入、額外欄位及過期結果建立負向驗證，將已測原型行為與尚未實作的多人安全分開。
objectives: 從規格與風險推導負向情境。
記錄拒絕、修正及回歸證據。
把未實作授權明確列為待實作與待驗。

readingGuide.goal: 從規格與風險推導負向情境。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 第三切片與測試、spec.md、驗證紀錄，以及多人版尚未實作事項。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份風險—案例—結果對照及獨立的未實作安全需求清單。

sections.heading: 除了能做什麼，也驗證何時必須拒絕
paragraphs: 正向情境證明一筆有效資料能完成，負向情境則檢查系統面對不應接受的輸入或操作，是否拒絕且不造成錯誤結果。每個案例先說明保護哪個要求，再選擇能觀察它的層次。
本課已有缺漏不能匯出、額外欄位不進報告、輸入變更使舊結果失效。這些是具體的資料完整性與輸出邊界測試，不等於已完成所有資安測試或正式風險評估。

sections.heading: 像檢查門禁，也確認不該放行的情況
paragraphs: 只測持證者能進門，不能證明失效證件或無權訪客會被拒絕。拒絕的條件、發生位置及留下的結果都需要明確。
軟體的畫面隱藏按鈕只限制一條操作路徑，資料或匯出函式也要驗證。多人授權則必須有真實身分與資源關係，不能用畫面上的 A、B 文字假裝已建立隔離。

sections.heading: 把風險轉成可執行案例
paragraphs: 缺漏直接呼叫 export_report 應拋出 ValueError；額外欄位輸入後，下載 data 仍只含三個允許鍵；完整後清空欄位，成功與下載應消失。
下表最後一列是多人版的候選驗收。單人原型沒有帳號與資料庫，先記未實作，不能執行一份與系統無關的假授權函式就宣告通過。

sections.heading: 修正後驗原案例，也驗原有功能
paragraphs: 若負向案例失敗，先保留重現條件與觀察，定位根因後做最小修正。重跑原失敗案例，再跑受影響的正常與負向情境，確認修正沒有讓有效報告也無法產生。
回歸證據要包含相同版本、環境與案例。只寫「已修復」或只提供一張成功截圖，無法確認原錯誤是否消失；缺少測試時，先補可失敗的斷言。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜負向案例的回歸鏈
blocks.description: 從要求到修正再驗證，未涵蓋控制維持獨立待辦。

items.title: 要求與風險
items.body: 指出何種資料或操作應被拒絕。

items.title: 可重現失敗
items.body: 保存輸入、動作、預期及實際結果。

items.title: 局部修正
items.body: 處理根因，保留其他工作。

items.title: 回歸證據
items.body: 原案例通過，再驗受影響正反情境。

sections.heading: 多人授權的測試必須等控制真的存在
paragraphs: 未來若擴為十人使用，需先定義身分、角色、資料所有權與共享例外，再在資料存取處檢查授權。負向測試要使用真實測試身分及隔離合成資料，驗證 A 不能讀到未授權的 B 資料。
這是另外的需求與架構工作，不在本機單人原型內偷加。先記下候選 Given／When／Then、實作負責人與驗收範圍；目前狀態保持未實作、未驗證。

blocks.heading: 多人版候選驗收
paragraphs: 放入待確認需求，不宣稱已執行或正式單位規定。

Given 測試使用者 A 已驗證身分，且未獲授權讀取 B 的合成紀錄
When A 透過資料存取入口請求該紀錄
Then 系統拒絕且不回傳紀錄內容
狀態：本機原型未實作此控制，待多人版確認及驗證

sections.heading: 保留可交接的限制與下一步
paragraphs: 將測試命令、結果、失敗與修正連結到 spec；另外列出尚未實作的身分、授權、持久儲存及組織部署需求。它們不會因完整性測試通過而自動完成。
M09 會把這些證據放入 README、版本與展示。你應能說明目前原型已保護哪些行為，也能明確指出哪些要求仍需下一個設計與實作階段。

exercise.environment: 第三切片與測試、spec.md、驗證紀錄，以及多人版尚未實作事項。
steps: 執行缺漏匯出、額外欄位與完整後變更三類負向情境，保留真實結果。
選一個失敗案例，若有則定位、修正並重跑原案例及受影響測試；沒有則如實記錄通過範圍。
寫一條未授權讀取的候選驗收，標明本原型未實作，不填假通過。
exercise.expected: 一份風險—案例—結果對照及獨立的未實作安全需求清單。
exercise.check: 可測拒絕有實際證據；多人授權保持未實作，沒有以 UI 隱藏或假函式替代控制。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Verify invalid input, extra fields and stale results through negative cases, separating tested prototype behavior from unimplemented multiuser security.
objectives: Derive negative scenarios from requirements and risks.
Record rejection, repair and regression evidence.
List absent authorization explicitly as not implemented and unverified.

readingGuide.goal: Derive negative scenarios from requirements and risks.
readingGuide.startingPoint: The third slice and tests, spec.md, verification records and unimplemented shared-version requirements.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A risk–case–result mapping with a separate list of unimplemented security requirements.

sections.heading: Check When the System Must Reject
paragraphs: A positive case shows one valid record completing a task. Negative cases check rejection of input or actions that should not be accepted, without producing an incorrect result. Identify the protected requirement before selecting an observation layer.

This course already rejects incomplete exports, excludes extra report fields and invalidates old results on input change. These specific integrity/output-boundary tests do not establish completion of all security testing or a formal risk assessment.

sections.heading: Test Access That Should Be Denied Too
paragraphs: A valid pass opening a door does not establish rejection of expired passes or unauthorized visitors. Define denial conditions, enforcement locations and observable outcomes.

Hiding a button restricts one interface path; data/export functions need validation too. Multiuser authorization needs actual identities and resource relationships. Displaying A/B labels does not implement isolation.

sections.heading: Turn Risks into Executable Cases
paragraphs: A direct export_report call with missing data must raise ValueError. Extra input fields must not expand the three allowlisted data keys. After a complete record’s required field is cleared, success and download must disappear.

The final table row is candidate acceptance for a shared version. The single-user prototype has no accounts or database: record that control as unimplemented. An unrelated fake authorization function cannot establish its success.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Verifiable Prototype Behavior and Pending Shared Controls
rows: Blank, wrong-type or overlong export input
Reject a complete report.
Rule exception tests.
Input includes extra debug_note
Exclude the extra key from the report.
JSON and allowlisted-field checks.
Clear a required field after completion
Invalidate old success and download.
AppTest + real browser.
A requests B’s data without permission
Reject at data access without returning content.
Unimplemented in this prototype; verify separately for a shared version.

sections.heading: Retest the Original Fault and Existing Features
paragraphs: If a negative case fails, preserve reproduction conditions and observations, locate the cause and apply a minimal repair. Rerun the original failing case and affected normal/negative scenarios, checking that valid reports still work.

Regression evidence identifies the same version, environment and cases. “Fixed” or a success screenshot alone does not establish removal of the original fault. Where coverage is missing, first add assertions that can detect failure.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Regression Evidence for a Negative Case
blocks.description: Follow requirements through repair and verification. Uncovered controls remain separate pending work.

items.title: Requirement and risk
items.body: Identify data or actions that must be rejected.

items.title: Reproducible failure
items.body: Retain input, action, expectation and actual result.

items.title: Local repair
items.body: Address the cause while preserving other work.

items.title: Regression evidence
items.body: Pass the original case, then affected positive/negative scenarios.

sections.heading: Authorization Tests Need Implemented Controls
paragraphs: A future ten-user version first needs defined identities, roles, data ownership and sharing exceptions, followed by authorization enforcement at data access. Negative tests should use actual test identities and isolated synthetic records to verify that A cannot read unauthorized B data.

That is separate requirements/architecture work, not a feature to add silently to this local single-user prototype. Record candidate Given/When/Then, an implementation owner and acceptance scope; current status remains not implemented and unverified.

blocks.heading: Candidate Shared-version Acceptance
paragraphs: Keep this among requirements awaiting confirmation, not executed findings or official policy. The unchanged scenario says: Given authenticated test user A lacks permission for B’s synthetic record, When A requests it through data access, Then deny without returning content. This local prototype has not implemented the control; shared-version confirmation and verification remain pending.
blocks.code:
Given 測試使用者 A 已驗證身分，且未獲授權讀取 B 的合成紀錄
When A 透過資料存取入口請求該紀錄
Then 系統拒絕且不回傳紀錄內容
狀態：本機原型未實作此控制，待多人版確認及驗證

sections.heading: Retain Limits and Next Steps for Handoff
paragraphs: Link test commands, results, failures and repairs to spec. Separately list absent identity, authorization, persistence and organizational-deployment needs. Completeness tests passing do not implement them.
M09 places evidence into README, versions and demonstrations. Explain both the prototype behavior already protected and requirements needing another design/implementation stage.

exercise.environment: The third slice and tests, spec.md, verification records and unimplemented shared-version requirements.
steps: Run negative scenarios for incomplete export, extra fields and input change after completeness; retain real results.
If a case fails, locate and repair it, then rerun that case and affected tests. If none fail, accurately record the passing scope.
Write candidate unauthorized-read acceptance, marking it unimplemented in this prototype without a fabricated pass.
exercise.expected: A risk–case–result mapping with a separate list of unimplemented security requirements.
exercise.check: Executable rejection claims have actual evidence. Multiuser authorization remains unimplemented; hidden UI or fake functions cannot substitute for controls.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.prompt: 額外 debug_note 不出現在報告，最直接證明什麼？
options: 全部資安風險解決
該情境的輸出欄位受到約束
多人隔離完成
所有資料已安全刪除
rationales: 範圍過度擴張。
結論與實際案例相符。
與身分授權不同。
沒有刪除證據。

en.prompt: What does debug_note being absent from a report directly establish?
options: Every security risk is resolved.
Output fields are constrained in that scenario.
Multiuser isolation is complete.
All data was securely deleted.
rationales: That exceeds the evidence.
The conclusion matches the executed case.
Identity/authorization is a different concern.
There is no deletion evidence.

zh.prompt: 本機沒有帳號與資料庫，授權測試應如何標記？
options: 預設通過
用假 A／B 文字宣告通過
未實作，記候選需求與後續驗證
不需列出此限制
rationales: 控制不存在。
無法驗證真實存取。
清楚保留能力邊界。
接手者仍需知道。

en.prompt: With no accounts or database in this prototype, how should authorization testing be recorded?
options: Assume it passed.
Declare success using A/B text labels.
Not implemented; record candidate requirements and later verification.
Omit the limitation.
rationales: The control does not exist.
That does not test actual access.
This preserves capability boundaries.
Successors still need to know.

zh.prompt: 修好負向情境後，還需做什麼？
options: 刪掉失敗證據
只看成功截圖
放寬規格
重跑原案例及受影響正反測試，保存版本與結果
rationales: 會遺失回歸依據。
不能涵蓋原錯誤。
須經明確需求決策。
確認修正與既有行為。

en.prompt: After repairing a negative scenario, what else is needed?
options: Delete failure evidence.
Inspect only a success screenshot.
Relax the specification.
Rerun the original and affected positive/negative tests, keeping versions and results.
rationales: That removes regression evidence.
That cannot cover the original fault.
That requires an explicit requirements decision.
Confirm both repair and existing behavior.

zh.summary: 用可審查的提交保存每次切片，還原時明確指定來源與路徑，保留其他尚未完成的工作。
objectives: 分辨工作區、暫存區、提交與遠端發布。
建立能對應規格的單一目的提交。
在獨立練習中局部還原並保留其他修改。

readingGuide.goal: 分辨工作區、暫存區、提交與遠端發布。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 已安裝 Git、編輯器與新建空白 git-lab/；不用真實資料或遠端。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份能對應目的的提交及局部還原紀錄，其他工作保持原樣。

sections.heading: 讓變更有理由，也有可找回的起點
paragraphs: M07 的 Diff 告訴你現在改了什麼，Git 提交（Commit）則保存暫存區的專案快照，讓下次能比較、定位及回復。每次切片先核對驗收情境，再把相關檔案放進同一個有目的的提交。
提交保存在本機，不代表已推送遠端、部署或通過驗收。這些狀態分開記錄；也不要把真實資料、金鑰或未確認可公開的內容寫進歷史。

sections.heading: 像整理一份能追溯修訂的工程紀錄
paragraphs: 工作臺上可能同時放著不同任務的材料；暫存區像本次要歸檔的清單，提交是實際封存的一版。只記一句「完成」會讓接手者難以知道它對應哪個要求。
好的提交說明指出變更目的，例如「表單切片：新增三欄及未檢核預覽」。測試與限制可在相關紀錄連結，不把無關修正一併混入。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜從修改到可追溯提交
blocks.description: 先核對範圍再保存；遠端發布與實際部署另行驗證。

items.title: 工作區
items.body: 編輯程式、測試與文件。

items.title: 審查 Diff
items.body: 核對規格及修改範圍，也查看未追蹤檔案。

items.title: 暫存指定路徑
items.body: 只加入這次準備提交的內容。

items.title: 提交快照
items.body: 記錄目的與版本，再分別處理推送及部署。

sections.heading: 先在獨立目錄練習
paragraphs: 新建並進入空白 git-lab/，不要在既有專案或包含其他工作的位置初始化。以下身分只供本機合成練習；正式專案使用自己獲准的署名設定，不修改全域設定。
用編輯器建立 slice-notes.md，內容記「切片一：三欄輸入及未檢核預覽」，再建立 keep.txt，內容記「其他工作：原始紀錄」。另建 .gitignore，排除 .venv/、__pycache__/、.pytest_cache/ 與 .env；忽略規則不會自動清除已追蹤檔案或歷史中的內容。

blocks.heading: 初始化本機練習
paragraphs: 只在剛建立的空白 git-lab/ 執行，不設定遠端，也不推送。
blocks.code:
git init
git config user.name "AASE Learner"
git config user.email "aase@example.invalid"

blocks.heading: .gitignore｜練習內容
paragraphs: 逐行放入 .gitignore；這些模式不取代提交前的內容檢查。
blocks.code:
.venv/
__pycache__/
.pytest_cache/
.env

blocks.heading: 建立基準提交
paragraphs: 確認三個檔案內容後，逐路徑暫存；不要用全目錄加入代替審查。
blocks.code:
git status --short
git add .gitignore slice-notes.md keep.txt
git diff --cached
git commit -m "建立合成切片紀錄基準"
git log -1 --oneline

sections.heading: 分清兩種差異與未追蹤檔案
paragraphs: git diff 預設看工作區相對暫存區，git diff --cached 看準備提交的內容相對 HEAD。新檔案尚未追蹤時要另看 status 及檔案內容；沒有 diff 不能推定完全沒有修改。
完成基準提交後，在 slice-notes.md 加入「誤加：完整報告已完成」，在 keep.txt 加入「其他工作：尚待完成」。查看差異，確認兩者都只在工作區，且暫存區沒有這次修改。

blocks.heading: 還原前的唯讀核對
paragraphs: 先保留現況；若有別人的或已暫存修改，先停止這個簡化練習並釐清範圍。
blocks.code:
git status --short
git diff -- slice-notes.md keep.txt
git diff --cached -- slice-notes.md keep.txt

sections.heading: 只還原已確認的路徑
paragraphs: 先用編輯器把目前 slice-notes.md 另存為 slice-notes.backup.md，確認副本可讀。以下明確從 HEAD 回復工作區的 slice-notes.md，會覆蓋該檔目前內容；keep.txt 的其他修改應保持。
這個練習以目標檔只有本次修改為前提。若同一檔案混有其他工作，先保留副本並分段處理，不整份覆蓋。還原後核對檔案及 Diff；程式檔則需重跑受影響測試。

blocks.heading: 局部回復基準
paragraphs: 僅在本篇獨立練習且已保留副本後執行。
blocks.code:
git restore --source=HEAD --worktree -- slice-notes.md
git diff -- slice-notes.md
git diff -- keep.txt
git status --short

sections.heading: 用歷史支持接手與復原
paragraphs: 將此方法帶回三次切片：每次提交對應規格、修改及測試結果，交接時提供提交識別碼。修復已公開變更時要遵循專案協作流程，不能為了整理紀錄任意重寫別人的歷史。
Git 保存的是你交給它的內容；沒有提交或另存的工作仍需保護。本機提交也不是遠端備份、權限控制或個資清理工具。下一篇把啟動、限制與復原方式整理到 README。

exercise.environment: 已安裝 Git、編輯器與新建空白 git-lab/；不用真實資料或遠端。
steps: 建立練習檔、忽略規則及基準提交，記錄提交目的。
分別修改 slice-notes.md 與 keep.txt，檢查工作區及暫存區，再保留目標副本。
只還原 slice-notes.md，核對它回到基準、keep.txt 修改與副本仍在。
exercise.expected: 一份能對應目的的提交及局部還原紀錄，其他工作保持原樣。
exercise.check: 不使用整個專案的強制重設；能指出提交、推送、部署與驗收的差別。
exercise.cleanup: 保留練習結果或自行刪除整個獨立練習目錄；不要在正常專案執行練習的覆蓋操作。

en.summary: Preserve each slice in a reviewable commit, naming recovery sources and paths explicitly while retaining other unfinished work.
objectives: Distinguish working tree, staging area, commit and remote publication.
Create a single-purpose commit traceable to a specification.
Restore a selected path in an independent lab while preserving other edits.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish working tree, staging area, commit and remote publication.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Git, an editor and a new empty git-lab/; use neither real data nor a remote.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A purpose-linked commit and selective-restoration record with other work preserved.

sections.heading: Give Changes a Reason and a Recoverable Starting Point
paragraphs: M07 diffs show current changes; a Git commit records the project snapshot prepared in the staging area for later comparison, diagnosis and recovery. Check each slice’s acceptance scenarios, then group related files into one purposeful commit.
A local commit does not establish remote push, deployment or acceptance. Record those statuses separately and keep real data, keys and unapproved public material out of history.

sections.heading: Maintain a Traceable Engineering Record
paragraphs: A workbench may hold material for different tasks. The staging area resembles the selected material to archive now; a commit records that version. “Done” alone does not explain the requirement it serves.
A useful message states purpose, such as “Form slice: add three fields and an unvalidated preview.” Link relevant tests and limits without mixing unrelated repairs into that commit.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | From Edits to a Traceable Commit
blocks.description: Review scope before recording it. Verify remote publication and actual deployment separately.

items.title: Working tree
items.body: Edit code, tests and documents.

items.title: Review the diff
items.body: Check specification/scope and inspect untracked files too.

items.title: Stage selected paths
items.body: Include only content ready for this commit.

items.title: Commit the snapshot
items.body: Record purpose and version, then handle push and deployment separately.

sections.heading: Practice in a Separate Directory First
paragraphs: Create and enter an empty git-lab/, preserving existing projects and other work. The identity below is for this local synthetic exercise only; use authorized authorship in real projects and leave global configuration unchanged.

Create slice-notes.md with “切片一：三欄輸入及未檢核預覽” (slice one: three fields and unvalidated preview), and keep.txt with “其他工作：原始紀錄” (other work: original note). Add .gitignore entries for .venv/, __pycache__/, .pytest_cache/ and .env. Ignore rules do not remove already tracked files or historical content.

blocks.heading: Initialize the Local Lab
paragraphs: Run only in the new empty git-lab/, without configuring a remote or pushing.
blocks.code:
git init
git config user.name "AASE Learner"
git config user.email "aase@example.invalid"

blocks.heading: .gitignore | Exercise Contents
paragraphs: Put these patterns on separate lines. They do not replace pre-commit content inspection.
blocks.code:
.venv/
__pycache__/
.pytest_cache/
.env

blocks.heading: Create a Baseline Commit
paragraphs: Inspect the three files, then stage explicit paths. The retained Chinese commit message means “create synthetic slice-record baseline.”
blocks.code:
git status --short
git add .gitignore slice-notes.md keep.txt
git diff --cached
git commit -m "建立合成切片紀錄基準"
git log -1 --oneline

sections.heading: Distinguish Both Diffs and Untracked Files
paragraphs: git diff compares the working tree with staging by default; git diff --cached compares staged content with HEAD. Inspect status and contents for untracked files. An empty diff does not establish that nothing changed anywhere.

After the baseline, append “誤加：完整報告已完成” (mistaken claim: complete report finished) to slice-notes.md and “其他工作：尚待完成” (other work: pending) to keep.txt. Check that both edits are in the working tree only, with neither staged.

blocks.heading: Read-only Checks Before Restoration
paragraphs: Preserve current state. If another person’s work or staged edits are present, stop this simplified exercise and establish scope first.
blocks.code:
git status --short
git diff -- slice-notes.md keep.txt
git diff --cached -- slice-notes.md keep.txt

sections.heading: Restore Only the Confirmed Path
paragraphs: First save the current slice-notes.md as readable slice-notes.backup.md. The command explicitly restores the working-tree slice-notes.md from HEAD, overwriting its current contents. Other edits in keep.txt must remain.

This exercise assumes the target contains only this task’s edit. For mixed work, preserve a copy and recover selected sections instead of overwriting the whole file. Check files and diffs afterward, rerunning affected tests for program changes.

blocks.heading: Recover the Baseline Selectively
paragraphs: Use only in this independent lab after saving the backup.
blocks.code:
git restore --source=HEAD --worktree -- slice-notes.md
git diff -- slice-notes.md
git diff -- keep.txt
git status --short

sections.heading: Use History for Handoff and Recovery
paragraphs: Apply the method to the three slices: connect each commit to requirements, changes and test results, and give successors its identifier. Follow project collaboration rules for published changes; preserve other people’s history rather than rewriting it for tidiness.

Git preserves content entrusted to it. Protect uncommitted or unsaved work separately. A local commit is neither a remote backup, permission control nor personal-data cleanup tool. The next lesson records startup, limits and recovery in README.

exercise.environment: Git, an editor and a new empty git-lab/; use neither real data nor a remote.
steps: Create the exercise files, ignore rules and baseline commit; record its purpose.
Edit slice-notes.md and keep.txt, inspect working/staged differences and save the target backup.
Restore only slice-notes.md; verify its baseline, retained keep.txt edit and preserved backup.
exercise.expected: A purpose-linked commit and selective-restoration record with other work preserved.
exercise.check: Use no whole-project forced reset. Distinguish commit, push, deployment and acceptance.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the lab results or delete only the independent lab directory; do not perform the exercise’s overwrite operations in a normal project.

zh.prompt: Commit 最直接保存什麼？
options: 所有未追蹤檔案
暫存區準備的專案快照
正式部署狀態
全部使用者的驗收
rationales: 未加入者不會自動進入。
需先核對暫存內容。
提交與部署分開。
需要各自證據。

en.prompt: What does a commit most directly record?
options: Every untracked file.
The project snapshot prepared in staging.
Production deployment status.
Acceptance by every user.
rationales: Files not added are not included automatically.
Inspect staged content first.
Commit and deployment are separate.
Those need their own evidence.

zh.prompt: 目標檔混有其他工作，還原前應怎麼做？
options: 直接整份覆蓋
先保留現況並釐清或分段回復
刪掉其他人的內容
只改提交訊息
rationales: 可能遺失工作。
確認來源、路徑與保留範圍。
未獲授權。
無法回復檔案內容。

en.prompt: The target file contains other work. What should precede restoration?
options: Overwrite it immediately.
Preserve current state and clarify scope or recover selected sections.
Delete the other person’s content.
Change only the commit message.
rationales: That may lose work.
Identify source, paths and what must remain.
That is unauthorized.
That does not restore file content.

zh.prompt: 加上 .gitignore 就能清除歷史秘密嗎？
options: 能，會刪除所有歷史
能，推送就完成
不能，仍需檢查已追蹤內容與依事件處理
不能，所以不用審查
rationales: 忽略不改既有歷史。
推送也不會自動清除。
需針對實際暴露採取措施。
更需要提交前核對。

en.prompt: Does adding .gitignore remove historical secrets?
options: Yes; all history is deleted.
Yes; pushing completes cleanup.
No; inspect tracked content and respond to the actual exposure.
No; therefore review is unnecessary.
rationales: Ignoring does not change existing history.
Push does not remove it automatically.
Address the actual exposure separately.
Pre-commit review is still necessary.

zh.summary: 讓接手者依 README 找到入口、重建環境、完成驗收，也清楚知道原型的限制與停止方式。
objectives: 寫出可操作的環境、命令與驗收說明。
區分預期結果、作者實測與接手者重現。
把限制、復原與清理方式納入交接。

readingGuide.goal: 寫出可操作的環境、命令與驗收說明。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 指定版本的工作坊或學員專案、新目錄與獨立環境；有同儕時使用其自有環境。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: README.md 與重現紀錄能讓接手者知道如何啟動、驗收及收工。

sections.heading: 以第一次接手的人為讀者
paragraphs: README 是專案入口。接手者應能知道這份程式幫誰做什麼、從哪個目錄啟動、需要哪些版本及如何判斷結果。只寫「執行 app.py」會漏掉環境、路徑與操作情境。
README 的命令必須對應交付檔案。若學員 app.py 在專案根目錄，就改成實際路徑；不要原樣貼上教師 reference/ 命令卻交付不同結構。

sections.heading: 像把工具與可照做的使用說明一起交出
paragraphs: 工具放進箱子還不夠，接手者需要知道接線、啟動、正常狀態與收工方式。說明若只記製作者當時的習慣，另一個人仍得重新猜測。
軟體交接也要保留前置條件與結果邊界。作者自己能啟動、另一個乾淨環境能重建、同儕能獨立使用，是不同證據，不互相替代。

sections.heading: 對照工作坊的完整 README 範例
paragraphs: 以下以整個工作坊解壓根目錄為起點，示範如何啟動教師參考解答。學員交接自己的專案時，保留這些資訊類別，改成自己實際檔案及已確認需求。
這裡列的是預期行為與操作方法，沒有替你填入尚未執行的結果。requirements.txt 固定直接套件版本，不代表所有平台及間接依賴已驗證。

blocks.heading: README.md｜工作坊重現範例
paragraphs: 命令逐條執行；Windows 啟用方式另依說明，未經實測的平台保留待驗。
blocks.code:
# 合成收件資料完整性檢核｜工作坊重現範例

## 用途與範圍
本機單人、只用合成資料；檢查申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型。
去除首尾空白後為 1–80 字元。完整僅代表教學欄位，不代表正式受理。
沒有登入、多人授權、持久資料庫、外部 API 或正式部署。

## 環境與檔案
Python 3.11／3.12；依 requirements.txt 安裝固定直接依賴。
Streamlit 1.51.0、pytest 8.4.2；未宣稱所有間接依賴鎖定。
在解壓根目錄可見 requirements.txt、starter/、slices/、reference/。

## 建立環境（POSIX shell，從解壓根目錄）
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python --version
python -m streamlit version
python -m pytest --version

## 測試及啟動參考解答
cd reference
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1
瀏覽器開啟終端機顯示的本機網址；Ctrl+C 停止服務。
Windows PowerShell 從解壓根目錄啟用的命令為 .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1；依既有政策操作。

## 最小操作驗收
填 SYN-001、DEMO-A，文件類型空白時按檢查：提示缺漏，無完整下載。
補上「合成申請表」再檢查：可預覽及下載 JSON。
清空文件類型並提交變更：舊成功與下載失效，補值後需重查。
讀取下載檔，核對三欄、status、scope 與中文內容。

## 結果、限制與清理
另記實際日期、平台、版本、命令、退出結果與尚未執行項目。
AppTest 不取代真實瀏覽器下載或真人任務觀察。
下載檔在操作者裝置，關閉頁面不代表已刪除。
結束後停止本次服務，依需要保留或刪除合成下載。
多人版需先確認身分、授權、儲存與維運要求，再設計及驗證。

sections.heading: 乾淨環境用來找出隱藏前提
paragraphs: 請另一位同儕取得指定提交或同一版資源包，在新目錄建立自己的虛擬環境，依 README 執行，不複製作者現有 .venv。記錄需要補問或自行猜測的地方，再修正文件。
沒有同儕時，可先由作者在獨立目錄重建，找出漏掉的依賴與路徑；把結果標成作者重建，仍保留真人交接待驗，不能代填別人的通過。

sections.heading: 限制要能指向下一個決策
paragraphs: 寫明單人本機、合成資料、沒有登入與多人授權、沒有持久資料庫或正式部署。若要十人共用，下一步先確認資料存取、保存、備份與維運，不只換一個啟動位址。
出錯時說明先停止哪個服務、保存哪些紀錄與如何回到已知版本；下載檔在裝置上另行管理。不要宣稱關閉網頁就安全刪除所有資料。

sections.heading: 用實際重現修正文件
paragraphs: 若接手者遇到 import 錯誤，先確認工作目錄、環境與檔案是否齊全；不要要求對方降低系統政策或安裝與任務無關的套件來掩蓋問題。
交接後每次改動入口、依賴、規則或輸出，連同 README 與驗收紀錄更新。下一篇以這些作品組織成果展示，讓每一個完成主張都能回到證據。

補齊限制、停止與復原資訊；分開標記作者重建與真人交接。

readingGuide.goal: Write actionable environment, command and acceptance instructions.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A specified workshop/project version, a new directory and separate environment; a peer uses their own environment when available.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: README.md and reproduction records explaining startup, acceptance and shutdown.

sections.heading: Write for Someone Taking Over for the First Time
paragraphs: README is the project entry point. Successors need purpose, users, starting directory, versions and observable outcomes. “Run app.py” omits environment, paths and task scenarios.
Commands must match delivered files. If your app.py is at project root, use that path; do not copy teacher reference/ commands while delivering a different structure.

sections.heading: Deliver the Tool with Instructions People Can Follow
paragraphs: Putting a tool in a box is insufficient: the recipient needs connections, startup, normal status and shutdown instructions. Notes covering only the maker’s habits leave others guessing.
Software handoff also preserves prerequisites and result limits. Author startup, rebuilding in a clean environment and independent peer operation are distinct evidence.

items.title: Accept

items.title: Hand over
items.body: Limits, recovery, shutdown and cleanup.

sections.heading: A Complete README Example for the Workshop
paragraphs: The example starts from the extracted workshop root and runs the teacher reference. When handing over your own project, retain these information categories but substitute actual files and confirmed requirements.
These are instructions and expected behavior, not prefilled execution results. requirements.txt pins direct packages without establishing every platform or transitive dependency.

blocks.heading: README.md | Workshop Reproduction Example
paragraphs: Execute commands individually; follow the separate Windows activation instructions and leave untested platforms pending. The unchanged Traditional Chinese example covers local single-user synthetic input, three trimmed 1–80-character fields and no official acceptance; absent login/multiuser/database/API/deployment; Python 3.11/3.12 with Streamlit 1.51.0/pytest 8.4.2; root directories; a new venv and installation; reference tests/startup and Ctrl+C; omission, correction, change invalidation and JSON inspection; actual version/result records, separate human checks, device downloads and future shared-version decisions.

sections.heading: Use a Clean Environment to Reveal Hidden Assumptions
paragraphs: Ask a peer to obtain the specified commit or resource-package version, create a new environment and follow README without copying the author’s .venv. Record questions and guesses, then improve the instructions.

Without a peer, the author can rebuild in another directory to find missing dependencies or paths. Label it author reproduction and keep human handoff pending; do not substitute it for someone else’s result.

sections.heading: Make Each Limitation Point to a Decision
paragraphs: State local single-user execution, synthetic data, absent login/multiuser authorization, no persistent database and no production deployment. For ten users, first address access, retention, backup and operations rather than only changing the bind address.

Explain which service to stop on failure, which records to retain and how to recover a known version. Downloaded files are managed separately on the device; closing the page does not securely erase all data.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Separate These Handoff Fields
rows: Expected behavior
Inputs that should succeed or be rejected.
Author checks
Actual platform, versions, commands and results.
Successor reproduction
Who followed the instructions in which environment, with any assistance.
Limits and pending checks
Unimplemented controls and unmeasured scenarios.
Shutdown and recovery
Service shutdown, retained files and recoverable version.

sections.heading: Improve Instructions Through Actual Reproduction
paragraphs: For import errors, check working directory, environment and complete files first. Do not ask recipients to lower system policy or install unrelated packages to hide problems.
After handoff, update README and acceptance records whenever entry points, dependencies, rules or output change. The next lesson uses these artifacts to connect demonstration claims to evidence.

exercise.environment: A specified workshop/project version, a new directory and separate environment; a peer uses their own environment when available.
steps: Adapt README so paths and dependencies match actual delivery.
Rebuild, test and start in a new directory; perform omission, correction and change acceptance and record assistance needed.
Complete limitations, shutdown and recovery information, separating author reproduction from human handoff.
exercise.expected: README.md and reproduction records explaining startup, acceptance and shutdown.
exercise.check: Copy no existing virtual environment. Expected output or author reproduction is not peer execution.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

readingGuide.goal: 建立需求到作品與驗收的追溯。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的完整作品、指定提交、測試與重現紀錄，以及教師指南六題。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 展示紀錄能將每項完成主張連到作品、提交與真實證據。

sections.heading: 展示一個可以被追問的工程成果
paragraphs: 成果展示要回答使用者的哪個問題被改善、系統如何做到，以及憑什麼相信它符合規格。漂亮截圖可幫助定位畫面，但無法取代程式版本、測試及實際操作。
選同一筆合成資料串起 problem.md、wireframe.svg、spec.md、architecture.md、app.py、tests/、README.md 與 Git 紀錄；不要每份作品換一個案例，讓追溯斷開。

sections.heading: 像帶人沿著工程紀錄走到現場
paragraphs: 先說明要解決的問題，再看設計與施工依據，最後到現場驗證關鍵行為。現場看起來能動，仍要確認與原先約定相符。
軟體展示也保留同一條線：要求、決策、修改及證據。遇到尚未完成的部分，說明差距與下一步，讓接手者知道可以使用的範圍。

sections.heading: 先準備一張需求追溯表
paragraphs: 以「缺漏不得產生完整報告」為例：problem 說明交接前的缺漏風險，wireframe 呈現修正方式，spec 定義負向情境，rules.py 拒絕匯出，AppTest 及瀏覽器確認提示與下載狀態。
表內記實際檔名、測試名稱與提交，結果欄只填本次已執行的觀察。規格文件中的預期不是測試結果；教師參考答案也不是學員作品完成證明。

sections.heading: 用三種情境展示關鍵行為
paragraphs: 第一段保留文件類型空白，說明缺漏提示與為何不能下載完整報告；第二段補齊並檢查，核對下載 JSON；第三段清空欄位，確認舊成功與下載失效。
若現場操作失敗，保存實際狀態並指出待修，不切換預錄畫面後宣稱已通過。可以補充先前紀錄，但要標明版本與觀察時間，不能混成當次結果。

sections.heading: 用六題整合評量檢查是否串得起來
paragraphs: 教師指南六題分別檢查需求、Agent、人機互動、規格與架構、實作與驗證、交接治理。回答時指出作品與理由，不能只背術語；多人版問題要說明原型未實作哪些控制。
每題依「具體可操作、作品可追溯、限制與下一步」評閱。尚無真人作答時保留未評量，不能由答案已公開推定學員理解。

blocks.heading: 展示前核對
paragraphs: 用自己的真實資料位置填寫，仍只使用合成案例。
blocks.code:

曾失敗、修正及回歸證據：

en.summary: Connect requirements, design, specification, code and tests through one task, demonstrating completed behavior, repair evidence and pending work.
objectives: Trace requirements to artifacts and acceptance.
Demonstrate normal, negative and stale-result scenarios.
Explain tradeoffs and limits through the six integrated assessment questions.

readingGuide.goal: Trace requirements to artifacts and acceptance.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your complete artifacts, specified commit, test/reproduction records and the six questions in the instructor guide.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A demonstration record linking each completion claim to artifacts, commits and actual evidence.

sections.heading: Present Work That Can Be Examined
paragraphs: A demonstration explains the user problem improved, how the system addresses it and why its behavior meets spec. Screenshots can locate an interface but cannot replace versions, tests and actual operations.
Use one synthetic record across problem.md, wireframe.svg, spec.md, architecture.md, app.py, tests/, README.md and Git history. Changing cases between artifacts breaks traceability.

sections.heading: Follow the Engineering Record to the Site
paragraphs: Explain the problem, inspect design/construction commitments, then verify key behavior on site. An apparently working installation still needs comparison with the agreement.
Software demonstrations likewise connect requirements, decisions, changes and evidence. Identify gaps and next steps so successors understand the usable scope.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | From Problem to Verifiable Results
blocks.description: Each node links to artifacts, with the same scenario throughout.

items.title: Problem and design
items.body: Who has the problem, and how actions/states are arranged.

items.title: Specification and architecture
items.body: Required conditions and processing locations.

items.title: Implementation and verification
items.body: Commits, diffs, rules and interface evidence.

items.title: Delivery and limits
items.body: README reproduction, absent features and next steps.

sections.heading: Prepare a Requirements-traceability Record
paragraphs: For incomplete data not producing complete reports, problem describes omission risk before handoff, wireframe shows correction, spec defines negative scenarios, rules.py rejects export, and AppTest/browser checks examine feedback and download state.

Record actual filenames, test names and commits. Fill results only from this execution: specification expectations are not test outcomes, and the teacher solution does not establish a learner’s completed work.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Demonstration Traceability Fields
rows: Find omissions before handoff
problem.md, wireframe.svg
Problem assumptions and task observations.
Incomplete data cannot export as complete
spec.md, rules.py
Expected ValueError and negative interface tests.
Changed input invalidates old results
app.py snapshot/invalidation conditions
AppTest and real-browser replay.
Another person can restart the app
README.md, specified commit
Clean-environment and peer reproduction recorded separately.

sections.heading: Demonstrate Three Key Scenarios
paragraphs: First leave document type blank and explain omission feedback and unavailable complete download. Next fill and check it, inspecting downloaded JSON. Finally clear the field and verify old success/download invalidation.

If live operation fails, retain its state and needed repair. Do not switch to prerecorded footage and call the live trial passed. Earlier records can supplement the demonstration with explicit versions and observation times.

sections.heading: Connect the Course Through Six Integrated Questions
paragraphs: The instructor guide’s questions cover requirements, Agents, HCI, specification/architecture, implementation/verification and handoff/governance. Cite artifacts and reasons rather than terminology alone. For multiuser questions, identify controls absent from the prototype.
Assess specificity, traceable artifacts, limits and next steps for each answer. With no actual learner response, keep assessment unperformed; published answers do not establish understanding.

blocks.heading: Pre-demonstration Checklist
paragraphs: Use actual artifact locations with synthetic cases only. The unchanged Traditional Chinese template records version/commit, problem/scope, normal/omission/stale-result operations, spec/test results, failures/repairs/regressions, README reproduction and absent/unverified work with next steps.

指定版本／提交：

曾失敗、修正及回歸證據：
README 重現方式：
未實作／未驗與下一步：

sections.heading: Turn Results into an Explicit Handoff Decision
paragraphs: Consistent artifacts and acceptance can support acceptance as a local teaching prototype. A ten-user request separately requires identity, authorization, retention and deployment work; prototype demonstration does not satisfy those automatically.
Retain accepted scope, repairs and owners. The course concludes with traceable, reproducible results, without treating one demonstration as verification of every business or user scenario.

exercise.environment: Your complete artifacts, specified commit, test/reproduction records and the six questions in the instructor guide.
steps: Choose a requirement and trace problem, design, specification, implementation and acceptance.
Operate omission, correction and input-change scenarios, inspecting actual JSON and limitations.
Use the six questions to explain artifacts and reasons; record accepted scope, repairs and unverified work.
exercise.expected: A demonstration record linking each completion claim to artifacts, commits and actual evidence.
exercise.check: Include negative scenarios and limits. Without human demonstration or assessment, do not fill in a pass.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.summary: 更換工具時保留已確認需求、權限與驗收契約，依變更影響規劃回歸，不用品牌或版本代替工程判斷。
objectives: 區分可替換工具與需要持續維持的責任。
說明 Agent、框架及多人需求改變的不同影響。
為遷移設定驗收與復原條件。

readingGuide.goal: 區分可替換工具與需要持續維持的責任。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 既有作品與測試紀錄，選擇一項假設的工具替換；本練習不必安裝新產品或使用真實資料。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份有範圍、驗收及復原條件的遷移計畫，不假裝新工具已通過實測。

sections.heading: 工具會變，判斷依據要能帶走
paragraphs: 模型、Coding Agent、框架及套件持續變動。換工具前先說明想改善什麼，以及哪些既有行為必須保持；單靠新版本名稱，無法判斷是否值得遷移。
本課長期保留的是問題定義、使用者任務、規格、資料與權限邊界、可核對驗證及交接。工具能協助執行，需求與接受結果仍要有明確負責人。

sections.heading: 像換一組施工工具，仍需遵守圖面與驗收
paragraphs: 更換工具可能提高效率，也可能需要新的操作與安全條件。不能因工具更新，就自行改掉尺寸、用途或責任範圍。
軟體遷移同樣先看變更影響。換 Agent 主要改開發流程，換 UI 框架可能改執行與部署，從單人到多人則新增身分與資料治理需求；三者不能當成同一種更新。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜工具變更下的共同責任
blocks.description: 平行卡片是同時需要維持的契約，不是以新工具取代前一項。

items.title: 問題與使用者
items.body: 仍要知道誰需要何種結果。

items.title: 規格與邊界
items.body: 保留驗收、資料、權限與不做事項。

items.title: 驗證與復原
items.body: 檢查受影響行為，保存可回復版本。

items.title: 交接與負責人
items.body: 更新環境、操作、限制與決策紀錄。

sections.heading: 依替換範圍選擇回歸
paragraphs: 若替換 Coding Agent，要確認新工具能讀取正確來源、受允許路徑與工具限制、產生可審查 Diff，並留下實際命令結果。程式若未變，也不能聲稱新 Agent 已完成實作驗收。
若改 UI 框架，規則函式可能仍可沿用，但畫面狀態、輸入提交、下載、鍵盤、依賴與部署方式都需要重新核對。不要僅跑原規則測試就宣布遷移完成。

資料完整性及既有任務

sections.heading: 先定義遷移驗收與復原點
paragraphs: 保留目前可用提交與測試結果，在獨立副本或分支逐項替換。為這次變更列出代表任務、負向案例、通過條件及停止條件，再觀察實際差異。
若權限需求不清、輸出契約改變或核心任務無法完成，先保存證據並停在該範圍，不把未決要求交給 Agent 自行補完。需要復原時依明確來源與路徑處理，保留其他工作。

sections.heading: 用風險與證據安排人類決策
paragraphs: NIST AI RMF 提供自願使用的風險管理框架，協助組織把責任與風險考量帶進 AI 系統設計、使用與評估；引用框架不代表已通過認證或符合所有正式規定。
本課將責任落在具體問題：誰確認業務規則？誰能授權工具？誰接受目前版本？誰處理資料與後續維運？寫明負責角色、依據與未決項目，避免把模型回覆當成責任移轉。

sections.heading: 沿著同一條路線持續改善
paragraphs: 保留使用者回饋與實際錯誤，從一個可觀察問題開始下一輪：重新確認需求、調整設計與規格、小步修改、驗證並交接。不要為了追逐新工具，無限重啟已延後的功能。
完成這個系列後，應能拿出問題、設計、規格、架構、可執行原型、測試、README 與 Git 證據，也能說明哪些仍未實作或未驗。這份責任與方法可以帶到其他合成產業案例，正式導入仍依實際需求驗證。

exercise.environment: 既有作品與測試紀錄，選擇一項假設的工具替換；本練習不必安裝新產品或使用真實資料。
steps: 寫下替換目的、維持不變的契約，以及會影響哪些執行層次。
列出代表任務、負向案例、權限與環境檢查，以及停止及復原條件。
標記目前是遷移計畫、已執行或已驗收；沒有執行就保留未執行。
exercise.expected: 一份有範圍、驗收及復原條件的遷移計畫，不假裝新工具已通過實測。
exercise.check: 不同變更對應不同回歸；保留人類負責角色與原型限制。
exercise.cleanup: 保留計畫與未決項目，不因本篇閱讀而自動安裝、付費或部署新服務。

en.summary: When replacing tools, preserve confirmed requirements, permissions and acceptance contracts, choosing regression checks by impact rather than brand or version.
objectives: Distinguish replaceable tools from continuing responsibilities.
Explain different impacts of Agent, framework and multiuser changes.
Define migration acceptance and recovery conditions.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish replaceable tools from continuing responsibilities.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Existing artifacts/tests and one hypothetical tool replacement; no new product installation or real data is required.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A scoped migration plan with acceptance and recovery conditions, without claiming an untested tool passed.

sections.heading: Carry Decision Criteria Across Tool Changes
paragraphs: Models, Coding Agents, frameworks and packages change. Identify the intended improvement and behavior to preserve before switching. A new version name alone does not establish the value of migration.

The course’s durable responsibilities are problem definition, user tasks, specifications, data/permission boundaries, verifiable evidence and handoff. Tools help execute work; requirements and acceptance still need named human owners.

sections.heading: New Construction Tools Still Follow Plans and Inspection
paragraphs: Replacement tools may improve efficiency or introduce operating/safety conditions. They do not authorize changes to agreed dimensions, purpose or responsibility.

Software migrations likewise depend on impact. Agent replacement mainly changes development work, a UI framework may change runtime/deployment, and moving to multiple users adds identity/data governance. These are different changes.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Responsibilities Across Tool Changes
blocks.description: These parallel contracts remain together; a new tool does not replace an earlier responsibility.

items.title: Problem and users
items.body: Know who needs which outcome.

items.title: Specification and boundaries
items.body: Retain acceptance, data, permissions and exclusions.

items.title: Verification and recovery
items.body: Check affected behavior and keep a recoverable version.

items.title: Handoff and owners
items.body: Update environments, operations, limits and decisions.

sections.heading: Select Regression Checks for the Replacement Scope
paragraphs: For a replacement Coding Agent, check source access, allowed paths/tools, reviewable diffs and actual command reports. Unchanged code alone does not establish that the new Agent completed an implementation task.

For a UI-framework migration, rule functions may remain reusable, but state, committed input, downloads, keyboard behavior, dependencies and deployment all need review. Passing old rule tests alone does not establish completed migration.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Different Changes Need Different Acceptance
rows: Replace the Coding Agent
Specifications, allowed scope and evidence.
Source reading, permissions, changes and reports.
Replace the UI framework
Rules, interactions and output.
State, keyboard, downloads, environment and deployment.
Move from one user to many
Integrity and existing tasks.
Identity, authorization at each data access, storage and governance.

sections.heading: Define Acceptance and a Recovery Point First
paragraphs: Keep the current working commit and test results, then replace parts in a separate copy or branch. Define representative tasks, negative cases, pass criteria and stop conditions before observing actual differences.

If permissions are unclear, outputs change or a core task fails, retain evidence and stop the affected scope rather than letting an Agent invent requirements. Recover from explicit sources/paths while preserving other work.

sections.heading: Place Human Decisions Around Risk and Evidence
paragraphs: NIST AI RMF is a voluntary risk-management framework supporting responsibility and risk considerations in AI-system design, use and evaluation. Referencing it establishes neither certification nor compliance with every formal rule.

Make responsibility concrete: who confirms business rules, authorizes tools, accepts this version and manages data/operations? Record roles, evidence and unresolved matters; model responses do not transfer responsibility.

sections.heading: Continue Along the Same Improvement Route
paragraphs: Retain user feedback and actual errors. Begin another cycle from an observable problem: reconfirm needs, adjust design/specification, change incrementally, verify and hand over. Do not endlessly reactivate deferred features to chase new tools.

After this series, learners should be able to present problem, design, specification, architecture, runnable prototype, tests, README and Git evidence, explaining what remains absent or unverified. The method transfers to other synthetic industry cases; formal adoption still needs context-specific verification.

exercise.environment: Existing artifacts/tests and one hypothetical tool replacement; no new product installation or real data is required.
steps: State the replacement goal, contracts to preserve and affected execution layers.
List representative tasks, negative cases, permission/environment checks and stop/recovery conditions.
Mark whether work is a plan, executed change or accepted result; preserve unexecuted status when nothing ran.
exercise.expected: A scoped migration plan with acceptance and recovery conditions, without claiming an untested tool passed.
exercise.check: Match regression scope to the change; retain human owners and prototype limits.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the plan and open decisions. Reading this lesson does not trigger installation, payment or deployment.
